theorem card_nbExtend {x : V} {s : Σ v : V, G.Walk x v} (hnn : ¬ s.2.Nil) :
    (nbExtend G x s).card = G.degree s.1 - 1

name: ACMax.mem_nbAll
statement:
theorem mem_nbAll {k : ℕ} {t : Σ x : V, Σ v : V, G.Walk x v} :
    t ∈ nbAll (G := G) k ↔ t.2.2.length = k ∧ IsNonBacktracking t.2.2

name: ACMax.nbWalksFrom_succ_eq_biUnion
statement:
theorem nbWalksFrom_succ_eq_biUnion (x : V) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    nbWalksFrom G x (k + 1) = (nbWalksFrom G x k).biUnion (nbExtend G x)

name: ACMax.nbWeight_concat
statement:
theorem nbWeight_concat {x v t : V} (p : G.Walk x v) (hp : ¬ p.Nil) (h : G.Adj v t) :
    nbWeight (⟨t, p.concat h⟩ : Σ w : V, G.Walk x w) =
      nbWeight (⟨v, p⟩ : Σ w : V, G.Walk x w) * ((G.degree v : ℝ) - 1)⁻¹

name: ACMax.nbWeight_mk
statement:
theorem nbWeight_mk {x v : V} (p : G.Walk x v) :
    nbWeight (⟨v, p⟩ : Σ w : V, G.Walk x w) =
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 p.length, ((G.degree (p.getVert j) : ℝ) - 1)⁻¹

name: ACMax.nbWeight_one
statement: theorem nbWeight_one {x : V} {s : Σ v : V, G.Walk x v} (h : s.2.length ≤ 1) : nbWeight s = 1

name: ACMax.nbWeight_pos
statement:
theorem nbWeight_pos (hδ2 : ∀ v, 2 ≤ G.degree v) {x : V} (s : Σ v : V, G.Walk x v) :
    0 < nbWeight s

name: ACMax.pairwiseDisjoint_nbExtend
statement:
theorem pairwiseDisjoint_nbExtend (x : V) (k : ℕ) :
    Set.PairwiseDisjoint (↑(nbWalksFrom G x k)) (nbExtend G x)

name: ACMax.penultimate_of_mem_nbExtend
statement:
theorem penultimate_of_mem_nbExtend {x : V} {s s' : Σ v : V, G.Walk x v}
    (hs' : s' ∈ nbExtend G x s) : s'.2.penultimate = s.1

name: ACMax.innerLast_succ
statement:
theorem innerLast_succ {u v : V} (huv : G.Adj u v) (x : V) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ∑ s ∈ (nbWalksFrom G x (k + 1)).filter (fun s => s.1 = v ∧ s.2.penultimate = u), nbWeight s =
      (∑ s' ∈ (nbWalksFrom G x k).filter (fun s' => s'.1 = u ∧ s'.2.penultimate ≠ v), nbWeight s')
        * ((G.degree u : ℝ) - 1)⁻¹

name: ACMax.nbEndWeight_eq_degree
statement:
theorem nbEndWeight_eq_degree (hδ2 : ∀ w, 2 ≤ G.degree w) {v : V} {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    nbEndWeight (G := G) k v = (G.degree v : ℝ)

name: ACMax.nbEndWeight_eq_sum_lastWeight
statement:
theorem nbEndWeight_eq_sum_lastWeight {v : V} {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    nbEndWeight (G := G) k v = ∑ u ∈ G.neighborFinset v, nbLastWeight (G := G) k u v

name: ACMax.nbLastWeight_eq_one
statement:
theorem nbLastWeight_eq_one (hδ2 : ∀ w, 2 ≤ G.degree w) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ∀ {u v : V}, G.Adj u v → nbLastWeight (G := G) k u v = 1

name: ACMax.nbLastWeight_eq_sum
statement:
theorem nbLastWeight_eq_sum (k : ℕ) (u v : V) :
    nbLastWeight (G := G) k u v =
      ∑ x : V, ∑ s ∈ (nbWalksFrom G x k).filter (fun s => s.1 = v ∧ s.2.penultimate = u),
        nbWeight s

name: ACMax.nbLastWeight_succ_eq
statement:
theorem nbLastWeight_succ_eq {u v : V} (huv : G.Adj u v) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    nbLastWeight (G := G) (k + 1) u v =
      (∑ w ∈ G.neighborFinset u \ {v}, nbLastWeight (G := G) k w u) * ((G.degree u : ℝ) - 1)⁻¹

name: ACMax.nbWeightTotal_eq
statement:
theorem nbWeightTotal_eq (hδ2 : ∀ w, 2 ≤ G.degree w) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    nbWeightTotal (G := G) k = ∑ v : V, (G.degree v : ℝ)

name: ACMax.penultimate_of_length_one
statement:
theorem penultimate_of_length_one {x w : V} {p : G.Walk x w} (hp : p.length = 1) :
    p.penultimate = x

name: ACMax.sum_R_eq_sum
statement:
theorem sum_R_eq_sum (k : ℕ) (u v : V) :
    ∑ t ∈ (nbAll (G := G) k).filter (fun t => t.2.1 = u ∧ t.2.2.penultimate ≠ v), nbWeight t.2 =
      ∑ x : V, ∑ s ∈ (nbWalksFrom G x k).filter (fun s => s.1 = u ∧ s.2.penultimate ≠ v),
        nbWeight s

name: ACMax.sum_R_eq_sum_lastWeight
statement:
theorem sum_R_eq_sum_lastWeight {u v : V} (huv : G.Adj u v) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ∑ t ∈ (nbAll (G := G) k).filter (fun t => t.2.1 = u ∧ t.2.2.penultimate ≠ v), nbWeight t.2 =
      ∑ w ∈ G.neighborFinset u \ {v}, nbLastWeight (G := G) k w u

name: ACMax.sum_nbAll_filter
statement:
theorem sum_nbAll_filter (k : ℕ) (Q : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel Q] :
    ∑ t ∈ (nbAll (G := G) k).filter (fun t => Q t.2.1 t.2.2.penultimate), nbWeight t.2 =
      ∑ x : V, ∑ s ∈ (nbWalksFrom G x k).filter (fun s => Q s.1 s.2.penultimate), nbWeight s

name: ACMax.sum_nbExtend_ite
statement:
theorem sum_nbExtend_ite {u v : V} (huv : G.Adj u v) {x : V} {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    {s' : Σ w : V, G.Walk x w} (hs' : s' ∈ nbWalksFrom G x k) :
    (∑ s ∈ nbExtend G x s', (if s.1 = v ∧ s.2.penultimate = u then nbWeight s else 0)) =
      (if s'.1 = u ∧ s'.2.penultimate ≠ v then nbWeight s' * ((G.degree u : ℝ) - 1)⁻¹ else 0)

name: ACMax.Lambda_pos
statement: theorem Lambda_pos (hδ2 : ∀ v, 2 ≤ G.degree v) : 0 < Lambda G

name: ACMax.card_nbAll
statement: theorem card_nbAll (k : ℕ) : (nbAll (G := G) k).card = nbTotalWalks G k

name: ACMax.convexOn_deg_mul_log
statement:
theorem convexOn_deg_mul_log :
    ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici (2 : ℝ)) (fun x => x * Real.log (x - 1))

name: ACMax.fiber_entropy
statement:
theorem fiber_entropy (hδ2 : ∀ w, 2 ≤ G.degree w) {x : V} {s' : Σ v : V, G.Walk x v}
    (hnn : ¬ s'.2.Nil) :
    ∑ s ∈ nbExtend G x s', nbWeight s * Real.log (nbWeight s)⁻¹ =
      nbWeight s' * Real.log (nbWeight s')⁻¹
        + nbWeight s' * Real.log ((G.degree s'.1 : ℝ) - 1)

name: ACMax.lambda_ge
statement:
theorem lambda_ge (hδ2 : ∀ v, 2 ≤ G.degree v) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card V) :
    ((∑ v, (G.degree v : ℝ)) - Fintype.card V) / Fintype.card V ≤ Lambda G

name: ACMax.log_Lambda
statement:
theorem log_Lambda (hδ2 : ∀ v, 2 ≤ G.degree v) :
    Real.log (Lambda G)
      = (∑ v, (G.degree v : ℝ) * Real.log ((G.degree v : ℝ) - 1)) / ∑ w, (G.degree w : ℝ)

name: ACMax.nbEntropy_eq
statement:
theorem nbEntropy_eq (hδ2 : ∀ w, 2 ≤ G.degree w) {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ) :
    nbEntropy G ℓ = ((ℓ : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ v, (G.degree v : ℝ) * Real.log ((G.degree v : ℝ) - 1)

name: ACMax.nbEntropy_one
statement: theorem nbEntropy_one : nbEntropy G 1 = 0

name: ACMax.nbEntropy_succ
statement:
theorem nbEntropy_succ (hδ2 : ∀ w, 2 ≤ G.degree w) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    nbEntropy G (k + 1)
      = nbEntropy G k + ∑ v, (G.degree v : ℝ) * Real.log ((G.degree v : ℝ) - 1)

name: ACMax.nbEntropy_sumstart
statement:
theorem nbEntropy_sumstart (k : ℕ) :
    nbEntropy G k = ∑ x : V, ∑ s ∈ nbWalksFrom G x k, nbWeight s * Real.log (nbWeight s)⁻¹

name: ACMax.nbWeight_of_mem_nbExtend
statement:
theorem nbWeight_of_mem_nbExtend {x : V} {s' s : Σ v : V, G.Walk x v} (hnn : ¬ s'.2.Nil)
    (hs : s ∈ nbExtend G x s') :
    nbWeight s = nbWeight s' * ((G.degree s'.1 : ℝ) - 1)⁻¹

name: ACMax.nb_amgm
statement:
theorem nb_amgm (hδ2 : ∀ v, 2 ≤ G.degree v) [Nonempty V] {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    (∑ v, (G.degree v : ℝ)) * Real.exp (nbEntropy G k / (∑ v, (G.degree v : ℝ)))
      ≤ (nbTotalWalks G k : ℝ)

name: ACMax.nb_amgm_lambda
statement:
theorem nb_amgm_lambda (hδ2 : ∀ v, 2 ≤ G.degree v) [Nonempty V] {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ) :
    (∑ v, (G.degree v : ℝ)) * (Lambda G) ^ ((ℓ : ℝ) - 1) ≤ (nbTotalWalks G ℓ : ℝ)

name: ACMax.sum_deg_mul_log_ge
statement:
theorem sum_deg_mul_log_ge (hδ2 : ∀ v, 2 ≤ G.degree v) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card V) :
    (∑ v, (G.degree v : ℝ)) *
        Real.log (((∑ v, (G.degree v : ℝ)) - Fintype.card V) / Fintype.card V) ≤
      ∑ v, (G.degree v : ℝ) * Real.log ((G.degree v : ℝ) - 1)

name: ACMax.sum_weight_log_deg
statement:
theorem sum_weight_log_deg (hδ2 : ∀ w, 2 ≤ G.degree w) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ∑ t ∈ nbAll (G := G) k, nbWeight t.2 * Real.log ((G.degree t.2.1 : ℝ) - 1) =
      ∑ v, (G.degree v : ℝ) * Real.log ((G.degree v : ℝ) - 1)

name: ACMax.sum_cert_of_power
statement:
theorem sum_cert_of_power {t v ell : ℕ}
    (ht10 : 10 ≤ t)
    (hA : t * (v - 1) + 1 ≤ (t - 10) * (v + t))
    (hpower : (t - 9) * v ^ ell ≤ (v + 2 * t) ^ ell)
    (hv : 0 < v) :
    t * (v - 1) * v ^ ell <
      (v + t) * ((v + 2 * t) ^ ell - v ^ ell)

name: ACMax.uniform_cubic_arith
statement:
theorem uniform_cubic_arith (t v ell : ℕ)
    (ht43 : 43 ≤ t) (htv : t ≤ v) (hv122 : v ≤ 122)
    (hell5 : 5 ≤ ell) (hell10 : ell ≤ 10)
    (hlin : 5 * v + 41 ≤ 50 * ell + 3 * t) :
    3 * (t - 10) * v ^ 3 ≤
      6 * ell * t * v ^ 2 +
      6 * ell * (ell - 1) * t ^ 2 * v +
      4 * ell * (ell - 1) * (ell - 2) * t ^ 3

name: ACMax.uniform_power_certificate
statement:
theorem uniform_power_certificate (t v ell : ℕ)
    (ht43 : 43 ≤ t) (htv : t ≤ v) (hv122 : v ≤ 122)
    (hell4 : 4 ≤ ell) (hell10 : ell ≤ 10)
    (hlin : 5 * v + 41 ≤ 50 * ell + 3 * t) :
    (t - 9) * v ^ ell ≤ (v + 2 * t) ^ ell

name: ACMax.uniform_power_four
statement:
theorem uniform_power_four (t v : ℕ)
    (ht43 : 43 ≤ t) (htv : t ≤ v) (hv122 : v ≤ 122)
    (hlin : 5 * v + 41 ≤ 200 + 3 * t) :
    (t - 9) * v ^ 4 ≤ (v + 2 * t) ^ 4

name: ACMax.uniform_power_ge_five
statement:
theorem uniform_power_ge_five (t v k : ℕ)
    (ht43 : 43 ≤ t) (htv : t ≤ v) (hv122 : v ≤ 122)
    (hk2 : 2 ≤ k) (hk7 : k ≤ 7)
    (hlin : 5 * v + 41 ≤ 50 * (k + 3) + 3 * t) :
    (t - 9) * v ^ (k + 3) ≤ (v + 2 * t) ^ (k + 3)

name: ACMax.uniform_region_bounds
statement:
theorem uniform_region_bounds (n X h : ℕ)
    (hM : 10 * X + 7 * h + 186 ≤ 4 * n)
    (hHoard : 3 * X + 26 ≤ n) (hhX : h ≤ X)
    (hn48 : 48 ≤ n) (hn122 : n ≤ 122) :
    let t := n - 4 - X - 3 * h
    let v := n - h
    let ell := (2 * n - X) / 12 / 2
    43 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ v ∧ v ≤ 122 ∧ 4 ≤ ell ∧ ell ≤ 10 ∧
      5 * v + 41 ≤ 50 * ell + 3 * t

name: ACMax.ahl_ball_girth_bound
statement:
theorem ahl_ball_girth_bound (hδ2 : ∀ v, 2 ≤ G.degree v) [Nonempty V] (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ)
    (hbig : (Fintype.card V) ^ ℓ * (Fintype.card V - 1)
        < (∑ v, G.degree v) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range ℓ,
            ((∑ v, G.degree v) - Fintype.card V) ^ k * (Fintype.card V) ^ (ℓ - 1 - k)) :
    ∃ (v : V) (c : G.Walk v v), c.IsCycle ∧ c.length ≤ 2 * ℓ

name: ACMax.ahl_ball_moore
statement:
theorem ahl_ball_moore (hδ2 : ∀ v, 2 ≤ G.degree v) [Nonempty V] (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ)
    (hg : ∀ (v : V) (c : G.Walk v v), c.IsCycle → 2 * ℓ < c.length) :
    (∑ v, G.degree v) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range ℓ,
        ((∑ v, G.degree v) - Fintype.card V) ^ k * (Fintype.card V) ^ (ℓ - 1 - k)
      ≤ (Fintype.card V) ^ ℓ * (Fintype.card V - 1)

name: ACMax.nb_ball_injectivity
statement:
theorem nb_ball_injectivity
    (hg : ∀ (v : V) (c : G.Walk v v), c.IsCycle → 2 * ℓ < c.length) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ℓ, nbTotalWalks G k ≤ Fintype.card V * (Fintype.card V - 1)

ACMax.sum_inDegree_even
statement:
theorem sum_inDegree_even {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (s : Finset V) :
    Even (∑ v ∈ s, (G.neighborFinset v ∩ s).card)

name: ACMax.cross_count
statement:
theorem cross_count {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (X Y : Finset V) :
    ∑ v ∈ X, (G.neighborFinset v ∩ Y).card = ∑ w ∈ Y, (G.neighborFinset w ∩ X).card

name: ACMax.sum_adj_eq_single
statement:
theorem sum_adj_eq_single {V R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (A B : Finset V) (a b : V) (weight : V → V → R) (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ B)
    (hsupport : ∀ i ∈ A, ∀ j ∈ B, G.Adj i j → i = a ∧ j = b) :
    (∑ i ∈ A, ∑ j ∈ B, if G.Adj i j then weight i j else 0) =
      if G.Adj a b then weight a b else 0

name: ACMax.exists_induced_2K2_of_triangleFree_smalldeg
statement:
theorem exists_induced_2K2_of_triangleFree_smalldeg {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (D : Finset V)
    (htri : ∀ a ∈ D, ∀ b ∈ D, ∀ c ∈ D, ¬ (G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj b c ∧ G.Adj a c))
    (hmin : ∀ a ∈ D, 1 ≤ (G.neighborFinset a ∩ D).card)
    (hmax : ∀ a ∈ D, (G.neighborFinset a ∩ D).card ≤ 3)
    (hcard : 8 ≤ D.card) :
    ∃ a ∈ D, ∃ b ∈ D, ∃ c ∈ D, ∃ d ∈ D,
      ({a, b, c, d} : Finset V).card = 4 ∧
      G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj c d ∧
      ¬ G.Adj a c ∧ ¬ G.Adj a d ∧ ¬ G.Adj b c ∧ ¬ G.Adj b d

name: ACMax.card_deg3_ge_eight
statement:
theorem card_deg3_ge_eight (n : ℕ) (hn : 8 ≤ n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
    (hm : G.edgeFinset.card = 2 * (n - 2)) (h3 : ∀ v : Fin n, 3 ≤ G.degree v) :
    8 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin n => G.degree v = 3)).card

name: ACMax.goodC4Threshold_eq_of_ge_thirtytwo
statement:
theorem goodC4Threshold_eq_of_ge_thirtytwo {n : ℕ} (hn : 32 ≤ n) :
    goodC4Threshold n = 15

name: ACMax.goodC4Threshold_eq_of_window
statement:
theorem goodC4Threshold_eq_of_window {n : ℕ} (h1 : 16 ≤ n) (h2 : n < 32) :

name: ACMax.goodC4_threshold_iff
statement:
theorem goodC4_threshold_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (S : ℕ) :
    n * (S - 8) ≤ 2 * (4 * (n - 4)) ↔ S ≤ goodC4Threshold n

name: ACMax.goodTriThreshold_eq_of_ge_eighteen
statement:
theorem goodTriThreshold_eq_of_ge_eighteen {n : ℕ} (hn : 18 ≤ n) :

name: ACMax.goodTri_threshold_iff
statement:
theorem goodTri_threshold_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (S : ℕ) :

name: ACMax.leak_split
statement:
theorem leak_split {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) {X Y : Finset V}
    (hd : Disjoint X Y) (p : V) :
    (G.neighborFinset p \ X).card
      = (G.neighborFinset p ∩ Y).card + (G.neighborFinset p \ (X ∪ Y)).card

name: ACMax.nat_div_eq_of_between
statement:
theorem nat_div_eq_of_between {m n k : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (h1 : k * n ≤ m)
    (h2 : m < (k + 1) * n) : m / n = k

name: ACMax.nat_mul_sub_le_iff
statement:
theorem nat_mul_sub_le_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (c m S : ℕ) :
    n * (S - c) ≤ m ↔ S ≤ c + m / n

theorem residual_degree_sum (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))

name: ACMax.twoBlockConfig_iff_signed
statement:
theorem twoBlockConfig_iff_signed {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    TwoBlockConfig G ↔
      ∃ P N : Finset V, Disjoint P N ∧ P.card = N.card ∧ 0 < P.card ∧
        4 * (∑ p ∈ P, (G.neighborFinset p ∩ N).card)
          + (∑ p ∈ P, (G.neighborFinset p \ (P ∪ N)).card)
          + (∑ q ∈ N, (G.neighborFinset q \ (P ∪ N)).card)
        ≤ 4 * P.card

name: ACMax.twoBlock_eq_signed
statement:
theorem twoBlock_eq_signed {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (P N : Finset V)
    (hd : Disjoint P N) :
    2 * (∑ p ∈ P, (G.neighborFinset p ∩ N).card)
      + (∑ p ∈ P, (G.neighborFinset p \ P).card)
      + (∑ q ∈ N, (G.neighborFinset q \ N).card)
    = 4 * (∑ p ∈ P, (G.neighborFinset p ∩ N).card)
      + (∑ p ∈ P, (G.neighborFinset p \ (P ∪ N)).card)
      + (∑ q ∈ N, (G.neighborFinset q \ (P ∪ N)).card)

ACMax.doubleStar_P_cross
statement:
theorem doubleStar_P_cross (G : SimpleGraph V) (g h : V) (F : Finset V)
    (hfar : ∀ f ∈ F, ∀ w ∈ insert g (privTwins G g h) ∪ insert h (privTwins G h g),
      ¬G.Adj f w) :
    ∑ p ∈ insert g (privTwins G g h),
        (G.neighborFinset p ∩ (insert h (privTwins G h g) ∪ F)).card
      ≤ adjInd G g h + mCross G g h

name: ACMax.doubleStar_P_leak
statement:
theorem doubleStar_P_leak (G : SimpleGraph V) (g h : V) :
    ∑ p ∈ insert g (privTwins G g h),
        (G.neighborFinset p \ insert g (privTwins G g h)).card
      ≤ (sharedTwins G g h).card + intDeg G g + 2 * (privTwins G g h).card

name: ACMax.doubleStar_center_leak
statement:
theorem doubleStar_center_leak (G : SimpleGraph V) (g h : V) :
    (G.neighborFinset g \ insert g (privTwins G g h)).card
      ≤ (sharedTwins G g h).card + intDeg G g

name: ACMax.isoTwins_not_adj

name: ACMax.mIncidence_eq_sum

name: ACMax.mem_deg3Set

name: ACMax.mem_hubSet

name: ACMax.nbr_inter_triple_zero

name: ACMax.privTwins_card_add_shared

theorem privTwins_card_add_shared (G : SimpleGraph V) (g h : V) :

name: ACMax.privTwins_disjoint

    (h12 : w₁ ≠ w₂) (h13 : w₁ ≠ w₃) (h23 : w₂ ≠ w₃)
    (hap : G.Adj w₁ p) (hpv : p ≠ v₀) :
    (∃ q l₁ l₂ p' e', MShapeChair G q l₁ l₂ p' e') ∨

name: ACMax.ball_weighted_lower
statement:
theorem ball_weighted_lower {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {r : ℕ} (hmin : ∀ v, 2 ≤ G.degree v)
    (hg : ∀ (v : V) (c : G.Walk v v), c.IsCycle → 2 * r + 1 < c.length)
    (hconn : G.Connected) (x : V) :
    1 + 2 * r + ∑ i ∈ range r, (r - i) *
        (∑ v ∈ univ.filter (fun v => G.dist x v = i), (G.degree v - 2))

    (hi1 : 1 ≤ i) (hir : i + 1 ≤ r) :

name: ACMax.six_binary_columns_force_repeated_pair
statement:
theorem six_binary_columns_force_repeated_pair {α : Type*}
    (B : Finset α) (a₁ a₂ c₁ c₂ d₁ d₂ : α → Prop)
    (hB : B.card = 6)
    (hcol : ∀ x ∈ B,
      (if a₁ x then 1 else 0) + (if a₂ x then 1 else 0) +
        (if c₁ x then 1 else 0) + (if c₂ x then 1 else 0) +
        (if d₁ x then 1 else 0) + (if d₂ x then 1 else 0) = 3)
    (ha₁ : (B.filter a₁).card = 3) (ha₂ : (B.filter a₂).card = 3) :
    2 ≤ (B.filter fun x => a₁ x ∧ a₂ x).card ∨
    2 ≤ (B.filter fun x => c₁ x ∧ c₂ x).card ∨
    2 ≤ (B.filter fun x => d₁ x ∧ d₂ x).card ∨
    2 ≤ (B.filter fun x => a₁ x ∧ c₁ x).card ∨
    2 ≤ (B.filter fun x => a₁ x ∧ c₂ x).card ∨
    2 ≤ (B.filter fun x => a₂ x ∧ c₁ x).card ∨
    2 ≤ (B.filter fun x => a₂ x ∧ c₂ x).card ∨
    2 ≤ (B.filter fun x => a₁ x ∧ d₁ x).card ∨
    2 ≤ (B.filter fun x => a₁ x ∧ d₂ x).card ∨
    2 ≤ (B.filter fun x => a₂ x ∧ d₁ x).card ∨
    2 ≤ (B.filter fun x => a₂ x ∧ d₂ x).card

name: ACMax.six_triple_census_impossible
statement:
theorem six_triple_census_impossible {α : Type*}
    (B : Finset α) (a c d : α → ℕ)
    (hB : B.card = 6)
    (hcol : ∀ x ∈ B, a x ≤ 2 ∧ c x ≤ 2 ∧ d x ≤ 2 ∧ a x + c x + d x = 3)
    (ha : ∑ x ∈ B, a x = 6)
    (hwithin : ∑ x ∈ B,
        ((if a x = 2 then 1 else 0) + (if c x = 2 then 1 else 0) +
          (if d x = 2 then 1 else 0)) ≤ 3)
    (hac : ∑ x ∈ B, a x * c x ≤ 4)
    (had : ∑ x ∈ B, a x * d x ≤ 4) : False

        |(μ (E ∩ A ∩ s.1) / μ (A ∩ s.1)).toReal - r.toReal| ≤ 1 - p.toReal)
    (s : P.val) :
    |(μ (A ∩ s.1)).toReal * r.toReal - (μ (E ∩ A ∩ s.1)).toReal|
      ≤ (μ (A ∩ s.1)).toReal * (1 - p.toReal)

    (hμEA : μ (E ∩ A) = ∑' (s : P.val), μ (E ∩ A ∩ s.1))
    (hAtom : ∀ (s : P.val), 0 < μ (A ∩ s.1) →
        |(μ (E ∩ A ∩ s.1) / μ (A ∩ s.1)).toReal - r.toReal| ≤ 1 - p.toReal) :
    |r.toReal * (μ A).toReal - (μ (E ∩ A)).toReal|

    Module.finrank F (restrictTotalDegree (Fin d) F s) = Nat.choose (d + s) s

name: Biswal.Theorem1.L_coe_eq_rescale_one_sub_X
statement:
lemma L_coe_eq_rescale_one_sub_X (ρ : ℝ) :
    let L : Polynomial ℝ := 1 - Polynomial.C (1/ρ) * Polynomial.X
    (↑L : PowerSeries ℝ) = PowerSeries.rescale (1/ρ) (1 - PowerSeries.X)

name: Biswal.Theorem1.L_eq_neg_C_mul
statement:
lemma L_eq_neg_C_mul (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    1 - Polynomial.C (1 / ρ) * Polynomial.X =
    -Polynomial.C (1 / ρ) * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ρ)

name: Biswal.Theorem1.L_eval_at_rho
statement:
lemma L_eval_at_rho (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    Polynomial.eval ρ (1 - Polynomial.C (1/ρ) * Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℝ) = 0

name: Biswal.Theorem1.L_part_coeff_lower_bound
statement:
lemma L_part_coeff_lower_bound
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ_pos : 0 < ρ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (N_poly : Polynomial ℝ)
    (hN_pos : 0 < Polynomial.eval ρ N_poly) :
    let L : Polynomial ℝ := 1 - Polynomial.C (1/ρ) * Polynomial.X
    ∃ (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 < c ∧
      ∀ r, N < r →
        c * (↑r) ^ (k - 1) * (1/ρ) ^ r ≤
        (PowerSeries.coeff r)
          ((↑N_poly : PowerSeries ℝ) * ((↑L : PowerSeries ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹)

name: Biswal.Theorem1.L_part_eventually_pos
statement:
lemma L_part_eventually_pos
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ_pos : 0 < ρ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (N_poly : Polynomial ℝ)
    (hN_pos : 0 < Polynomial.eval ρ N_poly) :
    let L : Polynomial ℝ := 1 - Polynomial.C (1/ρ) * Polynomial.X
    ∃ N, ∀ r, N < r →
      (0 : ℝ) < (PowerSeries.coeff r)
        ((↑N_poly : PowerSeries ℝ) * ((↑L : PowerSeries ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹)

name: Biswal.Theorem1.N_scaled_coe_eq_rescale
statement:
lemma N_scaled_coe_eq_rescale (ρ : ℝ) (N_poly : Polynomial ℝ) :
    (↑(nScaled ρ N_poly) : PowerSeries ℝ) =
    (PowerSeries.rescale ρ) (↑N_poly : PowerSeries ℝ)

name: Biswal.Theorem1.N_scaled_eval_one
statement:
lemma N_scaled_eval_one (ρ : ℝ) (N_poly : Polynomial ℝ) :
    (nScaled ρ N_poly).eval 1 = N_poly.eval ρ

name: Biswal.Theorem1.S_eq_one_of_deg_zero_const_one
statement:
lemma S_eq_one_of_deg_zero_const_one (S : Polynomial ℝ) (hS_const_coeff : Polynomial.eval 0 S = 1)
    (hS_deg : S.natDegree = 0) :
    S = 1

name: Biswal.Theorem1.S_eval_pos
statement:
lemma S_eval_pos (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ_pos : 0 < ρ)
    (hρ_root : Polynomial.eval ρ (polyP ℝ m) = 0)
    (hρ_lower : ∀ j : ℕ, j < m → 0 < Polynomial.eval ρ (polyP ℝ j)) (S : Polynomial ℝ)
    (hfact : polyP ℝ m = (1 - Polynomial.C (1/ρ) * Polynomial.X) * S) :
    0 < Polynomial.eval ρ S

name: Biswal.Theorem1.S_part_eventually_zero_of_const
statement:
lemma S_part_eventually_zero_of_const
    (M_poly S : Polynomial ℝ) (k : ℕ) (_hk : 0 < k) (hS_const_coeff : Polynomial.eval 0 S = 1)
    (hS_deg : S.natDegree = 0) :
    ∃ N, ∀ r, N < r →
      (PowerSeries.coeff r)
        ((↑M_poly : PowerSeries ℝ) * ((↑S : PowerSeries ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹) = 0

name: Biswal.Theorem1.S_splits
statement:
lemma S_splits (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (ρ : ℝ) (S : Polynomial ℝ)
    (hfact : polyP ℝ m = (1 - Polynomial.C (1 / ρ) * Polynomial.X) * S) :
    S.Splits

name: Biswal.Theorem1.X_sub_C_eq_neg_C_mul_L
statement:
lemma X_sub_C_eq_neg_C_mul_L (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C α =
    -Polynomial.C α * (1 - Polynomial.C (1 / α) * Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℝ)

name: Biswal.Theorem1.angle_gt_pi
statement:
lemma angle_gt_pi (m k : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (_hk_bound : 2 * k < m + 1) :
    Real.pi < (↑((m + 1) / k) + 1) * (↑k * Real.pi / (↑m + 1))

name: Biswal.Theorem1.angle_lt_pi
statement:
lemma angle_lt_pi (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (j : Fin (m / 2)) :
    (↑(j : ℕ) + 1) * Real.pi / (↑m + 1) < Real.pi

name: Biswal.Theorem1.angle_lt_pi_div_two
statement:
lemma angle_lt_pi_div_two (m k : ℕ) (_hm : 2 ≤ m) (hk_bound : 2 * k < m + 1) :
    ↑k * Real.pi / (↑m + 1) < Real.pi / 2

name: Biswal.Theorem1.angle_lt_two_pi
statement:
lemma angle_lt_two_pi (m k : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hk_bound : 2 * k < m + 1) :
    (↑((m + 1) / k) + 1) * (↑k * Real.pi / (↑m + 1)) < 2 * Real.pi

name: Biswal.Theorem1.angle_pos
statement:
lemma angle_pos (m : ℕ) (_hm : 2 ≤ m) (j : Fin (m / 2)) :
    0 < (↑(j : ℕ) + 1) * Real.pi / (↑m + 1)

name: Biswal.Theorem1.angle_strict_mono
statement:
lemma angle_strict_mono (m k_ρ k_x : ℕ) (_hm : 2 ≤ m) (hk_lt : k_ρ < k_x) :
    ↑k_ρ * Real.pi / (↑m + 1) < ↑k_x * Real.pi / (↑m + 1)

name: Biswal.Theorem1.base_case_bound
statement:
lemma base_case_bound (k : ℕ) (ρ₁ : ℝ) (_hk : 0 < k) (hρ₁_pos : 0 < ρ₁) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (D : ℕ), 0 < C ∧
      ∀ r, |(PowerSeries.coeff r)
        ((Multiset.map (fun α =>
          (((↑(1 - Polynomial.C (1/α) * Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℝ) : PowerSeries ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹))
          (0 : Multiset ℝ)).prod)| ≤
        C * (↑r + 1) ^ D * (1/ρ₁) ^ r

name: Biswal.Theorem1.bezout_core
statement:
lemma bezout_core (ρ : ℝ) (hρ_pos : 0 < ρ) (s : ℝ) (hs_pos : 0 < s) (Q : Polynomial ℝ) :
    Polynomial.C (1 / s) * ((Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ρ) * Q + Polynomial.C s) +
    Polynomial.C (ρ / s) * Q * (-Polynomial.C (1 / ρ) * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ρ)) = 1

name: Biswal.Theorem1.bezout_eval_at_root
statement:
lemma bezout_eval_at_root (L S a b : Polynomial ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hL_zero : Polynomial.eval ρ L = 0) (hbez : a * L ^ k + b * S ^ k = 1) :
    Polynomial.eval ρ b * (Polynomial.eval ρ S) ^ k = 1

name: Biswal.Theorem1.bezout_fraction_split
statement:
lemma bezout_fraction_split (m : ℕ) (_hm : 2 ≤ m) (R_rem : Polynomial ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ_pos : 0 < ρ) (hR_pos : 0 < Polynomial.eval ρ R_rem) (S : Polynomial ℝ)
    (hfact : polyP ℝ m = (1 - Polynomial.C (1 / ρ) * Polynomial.X) * S)
    (hS_pos : 0 < Polynomial.eval ρ S)
    (hCop : IsCoprime (1 - Polynomial.C (1 / ρ) * Polynomial.X) S) :
    ∃ (N_poly M_poly : Polynomial ℝ),
      let L : Polynomial ℝ := 1 - Polynomial.C (1/ρ) * Polynomial.X
      (↑R_rem : PowerSeries ℝ) * ((↑(polyP ℝ m) : PowerSeries ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ =
        (↑N_poly : PowerSeries ℝ) * ((↑L : PowerSeries ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ +
        (↑M_poly : PowerSeries ℝ) * ((↑S : PowerSeries ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ ∧
      0 < Polynomial.eval ρ N_poly

name: Biswal.Theorem1.bezout_lift_to_ps
statement:
lemma bezout_lift_to_ps (L S a b : Polynomial ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hbez : a * L ^ k + b * S ^ k = 1) :
    (↑a : PowerSeries ℝ) * (↑L : PowerSeries ℝ) ^ k +
    (↑b : PowerSeries ℝ) * (↑S : PowerSeries ℝ) ^ k = 1

name: Biswal.Theorem1.bound_transfer
statement:
lemma bound_transfer
    (C c : ℝ) (D E r : ℕ) (ρ ρ₂ : ℝ) (hρ_pos : 0 < ρ) (hρ₂_pos : 0 < ρ₂)
    (h : C * (↑r + 1) ^ D * (ρ / ρ₂) ^ r < c * (↑r) ^ E) :
    C * (↑r + 1) ^ D * (1 / ρ₂) ^ r < c * (↑r) ^ E * (1 / ρ) ^ r

name: Biswal.Theorem1.candidate_is_root
statement:
lemma candidate_is_root (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (j : Fin (m / 2)) :
    (polyP ℝ m).IsRoot (1 / (4 * Real.cos ((↑(j : ℕ) + 1) * Real.pi / (↑m + 1)) ^ 2))

name: Biswal.Theorem1.candidate_lt_m
statement:
lemma candidate_lt_m (m k : ℕ) (_hm : 2 ≤ m) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hk_bound : 2 * k < m + 1) :
    (m + 1) / k < m

name: Biswal.Theorem1.candidate_strictMono
statement:
lemma candidate_strictMono (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    StrictMono (fun j : Fin (m / 2) =>
      1 / (4 * Real.cos ((↑(j : ℕ) + 1) * Real.pi / (↑m + 1)) ^ 2))

name: Biswal.Theorem1.cauchy_summand_bound
statement:
lemma cauchy_summand_bound
    (C₁ C₂ : ℝ) (D₁ D₂ : ℕ) (q : ℝ) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁) (hC₂ : 0 ≤ C₂) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (r r₁ r₂ : ℕ) (hr : r₁ + r₂ = r) (b₁ b₂ : ℝ) (hb₁ : |b₁| ≤ C₁ * (↑r₁ + 1) ^ D₁ * q ^ r₁)
    (hb₂ : |b₂| ≤ C₂ * (↑r₂ + 1) ^ D₂ * q ^ r₂) :
    |b₁ * b₂| ≤ C₁ * C₂ * (↑r + 1) ^ (D₁ + D₂) * q ^ r

name: Biswal.Theorem1.chebyshev_root_parametrize
statement:
lemma chebyshev_root_parametrize (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (z : ℝ) (hz_pos : 0 < z)
    (hz_root : Polynomial.eval z (Polynomial.Chebyshev.U ℝ ↑m) = 0) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ 2 * k < m + 1 ∧
    z = Real.cos (↑k * Real.pi / (↑m + 1))

name: Biswal.Theorem1.choose_le_pow_succ_core
statement:
lemma choose_le_pow_succ_core (n r : ℕ) :
    ((n + r).choose n : ℝ) ≤ (↑r + 1) ^ n

name: Biswal.Theorem1.coe_pow_eq_prod_coe_pow
statement:
lemma coe_pow_eq_prod_coe_pow
    (S : Polynomial ℝ)
    (hS_eq : S = (S.roots.map
      (fun α => (1 - Polynomial.C (1 / α) * Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℝ))).prod)
    (k : ℕ) :
    (↑S : PowerSeries ℝ) ^ k =
      (S.roots.map (fun α =>
        ((↑(1 - Polynomial.C (1/α) * Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℝ) :
          PowerSeries ℝ) ^ k))).prod

name: Biswal.Theorem1.coeff_bound_strengthened
statement:
lemma coeff_bound_strengthened
    (f : PowerSeries ℝ) (C : ℝ) (D : ℕ) (q : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hbound : ∀ r, |(PowerSeries.coeff r) f| ≤ C * (↑r + 1) ^ D * q ^ r)
    (r i j : ℕ) (hij : i + j = r) :
    |(PowerSeries.coeff j) f| ≤ C * (↑r + 1) ^ D * q ^ r * q⁻¹ ^ i

name: Biswal.Theorem1.coeff_rational_fraction_eq_proper_part
statement:
lemma coeff_rational_fraction_eq_proper_part
    (A D : Polynomial ℚ) (_hD : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (↑D : PowerSeries ℚ) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (S R : Polynomial ℚ) (N : ℕ),
      (↑A : PowerSeries ℚ) * ((↑D : PowerSeries ℚ))⁻¹ =
        ↑S + ↑R * ((↑D : PowerSeries ℚ))⁻¹ ∧
      ∀ r, N < r →
        (PowerSeries.coeff r) ((↑A : PowerSeries ℚ) * ((↑D : PowerSeries ℚ))⁻¹) =
        (PowerSeries.coeff r) ((↑R : PowerSeries ℚ) * ((↑D : PowerSeries ℚ))⁻¹)

name: Biswal.Theorem1.convolution_sum_step
statement:
lemma convolution_sum_step (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 3), polyP R j * polyP R (n + 2 - j) =
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), polyP R j * polyP R (n + 1 - j) +
    polyP R (n + 2) -
    Polynomial.X * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), polyP R j * polyP R (n - j)

name: Biswal.Theorem1.cos_angle_pos
statement:
lemma cos_angle_pos (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (j : Fin (m / 2)) :
    0 < Real.cos ((↑(j : ℕ) + 1) * Real.pi / (↑m + 1))

name: Biswal.Theorem1.cos_pos_angle_bound
statement:
lemma cos_pos_angle_bound (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < m)
    (hcos_pos : 0 < Real.cos ((↑j + 1) * Real.pi / (↑m + 1))) :
    2 * (j + 1) < m + 1

name: Biswal.Theorem1.cos_pos_from_param
statement:
lemma cos_pos_from_param (ρ : ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (h : 1 / (2 * Real.sqrt ρ) = c) :
    0 < c

name: Biswal.Theorem1.divide_by_rho_pow
statement:
lemma divide_by_rho_pow (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (c : ℝ) (d r : ℕ) (x : ℝ)
    (h : c * (r : ℝ) ^ d ≤ ρ ^ r * x) :
    c * (r : ℝ) ^ d * (1/ρ) ^ r ≤ x

name: Biswal.Theorem1.eval_deriv_eq_neg_inv_rho_mul_eval_S
statement:
lemma eval_deriv_eq_neg_inv_rho_mul_eval_S (m : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ_pos : 0 < ρ) (S : Polynomial ℝ)
    (hfact : polyP ℝ m = (1 - Polynomial.C (1 / ρ) * Polynomial.X) * S) :
    Polynomial.eval ρ (Polynomial.derivative (polyP ℝ m)) = -(1/ρ) * Polynomial.eval ρ S

name: Biswal.Theorem1.eval_deriv_polyP_neg
statement:
lemma eval_deriv_polyP_neg (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (ρ : ℝ) (_hρ_pos : 0 < ρ)
    (hρ_lower : ∀ j : ℕ, j < m → 0 < Polynomial.eval ρ (polyP ℝ j)) :
    Polynomial.eval ρ (Polynomial.derivative (polyP ℝ m)) < 0

name: Biswal.Theorem1.eval_eq_zero_of_mem_roots_toFinset
statement:
lemma eval_eq_zero_of_mem_roots_toFinset
    (S : Polynomial ℝ) (hS_ne : S ≠ 0) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ S.roots.toFinset) :
    Polynomial.eval x S = 0

name: Biswal.Theorem1.eval_pos_from_splits_and_roots_gt
statement:
lemma eval_pos_from_splits_and_roots_gt
    (S : Polynomial ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ_pos : 0 < ρ) (_hS_ne : S ≠ 0) (_hS_splits : S.Splits)
    (hS_eval_zero : Polynomial.eval 0 S = 1)
    (hS_roots_gt : ∀ x : ℝ, Polynomial.eval x S = 0 → ρ < x) :
    0 < Polynomial.eval ρ S

name: Biswal.Theorem1.exists_min_root_gt
statement:
lemma exists_min_root_gt
    (S : Polynomial ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ_pos : 0 < ρ) (hS_ne : S ≠ 0) (hS_splits : S.Splits)
    (hS_nconst : 0 < S.natDegree) (hS_roots_larger : ∀ x : ℝ, Polynomial.eval x S = 0 → ρ < x) :
    ∃ ρ₁ : ℝ, ρ < ρ₁ ∧ 0 < ρ₁ ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, Polynomial.eval x S = 0 → ρ₁ ≤ x)

name: Biswal.Theorem1.genFun_as_rational_fraction_with_pos_numerator
statement:
lemma genFun_as_rational_fraction_with_pos_numerator
    (m n : ℕ) {s : ℕ} (ξ : Nat.Partition s) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (h_parts : ∀ i ∈ ξ.parts, i ≤ m)
    (h_t : countMaxParts m ξ ≤ n / m) :
    ∃ (A : Polynomial ℚ) (k : ℕ), 0 < k ∧
      genFun ℚ m n ξ = ↑A *
        ((↑(polyP ℚ m) : PowerSeries ℚ) ^ k)⁻¹ ∧
      (∀ (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ →
        Polynomial.eval ρ (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ) (polyP ℚ m)) = 0 →
        (∀ j : ℕ, j < m →
          0 < Polynomial.eval ρ
            (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ) (polyP ℚ j))) →
        0 < Polynomial.eval ρ (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ) A))

name: Biswal.Theorem1.genFun_eq_one_of_m_eq_one
statement:
theorem genFun_eq_one_of_m_eq_one (K : Type*) [Field K]
    (n : ℕ) {s : ℕ} (ξ : Nat.Partition s) (h_parts : ∀ i ∈ ξ.parts, i ≤ 1) :
    genFun K 1 n ξ = 1

name: Biswal.Theorem1.genFun_is_poly_coe
statement:
lemma genFun_is_poly_coe (K : Type*) [Field K]
    (m n : ℕ) {s : ℕ} (ξ : Nat.Partition s) (_hm : 2 ≤ m) (_h_parts : ∀ i ∈ ξ.parts, i ≤ m)
    (h_t : n / m + 1 ≤ countMaxParts m ξ) :
    ∃ P : Polynomial K, genFun K m n ξ = ↑P

name: Biswal.Theorem1.genFun_is_polynomial
statement:
theorem genFun_is_polynomial (K : Type*) [Field K]
    (m n : ℕ) {s : ℕ} (ξ : Nat.Partition s) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (h_parts : ∀ i ∈ ξ.parts, i ≤ m)
    (h_t : n / m + 1 ≤ countMaxParts m ξ) :
    ∃ N, ∀ r, N < r → genFunCoeff K m n r ξ = 0

name: Biswal.Theorem1.hilbertPoly_pos_leadingCoeff
statement:
lemma hilbertPoly_pos_leadingCoeff (ρ : ℝ) (_hρ : 0 < ρ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (N_poly : Polynomial ℝ) (hN_pos : 0 < Polynomial.eval ρ N_poly) :
    0 < ((nScaled ρ N_poly).hilbertPoly k).leadingCoeff

name: Biswal.Theorem1.hilbertPoly_succ_leadingCoeff
statement:
lemma hilbertPoly_succ_leadingCoeff (p : Polynomial ℝ) (d : ℕ)
    (hp : p.eval 1 ≠ 0) :
    (p.hilbertPoly (d + 1)).leadingCoeff = p.eval 1 * ((d.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹)

name: Biswal.Theorem1.inner_sum_recurrence
statement:
lemma inner_sum_recurrence (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), polyP R j * polyP R (n + 2 - j) =
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), polyP R j * polyP R (n + 1 - j) -
    Polynomial.X * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), polyP R j * polyP R (n - j)

name: Biswal.Theorem1.inv_L_pow_coeff
statement:
lemma inv_L_pow_coeff (ρ : ℝ) (hρ_pos : 0 < ρ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (r : ℕ) :
    let L : Polynomial ℝ := 1 - Polynomial.C (1/ρ) * Polynomial.X
    (PowerSeries.coeff r) (((↑L : PowerSeries ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹) =
      ((k - 1 + r).choose (k - 1) : ℝ) * (1/ρ) ^ r

name: Biswal.Theorem1.inv_one_pow_coeff_bound
statement:
lemma inv_one_pow_coeff_bound (k : ℕ) (_hk : 0 < k) (ρ₁ : ℝ) (hρ₁_pos : 0 < ρ₁) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (D : ℕ), 0 < C ∧
      ∀ r, |(PowerSeries.coeff r) ((↑(1 : Polynomial ℝ) : PowerSeries ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹| ≤
        C * (↑r + 1) ^ D * (1/ρ₁) ^ r

name: Biswal.Theorem1.inv_one_sub_pow_eq_invOneSubPow
statement:
lemma inv_one_sub_pow_eq_invOneSubPow (k : ℕ) :
    ((1 - PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ =
      ↑(PowerSeries.invOneSubPow ℝ k)

name: Biswal.Theorem1.inv_prod_eq_prod_inv_of_roots
statement:
lemma inv_prod_eq_prod_inv_of_roots
    (roots : Multiset ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (roots.map (fun α =>
      ((↑(1 - Polynomial.C (1/α) * Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℝ) :
        PowerSeries ℝ) ^ k))).prod⁻¹ =
    (roots.map (fun α =>
      (((↑(1 - Polynomial.C (1/α) * Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℝ) :
        PowerSeries ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹))).prod

name: Biswal.Theorem1.isCoprime_of_eval_pos
statement:
lemma isCoprime_of_eval_pos (ρ : ℝ) (hρ_pos : 0 < ρ) (S : Polynomial ℝ)
    (hS_pos : 0 < Polynomial.eval ρ S) :
    IsCoprime S (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ρ)

name: Biswal.Theorem1.leadingCoeff_mul_prod_neg_roots_eq_one
statement:
lemma leadingCoeff_mul_prod_neg_roots_eq_one (S : Polynomial ℝ) (_hS_ne : S ≠ 0)
    (hS_splits : S.Splits) (hS_const : Polynomial.eval 0 S = 1) :
    S.leadingCoeff * (S.roots.map Neg.neg).prod = 1

name: Biswal.Theorem1.map_algebraMap_inv_comm
statement:
lemma map_algebraMap_inv_comm
    (f : PowerSeries ℚ) (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f ≠ 0) :
    (PowerSeries.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ)) f⁻¹ =
    ((PowerSeries.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ)) f)⁻¹

name: Biswal.Theorem1.polyP_deriv_recurrence

name: Biswal.Theorem1.polyP_factor_at_root
statement:
lemma polyP_factor_at_root (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ_pos : 0 < ρ)

    ∃ (S : Polynomial ℝ),
      polyP ℝ m = (1 - Polynomial.C (1/ρ) * Polynomial.X) * S ∧
      0 < Polynomial.eval ρ S ∧
      IsCoprime (1 - Polynomial.C (1/ρ) * Polynomial.X) S ∧
      Polynomial.eval 0 S = 1 ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, Polynomial.eval x S = 0 → ρ < x) ∧
      S.Splits

name: Biswal.Theorem23.alphaProd_eq_mul_nonMax
Biswal.Theorem23.cauchy_product_as_fin_prod
statement:
lemma cauchy_product_as_fin_prod (m μ : ℕ) {s : ℕ}
    (ξ : Nat.Partition s) (r : ℕ) :
    let αs := alphaValues m μ ξ
    let L1 := αs.length
    let k := reducedK m μ ξ
    (PowerSeries.coeff r)
      ((↑(alphaProd ℚ m μ ξ) : PowerSeries ℚ) *
        ((↑(polyP ℚ m) : PowerSeries ℚ)⁻¹) ^ k) =
    ∑ f ∈ Finset.Nat.antidiagonalTuple (L1 + k) r,
      (∏ i : Fin L1,
        ((-1 : ℚ) ^ (f (Fin.castAdd k i)) *
          ↑(Nat.choose (αs.getD i.val 0 - f (Fin.castAdd k i))
                        (f (Fin.castAdd k i))))) *
      (∏ ν : Fin k,
        bCoeff ℚ m (f (Fin.natAdd L1 ν)))

name: Biswal.Theorem23.coe_prod_mul_inv_pow_eq_prod
statement:
lemma coe_prod_mul_inv_pow_eq_prod (m k : ℕ)

    (↑(∏ ν : Fin k, (polyP ℚ (pairs ν).1 * polyP ℚ (pairs ν).2)) : PowerSeries ℚ) *
        ((↑(polyP ℚ m) : PowerSeries ℚ)⁻¹) ^ k =
      ∏ ν : Fin k, ((↑(polyP ℚ (pairs ν).1 * polyP ℚ (pairs ν).2) : PowerSeries ℚ) *
        ((↑(polyP ℚ m) : PowerSeries ℚ))⁻¹)

name: Biswal.Theorem23.coeff_prod_mk_eq_sum_antidiag
statement:

name: Biswal.Theorem23.thm_comb
statement:
theorem thm_comb (m μ : ℕ) {s : ℕ}
    (ξ : Nat.Partition s) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (h_parts : ∀ i ∈ ξ.parts, i ≤ m)
    (hk : countMaxParts m ξ ≤ μ / m + 1) (r : ℕ) :
    let αs := alphaValues m μ ξ
    let L1 := αs.length
    let k := reducedK m μ ξ
    genFunCoeff ℚ m μ r ξ =
      ∑ f ∈ Finset.Nat.antidiagonalTuple (L1 + k) r,
        (∏ i : Fin L1,
          ((-1 : ℚ) ^ (f (Fin.castAdd k i)) *
            ↑(Nat.choose (αs.getD i.val 0 - f (Fin.castAdd k i))
                          (f (Fin.castAdd k i))))) *
        (∏ ν : Fin k,
          bCoeff ℚ m (f (Fin.natAdd L1 ν)))

    (ξ : Nat.Partition s) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (h_parts : ∀ i ∈ ξ.parts, i ≤ m)
    (hk_nonneg : countMaxParts m ξ ≤ μ / m + 1)
    (k : ℕ) (hk_eq : k = reducedK m μ ξ)
    (pairs : Fin k → ℕ × ℕ)
    (h_bound : ∀ ν, (pairs ν).1 ≤ m - 1 ∧ (pairs ν).2 ≤ m - 1 ∧
                     (pairs ν).1 + (pairs ν).2 ≤ m - 1)

name: BSLambda.adj_comp_flip
statement:
theorem adj_comp_flip (f : Input W → Bool) (g : Input V → Bool) (x : Input (W × V)) (w : W)
    (v : V) :
    adj (comp f g) x (flipSet x {(w, v)})
      = adj f (topBits g x) (flipSet (topBits g x) {w})
        * adj g (blk x w) (flipSet (blk x w) {v})

name: BSLambda.adj_comp_mulVec_apply
statement:
theorem adj_comp_mulVec_apply (f : Input W → Bool) (g : Input V → Bool)
    (ψ : Input (W × V) → ℝ) (x : Input (W × V)) :
    (adj (comp f g) *ᵥ ψ) x
      = ∑ w : W, adj f (topBits g x) (flipSet (topBits g x) {w})
          * (adj g *ᵥ fun z ↦ ψ (setBlk x w z)) (blk x w)

name: BSLambda.adj_comp_mulVec_prod
statement:
theorem adj_comp_mulVec_prod (f : Input W → Bool) (g : Input V → Bool) {u : Input V → ℝ}
    {v : Input W → ℝ} (hu : adj g *ᵥ u = lam g • u) (hv : adj f *ᵥ v = lam f • v) :
    adj (comp f g) *ᵥ (fun x ↦ v (topBits g x) * ∏ w, u (blk x w))
      = (lam f * lam g) • fun x ↦ v (topBits g x) * ∏ w, u (blk x w)

name: BSLambda.adj_mulVec_block_prod
statement:
theorem adj_mulVec_block_prod (g : Input V → Bool) {u : Input V → ℝ} (v : Input W → ℝ)
    (hu : adj g *ᵥ u = lam g • u) (x : Input (W × V)) (w : W) :
    (adj g *ᵥ fun z : Input V ↦
        v (topBits g (setBlk x w z)) * ∏ w' : W, u (blk (setBlk x w z) w')) (blk x w)
      = lam g * v (flipSet (topBits g x) {w}) * ∏ w' : W, u (blk x w')

statement:
theorem sum_sq_block_le (g : Input V → Bool) (ψ : Input (W × V) → ℝ) (b : Input W) (w : W) :

        (if topBits g x = b then (adj g *ᵥ fun z ↦ ψ (setBlk x w z)) (blk x w) else 0) ^ 2
      ≤ lam g ^ 2 * fibreNorm g ψ (flipSet b {w}) ^ 2

statement:
theorem sum_sq_fibre_adj_comp_mulVec_le (f : Input W → Bool) (g : Input V → Bool)
    (ψ : Input (W × V) → ℝ) (b : Input W) :
    ∑ x : Input (W × V), (if topBits g x = b then (adj (comp f g) *ᵥ ψ) x else 0) ^ 2
      ≤ lam g ^ 2 * ((adj f *ᵥ fibreNorm g ψ) b) ^ 2

name: BSLambda.sum_sq_fibre_summand_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_fibre_summand_le (f : Input W → Bool) (g : Input V → Bool)
    (ψ : Input (W × V) → ℝ) (b : Input W) (w : W) :
    ∑ x : Input (W × V), (if topBits g x = b then
        adj f b (flipSet b {w}) * (adj g *ᵥ fun z ↦ ψ (setBlk x w z)) (blk x w) else 0) ^ 2
      ≤ (adj f b (flipSet b {w}) * (lam g * fibreNorm g ψ (flipSet b {w}))) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.vecMulVec_sub_single_apply
statement:

    (a b : n) :
    vecMulVec (e i - e j) (e i - e j) a b =
      if a = i ∧ b = i then 1
      else if a = j ∧ b = j then 1
      else if a = i ∧ b = j then -1
      else if a = j ∧ b = i then -1
      else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.bilinear_complete_last
statement:
lemma bilinear_complete_last (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hM : M.IsHermitian)
    (z w : Fin 3 → ℝ) (h22 : M 2 2 ≠ 0) :
    z ⬝ᵥ M *ᵥ w =
      (M *ᵥ z) 2 * (M *ᵥ w) 2 / M 2 2 +
      z 0 * w 0 * (M 0 0 - M 0 2 * M 2 0 / M 2 2) +
      z 0 * w 1 * (M 0 1 - M 0 2 * M 2 1 / M 2 2) +
      z 1 * w 0 * (M 1 0 - M 1 2 * M 2 0 / M 2 2) +
      z 1 * w 1 * (M 1 1 - M 1 2 * M 2 1 / M 2 2)

name: BollobasNikiforov.dotProduct_inv_𝒜
statement:
lemma dotProduct_inv_𝒜 (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (z w : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    z ⬝ᵥ (𝒜 t q)⁻¹ *ᵥ w =
      Δ t q * ((𝒜 t q)⁻¹ *ᵥ z) 2 * (Δ t q * ((𝒜 t q)⁻¹ *ᵥ w) 2) / (Δ t q * D2 t q) +
        (a0 t q * z 1 + Real.sqrt 2 * m t q 1 * z 0) *
            (a0 t q * w 1 + Real.sqrt 2 * m t q 1 * w 0) / (a0 t q * D2 t q) +
          z 0 * w 0 / a0 t q

      z 1 * (M 1 0 * w 0 + M 1 1 * w 1 + M 1 2 * w 2) +
      z 2 * (M 2 0 * w 0 + M 2 1 * w 1 + M 2 2 * w 2)

name: BollobasNikiforov.leading2_inv_bilinear
statement:
lemma leading2_inv_bilinear (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (z0 z1 w0 w1 : ℝ) :
    z0 * w0 * ((𝒜 t q).submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc)⁻¹ 0 0 +
      z0 * w1 * ((𝒜 t q).submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc)⁻¹ 0 1 +
      z1 * w0 * ((𝒜 t q).submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc)⁻¹ 1 0 +
      z1 * w1 * ((𝒜 t q).submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc)⁻¹ 1 1 =
      (a0 t q * z1 + Real.sqrt 2 * m t q 1 * z0) *
          (a0 t q * w1 + Real.sqrt 2 * m t q 1 * w0) / (a0 t q * D2 t q) +
        z0 * w0 / a0 t q

name: BollobasNikiforov.𝒦_bilinear
statement:
lemma 𝒦_bilinear (γ : ℝ) (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (hγ : 0 < γ) (z w : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    z ⬝ᵥ 𝒦 t q γ *ᵥ w =
      Δ t q * ((𝒜 t q)⁻¹ *ᵥ z) 2 * (Δ t q * ((𝒜 t q)⁻¹ *ᵥ w) 2) / (Δ t q * D2 t q) +
        (a0 t q * z 1 + Real.sqrt 2 * m t q 1 * z 0) *
            (a0 t q * w 1 + Real.sqrt 2 * m t q 1 * w 0) / (a0 t q * D2 t q) +
          γ * z 0 * w 0 / (a0 t q * (γ + a0 t q))

name: BollobasNikiforov.𝒦_factor
statement:
lemma 𝒦_factor (γ : ℝ) (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (hγ : 0 < γ) (x y : ℝ) :
    U t q γ x ⬝ᵥ 𝒦 t q γ *ᵥ U t q γ y =
      N t q x * N t q y / (Δ t q * D2 t q) +
        2 * P t q x * P t q y / (a0 t q * D2 t q) +
          Z t q γ x * Z t q γ y / (γ * a0 t q * (γ + a0 t q))

statement: @[simp] lemma row3_one (f : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : row3 f t 1 = t

name: BollobasNikiforov.row3_one_two_minors_nonneg
statement:
lemma row3_one_two_minors_nonneg
    (hf : ConvexOn ℝ (Ici (0 : ℝ)) f) (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (hfnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x) {t u : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 < t) (htu : t ≤ u) :
    (∀ j : Fin 3, 0 ≤ row3 f t j) ∧
      0 ≤ u - t ∧ 0 ≤ f u - f t ∧ 0 ≤ t * f u - u * f t

name: BollobasNikiforov.row3_two
statement: @[simp] lemma row3_two (f : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : row3 f t 2 = f t

name: BollobasNikiforov.row3_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma row3_zero (f : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : row3 f t 0 = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.D_inv
statement: lemma D_inv (x : ℝ) : (D x)⁻¹ = Dinv x

name: BollobasNikiforov.D_isUnit
statement: lemma D_isUnit (x : ℝ) : IsUnit (D x).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.D_mul_Dinv
statement: lemma D_mul_Dinv (x : ℝ) : D x * Dinv x = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.Dinv_mulVec_v
statement:
lemma Dinv_mulVec_v (x tj : ℝ) :
    Dinv x *ᵥ v tj =
      ![1 - x ^ 2 * tj ^ 2, -Real.sqrt 2 * tj - Real.sqrt 2 * x * tj ^ 2, tj ^ 2]

name: BollobasNikiforov.IsTotallyNonneg.det_principal
statement:
lemma IsTotallyNonneg.det_principal {n : Type*} [LinearOrder n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : IsTotallyNonneg A) (s : Finset n) :
    0 ≤ (A.submatrix (↑) (↑) : Matrix s s ℝ).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.IsTotallyNonneg.mul_diagonal
statement:
lemma IsTotallyNonneg.mul_diagonal {ι κ : Type*} [LinearOrder ι] [LinearOrder κ]
    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] {A : Matrix ι κ ℝ}
    (hA : IsTotallyNonneg A) {d : κ → ℝ} (hd : ∀ j, 0 ≤ d j) :
    IsTotallyNonneg (A * diagonal d)

name: BollobasNikiforov.N_eq_det_fromThreeCols
statement:
lemma N_eq_det_fromThreeCols (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (x : ℝ) :
    N t q x =
      (fromThreeCols (𝒜 t q *ᵥ Pi.single 0 1) (𝒜 t q *ᵥ Pi.single 1 1)
        (bhat t q x)).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.N_eq_det_one_add
statement:
lemma N_eq_det_one_add (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (x : ℝ) :
    N t q x = (1 + diagonal q * W t x).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.N_ge_one
statement:
lemma N_ge_one (x : ℝ) (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (htmono : Monotone t) (htpos : ∀ i, 0 < t i) :
    1 ≤ N t q x

name: BollobasNikiforov.W_apply
statement:
lemma W_apply (x : ℝ) (i j : Fin k) :
    W t x i j = 1 + 2 * t i * t j + fKernel x (t i) * t j ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.W_eq_mul_transpose
statement:
lemma W_eq_mul_transpose (x : ℝ) :
    W t x = fKernelRows t x * (sqRows t)ᵀ

name: BollobasNikiforov.W_isTotallyNonneg
statement:
lemma W_isTotallyNonneg (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (htmono : Monotone t) (htpos : ∀ i, 0 < t i) :
    IsTotallyNonneg (W t x)

name: BollobasNikiforov.cVec_one
statement: @[simp] lemma cVec_one (ti x : ℝ) : cVec ti x 1 = -Real.sqrt 2 * ti

name: BollobasNikiforov.cVec_two
statement: @[simp] lemma cVec_two (ti x : ℝ) : cVec ti x 2 = truncSq ti x

name: BollobasNikiforov.cVec_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma cVec_zero (ti x : ℝ) : cVec ti x 0 = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_D
statement: lemma det_D (x : ℝ) : (D x).det = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_one_add_diagonal_mul
statement:
lemma det_one_add_diagonal_mul {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (d : n → ℝ) (M : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (1 + diagonal d * M).det =
      ∑ s : Finset n, (∏ i ∈ s, d i) *
        (M.submatrix (↑) (↑) : Matrix s s ℝ).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.fKernel_convexOn
statement:
lemma fKernel_convexOn (x : ℝ) :
    ConvexOn ℝ (Ici (0 : ℝ)) (fKernel x)

name: BollobasNikiforov.fKernel_eq_linear
statement:
lemma fKernel_eq_linear {x t : ℝ} (hxt : x ≤ t) :
    fKernel x t = 2 * x * t - x ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.fKernel_eq_sq
statement: lemma fKernel_eq_sq {x t : ℝ} (htx : t ≤ x) : fKernel x t = t ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.fKernel_eq_trunc
statement:
lemma fKernel_eq_trunc (ti x : ℝ) :
    fKernel x ti = 2 * ti * x - x ^ 2 + truncSq ti x

name: BollobasNikiforov.fKernel_nonneg
statement: lemma fKernel_nonneg {x t : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : 0 ≤ fKernel x t

name: BollobasNikiforov.fKernel_zero
statement: lemma fKernel_zero {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : fKernel x 0 = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.fromThreeCols_add
statement:
lemma fromThreeCols_add (u0 u1 u2 v0 v1 v2 : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    fromThreeCols (u0 + v0) (u1 + v1) (u2 + v2) =
      fromThreeCols u0 u1 u2 + fromThreeCols v0 v1 v2

name: BollobasNikiforov.fromThreeCols_apply_one
statement:
lemma fromThreeCols_apply_one (c0 c1 c2 : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :
    fromThreeCols c0 c1 c2 i 1 = c1 i

name: BollobasNikiforov.fromThreeCols_apply_two
statement:
lemma fromThreeCols_apply_two (c0 c1 c2 : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :
    fromThreeCols c0 c1 c2 i 2 = c2 i

name: BollobasNikiforov.fromThreeCols_apply_zero
statement:
lemma fromThreeCols_apply_zero (c0 c1 c2 : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :
    fromThreeCols c0 c1 c2 i 0 = c0 i

name: BollobasNikiforov.fromThreeCols_eq_D_add_sum
statement:
lemma fromThreeCols_eq_D_add_sum (x : ℝ) :
    fromThreeCols (𝒜 t q *ᵥ Pi.single 0 1) (𝒜 t q *ᵥ Pi.single 1 1) (bhat t q x) =
      D x + ∑ i, q i • vecMulVec (v (t i)) (cVec (t i) x)

name: BollobasNikiforov.fromThreeCols_smul
statement:
lemma fromThreeCols_smul (c : ℝ) (u0 u1 u2 : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    fromThreeCols (c • u0) (c • u1) (c • u2) = c • fromThreeCols u0 u1 u2

name: BollobasNikiforov.fromThreeCols_sum
statement:
lemma fromThreeCols_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (f0 f1 f2 : ι → Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    fromThreeCols (∑ i ∈ s, f0 i) (∑ i ∈ s, f1 i) (∑ i ∈ s, f2 i) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, fromThreeCols (f0 i) (f1 i) (f2 i)

name: BollobasNikiforov.isTotallyNonneg_fKernelRows
statement:
lemma isTotallyNonneg_fKernelRows (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (htmono : Monotone t) (htpos : ∀ i, 0 < t i) :
    IsTotallyNonneg (fKernelRows t x)

name: BollobasNikiforov.isTotallyNonneg_sqRows
statement:
lemma isTotallyNonneg_sqRows (htmono : Monotone t) (htpos : ∀ i, 0 < t i) :
    IsTotallyNonneg (sqRows t)

name: BollobasNikiforov.qcRows_mul_invD_vCols
statement:
lemma qcRows_mul_invD_vCols (x : ℝ) :
    qcRows t q x * (D x)⁻¹ * vCols t = diagonal q * W t x

name: BollobasNikiforov.sqRows_eq_scale
statement:
lemma sqRows_eq_scale :
    sqRows t =
      convexRowMatrix (fun s : ℝ ↦ s ^ 2) t * diagonal (![(1 : ℝ), 2, 1])

name: BollobasNikiforov.updateCol_two_eq_fromThreeCols
statement:
lemma updateCol_two_eq_fromThreeCols (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (w : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    A.updateCol 2 w =
      fromThreeCols (A *ᵥ Pi.single 0 1) (A *ᵥ Pi.single 1 1) w

name: BollobasNikiforov.vCols_mul_qcRows
statement:
lemma vCols_mul_qcRows (x : ℝ) :
    vCols t * qcRows t q x = ∑ i, q i • vecMulVec (v (t i)) (cVec (t i) x)

name: BollobasNikiforov.vecMulVec_eq_fromThreeCols
statement:
lemma vecMulVec_eq_fromThreeCols (u v : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    vecMulVec u v = fromThreeCols (v 0 • u) (v 1 • u) (v 2 • u)

name: BollobasNikiforov.𝒜_mulVec_single_one
statement:
lemma 𝒜_mulVec_single_one :
    𝒜 t q *ᵥ Pi.single 1 1 =
      Pi.single 1 1 + ∑ i, (q i * (-Real.sqrt 2 * t i)) • v (t i)

name: BollobasNikiforov.𝒜_mulVec_single_zero
statement:
lemma 𝒜_mulVec_single_zero :
    𝒜 t q *ᵥ Pi.single 0 1 =
      Pi.single 0 1 + ∑ i, q i • v (t i)

name: BollobasNikiforov.P_expand
statement:
lemma P_expand (x : ℝ) :
    P t q x =
      a0 t q * x +
        ∑ i, q i * t i * (x ^ 2 - truncSq (t i) x) +
          ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ univ.filter (fun j ↦ i < j),
            q i * q j * (t j - t i) *
              (truncSq (t i) x - truncSq (t j) x)

name: BollobasNikiforov.P_nonneg
statement:
lemma P_nonneg (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hmono : Monotone t)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 0 ≤ P t q x

name: BollobasNikiforov.Z_nonneg
statement:
lemma Z_nonneg (γ : ℝ) (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (hγ : 0 < γ) {x : ℝ} (_hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    0 ≤ Z t q γ x

name: BollobasNikiforov.h_nonneg
statement: lemma h_nonneg (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ h t q x

name: BollobasNikiforov.m_one
statement: lemma m_one : m t q 1 = ∑ i, q i * t i

name: BollobasNikiforov.sq_sub_truncSq_nonneg
statement:
lemma sq_sub_truncSq_nonneg {ti x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hti : 0 < ti) :
    0 ≤ x ^ 2 - truncSq ti x

name: BollobasNikiforov.sum_add_swap_lt
statement:
lemma sum_add_swap_lt (f : Fin k → Fin k → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, f i i = 0) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, f i j =
      ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ univ.filter (fun j ↦ i < j), (f i j + f j i)

name: BollobasNikiforov.truncSq_eq_sq
statement: lemma truncSq_eq_sq {ti x : ℝ} (h : ti ≤ x) : truncSq ti x = (x - ti) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.truncSq_eq_zero
statement: lemma truncSq_eq_zero {ti x : ℝ} (h : x ≤ ti) : truncSq ti x = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.truncSq_nonneg
statement: lemma truncSq_nonneg (ti x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ truncSq ti x

name: BollobasNikiforov.truncSq_sub_truncSq_nonneg
statement:
lemma truncSq_sub_truncSq_nonneg {ti tj x : ℝ} (_hx : 0 ≤ x) (_hti : 0 < ti)
    (htij : ti ≤ tj) : 0 ≤ truncSq ti x - truncSq tj x

name: BollobasNikiforov.kernelCoeffN_nonneg
statement: lemma kernelCoeffN_nonneg (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) : 0 ≤ kernelCoeffN t q

name: BollobasNikiforov.kernelCoeffP_nonneg
statement: lemma kernelCoeffP_nonneg (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) : 0 ≤ kernelCoeffP t q

name: BollobasNikiforov.kernelCoeffZ_nonneg
statement:
lemma kernelCoeffZ_nonneg (γ : ℝ) (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (hγ : 0 < γ) :
    0 ≤ kernelCoeffZ t q γ

name: BollobasNikiforov.kernel_gram_eq
statement:
lemma kernel_gram_eq {κ : Type*}
    (γ : ℝ) (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (hγ : 0 < γ) (x : κ → ℝ) :
    (fun j ℓ ↦ U t q γ (x j) ⬝ᵥ 𝒦 t q γ *ᵥ U t q γ (x ℓ)) =
      kernelCoeffN t q • vecMulVec (fun j ↦ N t q (x j)) (fun j ↦ N t q (x j)) +
        kernelCoeffP t q • vecMulVec (fun j ↦ P t q (x j)) (fun j ↦ P t q (x j)) +
          kernelCoeffZ t q γ •
            vecMulVec (fun j ↦ Z t q γ (x j)) (fun j ↦ Z t q γ (x j))

name: BollobasNikiforov.kernel_gram_isCompletelyPositive
statement:
lemma kernel_gram_isCompletelyPositive {κ : Type*}
    (γ : ℝ) (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (htmono : Monotone t) (htpos : ∀ i, 0 < t i)
    (x : κ → ℝ) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    IsCompletelyPositive
      (fun j ℓ ↦ U t q γ (x j) ⬝ᵥ 𝒦 t q γ *ᵥ U t q γ (x ℓ))

name: BollobasNikiforov.kernel_lemma
statement:
lemma kernel_lemma (γ : ℝ) (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (htmono : Monotone t) (htpos : ∀ i, 0 < t i) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    1 ≤ N t q x ∧ 0 ≤ P t q x ∧ 0 ≤ Z t q γ x ∧
      ∀ y : ℝ,
        U t q γ x ⬝ᵥ 𝒦 t q γ *ᵥ U t q γ y =
          N t q x * N t q y / (Δ t q * D2 t q) +
            2 * P t q x * P t q y / (a0 t q * D2 t q) +
              Z t q γ x * Z t q γ y / (γ * a0 t q * (γ + a0 t q))

name: BollobasNikiforov.M_apply
statement:
lemma M_apply (X : Matrix n n ℝ) (a b : n) :
    M X a b =
      X a b * X a b +
        ∑ i, ∑ j, laplacianCoeff X i j *
          vecMulVec (e i - e j) (e i - e j) a b

name: BollobasNikiforov.M_apply_of_ne
statement:
lemma M_apply_of_ne (X : Matrix n n ℝ) (hX : X.IsSymm) {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    M X i j = posPart X i j ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.M_mulVec_one
statement:
lemma M_mulVec_one (X : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    M X *ᵥ (1 : n → ℝ) = (X ⊙ X) *ᵥ (1 : n → ℝ)

name: BollobasNikiforov.M_nonneg
statement: lemma M_nonneg {X : Matrix n n ℝ} (hX : X.PosSemidef) (i j : n) : 0 ≤ M X i j

name: BollobasNikiforov.M_posSemidef
statement: lemma M_posSemidef {X : Matrix n n ℝ} (hX : X.PosSemidef) : (M X).PosSemidef

name: BollobasNikiforov.M_smul_sq
statement:
lemma M_smul_sq {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (X : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    M ((c ^ 2) • X) = (c ^ 4) • M X

name: BollobasNikiforov.continuous_M
statement: lemma continuous_M : Continuous (fun X : Matrix n n ℝ => M X)

name: BollobasNikiforov.continuous_laplacianCoeff
statement:
lemma continuous_laplacianCoeff (i j : n) :
    Continuous fun X : Matrix n n ℝ => laplacianCoeff X i j

name: BollobasNikiforov.inner_ones_M
statement:
lemma inner_ones_M (X : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    inner (ones : Matrix n n ℝ) (M X) = inner X X

name: BollobasNikiforov.inner_ones_hadamard_self
statement:
lemma inner_ones_hadamard_self (X : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    inner (ones : Matrix n n ℝ) (X ⊙ X) = inner X X

name: BollobasNikiforov.inner_ones_vecMulVec_sub_single
statement:
lemma inner_ones_vecMulVec_sub_single (i j : n) :
    inner (ones : Matrix n n ℝ) (vecMulVec (e i - e j) (e i - e j)) = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.inner_sum_right
statement:
lemma inner_sum_right {ι : Type*} (B : Matrix n n ℝ) (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → Matrix n n ℝ) :
    inner B (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, inner B (f i)

name: BollobasNikiforov.isSymm_ones
statement: lemma isSymm_ones : (ones : Matrix n n ℝ).IsSymm

name: BollobasNikiforov.ite_neg_sq_eq_min_sq
statement:
lemma ite_neg_sq_eq_min_sq (x : ℝ) :
    (if x < 0 then x ^ 2 else 0) = (min x 0) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.laplacianCoeff_correction_offDiag
statement:
lemma laplacianCoeff_correction_offDiag (X : Matrix n n ℝ) {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ∑ p, ∑ q, laplacianCoeff X p q * vecMulVec (e p - e q) (e p - e q) i j =
      - laplacianCoeff X i j - laplacianCoeff X j i

name: BollobasNikiforov.laplacianCoeff_eq_min
statement:
lemma laplacianCoeff_eq_min (X : Matrix n n ℝ) (i j : n) :
    laplacianCoeff X i j = if i < j then (min (X i j) 0) ^ 2 else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.laplacianCoeff_nonneg
statement:
lemma laplacianCoeff_nonneg (X : Matrix n n ℝ) (i j : n) :
    0 ≤ laplacianCoeff X i j

name: BollobasNikiforov.laplacianCoeff_smul_sq
statement:
lemma laplacianCoeff_smul_sq (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (X : Matrix n n ℝ) (i j : n) :
    laplacianCoeff ((c ^ 2) • X) i j = c ^ 4 * laplacianCoeff X i j

name: BollobasNikiforov.sub_single_dotProduct_one
statement:
lemma sub_single_dotProduct_one (i j : n) :
    (e i - e j) ⬝ᵥ (1 : n → ℝ) = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.sum_sum_ite_eq_pair
statement:
lemma sum_sum_ite_eq_pair (f : n → n → ℝ) (i j : n) :
    ∑ p, ∑ q, (if p = i ∧ q = j then f p q else 0) = f i j

name: BollobasNikiforov.vecMulVec_sub_single_mulVec_one
statement:
lemma vecMulVec_sub_single_mulVec_one (i j : n) :
    vecMulVec (e i - e j) (e i - e j) *ᵥ (1 : n → ℝ) = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.vecMulVec_sub_single_offDiag
statement:
lemma vecMulVec_sub_single_offDiag {p q i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    vecMulVec (e p - e q) (e p - e q) i j =
      if p = i ∧ q = j then (-1 : ℝ)
      else if p = j ∧ q = i then -1
      else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.MX_z0_nonneg
statement:
lemma MX_z0_nonneg (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j)
    (α : ConfigIdx k p) :
    0 ≤ M (Xconfig s t ρ x) idxZ0 α

name: BollobasNikiforov.MX_z0_y
statement:
lemma MX_z0_y (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) (j : Fin p) :
    M (Xconfig s t ρ x) idxZ0 (idxY j) = ρ j * x j ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.MX_z0_z
statement:
lemma MX_z0_z (i : Fin k) :
    M (Xconfig s t ρ x) idxZ0 (idxZ i) = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.MX_z0_z0
statement:
lemma MX_z0_z0 (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    M (Xconfig s t ρ x) idxZ0 idxZ0 = 1 + configσ s

name: BollobasNikiforov.MX_z0_z0_pos
statement:
lemma MX_z0_z0_pos (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    0 < M (Xconfig s t ρ x) idxZ0 idxZ0

name: BollobasNikiforov.MX_z_y
statement:
lemma MX_z_y (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j) (i : Fin k) (j : Fin p) :
    M (Xconfig s t ρ x) (idxZ i) (idxY j) =
      s i * ρ j * (max (t i - x j) 0) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.MX_z_z
statement:
lemma MX_z_z (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (i h : Fin k) :
    M (Xconfig s t ρ x) (idxZ i) (idxZ h) =
      s i * s h * (1 + t i * t h) ^ 2 +
        (if i = h then s i * configD t ρ x i else 0)

name: BollobasNikiforov.MX_z_z_diag
statement:
lemma MX_z_z_diag (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (i : Fin k) :
    M (Xconfig s t ρ x) (idxZ i) (idxZ i) =
      s i * s i * (1 + t i * t i) ^ 2 + s i * configD t ρ x i

name: BollobasNikiforov.MX_z_z_of_ne
statement:
lemma MX_z_z_of_ne (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) {i h : Fin k}
    (hih : i ≠ h) :
    M (Xconfig s t ρ x) (idxZ i) (idxZ h) =
      s i * s h * (1 + t i * t h) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.M_diag
statement:
lemma M_diag {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [LinearOrder n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℝ) (a : n) :
    M X a a =
      X a a ^ 2 +
        ∑ q, (if a < q ∧ X a q < 0 then X a q ^ 2 else 0) +
          ∑ u, (if u < a ∧ X u a < 0 then X u a ^ 2 else 0)

name: BollobasNikiforov.Xconfig_apply
statement:
lemma Xconfig_apply (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (a b : ConfigIdx k p) :
    Xconfig s t ρ x a b = configVec s t ρ x a ⬝ᵥ configVec s t ρ x b

name: BollobasNikiforov.Xconfig_eq_mul_transpose
statement:
lemma Xconfig_eq_mul_transpose (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) :
    Xconfig s t ρ x = configMat s t ρ x * (configMat s t ρ x)ᵀ

name: BollobasNikiforov.Xconfig_isSymm
statement:
lemma Xconfig_isSymm (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) :
    (Xconfig s t ρ x).IsSymm

name: BollobasNikiforov.Xconfig_posSemidef
statement:
lemma Xconfig_posSemidef (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) :
    (Xconfig s t ρ x).PosSemidef

name: BollobasNikiforov.Xconfig_z0_y
statement:
lemma Xconfig_z0_y (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (j : Fin p) :
    Xconfig s t ρ x idxZ0 (idxY j) = Real.sqrt (ρ j) * x j

name: BollobasNikiforov.Xconfig_z0_y_nonneg
statement:
lemma Xconfig_z0_y_nonneg (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) (j : Fin p) :
    0 ≤ Xconfig s t ρ x idxZ0 (idxY j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.Xconfig_z0_z
statement:
lemma Xconfig_z0_z (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (i : Fin k) :
    Xconfig s t ρ x idxZ0 (idxZ i) = -Real.sqrt (s i)

name: BollobasNikiforov.Xconfig_z0_z0
statement:
lemma Xconfig_z0_z0 (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) :
    Xconfig s t ρ x idxZ0 idxZ0 = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.Xconfig_z0_z_neg
statement:
lemma Xconfig_z0_z_neg (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (i : Fin k) :

name: BollobasNikiforov.Xconfig_z_y
statement:
lemma Xconfig_z_y (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (i : Fin k) (j : Fin p) :
    Xconfig s t ρ x (idxZ i) (idxY j) =
      Real.sqrt (s i) * Real.sqrt (ρ j) * (t i - x j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.Xconfig_z_z
statement:
lemma Xconfig_z_z (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (i h : Fin k) :
    Xconfig s t ρ x (idxZ i) (idxZ h) =
      Real.sqrt (s i) * Real.sqrt (s h) * (1 + t i * t h)

name: BollobasNikiforov.Xconfig_z_z_pos
statement:
lemma Xconfig_z_z_pos (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (i h : Fin k) :
    0 < Xconfig s t ρ x (idxZ i) (idxZ h)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configD_pos
statement:
lemma configD_pos (t : Fin k → ℝ) {ρ : Fin p → ℝ} (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)

statement:
lemma configH_nonneg (t : Fin k → ℝ) {ρ : Fin p → ℝ} (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.configVec_y
statement:
lemma configVec_y (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (j : Fin p) :

name: BollobasNikiforov.configVec_z

lemma configVec_z (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (i : Fin k) :

statement:
lemma configVec_z0 (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) :

name: BollobasNikiforov.configσ_nonneg

name: BollobasNikiforov.idxY_val
statement: lemma idxY_val (j : Fin p) : (idxY (k := k) j).val = k + 1 + j.val

name: BollobasNikiforov.idxZ0_eq
statement: lemma idxZ0_eq : (idxZ0 : ConfigIdx k p) = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.idxZ0_lt_idxY
statement: lemma idxZ0_lt_idxY (j : Fin p) : (idxZ0 : ConfigIdx k p) < idxY j

name: BollobasNikiforov.idxZ0_lt_idxZ
statement: lemma idxZ0_lt_idxZ (i : Fin k) : (idxZ0 : ConfigIdx k p) < idxZ i

statement: lemma idxZ0_ne_idxY (j : Fin p) : (idxZ0 : ConfigIdx k p) ≠ idxY j

name: BollobasNikiforov.idxZ0_ne_idxZ
statement: lemma idxZ0_ne_idxZ (i : Fin k) : (idxZ0 : ConfigIdx k p) ≠ idxZ i

name: BollobasNikiforov.idxZ_lt_idxY
statement: lemma idxZ_lt_idxY (i : Fin k) (j : Fin p) : idxZ i < (idxY j : ConfigIdx k p)

statement:
lemma idxZ_lt_idxZ_iff {i h : Fin k} :

name: BollobasNikiforov.idxZ_ne_idxY
statement: lemma idxZ_ne_idxY (i : Fin k) (j : Fin p) : idxZ i ≠ (idxY j : ConfigIdx k p)

statement: lemma not_lt_idxZ0 (α : ConfigIdx k p) : ¬ α < idxZ0

name: BollobasNikiforov.sum_configIdx
statement:
lemma sum_configIdx (f : ConfigIdx k p → ℝ) :
    ∑ α, f α =
      f idxZ0 + ∑ i : Fin k, f (idxZ i) + ∑ j : Fin p, f (idxY j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.vecMulVec_sub_single_diag
statement:
lemma vecMulVec_sub_single_diag {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n] (u v a : n) :
    vecMulVec (e u - e v) (e u - e v) a a =
      if u = v then (0 : ℝ) else if a = u ∨ a = v then 1 else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.yVec_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma yVec_one (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (j : Fin p) :

name: BollobasNikiforov.yVec_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma yVec_zero (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (j : Fin p) :
    yVec ρ x j 0 = Real.sqrt (ρ j) * x j

name: BollobasNikiforov.z0_dot_yVec
statement:
lemma z0_dot_yVec (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (j : Fin p) :

name: BollobasNikiforov.z0_dot_z0
statement: lemma z0_dot_z0 : z0 ⬝ᵥ z0 = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.z0_dot_zVec
statement:
lemma z0_dot_zVec (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (i : Fin k) :

statement: @[simp] lemma z0_one : z0 1 = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.z0_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma z0_zero : z0 0 = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.zVec_dot_yVec
statement:
lemma zVec_dot_yVec (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ) (i : Fin k) (j : Fin p) :
    zVec s t i ⬝ᵥ yVec ρ x j =
      Real.sqrt (s i) * Real.sqrt (ρ j) * (t i - x j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.zVec_dot_zVec
statement:
lemma zVec_dot_zVec (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (i h : Fin k) :
    zVec s t i ⬝ᵥ zVec s t h =
      Real.sqrt (s i) * Real.sqrt (s h) * (1 + t i * t h)

name: BollobasNikiforov.zVec_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma zVec_one (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (i : Fin k) :
    zVec s t i 1 = Real.sqrt (s i) * t i

name: BollobasNikiforov.zVec_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma zVec_zero (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (i : Fin k) :
    zVec s t i 0 = -Real.sqrt (s i)

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_block_triangular_add
statement:
lemma det_block_triangular_add {m n : ℕ}
    (M : Matrix (Fin (m + n)) (Fin (m + n)) ℝ)
    (hz : ∀ (i : Fin n) (j : Fin m), M (Fin.natAdd m i) (Fin.castAdd n j) = 0) :
    M.det =
      (M.submatrix (Fin.castAdd n) (Fin.castAdd n)).det *
        (M.submatrix (Fin.natAdd m) (Fin.natAdd m)).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_mul_eq_sum_comp
statement:
lemma det_mul_eq_sum_comp {k m : ℕ}
    (P : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin m) ℝ) (Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin k) ℝ) :
    (P * Q).det =
      ∑ p : Fin k → Fin m, (P.submatrix id p).det * ∏ i, Q (p i) i

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_ones_of_le
statement:
lemma det_ones_of_le (n : ℕ) :
    (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin n => if i ≤ j then (1 : ℝ) else 0).det = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.diagonal_isTotallyNonneg
statement:
lemma diagonal_isTotallyNonneg {ι : Type*} [LinearOrder ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (d : ι → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i) :
    IsTotallyNonneg (diagonal d)

name: BollobasNikiforov.gridDelta_nonneg
statement:
lemma gridDelta_nonneg {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ gridDelta hr a t N

name: BollobasNikiforov.gridDelta_pos
BollobasNikiforov.gridDelta_tendsto
statement:
lemma gridDelta_tendsto {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => gridDelta hr a t (n + 1)) atTop (nhds 0)

name: BollobasNikiforov.gridH2_apply
statement:
lemma gridH2_apply (N : ℕ) (k ℓ : Fin (N + 1)) :
    gridH2 N k ℓ = if k ≤ ℓ then (1 : ℝ) else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.gridH2_isTotallyNonneg
statement: lemma gridH2_isTotallyNonneg (N : ℕ) : IsTotallyNonneg (gridH2 N)

name: BollobasNikiforov.gridK_apply
statement:
lemma gridK_apply {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ)
    (N : ℕ) (i : Fin r) (j : Fin c) :
    gridK hr a t N i j =
      gridDelta hr a t N ^ 2 *
        ∑ ℓ : Fin (N + 1), ∑ k : Fin (N + 1),
          if a i ≤ gridPt hr a t N k ∧ k ≤ ℓ ∧ gridPt hr a t N ℓ ≤ t j then
            (1 : ℝ) else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.gridK_apply_count
statement:
lemma gridK_apply_count {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ)
    (N : ℕ) (i : Fin r) (j : Fin c) :
    gridK hr a t N i j =
      gridDelta hr a t N ^ 2 *
        ((gridSupport hr a t N i j).card : ℝ) *
          (((gridSupport hr a t N i j).card : ℝ) + 1) / 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.gridPt_last
BollobasNikiforov.gridPt_mono
statement:
lemma gridPt_mono {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    Monotone (gridPt hr a t N)

name: BollobasNikiforov.gridPt_strictMono
statement:
lemma gridPt_strictMono {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    StrictMono (gridPt hr a t N)

name: BollobasNikiforov.gridPt_sub_eq
statement:
lemma gridPt_sub_eq {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ)
    (N : ℕ) {k ℓ : Fin (N + 1)} (hkl : k ≤ ℓ) :
    gridPt hr a t N ℓ - gridPt hr a t N k =
      ((ℓ.val - k.val : ℕ) : ℝ) * gridDelta hr a t N

name: BollobasNikiforov.gridPt_succ
statement:
lemma gridPt_succ {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ)
    (N : ℕ) (k : Fin (N + 1)) (hk : k.val + 1 < N + 1) :
    gridPt hr a t N ⟨k.val + 1, hk⟩ =
      gridPt hr a t N k + gridDelta hr a t N

name: BollobasNikiforov.gridPt_zero
statement:
lemma gridPt_zero {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    gridPt hr a t N 0 = gridXMin hr a t

name: BollobasNikiforov.gridSupport_card_mul_delta_sub_le
statement:
lemma gridSupport_card_mul_delta_sub_le {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)
    (i : Fin r) (j : Fin c) :
    |((gridSupport hr a t N i j).card : ℝ) * gridDelta hr a t N -
        max (t j - a i) 0| ≤ 2 * gridDelta hr a t N

name: BollobasNikiforov.gridSupport_interval
statement:
lemma gridSupport_interval {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ)
    {N : ℕ} (_hN : 0 < N) (i : Fin r) (j : Fin c)
    (hne : (gridSupport hr a t N i j).Nonempty) :
    gridSupport hr a t N i j =
      Icc (min' (gridSupport hr a t N i j) hne) (max' (gridSupport hr a t N i j) hne)

name: BollobasNikiforov.gridXMax_gt_a
statement:
lemma gridXMax_gt_a {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ) (i : Fin r) :
    a i < gridXMax hr a t

name: BollobasNikiforov.gridXMax_gt_t
statement:
lemma gridXMax_gt_t {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ) (j : Fin c) :
    t j < gridXMax hr a t

name: BollobasNikiforov.gridXMin_lt_a
statement:
lemma gridXMin_lt_a {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ) (i : Fin r) :
    gridXMin hr a t < a i

name: BollobasNikiforov.grid_pair_sum_eq
statement:
lemma grid_pair_sum_eq {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ)
    (N : ℕ) (i : Fin r) (j : Fin c) :
    (∑ ℓ : Fin (N + 1), ∑ k : Fin (N + 1),
        (if a i ≤ gridPt hr a t N k ∧ k ≤ ℓ ∧ gridPt hr a t N ℓ ≤ t j then
          (1 : ℝ) else 0)) =
      ∑ ℓ ∈ gridSupport hr a t N i j, ∑ k ∈ gridSupport hr a t N i j,
        (if k ≤ ℓ then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

name: BollobasNikiforov.grid_span_pos
statement:
lemma grid_span_pos {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ) :
    0 < gridXMax hr a t - gridXMin hr a t

name: BollobasNikiforov.image_comp_perm
statement:
lemma image_comp_perm {k m : ℕ} (S : Fin k → Fin m) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) :
    univ.image (S ∘ π) = univ.image S

name: BollobasNikiforov.injRearrange_mem
statement:
lemma injRearrange_mem {k m : ℕ} {u : Fin k → Fin m} (hu : Function.Injective u) (i : Fin k) :
    ∃ j, (injRearrange hu).1 j = u i

name: BollobasNikiforov.inj_eq_rearrange_comp
statement:
lemma inj_eq_rearrange_comp {k m : ℕ} {u : Fin k → Fin m} (hu : Function.Injective u) :
    u = (injRearrange hu).1 ∘ injPerm hu

name: BollobasNikiforov.le_finLast
statement: lemma le_finLast {k : ℕ} [NeZero k] (i : Fin k) : i ≤ finLast k

name: BollobasNikiforov.mem_gridSupport_iff
statement:
lemma mem_gridSupport_iff {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ)
    (N : ℕ) (i : Fin r) (j : Fin c) (k : Fin (N + 1)) :
    k ∈ gridSupport hr a t N i j ↔
      a i ≤ gridPt hr a t N k ∧ gridPt hr a t N k ≤ t j

name: BollobasNikiforov.monotone_comp_of_monotone
statement:
lemma monotone_comp_of_monotone {α β γ : Type*} [Preorder α] [Preorder β] [Preorder γ]
    {f : β → γ} {g : α → β} (hf : Monotone f) (hg : Monotone g) :

statement:
lemma monotone_of_strictMono {α β : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [Preorder β]

name: BollobasNikiforov.not_mem_gridSupport_last
statement:
lemma not_mem_gridSupport_last {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ)

name: BollobasNikiforov.not_mem_gridSupport_zero

lemma not_mem_gridSupport_zero {r c : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin c → ℝ)

name: BollobasNikiforov.stepCutoff_mono

lemma stepCutoff_mono {n : ℕ} {a t : Fin n → ℝ} (ha : Monotone a) :

lemma stepKernel_apply (a : ι → ℝ) (t : κ → ℝ) (i : ι) (j : κ) :

name: BollobasNikiforov.stepKernel_det_nonneg
BollobasNikiforov.stepKernel_eq_of_cutoff
statement:
lemma stepKernel_eq_of_cutoff {n : ℕ} {a t : Fin n → ℝ} (ht : Monotone t)

BollobasNikiforov.stepKernel_submatrix_eq

BollobasNikiforov.strictMono_fin_to_nat_ge

lemma strictMono_fin_to_nat_ge {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → ℕ} (hc : StrictMono c) (i : Fin n) :

name: BollobasNikiforov.sum_ite_le_finset

lemma sum_ite_le_finset {n : ℕ} (s : Finset (Fin n)) :

name: BollobasNikiforov.sum_ite_le_real
statement:
lemma sum_ite_le_real (n : ℕ) :

name: BollobasNikiforov.truncatedSquare_apply

BollobasNikiforov.truncatedSquare_block_zero_of_le
BollobasNikiforov.truncatedSquare_column_zero

name: BollobasNikiforov.truncatedSquare_isTotallyNonnegative_of_small
statement:
lemma truncatedSquare_isTotallyNonnegative_of_small {r c : ℕ}

    ∀ _k ≤ 3, ∀ I : Fin _k → Fin r, ∀ J : Fin _k → Fin c,

lemma truncatedSquare_minor_nonneg_of_small_or_chamber {r c k : ℕ}

    (I : Fin k → Fin r) (J : Fin k → Fin c)
    (hI : Monotone I) (hJ : Monotone J)
    (h : k ≤ 3 ∨ (∃ _ : NeZero k, t (J 0) ≤ a (I 0)) ∨
      (∃ _ : NeZero k, a (I (finLast k)) ≤ t (J 0))) :

name: BollobasNikiforov.unrestrictedSquare_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma unrestrictedSquare_apply (a : ι → ℝ) (t : κ → ℝ) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    unrestrictedSquare a t i j = (t j - a i) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.unrestrictedSquare_det_fin_three
statement:
lemma unrestrictedSquare_det_fin_three (a t : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    (unrestrictedSquare a t).det =
      2 * (a 1 - a 0) * (a 2 - a 1) * (a 2 - a 0) *
        (t 1 - t 0) * (t 2 - t 1) * (t 2 - t 0)

BollobasNikiforov.unrestrictedSquare_eq_mul
statement:
lemma unrestrictedSquare_eq_mul (a : ι → ℝ) (t : κ → ℝ) :
    unrestrictedSquare a t = unrestrictedSquareLeft a * unrestrictedSquareRight t

name: BollobasNikiforov.unrestrictedSquare_eq_sum_vecMulVec
statement:
lemma unrestrictedSquare_eq_sum_vecMulVec (a : ι → ℝ) (t : κ → ℝ) :
    unrestrictedSquare a t =
      vecMulVec (fun i => a i ^ 2) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) +
      vecMulVec (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (fun j => t j ^ 2) +
      (-2 : ℝ) • vecMulVec a t

name: BollobasNikiforov.unrestrictedSquare_rank_le
statement:
lemma unrestrictedSquare_rank_le [Fintype κ] (a : ι → ℝ) (t : κ → ℝ) :

name: BollobasNikiforov.unrestrictedSquare_submatrix_det_eq_zero
statement:
lemma unrestrictedSquare_submatrix_det_eq_zero {r : ℕ} (hr : 4 ≤ r)
    (a : ι → ℝ) (t : κ → ℝ) (I : Fin r → ι) (J : Fin r → κ) :
    ((unrestrictedSquare a t).submatrix I J).det = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.unrestrictedSquare_submatrix_eq
BollobasNikiforov.unrestrictedSquare_submatrix_eq_mul
statement:
lemma unrestrictedSquare_submatrix_eq_mul (a : ι → ℝ) (t : κ → ℝ)
    {r c : Type*} (I : r → ι) (J : c → κ) :
    (unrestrictedSquare a t).submatrix I J =
      (unrestrictedSquareLeft a).submatrix I id *
        (unrestrictedSquareRight t).submatrix id J

name: BollobasNikiforov.unrestricted_sq_two_eq
statement:
lemma unrestricted_sq_two_eq (a b t u : ℝ) :
    (t - a) ^ 2 * (u - b) ^ 2 - (u - a) ^ 2 * (t - b) ^ 2 =
      (t - u) * (a - b) * ((t - a) * (u - b) + (u - a) * (t - b))

name: BollobasNikiforov.MX_snoc_y_eq_gram_add_diag
statement:
lemma MX_snoc_y_eq_gram_add_diag (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    {m : ℕ} (e : Fin m → Fin k) (he : e.Injective) {jidx : Fin k} {ℓ : Fin p}
    (hj : jidx ∉ Set.range e) :
    (M (Xconfig s t ρ x)).submatrix (elimRowY e ℓ) (idxZ (p := p) ∘ elimSnoc e jidx) =
      elimGramZY s t (ρ ℓ) (x ℓ) e jidx +
        diagonal (elimIDiag s (configD t ρ x) e)

name: BollobasNikiforov.MX_snoc_z_eq_gram_add_diag
statement:
lemma MX_snoc_z_eq_gram_add_diag (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    {m : ℕ} (e : Fin m → Fin k) (he : e.Injective) {αidx jidx : Fin k}
    (hα : αidx ∉ Set.range e) (hj : jidx ∉ Set.range e) :
    (M (Xconfig s t ρ x)).submatrix
        (idxZ (p := p) ∘ elimSnoc e αidx) (idxZ (p := p) ∘ elimSnoc e jidx) =
      elimGramZZ s t e αidx jidx +
        diagonal (elimIDiag s (configD t ρ x) e) +
          diagonal (elimLastDiag s (configD t ρ x) αidx jidx)

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_MX_snoc_y_eq_sum
statement:
lemma det_MX_snoc_y_eq_sum (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    {m : ℕ} (e : Fin m → Fin k) (he : e.Injective) {jidx : Fin k} {ℓ : Fin p}
    (hj : jidx ∉ Set.range e) :
    ((M (Xconfig s t ρ x)).submatrix
        (elimRowY e ℓ) (idxZ (p := p) ∘ elimSnoc e jidx)).det =
      ∑ S ∈ (elimI m).powerset,
        (∏ i ∈ S, elimIDiag s (configD t ρ x) e i) *
          ((elimGramZY s t (ρ ℓ) (x ℓ) e jidx).submatrix
            (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → Fin m.succ)
            (Subtype.val)).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_MX_snoc_z_eq_sum
statement:
lemma det_MX_snoc_z_eq_sum (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    {m : ℕ} (e : Fin m → Fin k) (he : e.Injective) {αidx jidx : Fin k}
    (hα : αidx ∉ Set.range e) (hj : jidx ∉ Set.range e) :
    ((M (Xconfig s t ρ x)).submatrix
        (idxZ (p := p) ∘ elimSnoc e αidx) (idxZ (p := p) ∘ elimSnoc e jidx)).det =
      ∑ S ∈ (elimI m).powerset,
        (∏ i ∈ S, elimIDiag s (configD t ρ x) e i) *
          ((elimGramZZ s t e αidx jidx +
              diagonal (elimLastDiag s (configD t ρ x) αidx jidx)).submatrix
            (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → Fin m.succ)
            (Subtype.val)).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_add_diagonal_eq_sum
statement:
lemma det_add_diagonal_eq_sum {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (d : n → ℝ) :
    (A + diagonal d).det =
      ∑ S : Finset n,
        (∏ i ∈ Sᶜ, d i) *
          (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ S} → n)
            (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ S} → n)).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_add_diagonal_eq_sum_subset
statement:
lemma det_add_diagonal_eq_sum_subset {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (d : n → ℝ) (I : Finset n)
    (hd : ∀ i, i ∉ I → d i = 0) :
    (A + diagonal d).det =
      ∑ S ∈ I.powerset,
        (∏ i ∈ S, d i) *
          (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → n)
            (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → n)).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_elimGramZY_factor
statement:
lemma det_elimGramZY_factor (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρval xval : ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (e : Fin m → Fin k) (jidx : Fin k) :
    (elimGramZY s t ρval xval e jidx).det =
      (∏ a, if a = Fin.last m then ρval else s (elimSnoc e jidx a)) *
        (∏ b, s (elimSnoc e jidx b)) *
          (elimKernelMinorZY t xval e jidx).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_elimGramZY_submatrix_factor
statement:
lemma det_elimGramZY_submatrix_factor (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρval xval : ℝ)
    {m : ℕ} (e : Fin m → Fin k) (jidx : Fin k) (S : Finset (Fin m.succ)) :
    ((elimGramZY s t ρval xval e jidx).submatrix
        (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → Fin m.succ) Subtype.val).det =
      (∏ i : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ},
          if i.val = Fin.last m then ρval else s (elimSnoc e jidx i.val)) *
        (∏ i : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ}, s (elimSnoc e jidx i.val)) *
          ((elimKernelMinorZY t xval e jidx).submatrix
            (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → Fin m.succ) Subtype.val).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_elimGramZZ_factor
statement:
lemma det_elimGramZZ_factor (s t : Fin k → ℝ) {m : ℕ} (e : Fin m → Fin k)
    (αidx jidx : Fin k) :
    (elimGramZZ s t e αidx jidx).det =
      (∏ a, s (elimSnoc e αidx a)) * (∏ b, s (elimSnoc e jidx b)) *
        ((elimKernelZZ t).submatrix (elimSnoc e αidx) (elimSnoc e jidx)).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_elimGramZZ_submatrix_factor
statement:
lemma det_elimGramZZ_submatrix_factor (s t : Fin k → ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (e : Fin m → Fin k) (αidx jidx : Fin k) (S : Finset (Fin m.succ)) :
    ((elimGramZZ s t e αidx jidx).submatrix
        (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → Fin m.succ) Subtype.val).det =
      (∏ i : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ}, s (elimSnoc e αidx i.val)) *
        (∏ i : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ}, s (elimSnoc e jidx i.val)) *
          ((elimKernelZZ t).submatrix
            (elimSnoc e αidx ∘ (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → Fin m.succ))
            (elimSnoc e jidx ∘ (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → Fin m.succ))).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_piecewise_one_eq_compl_minor
statement:
lemma det_piecewise_one_eq_compl_minor {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (S : Finset n) :
    (of (Sᶜ.piecewise A.row (1 : Matrix n n ℝ).row)).det =
      (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ Sᶜ} → n) Subtype.val).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_smul_row_col
statement:
lemma det_smul_row_col {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (u v : n → ℝ) (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (of fun i j ↦ u i * v j * A i j).det =
      (∏ i, u i) * (∏ j, v j) * A.det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_submatrix_finset_eq
statement:
lemma det_submatrix_finset_eq {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {s t : Finset n} (h : s = t) :
    (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ s} → n) Subtype.val).det =

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_submatrix_snoc_eq_det_elim
statement:
lemma det_submatrix_snoc_eq_det_elim (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (e : Fin r → ι) (α j : ι) :
    (A.submatrix (Fin.snoc e α) (Fin.snoc e j)).det =
      (A.submatrix (Sum.elim e fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ α)
        (Sum.elim e fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ j)).det

name: BollobasNikiforov.det_submatrix_subtype_eq_orderEmb

lemma det_submatrix_subtype_eq_orderEmb {n : Type*}

    (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : {x // x ∈ S} → n) Subtype.val).det =

name: BollobasNikiforov.dotProduct_nonsing_inv_comm
statement:
lemma dotProduct_nonsing_inv_comm {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hU : IsUnit A) (x y : n → ℝ) :

name: BollobasNikiforov.dotProduct_sum_castSucc
statement:
lemma dotProduct_sum_castSucc {m : ℕ} (P x : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) :
    P ⬝ᵥ x =
      (fun i : Fin m => P i.castSucc) ⬝ᵥ (fun j => x j.castSucc) +
        P (Fin.last m) * x (Fin.last m)

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimC0_eq_elimGramE
statement:
lemma elimC0_eq_elimGramE (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    elimC0 s t ρ x = elimGramE s t ρ x

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimC0_eq_sum_scaled
statement:
lemma elimC0_eq_sum_scaled (s t : Fin k → ℝ) (ρ x : Fin p → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (hρ : ∀ j, 0 < ρ j)
    (hx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) :
    elimC0 s t ρ x =
      (M (Xconfig s t ρ x) idxZ0 idxZ0)⁻¹ •
          vecMulVec (fun α => M (Xconfig s t ρ x) α idxZ0)
            (fun α => M (Xconfig s t ρ x) α idxZ0) +
        ∑ j : Fin k,
          (elimPivot s t ρ x j)⁻¹ •
            vecMulVec (elimRes s t ρ x j) (elimRes s t ρ x j)

name: BollobasNikiforov.elimColArg_monotone
