statement: lemma rank_le_two : s.X.rank ≤ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.eigenvalues_lambdaMaxIndex
statement:
lemma eigenvalues_lambdaMaxIndex (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    hB.eigenvalues lambdaMaxIndex = lambdaMax hB

name: BollobasNikiforov.eigenvalues_lambdaSecondIndex
statement:
lemma eigenvalues_lambdaSecondIndex (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    hB.eigenvalues lambdaSecondIndex = lambdaSecond hB

name: BollobasNikiforov.eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct
statement:
lemma eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct (hB : B.IsHermitian) {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (hB.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (hB.eigenvectorBasis j : n → ℝ) = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.eigenvectorBasis_sum_sq
statement:
lemma eigenvectorBasis_sum_sq (hB : B.IsHermitian) (i : n) :
    ∑ k, (hB.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) k ^ 2 = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.exists_second_eigenvec
statement:
lemma exists_second_eigenvec (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    {u : n → ℝ} (hu : B *ᵥ u = lambdaMax hB • u) (hu1 : ∑ i, u i ^ 2 = 1)
    (_hb : 0 < lambdaSecond hB) :
    ∃ v : n → ℝ, ∑ i, v i ^ 2 = 1 ∧ u ⬝ᵥ v = 0 ∧
      B *ᵥ v = lambdaSecond hB • v

name: BollobasNikiforov.inner_hadamard_posPart_le_sqrt
statement:
lemma inner_hadamard_posPart_le_sqrt (X : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    inner B (G.adjMatrix ℝ ⊙ posPart X) ≤
      Real.sqrt (inner B B) *
        Real.sqrt (∑ i, ∑ j, G.adjMatrix ℝ i j * (posPart X i j) ^ 2)

name: BollobasNikiforov.inner_le_inner_hadamard_posPart
statement:
lemma inner_le_inner_hadamard_posPart {X : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hnn : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j) (hdiag : ∀ i, B i i = 0)
    (hsupp : ∀ i j, ¬ G.Adj i j → B i j = 0) :
    inner B X ≤ inner B (G.adjMatrix ℝ ⊙ posPart X)

name: BollobasNikiforov.inner_smul_vecMulVec
statement:
lemma inner_smul_vecMulVec (r : ℝ) (C : Matrix n n ℝ) (u : n → ℝ) :
    inner C (r • vecMulVec u u) = r * (u ⬝ᵥ C *ᵥ u)

name: BollobasNikiforov.inner_vecMulVec_vecMulVec
statement:
lemma inner_vecMulVec_vecMulVec (u v : n → ℝ) :
    inner (vecMulVec u u) (vecMulVec v v) = (u ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.isHermitian_dotProduct_mulVec
statement:
lemma isHermitian_dotProduct_mulVec (hB : B.IsHermitian) (x y : n → ℝ) :
    x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ y = (B *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ y

name: BollobasNikiforov.lambdaMaxIndex_ne_lambdaSecondIndex
statement: lemma lambdaMaxIndex_ne_lambdaSecondIndex : lambdaMaxIndex (n := n) ≠ lambdaSecondIndex

name: BollobasNikiforov.sum_sq_eq_dotProduct
statement: lemma sum_sq_eq_dotProduct (x : n → ℝ) : ∑ i, x i ^ 2 = x ⬝ᵥ x

name: BollobasNikiforov.vecMulVec_mulVec
statement:
lemma vecMulVec_mulVec (u v x : n → ℝ) :
    vecMulVec u v *ᵥ x = (v ⬝ᵥ x) • u

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.bessel_two
BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.cauchySchwarz_two
statement:
lemma cauchySchwarz_two (α β a b : ℝ) :
    α * a + β * b ≤
      Real.sqrt (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.eigenvalues_le_lambdaMax
statement:
lemma eigenvalues_le_lambdaMax [Nonempty n] (hB : B.IsHermitian) (i : n) :
    hB.eigenvalues i ≤ lambdaMax hB

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct
statement:
lemma eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct (hB : B.IsHermitian) {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (hB.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (hB.eigenvectorBasis j : n → ℝ) = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_self
statement:
lemma eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_self (hB : B.IsHermitian) (i : n) :
    (hB.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (hB.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) = 1

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.exists_card_one_writing
statement:
lemma exists_card_one_writing (hn : Fintype.card n = 1) {X : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hX : X.PosSemidef) :
    ∃ (u : n → ℝ) (α : ℝ),
      0 ≤ α ∧ u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 ∧ X = α • vecMulVec u u

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.exists_rankTwo_writing
statement:
lemma exists_rankTwo_writing [Nontrivial n] {X : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hX : X.PosSemidef) (hr : X.rank ≤ 2) :
    ∃ (u v : n → ℝ) (α β : ℝ),
      0 ≤ β ∧ β ≤ α ∧ u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 ∧ v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 ∧ u ⬝ᵥ v = 0 ∧
        X = α • vecMulVec u u + β • vecMulVec v v

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.inner_rankTwo
statement:
lemma inner_rankTwo (C : Matrix n n ℝ) (u v : n → ℝ) (α β : ℝ) :
    inner C (α • vecMulVec u u + β • vecMulVec v v) =
      α * (u ⬝ᵥ C *ᵥ u) + β * (v ⬝ᵥ C *ᵥ v)

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.inner_self_rankTwo
statement:
lemma inner_self_rankTwo {u v : n → ℝ} (hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1) (hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1)
    (huv : u ⬝ᵥ v = 0) (α β : ℝ) :
    inner (α • vecMulVec u u + β • vecMulVec v v)
        (α • vecMulVec u u + β • vecMulVec v v) =
      α ^ 2 + β ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.inner_smul_vecMulVec'
statement:
lemma inner_smul_vecMulVec' (r : ℝ) (C : Matrix n n ℝ) (u : n → ℝ) :
    inner C (r • vecMulVec u u) = r * (u ⬝ᵥ C *ᵥ u)

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.inner_vecMulVec'
statement:
lemma inner_vecMulVec' (C : Matrix n n ℝ) (u : n → ℝ) :
    inner C (vecMulVec u u) = u ⬝ᵥ C *ᵥ u

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.inner_vecMulVec_vecMulVec'
statement:
lemma inner_vecMulVec_vecMulVec' (u v : n → ℝ) :
    inner (vecMulVec u u) (vecMulVec v v) = (u ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.isHermitian_quadratic
statement:
lemma isHermitian_quadratic (hB : B.IsHermitian) (x : n → ℝ) :
    x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ x =
      ∑ k, hB.eigenvalues k *
        ((hB.eigenvectorBasis k : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.orthonormal_pair_le_lambdaMax_add_lambdaSecond
statement:
lemma orthonormal_pair_le_lambdaMax_add_lambdaSecond [Nontrivial n]
    (hB : B.IsHermitian) {u v : n → ℝ}
    (hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1) (hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1) (huv : u ⬝ᵥ v = 0) :
    u ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ u + v ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ v ≤ lambdaMax hB + lambdaSecond hB

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.parseval_eigenvectorBasis
statement:
lemma parseval_eigenvectorBasis (hB : B.IsHermitian) (x : n → ℝ) :
    ∑ k, ((hB.eigenvectorBasis k : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2 = x ⬝ᵥ x

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.rayleigh_le_lambdaMax
BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.sum_antitone_le_two_largest
statement:
lemma sum_antitone_le_two_largest {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (lam q : Fin m → ℝ) (hlam : Antitone lam)
    (hq0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) (hq1 : ∀ i, q i ≤ 1) (hsum : ∑ i, q i = 2) :
    ∑ i, lam i * q i ≤ lam ⟨0, by omega⟩ + lam ⟨1, by omega⟩

name: BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.variational_lemma
BollobasNikiforov.GramAux.vecMulVec_mulVec_real
statement:
lemma vecMulVec_mulVec_real (u v x : n → ℝ) :
    vecMulVec u v *ᵥ x = (v ⬝ᵥ x) • u

name: BollobasNikiforov.adjMatrix_hadamard_posPart_diag
statement:
lemma adjMatrix_hadamard_posPart_diag (X : Matrix V V ℝ) (i : V) :
    (G.adjMatrix ℝ ⊙ posPart X) i i = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.adjMatrix_hadamard_posPart_eq_zero_of_not_adj
statement:
lemma adjMatrix_hadamard_posPart_eq_zero_of_not_adj
    {X : Matrix V V ℝ} {i j : V} (hij : ¬ G.Adj i j) :
    (G.adjMatrix ℝ ⊙ posPart X) i j = 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.adjMatrix_hadamard_posPart_nonneg
statement:
lemma adjMatrix_hadamard_posPart_nonneg (X : Matrix V V ℝ) (i j : V) :
    0 ≤ (G.adjMatrix ℝ ⊙ posPart X) i j

name: BollobasNikiforov.inner_adjMatrix_hadamard_posPart
statement:
lemma inner_adjMatrix_hadamard_posPart [Fintype V] (X : Matrix V V ℝ) :
    inner (G.adjMatrix ℝ ⊙ posPart X) X =
      inner (G.adjMatrix ℝ ⊙ posPart X) (G.adjMatrix ℝ ⊙ posPart X)

name: BollobasNikiforov.inner_adjMatrix_hadamard_posPart_self
statement:
lemma inner_adjMatrix_hadamard_posPart_self [Fintype V] (X : Matrix V V ℝ) :
    inner (G.adjMatrix ℝ ⊙ posPart X) (G.adjMatrix ℝ ⊙ posPart X) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, G.adjMatrix ℝ i j * (posPart X i j) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.isSymm_adjMatrix_hadamard_posPart
statement:
lemma isSymm_adjMatrix_hadamard_posPart {X : Matrix V V ℝ} (hX : X.IsSymm) :
    (G.adjMatrix ℝ ⊙ posPart X).IsSymm

name: BollobasNikiforov.max_zero_mul_self
statement: lemma max_zero_mul_self (x : ℝ) : max x 0 * x = (max x 0) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.posPart_isSymm
statement:
lemma posPart_isSymm {X : Matrix V V ℝ} (hX : X.IsSymm) :

name: BollobasNikiforov.ChiVec3Feasible.mem_image_param
statement:
lemma ChiVec3Feasible.mem_image_param {X : Matrix V V ℝ}

    X ∈ (fun p : (V → ℝ) × (V → ℝ) => vecMulVec p.1 p.1 + vecMulVec p.2 p.2) ''
      chiVec3Param G

name: BollobasNikiforov.ChiVec3Feasible.of_mem_image_param
statement:
lemma ChiVec3Feasible.of_mem_image_param {X : Matrix V V ℝ}
    (hX : X ∈ (fun p : (V → ℝ) × (V → ℝ) => vecMulVec p.1 p.1 + vecMulVec p.2 p.2) ''

statement:
lemma bddAbove_image_inner_chiVec3 :
    BddAbove ((fun X : Matrix V V ℝ => inner X X) '' {X | ChiVec3Feasible G X})

name: BollobasNikiforov.chiVec3FeasibleSet_eq_image
statement:
lemma chiVec3FeasibleSet_eq_image :
    {X : Matrix V V ℝ | ChiVec3Feasible G X} =
      (fun p : (V → ℝ) × (V → ℝ) => vecMulVec p.1 p.1 + vecMulVec p.2 p.2) ''

name: BollobasNikiforov.chiVec3FeasibleSet_nonempty
statement:
lemma chiVec3FeasibleSet_nonempty [Nonempty V] :
    ({X : Matrix V V ℝ | ChiVec3Feasible G X}).Nonempty

name: BollobasNikiforov.chiVec3Feasible_cliqueGram
statement:
lemma chiVec3Feasible_cliqueGram {s : Finset V} (hs : G.IsClique (s : Set V))

name: BollobasNikiforov.chiVec3Feasible_single
statement:
lemma chiVec3Feasible_single [Nonempty V] :
    ChiVec3Feasible G
      (vecMulVec (Pi.single (Classical.arbitrary V) (1 : ℝ))
        (Pi.single (Classical.arbitrary V) 1))

name: BollobasNikiforov.cliqueGram_apply
statement:
lemma cliqueGram_apply (s : Finset V) (i j : V) :
    cliqueGram s i j =
      if i ∈ s ∧ j ∈ s then 1 / Real.sqrt s.card else 0

name: BollobasNikiforov.cliqueGram_sq_apply
statement:

name: BollobasNikiforov.dotProduct_mulVec_eq_sum_eigenvalues₀
statement:
lemma dotProduct_mulVec_eq_sum_eigenvalues₀ (hA : A.IsHermitian) (x : n → ℝ) :
    x ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ x =
      ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues₀ i *
        euclInner ((isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hA).eigenvectorBasis
          finrank_euclideanSpace i) (toLp 2 x) ^ 2

name: BollobasNikiforov.dotProduct_mulVec_le_lambdaSecond_of_orthogonal
statement:
lemma dotProduct_mulVec_le_lambdaSecond_of_orthogonal (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    [Nontrivial n] {x : n → ℝ} (hx : ∑ k, x k ^ 2 = 1)
    (horth :
      euclInner ((isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hA).eigenvectorBasis finrank_euclideanSpace
          ⟨0, Fintype.card_pos⟩)
        (toLp 2 x) = 0) :
    x ⬝ᵥ A *ᵥ x ≤ lambdaSecond hA

lemma exists_l2_mem_span_single_pair_orthogonal (hA : A.IsHermitian)

    ∃ x : n → ℝ,
      x ∈ Submodule.span ℝ ({Pi.single i (1 : ℝ), Pi.single j 1} : Set (n → ℝ)) ∧
        ∑ k, x k ^ 2 = 1 ∧
        euclInner ((isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hA).eigenvectorBasis finrank_euclideanSpace
            ⟨0, Fintype.card_pos⟩)
          (toLp 2 x) = 0

            H (m + 1) (x + y) ≤ max (H m x) y + max (H m y) x)
    {a b p q p0 p1 q0 q1 a0 a1 b0 b1 : ℕ}
    (ha : a ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1)) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1))
    (hcasc : CascadeSplit (n + 1) (a + b) p q)
    (hq_zero : q = 0)
    (_hp0 : p0 ≤ 2 ^ n) (_hp1 : p1 ≤ 2 ^ n)
    (_hq0 : q0 ≤ 2 ^ n) (_hq1 : q1 ≤ 2 ^ n)
    (_ha0 : a0 ≤ 2 ^ n) (_ha1 : a1 ≤ 2 ^ n)
    (_hb0 : b0 ≤ 2 ^ n) (_hb1 : b1 ≤ 2 ^ n)
    (hp_split : CascadeSplit n p p0 p1)
    (hq_split : CascadeSplit n q q0 q1)
    (ha_split : CascadeSplit n a a0 a1)
    (hb_split : CascadeSplit n b b0 b1) :
    max (max (H n p0) p1 + max (H n p1) p0) q +
    max (max (H n q0) q1 + max (H n q1) q0) p ≤
    max (max (H n a0) a1 + max (H n a1) a0) b +
    max (max (H n b0) b1 + max (H n b1) b0) a

lemma slice1_neighborhoodUnion {N x y px qx py qy : ℕ}
    (hx : CascadeSplit N x px qx) (hy : CascadeSplit N y py qy) :
    slice1 (neighborhood 1 (simplicialInitSeg (N + 1) x) ∪ simplicialInitSeg (N + 1) y)
      = neighborhood 1 (simplicialInitSeg N qx) ∪ simplicialInitSeg N px ∪
          simplicialInitSeg N qy

lemma slice1_simplicialInitSeg_eq_cascadeSplit {N x p q : ℕ} (h : CascadeSplit N x p q) :

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.slice1_union
statement:
lemma slice1_union {N : ℕ} (A B : Finset (Cube (N + 1))) :
    slice1 (A ∪ B) = slice1 A ∪ slice1 B

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.sum_Ico_PairLayerWindowCost_eq
statement:
lemma sum_Ico_PairLayerWindowCost_eq (N a b k : ℕ)
    (ha : a ≤ 2 ^ N) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ N) :
    ∑ r ∈ Finset.Ico k (N + 2), PairLayerWindowCost N r a b
      = (max (H N a) b - binomPrefix N k) + (max (H N b) a - binomPrefix N k)

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.sum_Ico_layerWindowRemainder_max_eq
statement:
lemma sum_Ico_layerWindowRemainder_max_eq (N x y k : ℕ) :
    ∑ r ∈ Finset.Ico k (N + 2), layerWindowRemainder N r (max (H N x) y)
      = ((neighborhood 1 (simplicialInitSeg N x) ∪ simplicialInitSeg N y).filter
          (fun z => k ≤ z.card)).card

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.swap_potential_lt

lemma swap_potential_lt {N : ℕ} {A A' : Finset (Cube N)} {x y : Cube N}

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.upShadow_filter_layer_eq
statement:
lemma upShadow_filter_layer_eq {N : ℕ} (A : Finset (Cube N)) (k : ℕ) :
    (Finset.upShadow A).filter (fun x => x.card = k) =
      (Finset.upShadow (A.filter (fun x => x.card = k - 1))).filter
        (fun x => x.card = k)

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.upperLayerShadow_eq_filter_layer

lemma upperLayerShadow_eq_filter_layer {N r : ℕ} (B : Finset (Cube N)) :

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.CoherentGap.correctionFor_target
statement:
lemma correctionFor_target (offset : ℕ)
    (index : Fin (guide (offset + 2) - 1)) :
    (correctionFor offset index).target =
      basis (negativeIndex offset index) -
        basis (⟨index.val + 1, by
          have hdeep := correction_deep_bound (dimension := offset + 2)
            (index := index.val) (by omega) index.isLt
          omega⟩ : Fin (offset + 2))

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.CoherentGap.correction_deep_bound
statement:
lemma correction_deep_bound {dimension index : ℕ}
    (hdimension : 2 ≤ dimension)
    (hindex : index < guide dimension - 1) :
    triangular index + index + 3 ≤ dimension

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.CoherentGap.corrections_target_sum
statement:
lemma corrections_target_sum (offset : ℕ) :
    ((corrections offset).map Correction.target).sum =
      ∑ index : Fin (guide (offset + 2) - 1),
        (basis (negativeIndex offset index) -
          basis (⟨index.val + 1, by
            have hdeep := correction_deep_bound (dimension := offset + 2)
              (index := index.val) (by omega) index.isLt
            omega⟩ : Fin (offset + 2)))

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.CoherentGap.iteratedLift_basis_eq
statement:
lemma iteratedLift_basis_eq {n : ℕ} (coordinate : Fin n) :
    ∀ {steps : ℕ} (hsteps : 0 < steps),
      iteratedLift (basis coordinate) steps =
        basis (⟨coordinate.val + steps, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + steps)) -
          basis (⟨steps - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + steps))
  | 0, hsteps => by omega
  | 1, _ => by
      change lift (basis coordinate) =
        basis (⟨coordinate.val + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1)) -
          basis (⟨1 - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1))
      rw [lift_basis]
      have hpositive :
          coordinate.succ =
            (⟨coordinate.val + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1))

        ∑ index : Fin (guide (offset + 2) - 1),

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.CoherentGap.block_identity_by_width
statement:
theorem block_identity_by_width :
    ∀ previous dimension : ℕ,
      guide dimension = previous + 1 →
        residual (previous + 1) dimension +
          ∑ index : Fin previous,
            conwayGuyHeight (triangular index.val) = 1
  | 0, dimension, hguide => by
      have hdimension : dimension = 2 := by
        obtain ⟨hlower, hupper⟩

statement:
lemma conwayGuyDifference_eq_height_window (dimension : ℕ)
    (hdimension : 0 < dimension) :

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.CoherentGap.conwayGuyDifference_succ
statement:
lemma conwayGuyDifference_succ (index : ℕ) :
    conwayGuyDifference (index + 1) =

statement:

    (hdimension : 2 ≤ dimension) :
    conwayGuyHeight dimension -
          ∑ index : Fin (guide dimension),
            conwayGuyHeight (dimension - index.val - 1) +
        ∑ index : Fin (guide dimension - 1),
          conwayGuyHeight (triangular index.val) = 1

statement:
lemma correction_sum_succ (previous : ℕ) :
    (∑ index : Fin (previous + 1),
        conwayGuyHeight (triangular index.val)) =
      (∑ index : Fin previous,
          conwayGuyHeight (triangular index.val)) +
        conwayGuyHeight (triangular previous)

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.CoherentGap.guide_eq_iff

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.CoherentGap.residual_next_block_start
statement:
lemma residual_next_block_start (previous : ℕ) :
    residual (previous + 2) (triangular (previous + 1) + 2) =
      residual (previous + 1) (triangular (previous + 1) + 1) -
        conwayGuyHeight (triangular previous)

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.CoherentGap.residual_succ_eq
statement:

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.CoherentGap.residual_succ_width
statement:
lemma residual_succ_width (width dimension : ℕ) :
    residual (width + 1) (dimension + 1) =
      residual width dimension +
        conwayGuyDifference dimension -
          conwayGuyHeight dimension

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.CoherentGap.reverse_difference_sum
statement:
lemma reverse_difference_sum (dimension : ℕ) :
    ∀ width : ℕ, width ≤ dimension →
      (∑ index : Fin width,
          (conwayGuyDifference (dimension - index.val - 1) : ℤ)) =
        conwayGuyHeight dimension -
          conwayGuyHeight (dimension - width)
  | 0, _ => by simp
  | width + 1, hwidth => by
      have hdimension : 0 < dimension := by omega
      obtain ⟨previous, rfl⟩

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.H_shadow_LE_sum_as_upperShadow
statement:
theorem H_shadow_LE_sum_as_upperShadow {N a b p q ra rb rp rq ta tb tp tq : ℕ}
    (hra : 1 ≤ ra) (hrb : 1 ≤ rb) (hrp : 1 ≤ rp) (hrq : 1 ≤ rq)
    (hae : a = binomPrefix N ra + ta) (hbe : b = binomPrefix N rb + tb)
    (hpe : p = binomPrefix N rp + tp) (hqe : q = binomPrefix N rq + tq) :
    (H N p + H N q ≤ H N a + H N b) ↔
      (binomPrefix N (rp + 1) + upperShadow N rp tp)
        + (binomPrefix N (rq + 1) + upperShadow N rq tq)
      ≤ (binomPrefix N (ra + 1) + upperShadow N ra ta)
        + (binomPrefix N (rb + 1) + upperShadow N rb tb)

lemma HIncrement_window_eq_gShiftIntervalCount (n lo hi : ℕ) (hlohi : lo ≤ hi) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico lo hi, HIncrement n i) = gShiftIntervalCount n lo hi

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.HIncrement_window_le_of_gShiftIntervalCount_le
statement:
lemma HIncrement_window_le_of_gShiftIntervalCount_le
    {n lo₁ hi₁ lo₂ hi₂ slack : ℕ}
    (h₁ : lo₁ ≤ hi₁) (h₂ : lo₂ ≤ hi₂)
    (hcount :
      gShiftIntervalCount n lo₁ hi₁ ≤ gShiftIntervalCount n lo₂ hi₂ + slack) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico lo₁ hi₁, HIncrement n i) ≤
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico lo₂ hi₂, HIncrement n i) + slack

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.H_inequality
statement:
lemma H_inequality (n a b : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ 2 ^ n) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ n) :
    H (n + 1) (a + b) ≤ max (H n a) b + max (H n b) a

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.H_inequality_core
statement:
lemma H_inequality_core :
    ∀ (n a b : ℕ), a ≤ 2 ^ n → b ≤ 2 ^ n →
      H (n + 1) (a + b) ≤ max (H n a) b + max (H n b) a

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.H_le_binomPrefix_of_layer
statement:
lemma H_le_binomPrefix_of_layer (N a b r : ℕ)
    (hb : b ≤ binomPrefix N (r + 1)) (hcase : a ≤ H N b) :
    a ≤ binomPrefix N (r + 2)

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.H_pair_step_backward_of_increment_le
statement:
lemma H_pair_step_backward_of_increment_le (N x y : ℕ)
    (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hinc : HIncrement N x ≤ HIncrement N (y - 1)) :
    H N (x + 1) + H N (y - 1) ≤ H N x + H N y

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.H_pair_step_forward_of_increment_le
statement:
lemma H_pair_step_forward_of_increment_le (N x y : ℕ)
    (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hinc : HIncrement N (y - 1) ≤ HIncrement N x) :
    H N x + H N y ≤ H N (x + 1) + H N (y - 1)

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.H_split_opt
statement:
lemma H_split_opt {n a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ 2 ^ n) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ n) :
    max (H n (slice0 (simplicialInitSeg (n + 1) (a + b))).card)
        (slice1 (simplicialInitSeg (n + 1) (a + b))).card +
    max (H n (slice1 (simplicialInitSeg (n + 1) (a + b))).card)
        (slice0 (simplicialInitSeg (n + 1) (a + b))).card
    ≤ max (H n a) b + max (H n b) a

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.H_window_sum_of_le
statement:
lemma H_window_sum_of_le (n lo hi : ℕ) (hlohi : lo ≤ hi) :
    H n hi = H n lo + ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico lo hi, HIncrement n i

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.H_window_sum_of_le_int
statement:
lemma H_window_sum_of_le_int (n lo hi : ℕ) (hlohi : lo ≤ hi) :
    (H n hi : ℤ) = (H n lo : ℤ) + (gShiftIntervalCount n lo hi : ℤ)

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.boundaryCostH_comm
statement:
lemma boundaryCostH_comm (N a b : ℕ) :
    boundaryCostH N a b = boundaryCostH N b a

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.boundaryCostH_eq_H_add_slack
statement:
lemma boundaryCostH_eq_H_add_slack (N a b : ℕ) :
    boundaryCostH N a b =
      H N a + H N b + (b - H N a) + (a - H N b)

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.boundaryCost_le_of_LE_GT_sums
statement:
lemma boundaryCost_le_of_LE_GT_sums (n : ℕ)
    (ih : ∀ m, m < n + 1 → ∀ x y, x ≤ 2 ^ m → y ≤ 2 ^ m →
            H (m + 1) (x + y) ≤ max (H m x) y + max (H m y) x)
    {a b p q : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1)) (_hb : b ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1))
    (hcasc : CascadeSplit (n + 1) (a + b) p q) (hba : b ≤ a) :
    max (H (n + 1) p) q + max (H (n + 1) q) p ≤
      max (H (n + 1) a) b + max (H (n + 1) b) a

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.boundaryCost_le_of_interleaves_core
statement:
lemma boundaryCost_le_of_interleaves_core (n p q a b : ℕ)
    (ih : ∀ m, m < n + 1 → ∀ x y, x ≤ 2 ^ m → y ≤ 2 ^ m →
            H (m + 1) (x + y) ≤ max (H m x) y + max (H m y) x)
    (ha : a ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1)) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1))
    (h_inter : CascadeInterleaves (n + 1) p q a b) :
    max (H (n + 1) p) q + max (H (n + 1) q) p ≤
      max (H (n + 1) a) b + max (H (n + 1) b) a

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.boundaryCost_le_of_lower_interleaves_step_live
statement:
lemma boundaryCost_le_of_lower_interleaves_step_live
    (n p q a b p0 p1 q0 q1 a0 a1 b0 b1 : ℕ)
    (_ : ∀ m, m < n + 1 → ∀ x y, x ≤ 2 ^ m → y ≤ 2 ^ m →
            H (m + 1) (x + y) ≤ max (H m x) y + max (H m y) x)
    (ha_cap : a ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1)) (hb_cap : b ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1))
    (hba : b ≤ a)
    (hpq_casc : CascadeSplit (n + 1) (a + b) p q)
    (hp : CascadeSplit n p p0 p1) (hq : CascadeSplit n q q0 q1)
    (_ : CascadeSplit n a a0 a1) (hb : CascadeSplit n b b0 b1)
    (_ : ∀ l,
      splitPrefixMass n a0 b0 (l + 1) + splitPrefixMass n a1 b1 l
        ≤ splitPrefixMass n p0 q0 (l + 1) + splitPrefixMass n p1 q1 l) :
    max (H (n + 1) p) q + max (H (n + 1) q) p ≤
      max (H (n + 1) a) b + max (H (n + 1) b) a

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.exists_binomPrefix_layer
statement:
lemma exists_binomPrefix_layer (N b : ℕ) (hb : b < 2 ^ N) :

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.gShiftIntervalCount_add_adjacent
statement:
lemma gShiftIntervalCount_add_adjacent (n lo mid hi : ℕ)
    (h1 : lo ≤ mid) (h2 : mid ≤ hi) :
    gShiftIntervalCount n lo mid + gShiftIntervalCount n mid hi
      = gShiftIntervalCount n lo hi

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.gShiftIntervalCount_binomPrefix_window
statement:
lemma gShiftIntervalCount_binomPrefix_window (n r s : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    gShiftIntervalCount n (binomPrefix n r) (binomPrefix n s)
      = (Finset.Ico (r + 1) (s + 1)).sum (fun i => Nat.choose n i)

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.gShiftIntervalCount_eq_H_sub
statement:
lemma gShiftIntervalCount_eq_H_sub (n lo hi : ℕ) (hlohi : lo ≤ hi) :
    gShiftIntervalCount n lo hi = H n hi - H n lo

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.gShiftIntervalCount_eq_macaulayShadowWeight_sum
statement:
lemma gShiftIntervalCount_eq_macaulayShadowWeight_sum
    (n lo hi : ℕ) (hlohi : lo ≤ hi) (hhi : hi ≤ 2 ^ n) :
    gShiftIntervalCount n lo hi =
      ∑ w ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Cube n => lo ≤ rank w ∧ rank w < hi)),
        macaulayShadowWeight w

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.gShiftIntervalCount_ge_binomPrefix_window_of_endpoints
statement:
lemma gShiftIntervalCount_ge_binomPrefix_window_of_endpoints
    (n r s lo hi : ℕ)
    (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (hlo : lo ≤ binomPrefix n r)
    (hhi : binomPrefix n s ≤ hi) :
    (Finset.Ico (r + 1) (s + 1)).sum (fun i => Nat.choose n i) ≤
      gShiftIntervalCount n lo hi

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.gShiftIntervalCount_le_binomPrefix_window_of_endpoints
statement:
lemma gShiftIntervalCount_le_binomPrefix_window_of_endpoints
    (n r s lo hi : ℕ)
    (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (hlo : binomPrefix n r ≤ lo)
    (hhi : hi ≤ binomPrefix n s) :
    gShiftIntervalCount n lo hi ≤
      (Finset.Ico (r + 1) (s + 1)).sum (fun i => Nat.choose n i)

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.gShiftIntervalCount_le_of_blocks
statement:
lemma gShiftIntervalCount_le_of_blocks
    (n r₁ s₁ r₂ s₂ lo₁ hi₁ lo₂ hi₂ : ℕ)
    (hr₁ : 1 ≤ r₁) (hrs₁ : r₁ ≤ s₁)
    (hr₂ : 1 ≤ r₂) (hrs₂ : r₂ ≤ s₂)
    (hlo₁ : binomPrefix n r₁ ≤ lo₁) (hhi₁ : hi₁ ≤ binomPrefix n s₁)
    (hlo₂ : lo₂ ≤ binomPrefix n r₂) (hhi₂ : binomPrefix n s₂ ≤ hi₂)
    (hblock :
      (Finset.Ico (r₁ + 1) (s₁ + 1)).sum (fun i => Nat.choose n i) ≤
        (Finset.Ico (r₂ + 1) (s₂ + 1)).sum (fun i => Nat.choose n i)) :
    gShiftIntervalCount n lo₁ hi₁ ≤ gShiftIntervalCount n lo₂ hi₂

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.gShiftIntervalCount_le_of_layer
statement:
lemma gShiftIntervalCount_le_of_layer {n r a L : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hlo : binomPrefix n r ≤ a) (hhi : a + L ≤ binomPrefix n (r + 1)) :
    gShiftIntervalCount n a (a + L) ≤ L * (n - r)

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.harper_base

lemma harper_base (A : Finset (Cube 0)) (k : ℕ) (hk : A.card = k) :

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.harper_bc_min
statement:
lemma harper_bc_min (n : ℕ)
    (ih : ∀ m, m < n → ∀ x y, x ≤ 2 ^ m → y ≤ 2 ^ m →
            H (m + 1) (x + y) ≤ max (H m x) y + max (H m y) x)
    {a b p q : ℕ}
    (ha : a ≤ 2 ^ n) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ n) (hp : p ≤ 2 ^ n) (hq : q ≤ 2 ^ n)
    (hpq : p + q = a + b) (hcasc : CascadeSplit n (a + b) p q) :
    max (H n p) q + max (H n q) p ≤ max (H n a) b + max (H n b) a

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.harper_bc_min_case_gt
statement:
lemma harper_bc_min_case_gt
    (n : ℕ)
    (ih : ∀ m, m < n → ∀ x y, x ≤ 2 ^ m → y ≤ 2 ^ m →
            H (m + 1) (x + y) ≤ max (H m x) y + max (H m y) x)
    {a b p q : ℕ}
    (ha : a ≤ 2 ^ n) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ n) (hp : p ≤ 2 ^ n) (hq : q ≤ 2 ^ n)
    (hq_pos : 1 ≤ q)
    (hb_le_a : b ≤ a) (hcase : H n b < a)
    (_ : p + q = a + b) (hcasc : CascadeSplit n (a + b) p q) :
    H n p + H n q ≤ H n a + a

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.harper_bc_min_case_le
statement:
lemma harper_bc_min_case_le
    (n : ℕ)
    (ih : ∀ m, m < n → ∀ x y, x ≤ 2 ^ m → y ≤ 2 ^ m →

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.harper_core

lemma harper_core :

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.harper_extremal_step
statement:
lemma harper_extremal_step (n : ℕ)
    (ih : ∀ m, m < n + 1 → ∀ x y, x ≤ 2 ^ m → y ≤ 2 ^ m →
            H (m + 1) (x + y) ≤ max (H m x) y + max (H m y) x)
    {a b p q : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1)) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1))
    (hcasc : CascadeSplit (n + 1) (a + b) p q) :
    max (H (n + 1) p) q + max (H (n + 1) q) p ≤

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.harper_extremal_step_nested
statement:
lemma harper_extremal_step_nested (n : ℕ)
    (ih : ∀ m, m < n + 1 → ∀ x y, x ≤ 2 ^ m → y ≤ 2 ^ m →
            H (m + 1) (x + y) ≤ max (H m x) y + max (H m y) x)
    {a b p q p0 p1 q0 q1 a0 a1 b0 b1 : ℕ}
    (ha : a ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1)) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1))
    (hcasc : CascadeSplit (n + 1) (a + b) p q)
    (hp0 : p0 ≤ 2 ^ n) (hp1 : p1 ≤ 2 ^ n)
    (hq0 : q0 ≤ 2 ^ n) (hq1 : q1 ≤ 2 ^ n)
    (ha0 : a0 ≤ 2 ^ n) (ha1 : a1 ≤ 2 ^ n)
    (hb0 : b0 ≤ 2 ^ n) (hb1 : b1 ≤ 2 ^ n)
    (hp_split : CascadeSplit n p p0 p1)
    (hq_split : CascadeSplit n q q0 q1)
    (ha_split : CascadeSplit n a a0 a1)
    (hb_split : CascadeSplit n b b0 b1) :
    max (max (H n p0) p1 + max (H n p1) p0) q +
    max (max (H n q0) q1 + max (H n q1) q0) p ≤
    max (max (H n a0) a1 + max (H n a1) a0) b +
    max (max (H n b0) b1 + max (H n b1) b0) a

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.harper_extremal_step_nested_pos
statement:
lemma harper_extremal_step_nested_pos (n : ℕ)

    {a b p q : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1)) (hb : b ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1))
    (hcasc : CascadeSplit (n + 1) (a + b) p q) :
    H (n + 1) p + H (n + 1) q ≤
      max (H (n + 1) a) b + max (H (n + 1) b) a

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.harper_gt_shadow_window_endpoints
statement:
lemma harper_gt_shadow_window_endpoints {n a b p q : ℕ}
    (hcasc : CascadeSplit (n + 1) (a + b) p q)
    (hq_pos : 1 ≤ q) (hcase : H (n + 1) b < a) :
    b ≤ q ∧ q ≤ p ∧ p ≤ a ∧ a - p = q - b

name: BooleanIsoperimetry.harper_macaulay_shadow_gt
statement:
lemma harper_macaulay_shadow_gt (n : ℕ)
    (ih : ∀ m, m < n + 1 → ∀ x y, x ≤ 2 ^ m → y ≤ 2 ^ m →

    (ha_mem : a ∈ D) (hb_mem : b ∈ D) (h_eq_mini : mini h_nonempty a = mini h_nonempty b)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (h_card : D.card = τ.card + 1)
    (h_disjoint : mSet τ D a h_nonempty ∩ mSet τ D b h_nonempty = ∅)
    (h_Ma_nonempty : (mSet τ D a h_nonempty).Nonempty)
    (h_Mb_nonempty : (mSet τ D b h_nonempty).Nonempty) :
    ∃ (σ₁ σ₂ : Finset T) (C₁ C₂ : Finset I),
      (σ₁, C₁) ≠ (σ₂, C₂) ∧
      IST.isRoom σ₁ C₁ ∧

name: Majorants.exists_majorant_p_eq_2
statement:
theorem exists_majorant_p_eq_2 (p : ℝ) (hp : p = 2) :
     ∃ u du_dx du_dy : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ∃ C : ℝ,
      0 ≤ C ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => u z.1 z.2) Set.univ ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => du_dx z.1 z.2) Set.univ ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => du_dy z.1 z.2) Set.univ ∧
      (∀ x y,
        |u x y| ≤ C * (Real.rpow |x| p + Real.rpow |y| p)) ∧
      (∀ x y,
        |du_dx x y| ≤ C * (Real.rpow |x| (p - 1) + Real.rpow |y| (p - 1))) ∧
      (∀ x y,
        |du_dy x y| ≤ C * (Real.rpow |x| (p - 1) + Real.rpow |y| (p - 1))) ∧
      (∀ x y h k, h * k ≤  0 →
          u (x + h) (y + k) ≤ u x y + du_dx x y * h + du_dy x y * k) ∧
      (∀ x y, v p x y ≤ u x y) ∧
      (∀ x y, x * y ≤ 0 → u x y ≤ 0) ∧
      (∀ x y, x*y = 0  ↔ u x y = 0)

      (∀ x y,
        |du_dx x y| ≤ C * (Real.rpow |x| (p - 1) + Real.rpow |y| (p - 1))) ∧

    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hsPos : 0 < μ s) (hsTop : μ s < ∞)
    (hf : IntegrableOn f s μ)
    (hfp : IntegrableOn (fun x => ‖f x‖ ^ p) s μ) :
    ‖⨍ x in s, f x ∂μ‖ ^ p ≤ ⨍ x in s, ‖f x‖ ^ p ∂μ

name: CKN.Foundation.Parabolic.Integration.setLaverage_abs_sub_setAverage_rpow_le
statement:
theorem setLaverage_abs_sub_setAverage_rpow_le {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} {s : Set α} {f : α → ℝ} {p c : ℝ}
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hsPos : 0 < μ s) (hsTop : μ s < ∞)
    (hf : IntegrableOn f s μ)
    (hfp : IntegrableOn (fun x => |f x - c| ^ p) s μ) :
    ⨍⁻ x in s, ‖f x - ⨍ y in s, f y ∂μ‖ₑ ^ p ∂μ ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ p * ⨍⁻ x in s, ‖f x - c‖ₑ ^ p ∂μ

name: CKN.Foundation.Parabolic.Integration.cylinder_setIntegral_comp_parabolicRescale
statement:
theorem cylinder_setIntegral_comp_parabolicRescale {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (x : Vec3) (t r : ℝ) (F : ParabolicPoint → ℝ)
    (hsource : IntegrableOn
      (fun z => F (parabolicTranslate x t (parabolicScale a z)))
      (parabolicCylinder 0 0 r) volume)
    (htarget : IntegrableOn F (parabolicCylinder x t (a * r)) volume) :
    ∫ z in parabolicCylinder 0 0 r,
        F (parabolicTranslate x t (parabolicScale a z)) =
      a⁻¹ ^ 5 * ∫ z in parabolicCylinder x t (a * r), F z

    ∫ z in parabolicCylinder 0 0 r,

    (hweak : HasWeakGradientOn U u g)

    (x : Vec3) (t r p : ℝ) (u : ParabolicPoint → ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (hsource : IntegrableOn
      (fun z => |u (parabolicTranslate x t (parabolicScale a z))| ^ p)
      (parabolicCylinder 0 0 r) volume)
    (htarget : IntegrableOn (fun z => |u z| ^ p)
      (parabolicCylinder x t (a * r)) volume) :
    cylinderPowerIntegral p
        (fun z => u (parabolicTranslate x t (parabolicScale a z)))
        ((0 : Vec3), 0) r =
      (ENNReal.ofReal a) ^ (-5 : ℝ) *
        cylinderPowerIntegral p u (x, t) (a * r)

name: CKN.Foundation.Parabolic.Morrey.cylinderPowerIntegral_translate
statement:
theorem cylinderPowerIntegral_translate {x : Vec3} {t r p : ℝ}
    (u : ParabolicPoint → ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (hsource : IntegrableOn
      (fun z => |u (parabolicTranslate x t z)| ^ p)
      (parabolicCylinder 0 0 r) volume)
    (htarget : IntegrableOn (fun z => |u z| ^ p)
      (parabolicCylinder x t r) volume) :
    cylinderPowerIntegral p (fun z => u (parabolicTranslate x t z))
        ((0 : Vec3), 0) r = cylinderPowerIntegral p u (x, t) r

name: CKN.Foundation.Parabolic.Morrey.morreyBallCell_mono

name: CKN.Foundation.Parabolic.Morrey.morreyBallNorm_mono

theorem morreyBallNorm_mono {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p)

name: CKN.Foundation.Parabolic.Morrey.morreyCell_eq
statement:
theorem morreyCell_eq (p q : ℝ) (f : ParabolicPoint → ℝ)
    (z : ParabolicPoint) (r : ℝ) :
    morreyCell p q f z r =
      (ENNReal.ofReal r) ^ (-(5 * (1 - p / q) / p)) *

name: CKN.Foundation.Parabolic.Morrey.morreyCell_mono

name: CKN.Foundation.Parabolic.Morrey.morreyNorm_mul_le
statement:
theorem morreyNorm_mul_le {p p₁ p₂ q q₁ q₂ : ℝ}
    (hp₁ : 1 ≤ p₁) (hp₂ : 1 ≤ p₂)
    (hrelp : 1 / p = 1 / p₁ + 1 / p₂)
    (hrelq : 1 / q = 1 / q₁ + 1 / q₂)
    {f g : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} (hf : AEMeasurable f volume)
    (hg : AEMeasurable g volume) :
    morreyNorm p q (fun z => f z * g z) ≤
      morreyNorm p₁ q₁ f * morreyNorm p₂ q₂ g

name: CKN.beta_sq_eq
statement:
theorem beta_sq_eq (u : ParabolicPoint → Vec3) (Du : ParabolicPoint → Fin 3 → Vec3)

    beta u Du z r ^ 2 = r⁻¹ *

        ENNReal.ofReal (spatialGradientSq u Du w)).toReal

name: CKN.delta_cube_eq
statement:
theorem delta_cube_eq (p : ParabolicPoint → ℝ) (z : ParabolicPoint) (r : ℝ)

name: CKN.lambda_pow_eq

theorem lambda_pow_eq (q : ℝ) (f : ParabolicPoint → Vec3)

theorem morreyNorm_bounded_support {p q q' : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)

    (hsupp : ∀ w ∉ parabolicCylinder z₀.1 z₀.2 R, f w = 0) :

name: CKN.Foundation.Parabolic.Morrey.morreyENorm_lintegral_le
statement:
theorem morreyENorm_lintegral_le

    {p q : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (_ : p ≤ q)
    {F : α × ParabolicPoint → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hF : AEMeasurable F (μ.prod volume)) :
    morreyENorm p q (fun z => ∫⁻ w, F (w, z) ∂μ) ≤

name: CKN.Foundation.Parabolic.Morrey.morreyENorm_parabolicConvolution_le
statement:
theorem morreyENorm_parabolicConvolution_le
    {p q : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    {K f : ParabolicPoint → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hF : AEMeasurable
      (fun wz : ParabolicPoint × ParabolicPoint =>
        K wz.1 * f (parabolicTranslate (-wz.1.1) (-wz.1.2) wz.2))
      (volume.prod volume))
    (hKtop : ∀ w, K w ≠ ∞)
    (hfinit : morreyENorm p q f ≠ ∞) :
    morreyENorm p q (parabolicConvolution K f) ≤
      (∫⁻ w, K w ∂volume) * morreyENorm p q f

name: CKN.Foundation.Parabolic.Morrey.morreyENorm_spatialConvolution_le

    (hF : AEMeasurable
      (fun yz : Vec3 × ParabolicPoint =>
        K yz.1 * f (parabolicTranslate (-yz.1) 0 yz.2))
      (volume.prod volume))
    (hKtop : ∀ y, K y ≠ ∞)
    (hfinit : morreyENorm p q f ≠ ∞) :
    morreyENorm p q (spatialConvolution K f) ≤
      (∫⁻ y, K y ∂volume) * morreyENorm p q f

name: CKN.Foundation.Parabolic.Morrey.morreyENorm_translate

name: CKN.Foundation.Parabolic.Morrey.morreyNorm_holder

theorem morreyNorm_holder {p p₁ p₂ q q₁ q₂ : ℝ}

    {f g : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} (hf : AEMeasurable f volume)

name: CKN.Foundation.Parabolic.Morrey.morreyNorm_lower_integrability

name: CKN.Core.Endgame.causal_linear_pressure_source_morrey_le
statement:
theorem causal_linear_pressure_source_morrey_le
    (q : ℝ) (KP : ℝ≥0∞) (a f : ParabolicPoint → ℝ)
    (ha : AEMeasurable a volume)
    (hf : AEMeasurable ((parabolicCylinder (0 : Vec3) 0 (5 / 8)).indicator f) volume)
    (hbound : ∀ z, z.2 ≤ 0 → |a z| ≤ 1)
    (hsupp : ∀ z, z.2 ≤ 0 → z ∉ parabolicCylinder (0 : Vec3) 0 (5 / 8) → a z = 0)
    (hN : morreyNorm (6 / 5) (min q (25 / 9 : ℝ))
      ((parabolicCylinder (0 : Vec3) 0 (5 / 8)).indicator f) ≤ KP) :
    AEMeasurable (pastMultiplierSource a f) volume ∧
      morreyNorm (6 / 5) (min q (25 / 9 : ℝ)) (pastMultiplierSource a f) ≤ KP

name: CKN.gamma_le_of_scale_normalized_interpolation
statement:
theorem gamma_le_of_scale_normalized_interpolation
    {Ω : Set Vec3} {I : Set ℝ} {q : ℝ}
    {u : ParabolicPoint → Vec3} {Du : ParabolicPoint → Fin 3 → Vec3}
    {p : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} {f : ParabolicPoint → Vec3}
    (_ : IsSuitableWeakSolutionIntegrable Ω I q u Du p f)
    {z : ParabolicPoint} {r C : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (_ : closure (parabolicCylinder z.1 z.2 (2 * r)) ⊆ spaceTimeSet Ω I)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hα : 0 ≤ alpha u z (2 * r)) (hβ : 0 ≤ beta u Du z (2 * r))
    (hfinite :
      (∫⁻ w in parabolicCylinder z.1 z.2 r,
        ENNReal.ofReal (vec3EuclideanNorm (u w)) ^ (3 : ℝ)) ≠ ⊤)
    (hinterpolation :
      (∫⁻ w in parabolicCylinder z.1 z.2 r,
        ENNReal.ofReal (vec3EuclideanNorm (u w)) ^ (3 : ℝ)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (2 : ℝ) *
          (C * alpha u z (2 * r) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * beta u Du z (2 * r) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) +
            C * alpha u z (2 * r)) ^ (3 : ℝ))) :
    gamma u z r ≤
      C * alpha u z (2 * r) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * beta u Du z (2 * r) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) +
        C * alpha u z (2 * r)

        ENNReal.ofReal (vec3EuclideanNorm (f z)) ^ q) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε₀) :
    ∀ i : Fin 3, AEMeasurable (causalForceComponent φ f i) volume ∧
      morreyNorm (6 / 5 : ℝ) (min q (25 / 9 : ℝ)) (causalForceComponent φ f i) ≤
        forceSourceMorreyBound q ε₀

    (hae : ∀ i, w i =ᵐ[volume.restrict (U i)] u)
    (hVU : V ⊆ ⋃ i, U i)
    (hclose : ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ y ∈ V, parabolicDist x y < δ →
      ∃ i, x ∈ U i ∧ y ∈ U i) :
    ∃ g : ParabolicPoint → Vec3, g =ᵐ[volume.restrict V] u ∧
      ParabolicHolderVecNormLE V g γ (C + max C (2 * C / δ ^ γ)) ∧

    (ENNReal.ofReal (2 * A₁ / t) * H + ENNReal.ofReal (4 * A₂ ^ 2 / t ^ 2) * L) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (p * t ^ (p - 1)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal p *
        (ENNReal.ofReal (2 * A₁) * (ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (p - 2)) * H) +

statement:
lemma tail_bound {T : (Vec3 → ℝ) → (Vec3 → ℝ)} {A₁ A₂ : ℝ}
    (hTsub : ∀ f g (x : Vec3), |T (f + g) x| ≤ |T f x| + |T g x|)
    (hTmeas : ∀ f, Measurable f → Measurable (T f))
    (hweak : ∀ f, Measurable f → ∀ l : ℝ, 0 < l →
      volume {x | l < |T f x|} ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal A₁ * (∫⁻ x, absE f x) / ENNReal.ofReal l)
    (hstrong : ∀ f, Measurable f →
      ∫⁻ x, absE (T f) x ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (A₂ ^ 2) * ∫⁻ x, absE f x ^ 2)
    {f : Vec3 → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    volume {x | t < |T f x|} ≤
      (ENNReal.ofReal (2 * A₁ / t) *
          ∫⁻ x in absE f ⁻¹' Ioi (ENNReal.ofReal (t / 2)), absE f x) +
        (ENNReal.ofReal (4 * A₂ ^ 2 / t ^ 2) *
          ∫⁻ x in absE f ⁻¹' Iic (ENNReal.ofReal (t / 2)), absE f x ^ 2)

name: CKN.Foundation.Euclidean.weighted_combined
statement:
lemma weighted_combined {N : Vec3 → ℝ≥0∞} (hN : Measurable N) (hNfin : ∀ x, N x < ∞)
    {A₁ A₂ p : ℝ} (hA₁ : 0 ≤ A₁) (hp1 : 1 < p) (hp2 : p < 2) :
    (∫⁻ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (2 * A₁) *
        (ENNReal.ofReal (rpowExt (p - 2) t) * highTail N t)) +
      (∫⁻ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (4 * A₂ ^ 2) *
        (ENNReal.ofReal (rpowExt (p - 3) t) * lowTail N t)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ p * (A₁ / (p - 1) + A₂ ^ 2 / (2 - p))) * ∫⁻ x, N x ^ p

    ∫⁻ x, absE (T f) x ^ p ≤

        ∫⁻ x, absE f x ^ p

    (hTsub : ∀ f g (x : Vec3), |T (f + g) x| ≤ |T f x| + |T g x|)

name: CKN.Foundation.Euclidean.interpolation_weak11_strong22_threeHalves

    (hTsub : ∀ f g (x : Vec3), |T (f + g) x| ≤ |T f x| + |T g x|)

statement:
theorem iteration_normalized_bound
    {T L Θ : ℕ → ℝ} {κ ε η C₂₇ C₂₈ C₂₉ Λ₀ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hC₂₇ : 0 ≤ C₂₇) (hC₂₈ : 0 ≤ C₂₈)
    (hA : C₂₇ * κ ^ (2 / 3 - ε) ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ))
    (hB : 2 * C₂₇ * κ ^ (-5 - ε) * η ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ))
    (hC₂₉ : C₂₉ = 2 * C₂₈ ^ 2 * κ ^ (-1 - 2 * ε)
      + C₂₈ * κ ^ (-3 - ε))
    (hC₂₉_nonneg : 0 ≤ C₂₉) (hΛ : C₂₉ * Λ₀ ≤ η / 2)
    (hT₀ : T 0 ≤ η) (hT_nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ T n)
    (hΘ_nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ Θ n) (hΘ_le : ∀ n, Θ n ≤ η)
    (hL_nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ L n) (hL_le : ∀ n, L n ≤ Λ₀)
    (hrec : ∀ n, T (n + 1) ≤
      C₂₇ * κ ^ (2 / 3 - ε) * T n
        + 2 * C₂₇ * κ ^ (-5 - ε) * Θ n ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * T n
        + C₂₈ * κ ^ (-1 / 2 - ε) * T n ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * L n ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
        + C₂₈ * κ ^ (-3 - ε) * L n) :
    ∀ n, T n ≤ η

name: CKN.theta_intermediate_scale_bound
statement:
theorem theta_intermediate_scale_bound
    (κ ε η r₅ r : ℝ) (u : ParabolicPoint → Vec3)
    (Du : ParabolicPoint → Fin 3 → Vec3) (p : ParabolicPoint → ℝ)
    (z : ParabolicPoint) {n : ℕ}
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκle : κ ≤ 1) (hε : 0 < ε) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hr₅ : 0 < r₅) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hinterval₁ : κ ^ (n + 1) * r₅ < r)
    (hinterval₂ : r ≤ κ ^ n * r₅)
    (hdisc : theta κ u Du p z (κ ^ n * r₅) ≤ η * κ ^ ((n : ℝ) * ε))
    (hα : timeSliceEnergyEssSup z.1 z.2 (κ ^ n * r₅)
      (fun w => vec3EuclideanNorm (u w)) ≠ ⊤)
    (hβ : (∫⁻ w in parabolicCylinder z.1 z.2 (κ ^ n * r₅),
      ENNReal.ofReal (spatialGradientSq u Du w)) ≠ ⊤)
    (hδ : (∫⁻ w in parabolicCylinder z.1 z.2 (κ ^ n * r₅),
      ENNReal.ofReal |p w| ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) ≠ ⊤) :
    max (max (alpha u z r) (beta u Du z r)) (delta p z r ^ 2) ≤
        theta κ u Du p z r ∧
      theta κ u Du p z r ≤
        κ ^ (-4 / 3 - ε) * η * r₅ ^ (-ε) * r ^ ε

    (κ : ℝ) (u : ParabolicPoint → Vec3) (Du : ParabolicPoint → Fin 3 → Vec3)

    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκle : κ ≤ 1) (hr : 0 < r) (hrr : r ≤ ρ)

    {z₀ : ParabolicPoint}
    {F : ParabolicPoint → Vec3} {G : Fin 3 → ParabolicPoint → Vec3}
    (hF : ∀ i, morreyNorm (6 / 5 : ℝ) (min q (25 / 9 : ℝ))
      (fun z => F z i) ≤ KF)
    (hG : ∀ j i, morreyNorm (6 / 5 : ℝ) (25 / 3 : ℝ)
      (fun z => G j z i) ≤ KG)

name: CKN.thetaDecay_algebra
statement:
theorem thetaDecay_algebra
    {κ C₉ C₁₄ C₁₅ C₂₅ C₂₆ α β γ δ lam αr βr δr : ℝ}
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκhalf : κ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hC₉ : 0 ≤ C₉)
    (hC₂₅ : 0 ≤ C₂₅) (hC₂₆ : 0 ≤ C₂₆)
    (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (hδr : 0 ≤ δr)
    (hA : αr + βr ≤ C₂₅ * κ * α
        + C₂₅ * κ⁻¹ * Real.sqrt α * Real.sqrt β * Real.sqrt γ
        + C₂₅ * κ⁻¹ * δ * Real.sqrt γ
        + C₂₆ * κ ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt γ * Real.sqrt lam)
    (hB : δr ≤ C₁₄ * κ ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt α * Real.sqrt β
        + C₁₄ * κ ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * δ
        + C₁₅ * κ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt lam)
    (hC : γ ≤ C₉ * Real.sqrt α * Real.sqrt β + C₉ * α) :
    thetaValue κ αr βr δr ≤
      thetaDecayC₂₇ C₉ C₁₄ C₂₅ * κ ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * thetaValue κ α β δ
        + thetaDecayC₂₇ C₉ C₁₄ C₂₅ * κ ^ (-5 : ℝ)
            * (Real.sqrt β + β) * thetaValue κ α β δ
        + thetaDecayC₂₈ C₉ C₁₅ C₂₆ * κ ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ)
            * Real.sqrt (thetaValue κ α β δ) * Real.sqrt lam
        + thetaDecayC₂₈ C₉ C₁₅ C₂₆ * κ ^ (-3 : ℝ) * lam

name: CKN.thetaDecay_algebra_small
statement:
theorem thetaDecay_algebra_small
    {κ C₉ C₁₄ C₁₅ C₂₅ C₂₆ α β γ δ lam αr βr δr : ℝ}
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκhalf : κ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hC₉ : 0 ≤ C₉)
    (hC₂₅ : 0 ≤ C₂₅) (hC₂₆ : 0 ≤ C₂₆)
    (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (hδr : 0 ≤ δr)
    (hθ : thetaValue κ α β δ ≤ 1)
    (hA : αr + βr ≤ C₂₅ * κ * α
        + C₂₅ * κ⁻¹ * Real.sqrt α * Real.sqrt β * Real.sqrt γ
        + C₂₅ * κ⁻¹ * δ * Real.sqrt γ
        + C₂₆ * κ ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt γ * Real.sqrt lam)
    (hB : δr ≤ C₁₄ * κ ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt α * Real.sqrt β
        + C₁₄ * κ ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * δ
        + C₁₅ * κ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt lam)
    (hC : γ ≤ C₉ * Real.sqrt α * Real.sqrt β + C₉ * α) :
    thetaValue κ αr βr δr ≤
      thetaDecayC₂₇ C₉ C₁₄ C₂₅ * κ ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * thetaValue κ α β δ
        + 2 * thetaDecayC₂₇ C₉ C₁₄ C₂₅ * κ ^ (-5 : ℝ)
            * Real.sqrt (thetaValue κ α β δ) * thetaValue κ α β δ
        + thetaDecayC₂₈ C₉ C₁₅ C₂₆ * κ ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ)
            * Real.sqrt (thetaValue κ α β δ) * Real.sqrt lam
        + thetaDecayC₂₈ C₉ C₁₅ C₂₆ * κ ^ (-3 : ℝ) * lam

name: CKN.iteration_of_thetaDecay
statement:
theorem iteration_of_thetaDecay
    {Ω : Set Vec3} {I : Set ℝ} {q : ℝ}
    {u : ParabolicPoint → Vec3} {Du : ParabolicPoint → Fin 3 → Vec3}
    {p : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} {f : ParabolicPoint → Vec3}
    (hsol : IsSuitableWeakSolutionIntegrable Ω I q u Du p f)
    {z : ParabolicPoint} {r₅ C₂₇ C₂₈ : ℝ}
    (hC₂₇ : 0 < C₂₇) (hC₂₈ : 0 < C₂₈) (hr₅ : 0 < r₅)
    (hz : closure (parabolicCylinder z.1 z.2 r₅) ⊆ spaceTimeSet Ω I)
    (hθ₅ : theta (iterationKappa C₂₇) u Du p z r₅ ≤ iterationEta C₂₇)
    (hLam₅ : lambda q f z r₅ ≤ iterationLambda₀ C₂₇ C₂₈)
    (hThetaDecay : ∀ {w : ParabolicPoint} {ρ : ℝ}, 0 < ρ →
      closure (parabolicCylinder w.1 w.2 ρ) ⊆ spaceTimeSet Ω I →
      theta (iterationKappa C₂₇) u Du p w (iterationKappa C₂₇ * ρ) ≤
        C₂₇ * iterationKappa C₂₇ ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * theta (iterationKappa C₂₇) u Du p w ρ +
          C₂₇ * iterationKappa C₂₇ ^ (-5 : ℝ) *
            (beta u Du w ρ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + beta u Du w ρ) *
              theta (iterationKappa C₂₇) u Du p w ρ +
          C₂₈ * iterationKappa C₂₇ ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) *
            theta (iterationKappa C₂₇) u Du p w ρ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
              lambda q f w ρ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) +
          C₂₈ * iterationKappa C₂₇ ^ (-3 : ℝ) * lambda q f w ρ ∧
      (theta (iterationKappa C₂₇) u Du p w ρ ≤ 1 →
        theta (iterationKappa C₂₇) u Du p w (iterationKappa C₂₇ * ρ) ≤
          C₂₇ * iterationKappa C₂₇ ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) *
              theta (iterationKappa C₂₇) u Du p w ρ +
            2 * C₂₇ * iterationKappa C₂₇ ^ (-5 : ℝ) *
              theta (iterationKappa C₂₇) u Du p w ρ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
                theta (iterationKappa C₂₇) u Du p w ρ +
            C₂₈ * iterationKappa C₂₇ ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) *
              theta (iterationKappa C₂₇) u Du p w ρ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
                lambda q f w ρ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) +
            C₂₈ * iterationKappa C₂₇ ^ (-3 : ℝ) * lambda q f w ρ)) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, theta (iterationKappa C₂₇) u Du p z
        (iterationKappa C₂₇ ^ n * r₅) ≤
      iterationEta C₂₇ * iterationKappa C₂₇ ^ ((n : ℝ) * iterationEpsilon)) ∧
    (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ r₅ →
      theta (iterationKappa C₂₇) u Du p z r ≤
        iterationKappa C₂₇ ^ (-4 / 3 - iterationEpsilon) *
          iterationEta C₂₇ * r₅ ^ (-iterationEpsilon) * r ^ iterationEpsilon)

name: CKN.Core.Step4.morreyNorm_one_sided_indicator_le_of_carrier_cells

theorem morreyNorm_one_sided_indicator_le_of_carrier_cells

    (hglobal : (∫⁻ w in parabolicCylinder (0 : Vec3) 0 a,
      ENNReal.ofReal |g w| ^ P) ≤ B) :

    {p : ParabolicPoint → ℝ}
    (hdom : closure (parabolicCylinder (0 : Vec3) 0 1) ⊆ CKN.spaceTimeSet Ω I)
    (hp : ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict I),
      LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x => p (x, t)) (vec3Ball (0 : Vec3) R₀) volume)
    (hslice : ∀ k : Fin 3, ∀ (c : Vec3) (t₀ ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ →

      ∀ᵐ s ∂(volume.restrict (Ioc (t₀ - ρ ^ 2) t₀)), ∃ g : Vec3 → ℝ,
        LocallyIntegrableOn g (euclideanBall c (ρ / 2)) volume ∧
        HasWeakPartialDerivOn (euclideanBall c (ρ / 2)) k (fun x => p (x, s)) g) :
    ∀ k : Fin 3, ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict I), ∃ g : Vec3 → ℝ,
      LocallyIntegrableOn g (vec3Ball (0 : Vec3) R₀) volume ∧
      HasWeakPartialDerivOn (vec3Ball (0 : Vec3) R₀) k (fun x => p (x, t)) g

name: CKN.Core.Step4.cylinderPowerIntegral_growth_of_large_cell
statement:
theorem cylinderPowerIntegral_growth_of_large_cell
    {f : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} {B : ℝ≥0∞} {P κ r₀ : ℝ}
    (hP : 0 < P) (hPκ : P ≤ κ) (hr₀ : 0 < r₀)
    {z : ParabolicPoint} {r : ℝ} (hr : r₀ ≤ r)
    (hB : cylinderPowerIntegral P f z r ≤ B) :
    cylinderPowerIntegral P f z r ≤
      (B * ENNReal.ofReal (r₀ ^ (-(5 * (1 - P / κ))))) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (5 * (1 - P / κ)))

name: CKN.Core.Step4.cylinderPowerIntegral_growth_two_regimes
statement:
theorem cylinderPowerIntegral_growth_two_regimes
    {S : Set ParabolicPoint} (hS : MeasurableSet S)
    {f : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} (hvan : ∀ w, w ∉ S → f w = 0)
    {A B : ℝ≥0∞} {P κ r₀ : ℝ}
    (hP : 0 < P) (hPκ : P ≤ κ) (hr₀ : 0 < r₀)
    (hglobal : (∫⁻ w in S, ENNReal.ofReal |f w| ^ P) ≤ B)
    (hsmall : ∀ (z : ParabolicPoint) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → r ≤ r₀ →
      cylinderPowerIntegral P f z r ≤
        A * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (5 * (1 - P / κ)))) :
    ∀ (z : ParabolicPoint) (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
      cylinderPowerIntegral P f z r ≤
        (A + B * ENNReal.ofReal (r₀ ^ (-(5 * (1 - P / κ))))) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (5 * (1 - P / κ)))

name: CKN.Core.Step4.cylinderPowerIntegral_indicator_eq_zero_of_disjoint

name: CKN.Core.Step4.morreyCell_le_of_cylinderPowerIntegral_growth

theorem morreyCell_le_of_cylinderPowerIntegral_growth
    {P κ : ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0∞} {f : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} {z : ParabolicPoint} {r : ℝ}

statement:
theorem morreyCell_le_two_regimes
    {S : Set ParabolicPoint} (hS : MeasurableSet S)
    {f : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} (hvan : ∀ w, w ∉ S → f w = 0)
    {A B : ℝ≥0∞} {P κ r₀ : ℝ}
    (hP : 0 < P) (hPκ : P ≤ κ) (hr₀ : 0 < r₀)
    (hglobal : (∫⁻ w in S, ENNReal.ofReal |f w| ^ P) ≤ B)

name: CKN.Core.Step4.cylinderPowerIntegral_eq_lintegral_slices
statement:
theorem cylinderPowerIntegral_eq_lintegral_slices

    (hmeas : AEMeasurable g (volume.restrict (parabolicCylinder x t r))) :
    cylinderPowerIntegral P g (x, t) r =
      ∫⁻ s in Set.Ioc (t - r ^ 2) t,
        ∫⁻ y in vec3Ball x r, ENNReal.ofReal |g (y, s)| ^ P

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_remainder_cylinder_power_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_remainder_cylinder_power_bound
    {F : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} {H : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hF : AEMeasurable F volume) (hH : AEMeasurable H volume)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume, ∀ x : Vec3, ‖F (x, s)‖ₑ ≤ H s)
    {x : Vec3} {t r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    cylinderPowerIntegral (6 / 5 : ℝ) F (x, t) r ≤
      volume (vec3Ball x r) *
        (∫⁻ s, H s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) *
          ENNReal.ofReal r ^ (2 / 5 : ℝ)

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_remainder_morreyCell_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_remainder_morreyCell_bound
    {κ : ℝ} {F : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} {H : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hF : AEMeasurable F volume) (hH : AEMeasurable H volume)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume, ∀ x : Vec3, ‖F (x, s)‖ₑ ≤ H s)
    {z : ParabolicPoint} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    morreyCell (6 / 5 : ℝ) κ F z r ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * 4 / 3) ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ) *
        (∫⁻ s, H s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) *
          ENNReal.ofReal r ^ (5 / κ - 4 / 3)

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_remainder_time_power_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_remainder_time_power_bound
    {H : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hH : AEMeasurable H volume)
    {t r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (∫⁻ s in Ioc (t - r ^ 2) t, H s ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ)) ≤
      (∫⁻ s, H s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) *
        ENNReal.ofReal r ^ (2 / 5 : ℝ)

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_remainder_indicator_morreyNorm_lt_top
statement:
theorem pressure_remainder_indicator_morreyNorm_lt_top
    {κ : ℝ} (hκlo : 3 / 2 ≤ κ) (hκhi : κ ≤ 25 / 9)
    {F : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} {H : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞}
    {A : Set ParabolicPoint} {S : Set Vec3}
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hAS : ∀ z ∈ A, z.1 ∈ S)
    (hF : AEMeasurable F (volume.restrict A)) (hH : AEMeasurable H volume)
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) (hSfinite : volume S < ⊤)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume, ∀ x : Vec3, (x, s) ∈ A → ‖F (x, s)‖ₑ ≤ H s)
    (hHfinite : (∫⁻ s, H s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) < ⊤) :
    morreyNorm (6 / 5 : ℝ) κ (A.indicator F) < ⊤

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_remainder_morreyNorm_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_remainder_morreyNorm_bound
    {κ : ℝ} (hκlo : 3 / 2 ≤ κ) (hκhi : κ ≤ 25 / 9)
    {F : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} {H : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} {S : Set Vec3}
    (hF : AEMeasurable F volume) (hH : AEMeasurable H volume)
    (hS : MeasurableSet S)
    (hsupport : ∀ x ∉ S, ∀ t : ℝ, F (x, t) = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume, ∀ x : Vec3, ‖F (x, s)‖ₑ ≤ H s) :
    morreyNorm (6 / 5 : ℝ) κ F ≤
      (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * 4 / 3) ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ) + volume S ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ)) *
        (∫⁻ s, H s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_remainder_morreyNorm_lt_top
statement:
theorem pressure_remainder_morreyNorm_lt_top
    {κ : ℝ} (hκlo : 3 / 2 ≤ κ) (hκhi : κ ≤ 25 / 9)
    {F : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} {H : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} {S : Set Vec3}
    (hF : AEMeasurable F volume) (hH : AEMeasurable H volume)
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) (hSfinite : volume S < ⊤)
    (hsupport : ∀ x ∉ S, ∀ t : ℝ, F (x, t) = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume, ∀ x : Vec3, ‖F (x, s)‖ₑ ≤ H s)
    (hHfinite : (∫⁻ s, H s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) < ⊤) :
    morreyNorm (6 / 5 : ℝ) κ F < ⊤

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_remainder_supported_cylinder_power_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_remainder_supported_cylinder_power_bound
    {F : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} {H : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} {S : Set Vec3}
    (hF : AEMeasurable F volume) (hH : AEMeasurable H volume)
    (hS : MeasurableSet S)
    (hsupport : ∀ x ∉ S, ∀ t : ℝ, F (x, t) = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume, ∀ x : Vec3, ‖F (x, s)‖ₑ ≤ H s)
    {x : Vec3} {t r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    cylinderPowerIntegral (6 / 5 : ℝ) F (x, t) r ≤
      volume S * (∫⁻ s, H s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) *
        ENNReal.ofReal r ^ (2 / 5 : ℝ)

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_remainder_supported_morreyCell_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_remainder_supported_morreyCell_bound
    {κ : ℝ} {F : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} {H : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} {S : Set Vec3}
    (hF : AEMeasurable F volume) (hH : AEMeasurable H volume)
    (hS : MeasurableSet S)
    (hsupport : ∀ x ∉ S, ∀ t : ℝ, F (x, t) = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume, ∀ x : Vec3, ‖F (x, s)‖ₑ ≤ H s)
    {z : ParabolicPoint} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    morreyCell (6 / 5 : ℝ) κ F z r ≤
      volume S ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ) * (∫⁻ s, H s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) *
        ENNReal.ofReal r ^ (5 / κ - 23 / 6)

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_source_cylinder_power_root_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_source_cylinder_power_root_bound
    {κ : ℝ} (F : ParabolicPoint → ℝ) (z : ParabolicPoint)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    cylinderPowerIntegral (6 / 5 : ℝ) F z ρ ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ (25 / 6 - 5 / κ) * morreyNorm (6 / 5 : ℝ) κ F

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_source_exterior_mass_time_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_source_exterior_mass_time_bound
    {κ : ℝ} {F : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} (hF : AEMeasurable F volume)
    {x : Vec3} {t r ρ : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrρ : r ≤ ρ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ (-3 : ℝ) *
        (∫⁻ s in Ioc (t - r ^ 2) t,
          (∫⁻ y in vec3Ball x ρ, ‖F (y, s)‖ₑ) ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ)) ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * 4 / 3) ^ (1 / 6 : ℝ) *
        ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ (5 / 3 - 5 / κ) * morreyNorm (6 / 5 : ℝ) κ F

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_source_spatial_mass_power_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_source_spatial_mass_power_bound
    {G : Vec3 → ℝ} {B : Set Vec3}
    (hG : AEMeasurable G (volume.restrict B)) :
    (∫⁻ y in B, ‖G y‖ₑ) ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) ≤
      volume B ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) * ∫⁻ y in B, ‖G y‖ₑ ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ)

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_source_spatial_mass_time_power_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_source_spatial_mass_time_power_bound
    {F : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} (hF : AEMeasurable F volume)
    {x : Vec3} {t r ρ : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrρ : r ≤ ρ) :
    (∫⁻ s in Ioc (t - r ^ 2) t,
      (∫⁻ y in vec3Ball x ρ, ‖F (y, s)‖ₑ) ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ)) ≤
      volume (vec3Ball x ρ) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) *
        cylinderPowerIntegral (6 / 5 : ℝ) F (x, t) ρ

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_source_dyadic_constant_lt_top
statement:
theorem pressure_source_dyadic_constant_lt_top :
    (1 - (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-2 / 15 : ℝ))⁻¹ < ⊤

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_source_dyadic_ratio_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_source_dyadic_ratio_bound
    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκhi : κ ≤ 25 / 9) :
    (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (5 / 3 - 5 / κ) ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-2 / 15 : ℝ) ∧
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-2 / 15 : ℝ) < 1

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_source_dyadic_sum_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_source_dyadic_sum_bound
    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκhi : κ ≤ 25 / 9) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (5 / 3 - 5 / κ)) ^ n) ≤
      (1 - (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-2 / 15 : ℝ))⁻¹

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_source_exterior_scale_sum_time_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_source_exterior_scale_sum_time_bound
    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκhi : κ ≤ 25 / 9)
    {F : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} (hF : AEMeasurable F volume)
    (x : Vec3) (t : ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (N : ℕ) :
    (∫⁻ s in Ioc (t - r ^ 2) t,
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
        ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * r) ^ (-3 : ℝ) *
          ∫⁻ y in vec3Ball x ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * r), ‖F (y, s)‖ₑ) ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ)) ^
            (5 / 6 : ℝ) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * 4 / 3) ^ (1 / 6 : ℝ) *
        ENNReal.ofReal r ^ (5 / 3 - 5 / κ) * morreyNorm (6 / 5 : ℝ) κ F *
          (1 - (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-2 / 15 : ℝ))⁻¹

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_source_spatial_mass_aemeasurable
statement:
theorem pressure_source_spatial_mass_aemeasurable

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_time_finite_sum_bound
statement:
theorem pressure_time_finite_sum_bound
    {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) {μ : Measure ℝ} {M : ι → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hM : ∀ n ∈ S, AEMeasurable (M n) μ) :
    (∫⁻ s, (∑ n ∈ S, M n s) ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) ∂μ) ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ n ∈ S, (∫⁻ s, M n s ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) ∂μ) ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ)

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_time_power_norm_const_mul
statement:
theorem pressure_time_power_norm_const_mul
    {μ : Measure ℝ} {M : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hM : AEMeasurable M μ) (c : ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∫⁻ s, (c * M s) ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) ∂μ) ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ) =
      c * (∫⁻ s, M s ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) ∂μ) ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ)

name: CKN.Core.Step4.morreyCell_ball_le_of_large_radius
statement:
theorem morreyCell_ball_le_of_large_radius
    {p q r₀ r R : ℝ} {f : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} (z₀ : ParabolicPoint)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hr₀ : 0 < r₀) (hr : r₀ ≤ r)
    (z : ParabolicPoint) :
    morreyCell p q ((Metric.ball z₀ R).indicator f) z r ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (r₀ ^ (-(5 * (1 - p / q) / p))) *
        (∫⁻ w in Metric.ball z₀ R, ENNReal.ofReal |f w| ^ p) ^ (1 / p)

name: CKN.Core.Step4.morreyCell_indicator_le_carrier_integral_of_large_radius
statement:
theorem morreyCell_indicator_le_carrier_integral_of_large_radius
    {p q r₀ r : ℝ} {f : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} {S : Set ParabolicPoint}

    (hr₀ : 0 < r₀) (hr : r₀ ≤ r) (z : ParabolicPoint) :

name: CKN.Core.Step4.morreyCell_origin_cylinder_le_of_large_radius

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_gradient_ball_large_cell_le
statement:
theorem pressure_gradient_ball_large_cell_le
    {κ r₀ r R : ℝ} {f : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} (z₀ : ParabolicPoint)

name: CKN.Core.Step4.pressure_gradient_origin_cylinder_large_cell_le

name: CKN.Core.Step4.lintegral_mul_six_fifths_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_mul_six_fifths_le
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α} {a b : α → ℝ≥0∞}
    (ha : AEMeasurable a μ) (hb : AEMeasurable b μ) :
    (∫⁻ x, (a x * b x) ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) ∂μ) ≤
      (∫⁻ x, a x ^ (3 : ℝ) ∂μ) ^ (2 / 5 : ℝ) *
        (∫⁻ x, b x ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂μ) ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ)

name: CKN.Core.Step4.lintegral_rpow_le_measure_add_lintegral_rpow
statement:
theorem lintegral_rpow_le_measure_add_lintegral_rpow
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    (h : α → ℝ≥0∞) {r t : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrt : r ≤ t) :
    (∫⁻ x, h x ^ r ∂μ) ≤ μ Set.univ + ∫⁻ x, h x ^ t ∂μ

name: CKN.Core.Step4.rpow_mul_rpow_le_add
statement:
theorem rpow_mul_rpow_le_add (x y : ℝ≥0∞) {θ : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ θ) (h1 : θ ≤ 1) :
    x ^ θ * y ^ (1 - θ) ≤ x + y

name: CKN.Core.Step4.slice_majorant_time_mass_le
statement:
theorem slice_majorant_time_mass_le
    {J : Set ℝ} {M a d F : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} {c₁ c₂ c₃ : ℝ≥0∞} {qq : ℝ}
    (ha : AEMeasurable a (volume.restrict J)) (hd : AEMeasurable d (volume.restrict J))
    (hF : AEMeasurable F (volume.restrict J)) (hq : 6 / 5 ≤ qq)
    (hM : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict J,
      M s ≤ c₁ * (a s * d s) + c₂ * a s ^ (2 : ℝ) + c₃ * F s)
    {Ea Ed Ef : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hEa : (∫⁻ s in J, a s ^ (3 : ℝ)) ≤ Ea)
    (hEd : (∫⁻ s in J, d s ^ (2 : ℝ)) ≤ Ed)
    (hEf : (∫⁻ s in J, F s ^ qq) ≤ Ef) :
    (∫⁻ s in J, M s ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ)) ≤
      4 * (c₁ ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) * (Ea + Ed) +
        c₂ ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) * (volume J + Ea) +
        c₃ ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) * (volume J + Ef))

name: CKN.Core.Step4.three_add_rpow_six_fifths_le
statement:
theorem three_add_rpow_six_fifths_le (a b c : ℝ≥0∞) :
    (a + b + c) ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * (a ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) + b ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) + c ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ))

name: CKN.Core.Step4.OriginInstance.exists_compact_ordConnected_exhaustion
statement:
theorem exists_compact_ordConnected_exhaustion {I : Set ℝ}
    (hopen : IsOpen I) (hord : I.OrdConnected) :
    ∃ J : ℕ → Set ℝ,
      Monotone J ∧
      (∀ n, (J n).OrdConnected) ∧
      (∀ n, IsCompact (J n)) ∧
      (∀ n, J n ⊆ I) ∧
      (⋃ n, J n) = I ∧
      (∀ T : Set ℝ, IsCompact T → T ⊆ I → ∃ n, T ⊆ J n)

name: CKN.Core.Step4.originClauseTimeExhaustion
statement:
theorem originClauseTimeExhaustion {I : Set ℝ}
    (hopen : IsOpen I) (hord : I.OrdConnected) :
    ∃ J : ℕ → Set ℝ,
      Monotone J ∧
      (∀ n, (J n).OrdConnected) ∧
      (∀ n, IsCompact (J n)) ∧
      (∀ n, J n ⊆ I) ∧
      (⋃ n, J n) = I ∧
      (∀ T : Set ℝ, IsCompact T → T ⊆ I → ∃ n, T ⊆ J n)

name: CKN.Core.Step4.prodPowerIntegral_eq_lintegral_slices
statement:
theorem prodPowerIntegral_eq_lintegral_slices

name: CKN.Core.Step4.routeA_uniform_kappa_mono

name: CKN.Core.Step4.halfBall_volume_rpow_five_sixths_mul_inv_cube_le

name: CKN.Foundation.Euclidean.mem_dyadicCube
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_dyadicCube {k : ℤ} {a : DyadicCorner} {x : Vec3} :
    x ∈ dyadicCube k a ↔
      ∀ i, (a i : ℝ) * dyadicScale k ≤ x i ∧
        x i < ((a i : ℝ) + 1) * dyadicScale k

name: CKN.Foundation.Euclidean.volume_dyadicCube

CKN.Foundation.Euclidean.dyadicMaximalCubes_spec
statement:
theorem dyadicMaximalCubes_spec
    {F : Vec3 → ℝ} (hF : Integrable F) {height : ℝ} (hheight : 0 < height) :
    let D := dyadicMaximalCubes F height
    D.Countable ∧
      D.Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint dyadicCubeSet) ∧
      (∀ Q ∈ D, height < dyadicAbsAverage F Q) ∧
      (∀ Q ∈ D, dyadicAbsAverage F Q ≤ 8 * height) ∧
      (∀ Q ∈ D, dyadicAbsAverage F (dyadicParent Q) ≤ height) ∧
      ((∑' Q : {Q // Q ∈ D}, volume (dyadicCubeSet Q.1)) ≤
        dyadicL1Norm F / ENNReal.ofReal height) ∧
      (∀ᵐ x ∂volume,
        x ∉ ⋃ Q ∈ D, dyadicCubeSet Q → |F x| ≤ height) ∧
      (∀ᵐ x ∂volume,
        |dyadicGoodPart F D x| ≤ 8 * height)

theorem rieszPotentialOne_far_le
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) {f : Vec3 → ℝ}
    (hf : AEMeasurable f volume) (z : Vec3) :
    (∫⁻ w in {w | R ≤ dist z w},
      rieszKernelOne z w * ENNReal.ofReal |f w|) ≤
      hedbergFarConstant * (ENNReal.ofReal R) ^ (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) *
        (∫⁻ w, ENNReal.ofReal |f w| ^ (5 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (2 / 5 : ℝ)

name: CKN.Foundation.Euclidean.rieszPotentialOne_hedberg
statement:
theorem rieszPotentialOne_hedberg
    {f : Vec3 → ℝ} (hf : AEMeasurable f volume)
    {M : Vec3 → ℝ≥0∞} (hM : IsMaximalMajorant f M) (z : Vec3)
    (hM0 : M z ≠ 0) (hMtop : M z ≠ ∞)
    (hB0 : (∫⁻ w, ENNReal.ofReal |f w| ^ (5 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (2 / 5 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
    (hBtop : (∫⁻ w, ENNReal.ofReal |f w| ^ (5 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (2 / 5 : ℝ) ≠ ∞) :
    rieszPotentialOne f z ≤
      (hedbergNearConstant + hedbergFarConstant) *
        M z ^ (1 / 6 : ℝ) *
        (∫⁻ w, ENNReal.ofReal |f w| ^ (5 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ)

name: CKN.Foundation.Euclidean.rieszPotentialOne_near_le
statement:

name: CKN.Foundation.Euclidean.rieszPotentialOne_scale_le
statement:

      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j K z‖ ≤ C j * (vec3EuclideanNorm z ^ (m + j))⁻¹)
    (hg : Integrable g volume) (hU : IsOpen U) (hg0 : ∀ y : Vec3, y ∉ A → g y = 0)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hsep : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ A, δ ≤ vec3EuclideanNorm (x - y)) (k : ℕ)
    {x : Vec3} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (kernelPotential K g) x‖ ≤
      C k * (δ ^ (m + k))⁻¹ * ∫ y : Vec3, ‖g y‖

lemma spatialDeriv_mul {f g : Vec3 → ℝ} {x : Vec3}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) (i : Fin 3) :
    spatialDeriv (fun y => f y * g y) i x =

name: CKN.spatialLaplacian_mul_smooth

theorem spatialLaplacian_mul_smooth {η φ : Vec3 → ℝ}
    (hη : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) η) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ) :
    spatialLaplacian (fun x => η x * φ x)
      = fun x => η x * spatialLaplacian φ x + 2 * spatialGradDot η φ x
          + φ x * spatialLaplacian η x

name: CKN.spatialSecondDeriv_mul_smooth
statement:
theorem spatialSecondDeriv_mul_smooth {η φ : Vec3 → ℝ}
    (hη : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) η) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ) (i j : Fin 3) (x : Vec3) :
    mixedSecond (fun y => η y * φ y) i j x =
      mixedSecond η i j x * φ x
      + spatialDeriv η j x * spatialDeriv φ i x
      + spatialDeriv η i x * spatialDeriv φ j x
      + η x * mixedSecond φ i j x

name: CKN.slice_divergence_zero_of_mollifier_family
statement:
theorem slice_divergence_zero_of_mollifier_family {d : ℕ}
    {Ω : Set (Vec d)} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {Q : Set (Vec d)} (hQ : Dense Q)
    {g : Vec d → Fin d → ℝ}
    (hg : ∀ i : Fin d,
      MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x => g x i) Ω MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hzero : ∀ y ∈ Q, ∀ n : ℕ, closedBall y (sliceRadius n) ⊆ Ω →
      ∫ x in Ω, ∑ i : Fin d, g x i *
        (fderiv ℝ (fun z : Vec d =>
          mollifier (d := d) (sliceRadius n) (sliceRadius_pos n) (z - y)) x)
          (basisVec i) ∂MeasureTheory.volume = 0)
    {ψ : Vec d → ℝ} (hψ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ) (hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ)
    (hψΩ : tsupport ψ ⊆ Ω) :
    ∫ x in Ω, ∑ i : Fin d, g x i * (fderiv ℝ ψ x) (basisVec i)
      ∂MeasureTheory.volume = 0

    (hF : MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrableOn F Ω MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hzero : ∀ y ∈ Q, ∀ n : ℕ, closedBall y (sliceRadius n) ⊆ Ω →
      ∫ x in Ω, F x *
        mollifier (d := d) (sliceRadius n) (sliceRadius_pos n) (x - y)
        ∂MeasureTheory.volume = 0)
    {ψ : Vec d → ℝ} (hψcont : Continuous ψ) (hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ)
    (hψΩ : tsupport ψ ⊆ Ω) :
    ∫ x in Ω, F x * ψ x ∂MeasureTheory.volume = 0

name: CKN.slice_pairing_zero_of_mollifier_family
statement:
theorem slice_pairing_zero_of_mollifier_family {d : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {Ω : Set (Vec d)} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {Q : Set (Vec d)} (hQ : Dense Q)
    {g : Vec d → ι → ℝ}
    (hg : ∀ i : ι,
      MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x => g x i) Ω MeasureTheory.volume)
    {κ : ℕ → ι → Vec d → ℝ}
    (hκcont : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ι), Continuous (κ n i))
    (hκzero : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ι), ∀ z : Vec d, sliceRadius n < ‖z‖ → κ n i z = 0)
    {ψ : Vec d → ℝ} (hψcont : Continuous ψ) (hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ)
    (hψΩ : tsupport ψ ⊆ Ω)
    {T : ι → Vec d → ℝ} (hTcont : ∀ i : ι, Continuous (T i))
    (hTsupp : ∀ (i : ι), ∀ x : Vec d, x ∉ tsupport ψ → T i x = 0)
    (hid : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ι) (x : Vec d),
      (∫ y, ψ y * κ n i (x - y) ∂MeasureTheory.volume)
        = mollify (T i) (sliceRadius n) (sliceRadius_pos n) x)
    (hzero : ∀ y ∈ Q, ∀ n : ℕ, closedBall y (sliceRadius n) ⊆ Ω →
      ∫ x in Ω, ∑ i : ι, g x i * κ n i (x - y) ∂MeasureTheory.volume = 0) :
    ∫ x in Ω, ∑ i : ι, g x i * T i x ∂MeasureTheory.volume = 0

name: CKN.exists_spacetime_weak_gradient_of_slices
statement:
theorem exists_spacetime_weak_gradient_of_slices (k : Fin 3)
    {B B' : Set Vec3} {J : Set ℝ} {p : Vec3 × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hB : IsOpen B) (hB' : MeasurableSet B') (hB'c : IsCompact (closure B'))
    (hB'B : closure B' ⊆ B)
    (hp : IntegrableOn p (B ×ˢ J) volume)
    (hslice : ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict J), ∃ g : Vec3 → ℝ,
      LocallyIntegrableOn g B volume ∧ HasWeakPartialDerivOn B k (fun x => p (x, t)) g) :
    ∃ Dp : Vec3 × ℝ → ℝ,
      AEMeasurable Dp (volume.restrict (B' ×ˢ J)) ∧
      (∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict J), ∀ g : Vec3 → ℝ,
        LocallyIntegrableOn g B volume → HasWeakPartialDerivOn B k (fun x => p (x, t)) g →
        (fun x => Dp (x, t)) =ᵐ[volume.restrict B'] g) ∧
      (∀ Ψ : Vec3 × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Ψ → HasCompactSupport Ψ →
        tsupport Ψ ⊆ B' ×ˢ J →
        (∫ t in J, ∫ x in B', p (x, t) * spatialPartial Ψ k (x, t)) =
          -∫ t in J, ∫ x in B', Dp (x, t) * Ψ (x, t)) ∧
      (∀ Ψ : Vec3 × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Ψ → HasCompactSupport Ψ →
        tsupport Ψ ⊆ B' ×ˢ J →
        IntegrableOn (fun z => p z * spatialPartial Ψ k z) (B' ×ˢ J) volume →
        IntegrableOn (fun z => Dp z * Ψ z) (B' ×ˢ J) volume →
        ∫ z in B' ×ˢ J, p z * spatialPartial Ψ k z = -∫ z in B' ×ˢ J, Dp z * Ψ z)

    {u : ParabolicPoint → Vec3} {Du : ParabolicPoint → Fin 3 → Vec3}
    {p : ParabolicPoint → ℝ} {f : ParabolicPoint → Vec3}
    (h : IsSuitableWeakSolutionIntegrable Ω I q u Du p f)
    {ψ : Vec3 → ℝ} (hψ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ)
    (hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ) (hψΩ : tsupport ψ ⊆ Ω)

    (hθc : HasCompactSupport θ) (hθI : tsupport θ ⊆ I) :
    Integrable (fun z => ∑ i, ∑ j,
      u z i * u z j * spatialPartial (fun w => pressureTestParabolic ψ θ w i) j z) volume ∧
    Integrable (fun z => ∑ i, ∑ j,
      Du z i j * spatialPartial (fun w => pressureTestParabolic ψ θ w i) j z) volume ∧
    Integrable (fun z => p z * ∑ i,
      spatialPartial (fun w => pressureTestParabolic ψ θ w i) i z) volume ∧
    Integrable (fun z => ∑ i, f z i * pressureTestParabolic ψ θ z i) volume

      ψ ∈ spaceTimeTestFunction (V := ℝ) Ω I →
      IntegrableOn (fun z => ∑ i, u z i * spatialPartial ψ i z) (tsupport ψ) volume ∧
      ∫ z in spaceTimeSet Ω I, ∑ i, u z i * spatialPartial ψ i z = 0)
    {ψ : Vec3 → ℝ} (hψ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ)

    IntegrableOn (fun z => ∑ i, u z i *
        timePartial (fun w => pressureTestParabolic ψ θ w i) z) (spaceTimeSet Ω I) volume ∧
      ∫ z in spaceTimeSet Ω I, ∑ i, u z i *
        timePartial (fun w => pressureTestParabolic ψ θ w i) z = 0

    (hφ : φ ∈ spaceTimeTestFunction (V := Vec3) Set.univ (Ioo 0 1)) :
    IntegrableOn (fun z =>
      (-(∑ i, shearFlow z i * timePartial (fun w => φ w i) z)) -
      ∑ i, ∑ j, shearFlow z i * shearFlow z j * spatialPartial (fun w => φ w i) j z +
      ∑ i, ∑ j, shearFlowGrad z i j * spatialPartial (fun w => φ w i) j z)
      (tsupport φ) volume ∧
    (∫ z in spaceTimeSet Set.univ (Ioo 0 1),
      (-(∑ i, shearFlow z i * timePartial (fun w => φ w i) z)) -
      ∑ i, ∑ j, shearFlow z i * shearFlow z j * spatialPartial (fun w => φ w i) j z +
      ∑ i, ∑ j, shearFlowGrad z i j * spatialPartial (fun w => φ w i) j z) = 0

statement:

    (hψ : ψ ∈ spaceTimeTestFunction (V := ℝ) Set.univ (Ioo 0 1)) :
    IntegrableOn (fun z => spatialGradientSq shearFlow shearFlowGrad z * ψ z)
      (tsupport ψ) volume ∧
    IntegrableOn (fun z => vec3EuclideanNorm (shearFlow z) ^ 2 *
      (timePartial ψ z + ∑ i, spatialSecondPartial ψ i i z) +
        vec3EuclideanNorm (shearFlow z) ^ 2 *
          (∑ i, shearFlow z i * spatialPartial ψ i z)) (tsupport ψ) volume ∧
    2 * (∫ z in spaceTimeSet Set.univ (Ioo 0 1),
      spatialGradientSq shearFlow shearFlowGrad z * ψ z) =
      ∫ z in spaceTimeSet Set.univ (Ioo 0 1),
        vec3EuclideanNorm (shearFlow z) ^ 2 *
          (timePartial ψ z + ∑ i, spatialSecondPartial ψ i i z) +
        vec3EuclideanNorm (shearFlow z) ^ 2 *
          (∑ i, shearFlow z i * spatialPartial ψ i z)

    (hbox : localBox Set.univ (Ioo 0 1) Ω' J) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable shearFlow (volume.restrict (spaceTimeSet Ω' J)) ∧
    AEStronglyMeasurable shearFlowGrad (volume.restrict (spaceTimeSet Ω' J)) ∧
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun _ : ParabolicPoint => (0 : ℝ))
      (volume.restrict (spaceTimeSet Ω' J)) ∧
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun _ : ParabolicPoint => (0 : Vec3))
      (volume.restrict (spaceTimeSet Ω' J)) ∧
    essSup (fun s => ∫⁻ x in Ω', ‖shearFlow (x, s)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ))
      (volume.restrict J) < ⊤ ∧
    (∫⁻ z in spaceTimeSet Ω' J,
      ‖shearFlow z‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) + ‖shearFlowGrad z‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ)) < ⊤ ∧
    MemLp (fun _ : ParabolicPoint => (0 : ℝ)) (ENNReal.ofReal (3 / 2 : ℝ))
      (volume.restrict (spaceTimeSet Ω' J)) ∧
    MemLp (fun _ : ParabolicPoint => (0 : Vec3)) (ENNReal.ofReal (3 : ℝ))
      (volume.restrict (spaceTimeSet Ω' J)) ∧
    ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict J,
      HasWeakGradientOn Ω' (fun x => shearFlow (x, s) i)
        (fun x => shearFlowGrad (x, s) i)

          (μ⁻¹ • (w.1 - z₀.1), (μ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (w.2 - z₀.2)))) i j
        (scalingParabolic μ z₀ z) =
      (μ ^ 2)⁻¹ * spatialSecondPartial ψ i j z

CKN.time_holder
statement:
theorem time_holder {t₀ r ρ : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrr : r ≤ ρ / 2)
    {g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g
      (volume.restrict (Ioc (t₀ - ρ ^ 2) t₀)))
    (hgn : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioc (t₀ - ρ ^ 2) t₀)] g) :
    (∫⁻ s in Ioc (t₀ - r ^ 2) t₀,
        ENNReal.ofReal (g s) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≤
        (ENNReal.ofReal r) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) *
          eLpNorm' g 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc (t₀ - ρ ^ 2) t₀)) ∧
      (∫⁻ s in Ioc (t₀ - r ^ 2) t₀,
        ENNReal.ofReal (g s) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≤
        eLpNorm' g (3 / 2 : ℝ)
          (volume.restrict (Ioc (t₀ - ρ ^ 2) t₀))

name: CKN.time_holder_q
statement:
theorem time_holder_q {t₀ r ρ q : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrr : r ≤ ρ / 2)
    (hq : 3 / 2 ≤ q)
    {g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g
      (volume.restrict (Ioc (t₀ - ρ ^ 2) t₀)))
    (hgn : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioc (t₀ - ρ ^ 2) t₀)] g) :
    (∫⁻ s in Ioc (t₀ - r ^ 2) t₀,
        ENNReal.ofReal (g s) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≤
      (ENNReal.ofReal r) ^ (2 * (2 / 3 - 1 / q)) *
        eLpNorm' g q (volume.restrict (Ioc (t₀ - ρ ^ 2) t₀))

lemma comp_eq_of_replicate (G : MonotoneMetricFamily) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (p : Simplex α) :

        ((MarkovMorphism.replicate (α := α) m hm).tangentPushforwardLinear)

        ((MarkovMorphism.replicate (α := α) m hm).tangentPushforward u)
        ((MarkovMorphism.replicate (α := α) m hm).tangentPushforward v)
      = G.g (α := α) p u v

name: PeriodPair.lemfrekur_even
statement:
theorem lemfrekur_even (j : ℕ) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≠ 0 → (k : ℂ) * z ∉ L.lattice) :
    L.Fm (2 * j + 4) z * L.Fm 2 z
      = L.Fm (j + 2) z
        * (L.Fm (j + 4) z * L.Fm (j + 1) z ^ 2 - L.Fm j z * L.Fm (j + 3) z ^ 2)

name: PeriodPair.lemfrekur_odd
statement:
theorem lemfrekur_odd (j : ℕ) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≠ 0 → (k : ℂ) * z ∉ L.lattice) :

      = L.Fm (j + 3) z * L.Fm (j + 1) z ^ 3 - L.Fm j z * L.Fm (j + 2) z ^ 3

statement:

    deriv L.derivWeierstrassP z = 6 * L.weierstrassP z ^ 2 - L.g₂ / 2

name: PeriodPair.lemwpnz
statement:
theorem lemwpnz (n : ℕ) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∉ L.lattice) (hnz : (n : ℂ) * z ∉ L.lattice) :
    L.weierstrassP ((n : ℂ) * z)
      = L.weierstrassP z - L.Fm (n - 1) z * L.Fm (n + 1) z / L.Fm n z ^ 2

name: PeriodPair.lemwpsigma
statement:
theorem lemwpsigma {u v : ℂ} (hu : u ∉ L.lattice) (hv : v ∉ L.lattice) :
    L.weierstrassP v - L.weierstrassP u
      = L.weierstrassSigma (u + v) * L.weierstrassSigma (u - v)
        / (L.weierstrassSigma u ^ 2 * L.weierstrassSigma v ^ 2)

name: PeriodPair.propfmpm
statement:
theorem propfmpm (m : ℕ) {z : ℂ} (hz : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≠ 0 → (k : ℂ) * z ∉ L.lattice) :
    (Odd m → L.Fm m z = (L.Pc m).eval (L.weierstrassP z))
      ∧ (Even m → L.Fm m z
          = -L.derivWeierstrassP z * (L.Pc m).eval (L.weierstrassP z))

name: PeriodPair.propfmprod
statement:
theorem propfmprod (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∉ L.lattice) :
    L.Fm m z ^ 2 = (m : ℂ) ^ 2
      * ∏ v ∈ Finset.univ.erase (0 : Fin m × Fin m),
          (L.weierstrassP z - L.weierstrassP (L.divPt m v))

name: PeriodPair.thmbaker_even
statement:
theorem thmbaker_even (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] (hm : Even m) :
    Polynomial.C ((m : ℂ) ^ 2)
        * ∏ v ∈ Finset.univ.erase (0 : Fin m × Fin m),
            (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (L.weierstrassP (L.divPt m v)))
      = L.Pc m ^ 2
        * (Polynomial.C 4 * (Polynomial.X ^ 3 - Polynomial.C (L.g₂ / 4) * Polynomial.X
            - Polynomial.C (L.g₃ / 4)))

name: Chvatal.covariance_dual_fourier
statement:
theorem covariance_dual_fourier (f : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    covariance f (dual f) = ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.erase ∅,
      -(-1 : ℝ) ^ S.card * fourier f S ^ 2

name: Chvatal.covariance_fourier
statement:
theorem covariance_fourier (f g : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    covariance f g = ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.erase ∅, fourier f S * fourier g S

name: Chvatal.cubeMean_add
statement:
theorem cubeMean_add (f g : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    cubeMean (fun x => f x + g x) = cubeMean f + cubeMean g

name: Chvatal.cubeMean_compl
statement:
theorem cubeMean_compl (f : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    cubeMean (fun x => f xᶜ) = cubeMean f

statement: @[simp] theorem cubeMean_const (c : ℝ) : cubeMean (fun _ : Finset ι => c) = c

name: Chvatal.cubeMean_dual
statement:
@[simp] theorem cubeMean_dual (f : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    cubeMean (dual f) = 1 - cubeMean f

name: Chvatal.cubeMean_mono
statement:
theorem cubeMean_mono {f g : Finset ι → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x) :

statement:
theorem cubeMean_mul_left (c : ℝ) (f : Finset ι → ℝ) :

name: Chvatal.cubeMean_mul_right
statement:
theorem cubeMean_mul_right (f : Finset ι → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    cubeMean (fun x => f x * c) = cubeMean f * c

name: Chvatal.cubeMean_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem cubeMean_neg (f : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    cubeMean (fun x => -f x) = -cubeMean f

name: Chvatal.cubeMean_nonneg
statement:
theorem cubeMean_nonneg {f : Finset ι → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) :
    0 ≤ cubeMean f

name: Chvatal.cubeMean_sub
statement:
theorem cubeMean_sub (f g : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    cubeMean (fun x => f x - g x) = cubeMean f - cubeMean g

name: Chvatal.cubeMean_sum
statement:
theorem cubeMean_sum {κ : Type*} (s : Finset κ) (f : κ → Finset ι → ℝ) :
    cubeMean (fun x => ∑ k ∈ s, f k x) = ∑ k ∈ s, cubeMean (f k)

name: Chvatal.cubeMean_symmDiff
statement:
theorem cubeMean_symmDiff (f : Finset ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) :
    cubeMean (fun x => f (x ∆ S)) = cubeMean f

name: Chvatal.cubeMean_walsh
statement:
theorem cubeMean_walsh (S : Finset ι) :
    cubeMean (walsh S) = if S = ∅ then 1 else 0

name: Chvatal.cubeMean_walsh_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem cubeMean_walsh_of_nonempty {S : Finset ι} (hS : S.Nonempty) :

name: Chvatal.cube_card_pos

name: Chvatal.flip_energy_fourier
statement:
theorem flip_energy_fourier (f : Finset ι → ℝ) (T : Finset ι) :
    cubeMean (fun x => (f x - f (x ∆ T)) ^ 2) =
      ∑ S, (1 - walsh S T) ^ 2 * fourier f S ^ 2

name: Chvatal.flip_energy_odd
statement:
theorem flip_energy_odd (f : Finset ι → ℝ) (T : Finset ι) :
    cubeMean (fun x => (f x - f (x ∆ T)) ^ 2) =
      4 * ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset ι => Odd (S ∩ T).card),
        fourier f S ^ 2

name: Chvatal.fourier_add
statement:
theorem fourier_add (f g : Finset ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) :
    fourier (fun x => f x + g x) S = fourier f S + fourier g S

name: Chvatal.fourier_compl
statement:
theorem fourier_compl (f : Finset ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) :
    fourier (fun x => f xᶜ) S = (-1 : ℝ) ^ S.card * fourier f S

name: Chvatal.fourier_const
statement:
theorem fourier_const (c : ℝ) (S : Finset ι) :
    fourier (fun _ : Finset ι => c) S = if S = ∅ then c else 0

statement:
theorem fourier_inversion (f : Finset ι → ℝ) (x : Finset ι) :

name: Chvatal.fourier_mul_walsh
statement:
theorem fourier_mul_walsh (f : Finset ι → ℝ) (S T : Finset ι) :

name: Chvatal.fourier_sub
statement:
theorem fourier_sub (f g : Finset ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) :

name: Chvatal.fourier_sub_mean
statement:
theorem fourier_sub_mean (f : Finset ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) :
    fourier (fun x => f x - cubeMean f) S =
      if S = ∅ then 0 else fourier f S

name: Chvatal.fourier_symmDiff
statement:
theorem fourier_symmDiff (f : Finset ι → ℝ) (S T : Finset ι) :
    fourier (fun x => f (x ∆ T)) S = walsh S T * fourier f S

name: Chvatal.parseval
statement:
theorem parseval (f : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    cubeMean (fun x => f x ^ 2) = ∑ S, fourier f S ^ 2

name: Chvatal.parseval_inner
statement:
theorem parseval_inner (f g : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    cubeMean (fun x => f x * g x) = ∑ S, fourier f S * fourier g S

name: Chvatal.sum_walsh_kernel
statement:
theorem sum_walsh_kernel (x y : Finset ι) :
    (∑ S, walsh S x * walsh S y) =
      if x = y then (Fintype.card (Finset ι) : ℝ) else 0

name: Chvatal.walsh_apply_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem walsh_apply_empty (S : Finset ι) : walsh S ∅ = 1

name: Chvatal.walsh_comm
statement: theorem walsh_comm (S x : Finset ι) : walsh S x = walsh x S

name: Chvatal.walsh_compl
statement:
theorem walsh_compl (S x : Finset ι) :
    walsh S xᶜ = (-1 : ℝ) ^ S.card * walsh S x

name: Chvatal.walsh_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem walsh_empty (x : Finset ι) : walsh ∅ x = 1

name: Chvatal.walsh_flip_factor
statement:
