name: Chvatal.walsh_insert
statement:
theorem walsh_insert {i : ι} {S : Finset ι} (hi : i ∉ S) (x : Finset ι) :
    walsh (insert i S) x = (if i ∈ x then -1 else 1) * walsh S x

name: Chvatal.walsh_orthogonality
statement:
theorem walsh_orthogonality (S T : Finset ι) :
    cubeMean (fun x => walsh S x * walsh T x) = if S = T then 1 else 0

name: Chvatal.walsh_singleton
statement:
theorem walsh_singleton (i : ι) (x : Finset ι) :
    walsh {i} x = if i ∈ x then -1 else 1

name: Chvatal.walsh_sq
statement: @[simp] theorem walsh_sq (S x : Finset ι) : walsh S x ^ 2 = 1

name: Chvatal.walsh_symmDiff_left
statement:
theorem walsh_symmDiff_left (S T x : Finset ι) :
    walsh (S ∆ T) x = walsh S x * walsh T x

name: Chvatal.walsh_symmDiff_right
statement:
theorem walsh_symmDiff_right (S x y : Finset ι) :
    walsh S (x ∆ y) = walsh S x * walsh S y

name: Chvatal.walsh_toggle
statement:
theorem walsh_toggle {S : Finset ι} {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ S) (x : Finset ι) :
    walsh S (x ∆ {i}) = -walsh S x

name: Chvatal.weighted_flip_energy
statement:
theorem weighted_flip_energy (f g : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ T, fourier g T ^ 2 *
      cubeMean (fun x => (f x - f (x ∆ T)) ^ 2) =
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * cubeMean (fun x =>
      ∑ y, (f x - f y) ^ 2 * fourier g (x ∆ y) ^ 2)

name: Chvatal.auxiliary_orthonormal_system
statement:
theorem auxiliary_orthonormal_system (F G : Family ι)
    (hF : F.IsIncreasing) (hG : G.IsIncreasing) :
    ∃ (u : ↥(F \ G) → Finset ι → ℝ) (v : ↥(F \ G.dual) → Finset ι → ℝ),
      UniformOrthonormal (Sum.elim u v) ∧
      (∀ i, u i ∈ supportSubspace F Gᶜ) ∧
      (∀ i, v i ∈ supportSubspace F G)

name: Chvatal.fourier_monomial
statement:
theorem fourier_monomial (S T : Finset ι) :
    fourier (monomial S) T =
      if T ⊆ S then ((2 : ℝ) ^ S.card)⁻¹ * (-1 : ℝ) ^ T.card else 0

      (∀ x, x ∉ F → f x = 0) ∧ (∀ S, S ∉ K → fourier f S = 0)

name: Chvatal.monomial_coefficients_eq_zero

name: Chvatal.monomial_expansion
statement:
theorem monomial_expansion (S x : Finset ι) :
    monomial S x = ((2 : ℝ) ^ S.card)⁻¹ *
      ∑ T ∈ S.powerset, (-1 : ℝ) ^ T.card * walsh T x

name: Chvatal.monomial_expansion_scaled
statement:
theorem monomial_expansion_scaled (S x : Finset ι) :
    (∑ T ∈ S.powerset, (-1 : ℝ) ^ T.card * walsh T x) =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ S.card * monomial S x

name: Chvatal.monomial_insert
statement:
theorem monomial_insert (i : ι) (S x : Finset ι) :
    monomial (insert i S) x = if i ∈ x then monomial S x else 0

name: Chvatal.monomial_ne_zero_iff

name: Chvatal.monomial_self

name: Chvatal.monomial_toggle

theorem monomial_toggle {S : Finset ι} {i : ι} (hi : i ∉ S) (x : Finset ι) :

name: Chvatal.monomial_twistedMonomial_orthogonal

theorem monomial_twistedMonomial_orthogonal {G : Family ι} (hG : G.IsIncreasing)

name: Chvatal.support_fourier_monomial

theorem support_fourier_monomial (S : Finset ι) :

name: Chvatal.support_fourier_twistedMonomial

theorem support_fourier_twistedMonomial (S : Finset ι) :

name: Chvatal.support_monomial

theorem support_monomial (S : Finset ι) :

name: Chvatal.support_twistedMonomial

theorem support_twistedMonomial (S : Finset ι) :

name: Chvatal.twistedMonomial_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem twistedMonomial_apply (S x : Finset ι) :
    twistedMonomial S x = monomial S x * walsh Finset.univ x

name: Chvatal.twistedMonomial_eq_zero_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem twistedMonomial_eq_zero_of_not_mem {F : Family ι} (hF : F.IsIncreasing)

name: Chvatal.uniformInner_comm
statement: theorem uniformInner_comm (f g : Finset ι → ℝ) : uniformInner f g = uniformInner g f

name: Chvatal.uniformInner_eq_cubeMean
statement:
theorem uniformInner_eq_cubeMean (f g : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    uniformInner f g = cubeMean (fun x => f x * g x)

name: Chvatal.uniformInner_eq_zero_of_fourier_support
statement:
theorem uniformInner_eq_zero_of_fourier_support (G : Family ι)
    {f g : Finset ι → ℝ} (hf : ∀ S, S ∈ G → fourier f S = 0)
    (hg : ∀ S, S ∉ G → fourier g S = 0) : uniformInner f g = 0

name: Chvatal.IsBoolean.dual
statement: theorem IsBoolean.dual {f : Finset ι → ℝ} (hf : IsBoolean f) : IsBoolean (dual f)

name: Chvatal.IsBoolean.nonneg
statement:
theorem IsBoolean.nonneg {f : Finset ι → ℝ} (hf : IsBoolean f) (x : Finset ι) :
    0 ≤ f x

name: Chvatal.IsBoolean.sq
statement:
theorem IsBoolean.sq {f : Finset ι → ℝ} (hf : IsBoolean f) (x : Finset ι) :
    f x ^ 2 = f x

name: Chvatal.coordinateSign_symmDiff
statement:
theorem coordinateSign_symmDiff {T : Finset ι} {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ T) (x : Finset ι) :
    coordinateSign i (x ∆ T) = -coordinateSign i x

name: Chvatal.flip_sq_eq_signed_difference
statement:
theorem flip_sq_eq_signed_difference {f : Finset ι → ℝ} (hf : IsBoolean f)
    (hm : Monotone f) (i : ι) (x : Finset ι) :
    (f x - f (x ∆ {i})) ^ 2 = coordinateSign i x * (f x - f (x ∆ {i}))

name: Chvatal.influence_eq_mean_indicator
statement:
theorem influence_eq_mean_indicator {f : Finset ι → ℝ} (hf : IsBoolean f) (i : ι) :
    influence f i = cubeMean (fun x => if f x ≠ f (x ∆ {i}) then 1 else 0)

name: Chvatal.influence_eq_signed_mean
statement:
theorem influence_eq_signed_mean {f : Finset ι → ℝ} (hf : IsBoolean f)
    (hm : Monotone f) (i : ι) :
    influence f i = 2 * cubeMean (fun x => coordinateSign i x * f x)

name: Chvatal.influence_le_flip_energy
statement:
theorem influence_le_flip_energy {f : Finset ι → ℝ} (hf : IsBoolean f)
    (hm : Monotone f) {T : Finset ι} {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ T) :
    influence f i ≤ cubeMean (fun x => (f x - f (x ∆ T)) ^ 2)

name: Chvatal.influence_nonneg
statement: theorem influence_nonneg (f : Finset ι → ℝ) (i : ι) : 0 ≤ influence f i

name: Chvatal.mean_eq_half_of_antipodal
statement:
theorem mean_eq_half_of_antipodal {g : Finset ι → ℝ} (hg : dual g = g) :
    cubeMean g = 1 / 2

name: Chvatal.monotone_dual
statement: theorem monotone_dual {f : Finset ι → ℝ} (hf : Monotone f) : Monotone (dual f)

name: Chvatal.signed_difference_le_sq
statement:
theorem signed_difference_le_sq {f : Finset ι → ℝ} (hf : IsBoolean f)
    (i : ι) (x y : Finset ι) :
    coordinateSign i x * (f x - f y) ≤ (f x - f y) ^ 2

name: Chvatal.signed_mean_difference
statement:
theorem signed_mean_difference {T : Finset ι} {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ T)
    (f : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    cubeMean (fun x => coordinateSign i x * (f x - f (x ∆ T))) =
      2 * cubeMean (fun x => coordinateSign i x * f x)

name: Chvatal.signed_mean_flip
statement:
theorem signed_mean_flip {T : Finset ι} {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ T) (f : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    cubeMean (fun x => coordinateSign i x * f (x ∆ T)) =
      -cubeMean (fun x => coordinateSign i x * f x)

name: Chvatal.variance_eq_quarter_of_antipodal
statement:
theorem variance_eq_quarter_of_antipodal {g : Finset ι → ℝ} (hb : IsBoolean g)
    (hg : dual g = g) : covariance g g = 1 / 4

name: Chvatal.Family.IsAntipodal.cubeMean_indicator
statement:
theorem IsAntipodal.cubeMean_indicator {B : Family ι} (hB : B.IsAntipodal) :
    cubeMean B.indicator = 1 / 2

name: Chvatal.Family.IsAntipodal.dual_indicator
statement:
theorem IsAntipodal.dual_indicator {B : Family ι} (hB : B.IsAntipodal) :

name: Chvatal.Family.IsHereditary.monotone_one_sub_indicator
statement:
theorem IsHereditary.monotone_one_sub_indicator {D : Family ι}
    (hD : D.IsHereditary) : Monotone (fun x => 1 - D.indicator x)

name: Chvatal.Family.IsIncreasing.isHereditary_compl
statement:
theorem IsIncreasing.isHereditary_compl {B : Family ι} (hB : B.IsIncreasing) :
    Bᶜ.IsHereditary

name: Chvatal.Family.IsIncreasing.monotone_indicator
statement:
theorem IsIncreasing.monotone_indicator {B : Family ι} (hB : B.IsIncreasing) :
    Monotone B.indicator

name: Chvatal.Family.covariance_one_sub_indicator
statement:
theorem covariance_one_sub_indicator {D B : Family ι} (hB : B.IsAntipodal) :
    covariance (fun x => 1 - D.indicator x) B.indicator =
      ((D.card : ℝ) / 2 - (D ∩ B).card) / Fintype.card (Finset ι)

name: Chvatal.Family.covariance_sub_quarter_influence
statement:
theorem covariance_sub_quarter_influence {D B : Family ι}
    (hD : D.IsHereditary) (hB : B.IsAntipodal) (i : ι) :
    covariance (fun x => 1 - D.indicator x) B.indicator -
      influence (fun x => 1 - D.indicator x) i / 4 =
      ((D.star i).card - (D ∩ B).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card (Finset ι)

name: Chvatal.Family.covariance_sub_quarter_min_influence
statement:
theorem covariance_sub_quarter_min_influence [Nonempty ι] {D B : Family ι}
    (hD : D.IsHereditary) (hB : B.IsAntipodal) :
    covariance (fun x => 1 - D.indicator x) B.indicator -
      (Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty (influence (fun x => 1 - D.indicator x))) / 4 =
      (((Finset.univ.sup fun i => (D.star i).card : ℕ) : ℝ) - (D ∩ B).card) /
        Fintype.card (Finset ι)

name: Chvatal.Family.cubeMean_coordinateSign
statement: theorem cubeMean_coordinateSign (i : ι) : cubeMean (coordinateSign i) = 0

name: Chvatal.Family.cubeMean_indicator
statement:
theorem cubeMean_indicator (B : Family ι) :
    cubeMean B.indicator = B.card / (Fintype.card (Finset ι) : ℝ)

name: Chvatal.Family.indicator_compl
statement:
theorem indicator_compl (D : Family ι) :
    Dᶜ.indicator = fun x => 1 - D.indicator x

name: Chvatal.Family.indicator_dual
statement:
theorem indicator_dual (B : Family ι) :
    B.dual.indicator = Chvatal.dual B.indicator

name: Chvatal.Family.indicator_inter
statement:
theorem indicator_inter (D B : Family ι) :
    (D ∩ B).indicator = fun x => D.indicator x * B.indicator x

name: Chvatal.Family.indicator_of_mem
statement:
@[simp] theorem indicator_of_mem {B : Family ι} {x : Finset ι} (hx : x ∈ B) :
    B.indicator x = 1

name: Chvatal.Family.indicator_of_not_mem
statement:
@[simp] theorem indicator_of_not_mem {B : Family ι} {x : Finset ι} (hx : x ∉ B) :
    B.indicator x = 0

name: Chvatal.Family.indicator_oneSupport
statement:
theorem indicator_oneSupport {f : Finset ι → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = 0 ∨ f x = 1) : (oneSupport f).indicator = f

name: Chvatal.Family.influence_le_four_covariance_iff
statement:
theorem influence_le_four_covariance_iff {D B : Family ι}
    (hD : D.IsHereditary) (hB : B.IsAntipodal) (i : ι) :
    influence (fun x => 1 - D.indicator x) i ≤
        4 * covariance (fun x => 1 - D.indicator x) B.indicator ↔
      (D ∩ B).card ≤ (D.star i).card

name: Chvatal.Family.influence_one_sub_indicator
statement:
theorem influence_one_sub_indicator {D : Family ι} (hD : D.IsHereditary) (i : ι) :
    influence (fun x => 1 - D.indicator x) i =
      2 * ((D.card : ℝ) - 2 * (D.star i).card) / Fintype.card (Finset ι)

name: Chvatal.Family.isAntipodal_iff_dual_indicator
statement:
theorem isAntipodal_iff_dual_indicator (B : Family ι) :
    B.IsAntipodal ↔ Chvatal.dual B.indicator = B.indicator

statement: theorem isBoolean_indicator (B : Family ι) : IsBoolean B.indicator

name: Chvatal.Family.isBoolean_one_sub_indicator
statement:
theorem isBoolean_one_sub_indicator (D : Family ι) :
    IsBoolean (fun x => 1 - D.indicator x)

Chvatal.Family.mem_oneSupport
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_oneSupport {f : Finset ι → ℝ} {x : Finset ι} :

name: Chvatal.antipodal_correlation_of_chvatal
statement:
theorem antipodal_correlation_of_chvatal
    (hstar : ∀ D : Family ι, D.IsHereditary → D.HasStarProperty) :
    AntipodalCorrelationBound ι

name: Chvatal.chvatal_iff_antipodal_correlation
statement:
theorem chvatal_iff_antipodal_correlation [Nonempty ι] :
    (∀ D : Family ι, D.IsHereditary → D.HasStarProperty) ↔
      AntipodalCorrelationBound ι

name: Chvatal.chvatal_of_antipodal_correlation
statement:
theorem chvatal_of_antipodal_correlation [Nonempty ι]
    (hcorr : AntipodalCorrelationBound ι) {D : Family ι} (hD : D.IsHereditary) :
    D.HasStarProperty

name: Chvatal.auxiliaryKernel_bessel_bound
statement:
theorem auxiliaryKernel_bessel_bound (F G : Family ι)
    (hF : F.IsIncreasing) (hG : G.IsIncreasing) (t : ℝ) :
    t ^ 2 * (F \ G).card + (1 - t) ^ 2 * (F \ G.dual).card ≤
      ∑ x ∈ F, ∑ y ∈ F, (fourier (fun S => G.indicator S - t) (x ∆ y)) ^ 2

name: Chvatal.auxiliaryKernel_energy_identity
statement:
theorem auxiliaryKernel_energy_identity (F : Family ι) (q : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ x ∈ F, ∑ y ∈ F, fourier q (x ∆ y) ^ 2) =
      (∑ y ∈ F, uniformInner (auxiliaryKernel F q y) (auxiliaryKernel F q y)) /
        Fintype.card (Finset ι)

name: Chvatal.auxiliaryKernel_inner_eigenvalue
statement:
theorem auxiliaryKernel_inner_eigenvalue (F : Family ι) (q h : Finset ι → ℝ)
    (y : Finset ι) (hh : ∀ x, x ∉ F → h x = 0) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ S, q S * fourier h S = c * fourier h S) :
    uniformInner h (auxiliaryKernel F q y) = c * h y

name: Chvatal.auxiliaryKernel_inner_fourier
statement:
theorem auxiliaryKernel_inner_fourier (F : Family ι) (q h : Finset ι → ℝ)
    (y : Finset ι) (hh : ∀ x, x ∉ F → h x = 0) :
    uniformInner h (auxiliaryKernel F q y) =
      ∑ S, q S * fourier h S * walsh S y

name: Chvatal.auxiliaryKernel_inner_inside
statement:
theorem auxiliaryKernel_inner_inside (F G : Family ι) (h : Finset ι → ℝ)
    (y : Finset ι) (t : ℝ) (hh : h ∈ supportSubspace F G) :
    uniformInner h (auxiliaryKernel F (fun S => G.indicator S - t) y) =
      (1 - t) * h y

name: Chvatal.auxiliaryKernel_inner_outside
statement:
theorem auxiliaryKernel_inner_outside (F G : Family ι) (h : Finset ι → ℝ)
    (y : Finset ι) (t : ℝ) (hh : h ∈ supportSubspace F Gᶜ) :
    uniformInner h (auxiliaryKernel F (fun S => G.indicator S - t) y) = -t * h y

name: Chvatal.auxiliaryKernel_inner_sum
statement:
theorem auxiliaryKernel_inner_sum (F : Family ι) (q h : Finset ι → ℝ)
    (y : Finset ι) (hh : ∀ x, x ∉ F → h x = 0) :
    uniformInner h (auxiliaryKernel F q y) = ∑ x, h x * fourier q (x ∆ y)

name: Chvatal.auxiliaryKernel_norm_sq
statement:
theorem auxiliaryKernel_norm_sq (F : Family ι) (q : Finset ι → ℝ) (y : Finset ι) :
    uniformInner (auxiliaryKernel F q y) (auxiliaryKernel F q y) =
      (Fintype.card (Finset ι) : ℝ) * ∑ x ∈ F, (fourier q (x ∆ y)) ^ 2

name: Chvatal.sum_mul_fourier_translate
statement:
theorem sum_mul_fourier_translate (h q : Finset ι → ℝ) (y : Finset ι) :
    (∑ x, h x * fourier q (x ∆ y)) =
      ∑ S, q S * fourier h S * walsh S y

name: Chvatal.sum_sq_of_supported_unit
statement:
theorem sum_sq_of_supported_unit (F : Family ι) (h : Finset ι → ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ x, x ∉ F → h x = 0) (hunit : uniformInner h h = 1) :
    ∑ x ∈ F, h x ^ 2 = (Fintype.card (Finset ι) : ℝ)

name: Chvatal.boolean_sub_const_norm
statement:
theorem boolean_sub_const_norm {g : Finset ι → ℝ} (hg : IsBoolean g) (t : ℝ) :
    cubeMean (fun z => (g z - t) ^ 2) =
      (1 - t) ^ 2 * cubeMean g + t ^ 2 * (1 - cubeMean g)

name: Chvatal.boundary_eq_total_sub_interior
statement:
theorem boundary_eq_total_sub_interior (F : Family ι) (g : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ x ∈ F, ∑ y ∈ Fᶜ, fourier g (x ∆ y) ^ 2) =
      F.card * cubeMean (fun z => g z ^ 2) -
        ∑ x ∈ F, ∑ y ∈ F, fourier g (x ∆ y) ^ 2

name: Chvatal.boundary_sub_const
statement:
theorem boundary_sub_const (F : Family ι) (g : Finset ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (∑ x ∈ F, ∑ y ∈ Fᶜ, fourier g (x ∆ y) ^ 2) =
      ∑ x ∈ F, ∑ y ∈ Fᶜ, fourier (fun z => g z - t) (x ∆ y) ^ 2

name: Chvatal.card_sdiff_div_cube
statement:
theorem card_sdiff_div_cube (F G : Family ι) :
    ((F \ G).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card (Finset ι) =
      cubeMean F.indicator - cubeMean (fun x => F.indicator x * G.indicator x)

name: Chvatal.indicator_boundary_sum
statement:
theorem indicator_boundary_sum (F : Family ι) (k : Finset ι → Finset ι → ℝ)
    (hk : ∀ x y, k x y = k y x) :
    (∑ x, ∑ y, (F.indicator x - F.indicator y) ^ 2 * k x y) =
      2 * ∑ x ∈ F, ∑ y ∈ Fᶜ, k x y

name: Chvatal.shifted_dimension_covariance
statement:
theorem shifted_dimension_covariance (F G : Family ι) (t : ℝ) :
    (F.card * cubeMean (fun z => (G.indicator z - t) ^ 2) -
      (t ^ 2 * (F \ G).card + (1 - t) ^ 2 * (F \ G.dual).card)) /
        Fintype.card (Finset ι) =
      t ^ 2 * covariance F.indicator G.indicator +
        (1 - t) ^ 2 * covariance F.indicator (dual G.indicator)

name: Chvatal.sum_fourier_kernel_sq
statement:
theorem sum_fourier_kernel_sq (g : Finset ι → ℝ) (x : Finset ι) :
    (∑ y, fourier g (x ∆ y) ^ 2) = cubeMean (fun z => g z ^ 2)

name: Chvatal.sum_indicator_mul
statement:
theorem sum_indicator_mul (F : Family ι) (h : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, F.indicator x * h x) = ∑ x ∈ F, h x

name: Chvatal.two_spectral_eq_boundary
statement:
theorem two_spectral_eq_boundary (F : Family ι) (g : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    2 * (∑ T, ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset ι => Odd (S ∩ T).card),
      fourier F.indicator S ^ 2 * fourier g T ^ 2) =
      (∑ x ∈ F, ∑ y ∈ Fᶜ, fourier g (x ∆ y) ^ 2) /
        Fintype.card (Finset ι)

name: Chvatal.two_spectral_eq_weighted_flip
statement:
theorem two_spectral_eq_weighted_flip (f g : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    2 * (∑ T, ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset ι => Odd (S ∩ T).card),
      fourier f S ^ 2 * fourier g T ^ 2) =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ T, fourier g T ^ 2 *
        cubeMean (fun x => (f x - f (x ∆ T)) ^ 2)

name: Chvatal.two_spectral_le_of_interior_bound
statement:
theorem two_spectral_le_of_interior_bound (F G : Family ι) (t : ℝ)
    (hinterior : t ^ 2 * (F \ G).card + (1 - t) ^ 2 * (F \ G.dual).card ≤
      ∑ x ∈ F, ∑ y ∈ F, fourier (fun z => G.indicator z - t) (x ∆ y) ^ 2) :
    2 * (∑ T, ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset ι => Odd (S ∩ T).card),
      fourier F.indicator S ^ 2 * fourier G.indicator T ^ 2) ≤
      t ^ 2 * covariance F.indicator G.indicator +
        (1 - t) ^ 2 * covariance F.indicator (dual G.indicator)

name: Chvatal.two_spectral_le_quadratic_covariance
statement:
theorem two_spectral_le_quadratic_covariance {f g : Finset ι → ℝ}
    (hf : IsBoolean f) (hmf : Monotone f) (hg : IsBoolean g) (hmg : Monotone g)
    (t : ℝ) :
    2 * (∑ T, ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset ι => Odd (S ∩ T).card),
      fourier f S ^ 2 * fourier g T ^ 2) ≤
      t ^ 2 * covariance f g + (1 - t) ^ 2 * covariance f (dual g)

name: Chvatal.sum_mul_antitone_nonneg_of_lowerSets
statement:
theorem sum_mul_antitone_nonneg_of_lowerSets (c : α → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ D : Finset α, IsLowerSet (D : Set α) → 0 ≤ ∑ x ∈ D, c x)
    (ω : α → ℝ) (hω : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ω x) (hanti : Antitone ω) :
    0 ≤ ∑ x, c x * ω x

name: Chvatal.harmonic_self
statement: theorem harmonic_self (a : ℝ) : 2 * a * a / (a + a) = a

name: Chvatal.le_harmonic_half_of_quadratic_bound
statement:
theorem le_harmonic_half_of_quadratic_bound {a b c : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (h : ∀ t : ℝ, c ≤ t ^ 2 * a + (1 - t) ^ 2 * b) :
    c ≤ a * b / (a + b)

name: Chvatal.le_harmonic_of_spectral_bound
statement:
theorem le_harmonic_of_spectral_bound {a b c w : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hw : w ≤ 2 * c) (h : ∀ t : ℝ, c ≤ t ^ 2 * a + (1 - t) ^ 2 * b) :
    w ≤ 2 * a * b / (a + b)

name: Chvatal.quadratic_covariance_identity
statement:
theorem quadratic_covariance_identity (a b t : ℝ) (hab : a + b ≠ 0) :
    t ^ 2 * a + (1 - t) ^ 2 * b =
      a * b / (a + b) + (a + b) * (t - b / (a + b)) ^ 2

name: Chvatal.quadratic_covariance_minimizer
statement:
theorem quadratic_covariance_minimizer (a b : ℝ) (hab : a + b ≠ 0) :
    (b / (a + b)) ^ 2 * a + (1 - b / (a + b)) ^ 2 * b = a * b / (a + b)

name: Chvatal.fourier_mass_of_antipodal
statement:
theorem fourier_mass_of_antipodal {g : Finset ι → ℝ} (hb : IsBoolean g)
    (hg : dual g = g) :
    (∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.erase (∅ : Finset ι), fourier g S ^ 2) = 1 / 4

name: Chvatal.influence_le_maxInfluence
statement:
theorem influence_le_maxInfluence (f : Finset ι → ℝ) {S : Finset ι} {i : ι}
    (hi : i ∈ S) : influence f i ≤ maxInfluence f S

name: Chvatal.maxInfluence_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem maxInfluence_empty (f : Finset ι → ℝ) : maxInfluence f ∅ = 0

name: Chvatal.maxInfluence_le_flip_energy
statement:
theorem maxInfluence_le_flip_energy {f : Finset ι → ℝ} (hf : IsBoolean f)
    (hm : Monotone f) (T : Finset ι) :
    maxInfluence f T ≤ cubeMean (fun x => (f x - f (x ∆ T)) ^ 2)

name: Chvatal.maxInfluence_le_odd_spectral
statement:
theorem maxInfluence_le_odd_spectral {f : Finset ι → ℝ} (hf : IsBoolean f)
    (hm : Monotone f) (T : Finset ι) :
    maxInfluence f T ≤ 4 * ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset ι => Odd (S ∩ T).card),
      fourier f S ^ 2

name: Chvatal.maxInfluence_nonneg
statement: theorem maxInfluence_nonneg (f : Finset ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) : 0 ≤ maxInfluence f S

name: Chvatal.maxInfluence_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem maxInfluence_of_nonempty (f : Finset ι → ℝ) {S : Finset ι} (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    maxInfluence f S = S.sup' hS (influence f)

name: Chvatal.quarter_le_spectralWeight
Chvatal.spectralWeight_eq_sum_nonempty
statement:
theorem spectralWeight_eq_sum_nonempty (f g : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    spectralWeight f g = ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.erase (∅ : Finset ι),
      fourier g S ^ 2 * maxInfluence f S

name: Chvatal.spectralWeight_le_four_spectral
statement:
theorem spectralWeight_le_four_spectral {f : Finset ι → ℝ} (hf : IsBoolean f)
    (hm : Monotone f) (g : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    spectralWeight f g ≤ 4 * ∑ T,
      ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset ι => Odd (S ∩ T).card),
        fourier f S ^ 2 * fourier g T ^ 2

name: Chvatal.spectralWeight_nonneg
statement: theorem spectralWeight_nonneg (f g : Finset ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ spectralWeight f g

name: Chvatal.antipodal_correlation
statement:
theorem antipodal_correlation [Nonempty ι] {f g : Finset ι → ℝ} (hf : IsBoolean f)
    (hmf : Monotone f) (hg : IsBoolean g) (hmg : Monotone g) (hdual : dual g = g) :
    minInfluence f / 4 ≤ covariance f g

name: Chvatal.antipodal_correlation_bound
statement: theorem antipodal_correlation_bound [Nonempty ι] : AntipodalCorrelationBound ι

name: Chvatal.antipodal_spectral_bound
statement:
theorem antipodal_spectral_bound {f g : Finset ι → ℝ} (hf : IsBoolean f)
    (hmf : Monotone f) (hg : IsBoolean g) (hmg : Monotone g) (hdual : dual g = g) :
    spectralWeight f g ≤ covariance f g

name: Chvatal.chvatal
statement:
theorem chvatal [Finite ι] [Nonempty ι] {D A : Family ι} (hD : D.IsHereditary)
    (hAD : A ⊆ D) (hA : A.IsIntersecting) :
    ∃ i : ι, A.card ≤ (D.star i).card

name: Chvatal.covariance_nonneg
statement:
theorem covariance_nonneg {f g : Finset ι → ℝ} (hf : IsBoolean f) (hmf : Monotone f)
    (hg : IsBoolean g) (hmg : Monotone g) : 0 ≤ covariance f g

name: Chvatal.exists_largest_intersecting_star
statement:
theorem exists_largest_intersecting_star [Finite ι] [Nonempty ι] {D : Family ι}
    (hD : D.IsHereditary) :
    ∃ i : ι, (D.star i).IsIntersecting ∧
      ∀ A : Family ι, A ⊆ D → A.IsIntersecting → A.card ≤ (D.star i).card

name: Chvatal.minInfluence_le
statement:
theorem minInfluence_le [Nonempty ι] (f : Finset ι → ℝ) (i : ι) :
    minInfluence f ≤ influence f i

name: Chvatal.sharp_correlation
statement:
theorem sharp_correlation {f g : Finset ι → ℝ} (hf : IsBoolean f) (hmf : Monotone f)
    (hg : IsBoolean g) (hmg : Monotone g) :
    spectralWeight f g ≤
      2 * covariance f g * covariance f (dual g) /
        (covariance f g + covariance f (dual g))

name: Chvatal.andFunction_antipodal_sharp
statement:
theorem andFunction_antipodal_sharp {g : Finset ι → ℝ} (hg : IsBoolean g)
    (hm : Monotone g) (hdual : dual g = g) (i : ι) :
    covariance andFunction g = influence andFunction i / 4

name: Chvatal.andFunction_one_antipodal
statement:
theorem andFunction_one_antipodal :
    dual (andFunction (ι := Fin 1)) = andFunction

name: Chvatal.andFunction_one_values
statement:
theorem andFunction_one_values :
    covariance (andFunction (ι := Fin 1)) andFunction = 1 / 4 ∧
      influence (andFunction (ι := Fin 1)) 0 = 1

name: Chvatal.andFunction_sharp
statement:
theorem andFunction_sharp {g : Finset ι → ℝ} (hg : IsBoolean g) (hm : Monotone g) :
    spectralWeight andFunction g =
      2 * covariance andFunction g * covariance andFunction (dual g) /
        (covariance andFunction g + covariance andFunction (dual g))

name: Chvatal.and_or_two_example
statement:
theorem and_or_two_example :
    covariance (andFunction (ι := Fin 2)) orFunction = 1 / 16 ∧
    covariance (andFunction (ι := Fin 2)) (dual orFunction) = 3 / 16 ∧
    spectralWeight (andFunction (ι := Fin 2)) orFunction = 3 / 32 ∧
    covariance (andFunction (ι := Fin 2)) orFunction <
      spectralWeight (andFunction (ι := Fin 2)) orFunction

name: Chvatal.covariance_andFunction
statement:
theorem covariance_andFunction (g : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    covariance andFunction g =
      (1 / Fintype.card (Finset ι)) * (g Finset.univ - cubeMean g)

name: Chvatal.covariance_andFunction_dual
statement:
theorem covariance_andFunction_dual (g : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    covariance andFunction (dual g) =
      (1 / Fintype.card (Finset ι)) * (cubeMean g - g ∅)

name: Chvatal.covariance_self_boolean
statement:
theorem covariance_self_boolean {g : Finset ι → ℝ} (hg : IsBoolean g) :
    covariance g g = cubeMean g * (1 - cubeMean g)

name: Chvatal.cubeMean_andFunction
statement:
theorem cubeMean_andFunction :
    cubeMean (andFunction (ι := ι)) = 1 / Fintype.card (Finset ι)

name: Chvatal.cubeMean_andFunction_mul
statement:
theorem cubeMean_andFunction_mul (g : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    cubeMean (fun x => andFunction x * g x) =
      g Finset.univ / Fintype.card (Finset ι)

name: Chvatal.cubeMean_orFunction
statement:
theorem cubeMean_orFunction :
    cubeMean (orFunction (ι := ι)) = 1 - 1 / Fintype.card (Finset ι)

name: Chvatal.influence_andFunction
statement:
theorem influence_andFunction (i : ι) :
    influence andFunction i = 2 / Fintype.card (Finset ι)

name: Chvatal.isBoolean_andFunction
statement: theorem isBoolean_andFunction : IsBoolean (andFunction (ι := ι))

name: Chvatal.isBoolean_orFunction
statement: theorem isBoolean_orFunction : IsBoolean (orFunction (ι := ι))

name: Chvatal.maxInfluence_andFunction
statement:
theorem maxInfluence_andFunction {S : Finset ι} (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    maxInfluence andFunction S = 2 / Fintype.card (Finset ι)

name: Chvatal.monotone_andFunction
statement: theorem monotone_andFunction : Monotone (andFunction (ι := ι))

name: Chvatal.monotone_boolean_endpoints
statement:
theorem monotone_boolean_endpoints {g : Finset ι → ℝ} (hg : IsBoolean g)
    (hm : Monotone g) :
    g = (fun _ => 0) ∨ g = (fun _ => 1) ∨ (g ∅ = 0 ∧ g Finset.univ = 1)

name: Chvatal.monotone_orFunction
statement: theorem monotone_orFunction : Monotone (orFunction (ι := ι))

name: Chvatal.orFunction_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem orFunction_empty : orFunction (∅ : Finset ι) = 0

name: Chvatal.orFunction_univ
statement:
@[simp] theorem orFunction_univ [Nonempty ι] :
    orFunction (Finset.univ : Finset ι) = 1

name: Chvatal.quarter_coefficient_optimal
statement:
theorem quarter_coefficient_optimal (c : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ (f g : Finset (Fin 1) → ℝ), IsBoolean f → Monotone f →
      IsBoolean g → Monotone g → dual g = g →
        c * Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty (influence f) ≤ covariance f g) :
    c ≤ 1 / 4

name: Chvatal.spectralWeight_andFunction
statement:
theorem spectralWeight_andFunction (g : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    spectralWeight andFunction g =
      (2 / Fintype.card (Finset ι)) * covariance g g

name: Chvatal.exists_largest_weighted_intersecting_star
statement:
theorem exists_largest_weighted_intersecting_star [Nonempty ι]
    (ω : Finset ι → ℝ) (hω : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ω x) (hanti : Antitone ω) :
    ∃ i : ι, (Family.star (Finset.univ : Family ι) i).IsIntersecting ∧
      ∀ A : Family ι, A.IsIntersecting →
        (∑ x ∈ A, ω x) ≤ ∑ x ∈ Family.star Finset.univ i, ω x

name: Chvatal.exists_weighted_star_bound
statement:
theorem exists_weighted_star_bound [Nonempty ι] {A : Family ι}
    (hA : A.IsIntersecting) (ω : Finset ι → ℝ)
    (hω : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ω x) (hanti : Antitone ω) :
    ∃ i : ι, (∑ x ∈ A, ω x) ≤ ∑ x ∈ Family.star Finset.univ i, ω x

name: Chvatal.hereditary_bound_of_selected_correlation
statement:
theorem hereditary_bound_of_selected_correlation {g : Finset ι → ℝ}
    (hg : IsBoolean g) (hdual : dual g = g) (select : Finset ι → ι)
    (hcor : ∀ f : Finset ι → ℝ, IsBoolean f → Monotone f →
      (∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.erase ∅, fourier g S ^ 2 * influence f (select S)) ≤
        covariance f g)
    {D : Family ι} (hD : D.IsHereditary) :
    ((D ∩ Family.oneSupport g).card : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ i, spectralWeights g select i * (D.star i).card

name: Chvatal.kleitman_weighted_bound
statement:
theorem kleitman_weighted_bound [LinearOrder ι] [Nonempty ι] {B : Family ι}
    (hB : B.IsMaximalIntersecting) (ω : Finset ι → ℝ)
    (hω : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ω x) (hanti : Antitone ω) :
    (∀ i, 0 ≤ spectralWeights B.indicator orderedSelector i) ∧
    (∑ i, spectralWeights B.indicator orderedSelector i) = 1 ∧
    (∑ x ∈ B, ω x) ≤
      (∑ i, spectralWeights B.indicator orderedSelector i *
        ∑ x ∈ Family.star Finset.univ i, ω x) ∧
    (∑ i, spectralWeights B.indicator orderedSelector i *
        ∑ x ∈ Family.star Finset.univ i, ω x) ≤
      Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun i => ∑ x ∈ Family.star Finset.univ i, ω x)

name: Chvatal.orderedSelector_mem
statement:
theorem orderedSelector_mem [LinearOrder ι] [Nonempty ι] {S : Finset ι}
    (hS : S.Nonempty) : orderedSelector S ∈ S

name: Chvatal.selected_spectral_le
statement:
theorem selected_spectral_le (f g : Finset ι → ℝ) (select : Finset ι → ι)
    (hselect : ∀ S : Finset ι, S.Nonempty → select S ∈ S) :
    (∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.erase ∅, fourier g S ^ 2 * influence f (select S)) ≤
      spectralWeight f g

name: Chvatal.spectralWeights_nonneg
statement:
theorem spectralWeights_nonneg (g : Finset ι → ℝ) (select : Finset ι → ι) (i : ι) :
    0 ≤ spectralWeights g select i

name: Chvatal.star_mixture_le_max
statement:
theorem star_mixture_le_max [Nonempty ι] (weights : ι → ℝ)
    (hweights : ∀ i, 0 ≤ weights i) (hsum : ∑ i, weights i = 1)
    (ω : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, weights i * ∑ x ∈ Family.star Finset.univ i, ω x) ≤
      Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun i => ∑ x ∈ Family.star Finset.univ i, ω x)

name: Chvatal.sum_defect_mul
statement:
theorem sum_defect_mul (weights : ι → ℝ) (B : Family ι) (ω : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, (starMixture weights x - B.indicator x) * ω x) =
      (∑ i, weights i * ∑ x ∈ Family.star Finset.univ i, ω x) - ∑ x ∈ B, ω x

name: Chvatal.sum_indicator_on_family
statement:
theorem sum_indicator_on_family (B D : Family ι) :
    (∑ x ∈ D, B.indicator x) = ((D ∩ B).card : ℝ)

name: Chvatal.sum_spectralWeights
statement:
theorem sum_spectralWeights {g : Finset ι → ℝ} (hg : IsBoolean g)
    (hdual : dual g = g) (select : Finset ι → ι) :
    ∑ i, spectralWeights g select i = 1

name: Chvatal.sum_spectralWeights_mul
statement:
theorem sum_spectralWeights_mul (g : Finset ι → ℝ) (select : Finset ι → ι)
    (a : ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, spectralWeights g select i * a i) =
      4 * ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.erase ∅, fourier g S ^ 2 * a (select S)

name: Chvatal.sum_starMixture
statement:
theorem sum_starMixture (weights : ι → ℝ) (D : Family ι) :
    (∑ x ∈ D, starMixture weights x) =
      ∑ i, weights i * (D.star i).card

name: Chvatal.sum_starMixture_sub_indicator
statement:
theorem sum_starMixture_sub_indicator (weights : ι → ℝ) (B D : Family ι) :
    (∑ x ∈ D, (starMixture weights x - B.indicator x)) =
      (∑ i, weights i * (D.star i).card) - (D ∩ B).card

name: Chvatal.weighted_bound_of_hereditary_bound
statement:
theorem weighted_bound_of_hereditary_bound (weights : ι → ℝ) (B : Family ι)
    (hbound : ∀ D : Family ι, D.IsHereditary →
      ((D ∩ B).card : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, weights i * (D.star i).card)
    (ω : Finset ι → ℝ) (hω : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ω x) (hanti : Antitone ω) :
    (∑ x ∈ B, ω x) ≤ ∑ i, weights i * ∑ x ∈ Family.star Finset.univ i, ω x

name: Chvatal.weighted_bound_of_spectral_bound
statement:
theorem weighted_bound_of_spectral_bound [Nonempty ι] {B : Family ι}
    (hB : B.IsMaximalIntersecting) (select : Finset ι → ι)
    (hselect : ∀ S : Finset ι, S.Nonempty → select S ∈ S)
    (hspectral : ∀ f : Finset ι → ℝ, IsBoolean f → Monotone f →
      spectralWeight f B.indicator ≤ covariance f B.indicator)
    (ω : Finset ι → ℝ) (hω : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ω x) (hanti : Antitone ω) :
    (∑ x ∈ B, ω x) ≤
      ∑ i, spectralWeights B.indicator select i * ∑ x ∈ Family.star Finset.univ i, ω x

name: Chvatal.weighted_star_mixture_bound
statement:
theorem weighted_star_mixture_bound [Nonempty ι] {B : Family ι}
    (hB : B.IsMaximalIntersecting) (select : Finset ι → ι)
    (hselect : ∀ S : Finset ι, S.Nonempty → select S ∈ S)
    (ω : Finset ι → ℝ) (hω : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ω x) (hanti : Antitone ω) :
    (∑ x ∈ B, ω x) ≤
      ∑ i, spectralWeights B.indicator select i * ∑ x ∈ Family.star Finset.univ i, ω x

name: Chvatal.IsBoolean.signLift
statement:
theorem IsBoolean.signLift {g : Finset ι → ℝ} (hg : IsBoolean g) :

name: Chvatal.IsSignedBoolean.booleanPart
statement:
theorem IsSignedBoolean.booleanPart {h : Finset ι → ℝ} (hh : IsSignedBoolean h) :

statement:
theorem IsSignedBoolean.positivePart_sq {h : Finset ι → ℝ} (hh : IsSignedBoolean h)
    (x : Finset ι) : max (h x) 0 ^ 2 = Chvatal.booleanPart h x

name: Chvatal.booleanPart_signLift
statement: @[simp] theorem booleanPart_signLift (g : Finset ι → ℝ) : booleanPart (signLift g) = g

name: Chvatal.dual_booleanPart
statement:
theorem dual_booleanPart {h : Finset ι → ℝ} (hh : ∀ x, h xᶜ = -h x) :
    dual (booleanPart h) = booleanPart h

name: Chvatal.fourier_signLift
statement:
theorem fourier_signLift (g : Finset ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) :
    fourier (signLift g) S = 2 * fourier g S - if S = ∅ then 1 else 0

name: Chvatal.fourier_signLift_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem fourier_signLift_of_nonempty (g : Finset ι → ℝ) {S : Finset ι}
    (hS : S.Nonempty) : fourier (signLift g) S = 2 * fourier g S

name: Chvatal.monotone_booleanPart
statement:
theorem monotone_booleanPart {h : Finset ι → ℝ} (hh : Monotone h) :
    Monotone (booleanPart h)

name: Chvatal.monotone_signLift
statement:
theorem monotone_signLift {g : Finset ι → ℝ} (hg : Monotone g) :
    Monotone (signLift g)

name: Chvatal.signLift_booleanPart
statement: @[simp] theorem signLift_booleanPart (h : Finset ι → ℝ) : signLift (booleanPart h) = h

name: Chvatal.signLift_compl
statement:
theorem signLift_compl {g : Finset ι → ℝ} (hg : dual g = g) (x : Finset ι) :
    signLift g xᶜ = -signLift g x

name: Chvatal.signLift_positivePart_sq
statement:
theorem signLift_positivePart_sq {g : Finset ι → ℝ} (hg : IsBoolean g) (x : Finset ι) :
    max (signLift g x) 0 ^ 2 = g x

name: Chvatal.signedSpectralWeights_nonneg
statement:
theorem signedSpectralWeights_nonneg (h : Finset ι → ℝ) (select : Finset ι → ι) (i : ι) :
    0 ≤ signedSpectralWeights h select i

name: Chvatal.signed_weighted_star_bound
statement:
theorem signed_weighted_star_bound [Nonempty ι] {h : Finset ι → ℝ}
    (hh : IsSignedBoolean h) (hm : Monotone h) (hanti : ∀ x, h xᶜ = -h x)
    (select : Finset ι → ι) (hselect : ∀ S : Finset ι, S.Nonempty → select S ∈ S)
    (ω : Finset ι → ℝ) (hω : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ω x) (hωanti : Antitone ω) :
    (∑ x, max (h x) 0 ^ 2 * ω x) ≤
      ∑ i, signedSpectralWeights h select i * ∑ x ∈ Family.star Finset.univ i, ω x

name: Chvatal.spectralWeights_eq_signed
statement:
theorem spectralWeights_eq_signed (g : Finset ι → ℝ) (select : Finset ι → ι) (i : ι) :
    spectralWeights g select i = signedSpectralWeights (signLift g) select i

name: Chvatal.sum_signedSpectralWeights
statement:
theorem sum_signedSpectralWeights {h : Finset ι → ℝ} (hh : IsSignedBoolean h)
    (hanti : ∀ x, h xᶜ = -h x) (select : Finset ι → ι) :
    (∑ i, signedSpectralWeights h select i) = 1

name: CircuitComplexity.Schnorr.xorBool_essential

name: CircuitComplexity.Schnorr.evalD_elimGateD
statement:
theorem evalD_elimGateD {N s : Nat} (d : CircDesc N (s + 1))
    (hs : 0 < s) (g : Fin (s + 1)) (rd : GateRedirect (N + s))
    (hrd : ∀ x : BitString N,
      wireValD d x ⟨N + g.val, by omega⟩ = match rd with
        | .const c => c
        | .wire w flip => flip.xor (wireValD d x ⟨w.val, by omega⟩))
    (hrd_wire : ∀ w' flip, rd = .wire w' flip → w'.val < N + g.val)
    (hg_not_last : g.val < s) :
    ∀ x, evalD hs (elimGateD d g rd) x = evalD (by omega : 0 < s + 1) d x

name: CircuitComplexity.Schnorr.evalD_essential_means_referenced
statement:
theorem evalD_essential_means_referenced
    {N s : Nat} (d : CircDesc N s) (hs : 0 < s) (a : Fin N)
    (hdep : ∃ x : BitString N, evalD hs d x ≠ evalD hs d (Function.update x a (!x a))) :
    ∃ g : Fin s, (d g).2.1.1.val = a.val ∨ (d g).2.1.2.val = a.val

name: CircuitComplexity.Schnorr.evalD_restrictD
statement:

    (hs : 0 < s) (a : Fin (N + 1)) (b : Bool) (x : BitString N) :
    evalD hs (restrictD d a b) x = evalD hs d (insertAt x a b)

name: CircuitComplexity.Schnorr.restriction_eliminates_two
statement:
theorem restriction_eliminates_two {n s : Nat} (d : CircDesc (n + 1) s)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hn : 0 < n) (comp : Bool)
    (heval : ∀ x, evalD hs d x = comp.xor (xorBool (n + 1) x))
    (hessential : ∀ (a : Fin (n + 1)) (x : BitString (n + 1)),
      evalD hs d x ≠ evalD hs d (Function.update x a (!x a))) :
    ∃ (s' : Nat) (d' : CircDesc n s') (hs' : 0 < s') (comp' : Bool),
      s' + 2 ≤ s ∧ (∀ x, evalD hs' d' x = comp'.xor (xorBool n x))

name: CircuitComplexity.Schnorr.wireValD_eq_of_unreferenced
statement:
theorem wireValD_eq_of_unreferenced
    {N s : Nat} (d : CircDesc N s) (a : Fin N) (b : Bool)
    (hno : ∀ g : Fin s, (d g).2.1.1.val ≠ a.val ∧ (d g).2.1.2.val ≠ a.val)
    (x : BitString N) (w : Fin (N + s)) (hw : w.val ≠ a.val) :
    wireValD d x w = wireValD d (Function.update x a b) w

statement:
lemma braiding_get
    (X Y : CombinationalCircuitCategory V G)
    (v : Wires V (X ⊗ Y).obj)

    ((X.braiding Y).hom.val v).get i =
      if h : i.val < Y.obj
      then v.get ⟨X.obj + i.val, braiding_add h⟩
      else v.get ⟨i.val - Y.obj, braiding_sub⟩

    (g : X₂ ⟶ Y₂) :
    (tensorHomVal f g a).get (Fin.castAdd Y₂.obj j) =
    Vector.get (f.val (Vector.ofFn fun i => Vector.get a (Fin.castAdd X₂.obj i))) j

name: Circuit.CombinationalCircuitCategory.tensorHom_get
statement:
lemma tensorHom_get
    {X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ : CombinationalCircuitCategory V G}
    (f : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (g : X₂ ⟶ Y₂) (w : Wires V (X₁.obj + X₂.obj))
    (i : Fin (Y₁.obj + Y₂.obj)) :
    (tensorHomVal f g w).get i =
    if h : i.val < Y₁.obj
    then (f.val (Vector.ofFn fun k => w.get (Fin.castAdd X₂.obj k))).get ⟨i.val, h⟩
    else (g.val (Vector.ofFn fun k => w.get (Fin.natAdd X₁.obj k))).get
      ⟨i.val - Y₁.obj, by omega⟩

    {X₁ Y₁ Z₁ X₂ Y₂ Z₂ : SequentialCircuitCategory V G}
    (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ Y₁)
    (f₂ : X₂ ⟶ Y₂)
    (g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Z₁)
    (g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Z₂) :
    tensorHom f₁ f₂ ≫ tensorHom g₁ g₂ = tensorHom (f₁ ≫ g₁) (f₂ ≫ g₂)

name: Circuit.SequentialCircuitCategory.tensorHom_def
statement:
@[simp]
lemma tensorHom_def
    {W X Y Z : SequentialCircuitCategory V G} (f : W ⟶ X) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    tensorHom f g = whiskerRight f Y ≫ whiskerLeft X g

name: Circuit.SequentialCircuitCategory.tensorHom_eq
statement:
lemma tensorHom_eq
    {X₁ Y₁ X₂ : SequentialCircuitCategory V G}
    (v : Stream (Wires V (X₁.obj + X₂.obj)))
    (f : X₁ ⟶ Y₁)
    (t : ℕ) :
    (f.val (Stream'.map tensorHomEq' v) t).toArray.size = Y₁.obj

name: Circuit.SequentialCircuitCategory.tensorHom_eq_left
statement:
lemma tensorHom_eq_left
    {X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ : SequentialCircuitCategory V G}
    (v : Stream (Wires V (X₁.obj + X₂.obj)))
    (t : ℕ) (j : Fin Y₁.obj)
    (f : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (g : X₂ ⟶ Y₂) :
    ((tensorHomVal f g v).get t).get (Fin.castAdd Y₂.obj j) =
    (f.val (Stream'.map tensorHomEq' v) t).get j

name: Circuit.SequentialCircuitCategory.tensorHom_eq_right
statement:
lemma tensorHom_eq_right
    {X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ : SequentialCircuitCategory V G}
    (v : Stream (Wires V (X₁.obj + X₂.obj)))
    (t : ℕ) (j : Fin Y₂.obj)
    (f : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (g : X₂ ⟶ Y₂) :
    ((tensorHomVal f g v).get t).get (Fin.natAdd Y₁.obj j) =
    (g.val (Stream'.map (fun w =>
      Vector.ofFn fun i ↦ Vector.get w (Fin.natAdd X₁.obj i)) v) t).get j

name: Circuit.SequentialCircuitCategory.tensorHom_get
statement:
lemma tensorHom_get
    {X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ : SequentialCircuitCategory V G}
    (f : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (g : X₂ ⟶ Y₂)
    (v : Stream (Wires V (X₁.obj + X₂.obj)))
    (t : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (Y₁.obj + Y₂.obj)) :
    (tensorHomVal f g v t).get i =
    if h : i.val < Y₁.obj
    then (f.val (Stream'.map tensorHomEq' v) t).get ⟨i.val, h⟩
    else (g.val (Stream'.map (fun w =>
      Vector.ofFn fun k => w.get (Fin.natAdd X₁.obj k)) v) t).get
      ⟨i.val - Y₁.obj, by omega⟩

      (stdSimplex.map (fun v : {v // v ∈ e.1} ↦ ⟨v.1, hef v.2⟩) x)

statement:
@[simp] theorem pullGeometricRealization_apply
    {A B : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [DecidableEq B]
    (e : A ↪ B) (F : Finset (Finset A))
    (y : GeometricRealization B (relabelFaceFamily e F)) (a : A) :

statement:
theorem pushGeometricRealization_apply_of_notMem_range

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.pushGeometricRealization_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem pushGeometricRealization_val
    {A B : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]

    (e : A ↪ B) (F : Finset (Finset A))

statement:
theorem pushGeometricRealization_val_eq_of_val_eq

    (x : GeometricRealization A F)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.relabelFaceSimplex_extended_apply
statement:
theorem relabelFaceSimplex_extended_apply
    {A B : Type*}
    [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B]
    (e : A ↪ B) (t : Finset A)
    (x : stdSimplex ℝ {b // b ∈ t.map e}) (a : A) :
    extendFaceCoordinates t (relabelFaceSimplex e t x) a =
      extendFaceCoordinates (t.map e) x (e a)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.relabelFaceSimplex_extended_eq_iff
statement:
theorem relabelFaceSimplex_extended_eq_iff
    {A B : Type*} [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B]
    (e : A ↪ B) {s t : Finset A}
    {x : stdSimplex ℝ {b // b ∈ s.map e}}
    {y : stdSimplex ℝ {b // b ∈ t.map e}} :
    extendFaceCoordinates s (relabelFaceSimplex e s x) =
        extendFaceCoordinates t (relabelFaceSimplex e t y) ↔
      extendFaceCoordinates (s.map e) x =
        extendFaceCoordinates (t.map e) y

statement:
theorem sum_attach_mul_eq_sum_extendFaceCoordinates
    {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V] (t : Finset V)
  (x : stdSimplex ℝ {v // v ∈ t}) (F : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ v : {v // v ∈ t}, x v * F v.1) =
      ∑ v ∈ t, extendFaceCoordinates t x v * F v

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.sum_extendFaceCoordinates_eq_of_eq
statement:
theorem sum_extendFaceCoordinates_eq_of_eq
    {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V] {s t : Finset V}
    (x : stdSimplex ℝ {v // v ∈ s}) (y : stdSimplex ℝ {v // v ∈ t})
    (hxy : extendFaceCoordinates s x = extendFaceCoordinates t y)
    (F : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ v : {v // v ∈ s}, x v * F v.1) =
      ∑ v : {v // v ∈ t}, y v * F v.1

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.sum_extendFaceCoordinates_relabelFaceSimplex
statement:
theorem sum_extendFaceCoordinates_relabelFaceSimplex
    {A B : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B]
    (e : A ↪ B) (t : Finset A)
    (x : stdSimplex ℝ {b // b ∈ t.map e}) (F : B → ℝ) :
    (∑ b : B, extendFaceCoordinates (t.map e) x b * F b) =
      ∑ a : A,
        extendFaceCoordinates t (relabelFaceSimplex e t x) a *
          F (e a)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.sum_extendFaceCoordinates_relabelUnivSimplex
statement:
theorem sum_extendFaceCoordinates_relabelUnivSimplex
    {A B : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [DecidableEq B]
    (e : A ↪ B)
    (x : stdSimplex ℝ
      {b // b ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset A).map e})
    (F : B → ℝ) :
    (∑ b : B,
        extendFaceCoordinates
          ((Finset.univ : Finset A).map e) x b * F b) =
      ∑ a : A, relabelUnivSimplex e x a * F (e a)

theorem midpointEval_central_coord

statement:
theorem midpointRecoverEdge_central
    (t : K.Face) {x : K.MidpointVertex → ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ w ∉ K.midpointCentralFace t, x w = 0)
    (hx0 : ∀ w, 0 ≤ x w) (hx1 : ∑ w, x w = 1) (e : K.Edge) :
    K.midpointRecoverEdge (K.midpointEvalAffine x) e = x (Sum.inr e)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.IntrinsicTwoComplex.midpointRecoverEdge_corner
statement:
theorem midpointRecoverEdge_corner
    (t : K.Face) (i : ZMod 3) {x : K.MidpointVertex → ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ w ∉ K.midpointCornerFace t i, x w = 0)
    (hx0 : ∀ w, 0 ≤ x w) (hx1 : ∑ w, x w = 1) (e : K.Edge) :
    K.midpointRecoverEdge (K.midpointEvalAffine x) e = x (Sum.inr e)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.IntrinsicTwoComplex.midpointRecoverEdge_faceEdge
statement:
theorem midpointRecoverEdge_faceEdge (p : K.Vertex → ℝ) (t : K.Face) (i : ZMod 3) :
    K.midpointRecoverEdge p (K.faceEdge t i) =
      max 0 (min (2 * p (K.faceVertex t i))
        (min (2 * p (K.faceVertex t (i + 1)))
          (2 * (p (K.faceVertex t i) + p (K.faceVertex t (i + 1))) - 1)))

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.IntrinsicTwoComplex.midpointRecoverOld_central
statement:
theorem midpointRecoverOld_central

    K.midpointRecoverOld (K.midpointEvalAffine x) v = x (Sum.inl v)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.IntrinsicTwoComplex.midpointRecoverOld_corner
statement:
theorem midpointRecoverOld_corner

    (hx0 : ∀ w, 0 ≤ x w) (hx1 : ∑ w, x w = 1) (v : K.Vertex) :

statement:
theorem affine_map_midpoint
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

statement:

    (t : K.Face) (a : (K.Vertex → ℝ) →ᵃ[ℝ] E)
    (x : K.realization) (hx : x ∈ K.faceCarrier t.1) :
    a x.1 ∈ convexHull ℝ
      (Set.range fun v : t.1 => a (K.facePoint t v).1)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.IntrinsicTwoComplex.dist_midpointPosition_central_le
statement:
theorem dist_midpointPosition_central_le
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (t : K.Face) (a : (K.Vertex → ℝ) →ᵃ[ℝ] E)
    {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hvertex : ∀ j k : ZMod 3,
      dist (a (Pi.single (K.faceVertex t j) 1))
        (a (Pi.single (K.faceVertex t k) 1)) ≤ d)
    {w z : K.MidpointVertex} (hw : w ∈ K.midpointCentralFace t)
    (hz : z ∈ K.midpointCentralFace t) :
    dist (a (K.midpointPosition w)) (a (K.midpointPosition z)) ≤ d / 2

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.IntrinsicTwoComplex.dist_midpointPosition_corner_le
statement:
theorem dist_midpointPosition_corner_le
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (t : K.Face) (i : ZMod 3) (a : (K.Vertex → ℝ) →ᵃ[ℝ] E)
    {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hvertex : ∀ j k : ZMod 3,
      dist (a (Pi.single (K.faceVertex t j) 1))
        (a (Pi.single (K.faceVertex t k) 1)) ≤ d)
    {w z : K.MidpointVertex} (hw : w ∈ K.midpointCornerFace t i)
    (hz : z ∈ K.midpointCornerFace t i) :
    dist (a (K.midpointPosition w)) (a (K.midpointPosition z)) ≤ d / 2

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.IntrinsicTwoComplex.exists_facePoints_dist_ge
statement:
theorem exists_facePoints_dist_ge
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (t : K.Face) (a : (K.Vertex → ℝ) →ᵃ[ℝ] E)
    (x y : K.realization) (hx : x ∈ K.faceCarrier t.1)
    (hy : y ∈ K.faceCarrier t.1) :
    ∃ v w : t.1,
      dist (a x.1) (a y.1) ≤
        dist (a (K.facePoint t v).1) (a (K.facePoint t w).1)

LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.IntrinsicTwoComplex.exists_subdivision_image_dist_lt
statement:
theorem exists_subdivision_image_dist_lt (K : IntrinsicTwoComplex)
    {h : K.realization → Plane} (hcont : Continuous h)
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) :
    ∃ R : K.Subdivision, ∀ t ∈ R.refined.faces,
      ∀ x ∈ R.refined.faceCarrier t, ∀ y ∈ R.refined.faceCarrier t,
        dist (h (R.homeo x)) (h (R.homeo y)) < eps

    ∃ R : K.Subdivision, ∀ t ∈ R.refined.faces,
      ∀ x ∈ R.refined.faceCarrier t, ∀ y ∈ R.refined.faceCarrier t,
        dist (R.homeo x) (R.homeo y) < eps

statement:

      ∃ i, ∀ x ∈ R.refined.faceCarrier t, R.homeo x ∈ U i

    ∃ j : K.AdaptiveEdgeInterval U hU t i,
      r ∈ Set.Icc

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.IntrinsicTwoComplex.exists_adjacent_get_of_pairwise_le
statement:
theorem exists_adjacent_get_of_pairwise_le {α : Type*} (L : List α) (f : α → ℝ)
    (hlength : 2 ≤ L.length)
    (hpair : L.Pairwise fun a b ↦ f a ≤ f b) {r : ℝ}
    (hfirst : f (L.get ⟨0, by omega⟩) ≤ r)
    (hlast : r ≤ f (L.get ⟨L.length - 1, by omega⟩)) :
    ∃ j : Fin (L.length - 1),
      f (L.get ⟨j.1, by omega⟩) ≤ r ∧
        r ≤ f (L.get ⟨j.1 + 1, by omega⟩)

statement:
theorem mem_boundaryEdgeVertices_iff (hU : IsOpen U) (t : K.AdaptiveFace U)
    (i : ZMod 3) (p : K.realization) :
    p ∈ K.boundaryEdgeVertices U hU t i ↔
      p ∈ K.boundaryVertices U hU t ∧
        p ∈ K.levelFaceEdgeCarrier t.2.1 i

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.IntrinsicTwoComplex.mem_boundaryVertices_iff
statement:
theorem mem_boundaryVertices_iff (hU : IsOpen U) (t : K.AdaptiveFace U)
    (p : K.realization) :

      p ∈ K.adaptiveFaceCarrier U t ∧
        ∃ (u : K.TouchingFace U t) (v : K.AdaptiveVertexOccurrence U u.1),
          K.adaptiveVertexPoint U u.1 v = p

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.IntrinsicTwoComplex.mem_boundaryVertices_iff_of_mem_adaptiveFaceCarrier_inter
statement:

    (hpt : p ∈ K.adaptiveFaceCarrier U t) :
    p ∈ K.boundaryVertices U hU s ↔
      p ∈ K.boundaryVertices U hU t

statement:

    K.levelFaceEdgeParameter t.2.1 i p ∉ Set.Ioo

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.PlaneComplex.cone_baryEval_coneWeights
statement:
theorem cone_baryEval_coneWeights (S : Set Plane) (hS : Convex ℝ S) (c : Plane)

    (hgraph : ∀ s ∈ K.simplexes, s.card ≤ 2)
    (hsupport : K.support = frontier S) (z : K.Vertex → ℝ) :
    (K.cone S hS c hc havoid hgraph hsupport).baryEval (K.coneWeights z) =

    (hgraph : ∀ s ∈ K.simplexes, s.card ≤ 2)
    (hsupport : K.support = frontier S) (hfrontier : (frontier S).Nonempty) :
    (K.cone S hS c hc havoid hgraph hsupport).support = S

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.PlaneComplex.exists_used_face_eq
statement:
theorem exists_used_face_eq (s : Finset K.Vertex) (hs : s ∈ K.simplexes) :
    ∃ t : Finset (used K).Vertex, t ∈ (used K).simplexes ∧
      t.map K.usedEmbedding = s ∧ (used K).cellCarrier t = K.cellCarrier s

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.PlaneComplex.mapGraph_baryEval_eq
statement:
theorem mapGraph_baryEval_eq (f : Plane → Plane)
    (hvertex : ∀ v, K.position v ∈ K.support) (hinj : Set.InjOn f K.support)
    (hgraph : ∀ s ∈ K.simplexes, s.card ≤ 2)
    (haffine : ∀ s ∈ K.simplexes, IsAffineOn f (K.cellCarrier s))
    {s : Finset K.Vertex} (hs : s ∈ K.simplexes) {z : K.Vertex → ℝ}
    (hzsupp : ∀ v ∉ s, z v = 0) (hz0 : ∀ v, 0 ≤ z v)
    (hzsum : ∑ v, z v = 1) :
    (K.mapGraph f hvertex hinj hgraph haffine).baryEval z = f (K.baryEval z)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.PlaneComplex.mapGraph_cellCarrier
statement:
theorem mapGraph_cellCarrier (f : Plane → Plane)

    (hgraph : ∀ s ∈ K.simplexes, s.card ≤ 2)
    (haffine : ∀ s ∈ K.simplexes, IsAffineOn f (K.cellCarrier s))
    {s : Finset K.Vertex} (hs : s ∈ K.simplexes) :
    (K.mapGraph f hvertex hinj hgraph haffine).cellCarrier s = f '' K.cellCarrier s

theorem mapGraph_support (f : Plane → Plane)

statement:

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.PlaneComplex.repositionMap_affineOn_face
statement:
theorem repositionMap_affineOn_face (position' : K.Vertex → Plane)
    (hinj : Function.Injective position')
    (haff : ∀ s ∈ K.simplexes, AffineIndependent ℝ fun v : s => position' v)
    (hface : ∀ s ∈ K.simplexes, ∀ t ∈ K.simplexes,
      convexHull ℝ (position' '' (s : Set K.Vertex)) ∩
          convexHull ℝ (position' '' (t : Set K.Vertex)) =
        convexHull ℝ (position' '' ((s ∩ t : Finset K.Vertex) : Set K.Vertex)))
    {s : Finset K.Vertex} (hs : s ∈ K.simplexes) :
    IsAffineOn (K.repositionMap position' hinj haff hface) (K.cellCarrier s)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.PlaneComplex.repositionMap_apply_realization
statement:
theorem repositionMap_apply_realization (position' : K.Vertex → Plane)
    (hinj : Function.Injective position')
    (haff : ∀ s ∈ K.simplexes, AffineIndependent ℝ fun v : s => position' v)
    (hface : ∀ s ∈ K.simplexes, ∀ t ∈ K.simplexes,
      convexHull ℝ (position' '' (s : Set K.Vertex)) ∩
          convexHull ℝ (position' '' (t : Set K.Vertex)) =
        convexHull ℝ (position' '' ((s ∩ t : Finset K.Vertex) : Set K.Vertex)))
    (x : GeometricRealization K.Vertex K.simplexes) :
    K.repositionMap position' hinj haff hface (K.baryEval x.1) =
      (K.reposition position' hinj haff hface).baryEval x.1

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.PlaneComplex.repositionMap_isPL
statement:
theorem repositionMap_isPL (position' : K.Vertex → Plane)
    (hinj : Function.Injective position')
    (haff : ∀ s ∈ K.simplexes, AffineIndependent ℝ fun v : s => position' v)
    (hface : ∀ s ∈ K.simplexes, ∀ t ∈ K.simplexes,
      convexHull ℝ (position' '' (s : Set K.Vertex)) ∩
          convexHull ℝ (position' '' (t : Set K.Vertex)) =
        convexHull ℝ (position' '' ((s ∩ t : Finset K.Vertex) : Set K.Vertex))) :
    IsPLOn K (K.repositionMap position' hinj haff hface)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.PlaneComplex.repositionMap_position
statement:
theorem repositionMap_position (position' : K.Vertex → Plane)
    (hinj : Function.Injective position')
    (haff : ∀ s ∈ K.simplexes, AffineIndependent ℝ fun v : s => position' v)
    (hface : ∀ s ∈ K.simplexes, ∀ t ∈ K.simplexes,
      convexHull ℝ (position' '' (s : Set K.Vertex)) ∩
          convexHull ℝ (position' '' (t : Set K.Vertex)) =
        convexHull ℝ (position' '' ((s ∩ t : Finset K.Vertex) : Set K.Vertex)))
    (v : K.Vertex) (hv : ({v} : Finset K.Vertex) ∈ K.simplexes) :
    K.repositionMap position' hinj haff hface (K.position v) = position' v

statement:
theorem affineIndependent_insert_interior_of_card_le_two {S : Set Plane} (hS : Convex ℝ S)
    {A : Finset Plane} (hAcard : A.card ≤ 2)
    (hAI : AffineIndependent ℝ ((↑) : A → Plane))
    (hAS : convexHull ℝ (A : Set Plane) ⊆ frontier S) {c : Plane}

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.convexHull_insert_inter_convexHull
LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.convexHull_insert_inter_convexHull'
statement:
theorem convexHull_insert_inter_convexHull' {S A B : Set Plane}
    (hS : Convex ℝ S) {c : Plane} (hc : c ∈ interior S)
    (hAS : convexHull ℝ A ⊆ frontier S) (hBS : convexHull ℝ B ⊆ frontier S)
    (hface : convexHull ℝ A ∩ convexHull ℝ B = convexHull ℝ (A ∩ B)) :
    convexHull ℝ (insert c A) ∩ convexHull ℝ B = convexHull ℝ (A ∩ B)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.convexHull_insert_inter_convexHull_insert
statement:
theorem convexHull_insert_inter_convexHull_insert {S A B : Set Plane}
    (hS : Convex ℝ S) (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty) {c : Plane}
    (hc : c ∈ interior S) (hAS : convexHull ℝ A ⊆ frontier S)
    (hBS : convexHull ℝ B ⊆ frontier S)
    (hface : convexHull ℝ A ∩ convexHull ℝ B = convexHull ℝ (A ∩ B)) :
    convexHull ℝ (insert c A) ∩ convexHull ℝ (insert c B) =
      convexHull ℝ (insert c (A ∩ B))

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.convexHull_insert_inter_convexHull_insert'
statement:
theorem convexHull_insert_inter_convexHull_insert' {S A B : Set Plane}
    (hS : Convex ℝ S) {c : Plane} (hc : c ∈ interior S)
    (hAS : convexHull ℝ A ⊆ frontier S) (hBS : convexHull ℝ B ⊆ frontier S)
    (hface : convexHull ℝ A ∩ convexHull ℝ B = convexHull ℝ (A ∩ B)) :
    convexHull ℝ (insert c A) ∩ convexHull ℝ (insert c B) =
      convexHull ℝ (insert c (A ∩ B))

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.eq_of_mem_segment_interior_frontier
statement:

    {c x y z : Plane} (hc : c ∈ interior S) (hx : x ∈ frontier S)
    (hy : y ∈ frontier S) (hzx : z ∈ segment ℝ c x) (hzy : z ∈ segment ℝ c y)
    (hzc : z ≠ c) : x = y

    {c x : Plane} (hc : c ∈ interior S) (hx : x ∈ S)
    (hfrontier : (frontier S).Nonempty) :
    ∃ y ∈ frontier S, x ∈ segment ℝ c y

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.TriangleMesh.convexHull_inter_of_signed_three_point_subsets
statement:
theorem convexHull_inter_of_signed_three_point_subsets
    {a b z : M.RefinedVertex f}
    (ha : 0 < f (a : Plane)) (hb : f (b : Plane) < 0) (hz : f (z : Plane) = 0)
    {A B : Finset (M.RefinedVertex f)}
    (hAclass : ∀ x ∈ A, x = a ∨ x = b ∨ x = z)
    (hBclass : ∀ x ∈ B, x = a ∨ x = b ∨ x = z)
    (hAmono : (∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ f (x : Plane)) ∨ (∀ x ∈ A, f (x : Plane) ≤ 0))
    (hBmono : (∀ x ∈ B, 0 ≤ f (x : Plane)) ∨ (∀ x ∈ B, f (x : Plane) ≤ 0)) :
    convexHull ℝ (((↑) : M.RefinedVertex f → Plane) '' (A : Set (M.RefinedVertex f))) ∩
        convexHull ℝ (((↑) : M.RefinedVertex f → Plane) '' (B : Set (M.RefinedVertex f))) =
      convexHull ℝ (((↑) : M.RefinedVertex f → Plane) ''
        ((A ∩ B : Finset (M.RefinedVertex f)) : Set (M.RefinedVertex f)))

      triangleAffineEquiv standardTrianglePosition p standardTrianglePosition_affineIndependent hp

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.TriangleMesh.strictMeshFor_triangles
statement:
theorem strictMeshFor_triangles (v : Fin 3 → M.Vertex)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.TriangleMesh.strictModelPosition_eq_affineReference
statement:
theorem strictModelPosition_eq_affineReference (p : Fin 3 → Plane)
    (hp : AffineIndependent ℝ p) (_ : 0 < f (p 0)) (_ : f (p 1) < 0)
    (_ : f (p 2) < 0) (i : Fin 5) :
    strictModelPosition p f i =
      triangleAffineEquiv standardTrianglePosition p standardTrianglePosition_affineIndependent hp
        (referenceSplitPosition (triangleCutParameter f (p 0) (p 1))
          (triangleCutParameter f (p 0) (p 2)) i)

statement:

theorem strictNegativeMeshFor_support (v : Fin 3 → M.Vertex)

theorem strictPattern_monochromatic_negative (z : Fin 5 → M.RefinedVertex f)

theorem strictPattern_monochromatic_positive (z : Fin 5 → M.RefinedVertex f)

statement:
theorem strictTriangles_monochromatic (v : Fin 3 → M.Vertex)

    M.RefinedTrianglesMonochromatic f
      (referenceSplitTriangles.image fun t =>

statement:

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.TriangleMesh.trace_vertex_eq_endpoint_of_edge_in_line
statement:
theorem trace_vertex_eq_endpoint_of_edge_in_line (t : M.Triangle) (k : Fin 3)
    {a b : M.Vertex} (_ : a ≠ b)
    (hedge : M.oppositeEdgePoints t k = ({a, b} : Finset M.Vertex).image M.position)
    {s : Finset (M.RefinedVertex f)} (hs : s ∈ M.localMeshTriangles f t)
    (ha : f (M.position a) = 0) (hb : f (M.position b) = 0)
    {x : M.RefinedVertex f} (hx : x ∈ M.childEdgeTrace f t k s) :
    x = M.oldRefinedVertex f a ∨ x = M.oldRefinedVertex f b

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.TriangleMesh.trace_vertex_eq_endpoint_of_mul_nonneg
statement:
theorem trace_vertex_eq_endpoint_of_mul_nonneg (t : M.Triangle) (k : Fin 3)
    {a b : M.Vertex} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hedge : M.oppositeEdgePoints t k = ({a, b} : Finset M.Vertex).image M.position)
    {s : Finset (M.RefinedVertex f)} (hs : s ∈ M.localMeshTriangles f t)
    (hprod : 0 ≤ f (M.position a) * f (M.position b))
    (hnotboth : ¬ (f (M.position a) = 0 ∧ f (M.position b) = 0))
    {x : M.RefinedVertex f} (hx : x ∈ M.childEdgeTrace f t k s) :
    x = M.oldRefinedVertex f a ∨ x = M.oldRefinedVertex f b

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.TriangleMesh.trace_vertex_eq_endpoint_or_cut
statement:
theorem trace_vertex_eq_endpoint_or_cut (t : M.Triangle) (k : Fin 3)
    {a b : M.Vertex} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hedge : M.oppositeEdgePoints t k = ({a, b} : Finset M.Vertex).image M.position)
    {s : Finset (M.RefinedVertex f)} (hs : s ∈ M.localMeshTriangles f t)
    (ha : 0 < f (M.position a)) (hb : f (M.position b) < 0)
    {x : M.RefinedVertex f} (hx : x ∈ M.childEdgeTrace f t k s) :
    x = M.oldRefinedVertex f a ∨ x = M.oldRefinedVertex f b ∨
      x = M.cutRefinedVertex f a b (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg ha hb)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.TriangleMesh.trace_vertex_mem_oppositeEdgeHull
statement:
theorem trace_vertex_mem_oppositeEdgeHull (t : M.Triangle) (k : Fin 3)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.TriangleMesh.trace_vertex_old_edge_or_zero
statement:
theorem trace_vertex_old_edge_or_zero (t : M.Triangle) (k : Fin 3)
    {e : Finset M.Vertex} (hedge : M.oppositeEdgePoints t k = e.image M.position)
    {s : Finset (M.RefinedVertex f)} (hs : s ∈ M.localMeshTriangles f t)
    {x : M.RefinedVertex f} (hx : x ∈ M.childEdgeTrace f t k s) :
    (∃ v ∈ e, (x : Plane) = M.position v) ∨ f (x : Plane) = 0

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.convexHull_image_inter_of_affine_separation
statement:
theorem convexHull_image_inter_of_affine_separation {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V]
    (position : V → Plane) (_ : Function.Injective position) (s t : Finset V)
    (f : Plane →ᵃ[ℝ] ℝ) (hs : ∀ v ∈ s, 0 ≤ f (position v))
    (ht : ∀ v ∈ t, f (position v) ≤ 0)
    (hszero : ∀ v ∈ s, f (position v) = 0 ↔ v ∈ (s ∩ t))
    (htzero : ∀ v ∈ t, f (position v) = 0 ↔ v ∈ (s ∩ t)) :
    convexHull ℝ (position '' (s : Set V)) ∩ convexHull ℝ (position '' (t : Set V)) =
      convexHull ℝ (position '' ((s ∩ t : Finset V) : Set V))

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.convexHull_inter_affine_zero_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem convexHull_inter_affine_zero_of_nonneg (s : Finset Plane) (f : Plane →ᵃ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ f x) :
    convexHull ℝ (s : Set Plane) ∩ {x | f x = 0} =
      convexHull ℝ ((s.filter fun x => f x = 0 : Finset Plane) : Set Plane)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.convexHull_inter_affine_zero_of_nonneg_set
statement:
theorem convexHull_inter_affine_zero_of_nonneg_set (s : Set Plane)
    (f : Plane →ᵃ[ℝ] ℝ) (hf : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ f x) :
    convexHull ℝ s ∩ {x | f x = 0} =
      convexHull ℝ (s ∩ {x | f x = 0})

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.convexHull_inter_of_affine_separation
statement:
theorem convexHull_inter_of_affine_separation (s t u : Finset Plane)
    (f : Plane →ᵃ[ℝ] ℝ) (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ f x) (ht : ∀ x ∈ t, f x ≤ 0)
    (hszero : s.filter (fun x => f x = 0) = u)
    (htzero : t.filter (fun x => f x = 0) = u) :

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.PolygonalCircle.StripScales.exists_edgeOverlapAngle
statement:
theorem StripScales.exists_edgeOverlapAngle (S : J.StripScales) (i : ZMod J.n) :
    ∃ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ ∧ θ < Real.pi ∧
      θ < (J.outgoingDirection i).angleDiff (J.incomingRayDirection i) ∧
      θ < (J.incomingRayDirection i).angleDiff (J.outgoingDirection i) ∧
      θ < (J.outgoingDirection (i + 1)).angleDiff (J.incomingRayDirection (i + 1)) ∧
      θ < (J.incomingRayDirection (i + 1)).angleDiff (J.outgoingDirection (i + 1)) ∧
      2 * S.trim < ((5 * S.trim / 2 : ℝ) * (Circle.exp θ : ℂ)).re ∧
      ((5 * S.trim / 2 : ℝ) * (Circle.exp θ : ℂ)).re <
        J.edgeLength i - 2 * S.trim ∧
      |((5 * S.trim / 2 : ℝ) * (Circle.exp θ : ℂ)).im| < S.width

statement:
theorem complexDirection_sub_eq_of_mem_segment {p q x : Plane} (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (hx : x ∈ segment ℝ p q) (hxp : x ≠ p) :
    complexDirection (planeComplexEquiv (x - p))
        (by
          intro h
          apply hxp
          rw [← sub_eq_zero]
          apply planeComplexEquiv.injective
          simpa using h) =
      complexDirection (planeComplexEquiv (q - p))
        (by
          intro h
          apply hpq.symm
          rw [← sub_eq_zero]
          apply planeComplexEquiv.injective
          simpa using h)

    ∀ᶠ Q in nhds P,

        if i ∈ J.upLeftEdges P then P 1 ≤ Q 1
        else if i ∈ J.downLeftEdges P then Q 1 < P 1
        else J.EdgeCrossed i P)

        ∀ x ∈ J.edgeSegment i, ∀ y ∈ J.edgeSegment j, 12 * ε < dist x y) ∧

          change 2 * (Fintype.equivFin I i).val < 2 * Fintype.card I + 1
          omega⟩ = left i

statement:
theorem sampledFaceCarrier_parameter_side (cuts : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card K.EdgeFace)) (r : Fin (cuts + 2))
    {u : Finset (K.sampledEdgeChain cuts).arrangementMesh.Vertex}
    (hu : u ∈ (K.sampledEdgeChain cuts).arrangementMesh.toPlaneComplex.simplexes) :
    (∀ x ∈ (K.sampledEdgeChain cuts).arrangementMesh.toPlaneComplex.cellCarrier u,
        K.edgeParameter i x ≤ r.val / (cuts + 1 : ℝ)) ∨
      (∀ x ∈ (K.sampledEdgeChain cuts).arrangementMesh.toPlaneComplex.cellCarrier u,
        r.val / (cuts + 1 : ℝ) ≤ K.edgeParameter i x)

statement:

    (hui : (K.sampledEdgeChain cuts).arrangementMesh.toPlaneComplex.cellCarrier u ⊆
      K.cellCarrier (K.edgeAt i).1)
    {x y : Plane}
    (hx : x ∈ (K.sampledEdgeChain cuts).arrangementMesh.toPlaneComplex.cellCarrier u)
    (hy : y ∈ (K.sampledEdgeChain cuts).arrangementMesh.toPlaneComplex.cellCarrier u) :
    |K.edgeParameter i x - K.edgeParameter i y| ≤ 1 / (cuts + 1 : ℝ)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.PlaneComplex.sampledFace_parameter_side
statement:

    (hu : u ∈ (K.sampledEdgeChain cuts).arrangementMesh.toPlaneComplex.simplexes) :
    (∀ v ∈ u, K.edgeParameter i
        ((K.sampledEdgeChain cuts).arrangementMesh.position v) ≤
          r.val / (cuts + 1 : ℝ)) ∨
      (∀ v ∈ u, r.val / (cuts + 1 : ℝ) ≤ K.edgeParameter i
        ((K.sampledEdgeChain cuts).arrangementMesh.position v))
