statement:
theorem exists_chartMatchingControl [T2Space S] [CompactSpace S]
    [SecondCountableTopology S] (T : PartialTriangulation S) (c : MoiseChart S) :
    ∃ mu : T.chartOverlap c → ℝ,
      StronglyPositiveOn Set.univ mu ∧
      ∀ (g' : T.chartOverlap c → c.kind.modelRegion)
        (g : T.toIntrinsic.realization → S),
        (∀ y : T.chartOverlap c, g y.1 = (c.chart.symm (g' y)).1) →
        (∀ y : T.chartOverlap c,
          dist (g' y : Plane) (T.chartOverlapMap c y) ≤ mu y) →
        MatchesAtFrontier (T.chartOverlap c) g T.embed

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.PartialTriangulation.exists_chartMatchingControlOn_of_metricSpace
statement:
theorem exists_chartMatchingControlOn_of_metricSpace
    {S' : Type*} [MetricSpace S']
    (T : PartialTriangulation S') (c : MoiseChart S')
    (U : Set T.toIntrinsic.realization) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hsub : U ⊆ T.chartOverlap c) :
    ∃ mu : U → ℝ,
      StronglyPositiveOn Set.univ mu ∧
      ∀ (g' : U → c.kind.modelRegion)
        (g : T.toIntrinsic.realization → S'),
        (∀ y : U, g y.1 = (c.chart.symm (g' y)).1) →
        (∀ y : U,
          dist (g' y : Plane)
            (T.chartOverlapMap c ⟨y.1, hsub y.2⟩) ≤ mu y) →
        MatchesAtFrontier U g T.embed ∧
          Disjoint (g '' U) (T.embed '' Uᶜ)

        (∀ y : T.chartOverlap c, g y.1 = (c.chart.symm (g' y)).1) →

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.PartialTriangulation.exists_glued
statement:
theorem PartialTriangulation.exists_glued {S : Type*} [TopologicalSpace S] [T2Space S]
    [ChartedSpace (EuclideanHalfSpace 2) S]
    (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (F₁ F₂ : Finset (Finset V))
    (hcard : ∀ t ∈ F₁ ∪ F₂, t.card = 3)
    (e₁ : GeometricRealization V F₁ → S) (e₂ : GeometricRealization V F₂ → S)
    (he₁ : _root_.Topology.IsEmbedding e₁) (he₂ : _root_.Topology.IsEmbedding e₂)
    (hagree : ∀ (x : GeometricRealization V F₁) (y : GeometricRealization V F₂),
      (x : V → ℝ) = (y : V → ℝ) → e₁ x = e₂ y)
    (hsep : ∀ (x : GeometricRealization V F₁) (y : GeometricRealization V F₂),
      e₁ x = e₂ y → (x : V → ℝ) = (y : V → ℝ))
    (hboundary₁ : BoundaryFacewiseRegularEmbedding F₁ e₁)
    (hboundary₂ : BoundaryFacewiseRegularEmbedding F₂ e₂) :
    ∃ T' : PartialTriangulation S,
      ∃ vertexEquiv : T'.Vertex ≃ V,
      Moise.relabelFaceFamily vertexEquiv.toEmbedding T'.faces = F₁ ∪ F₂ ∧
      T'.support = Set.range e₁ ∪ Set.range e₂ ∧
      (∀ e ∈ T'.edges, (T'.faces.filter fun t => e ⊆ t).card ≤ 2) ∧
      T'.BoundaryFacewiseRegular

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.PartialTriangulation.exists_refinedSubcomplex_between
statement:
theorem exists_refinedSubcomplex_between {C U : Set S}
    (hC : IsCompact C) (hCT : C ⊆ T.support) (hU : IsOpen U) (hCU : C ⊆ U) :
    ∃ (R : T.toIntrinsic.Subdivision)
      (keep : Finset (Finset R.refined.Vertex)),
      C ⊆ (@PartialTriangulation.restrictFaces _ _ (T.refine R)
        (fun t => t ∈ keep) (fun t => Finset.decidableMem t keep)).support ∧
      (@PartialTriangulation.restrictFaces _ _ (T.refine R)
        (fun t => t ∈ keep) (fun t => Finset.decidableMem t keep)).support ⊆ U

    (T : PartialTriangulation S) (c : MoiseChart S) :
    ∃ phi : T.chartOverlap c → ℝ,
      StronglyPositiveOn Set.univ phi ∧
      LocallyFiniteTriangleComplex.SeparatesVerticesFromFaces
        (T.adaptiveOverlapGraphRealization c)

theorem exists_straightenedChartAway
    {S' : Type*} [TopologicalSpace S'] [T2Space S'] [CompactSpace S']
    [SecondCountableTopology S']
    [ChartedSpace (EuclideanHalfSpace 2) S']
    (T : PartialTriangulation S') (c : MoiseChart S')
    (hc : c.BoundaryFaithful)
    (hboundary : T.BoundaryFacewiseRegular)
    (A : Set S') (hA : IsClosed A) :
    ∃ (U : Set T.toIntrinsic.realization) (_ : IsOpen U)
      (V : Set Plane) (_ : IsOpen V)
      (Q : PolygonalReplacementPresentation U V)
      (_ : PolygonalReplacementSourceAtlas T.toIntrinsic U V Q)
      (g' : U → c.kind.modelRegion)
      (g : T.toIntrinsic.realization → S'),
      V ⊆ c.kind.perturbationRegion ∧
      (∀ z : c.kind.modelRegion, (z : Plane) ∉ V →
        (c.chart.symm z).1 ∈ A) ∧
      (∀ y : T.chartOverlap c, T.embed y.1 ∈ A →
        T.chartOverlapMap c y ∉ V) ∧
      (∀ y : T.chartOverlap c, y.1 ∉ U → T.embed y.1 ∈ A) ∧
      (∀ y : U, (g' y : Plane) = (Q.sourceHomeomorph y).1.1) ∧
      (∀ (_hk : c.kind = ChartKind.halfDisk) (y : U),
        (Q.sourceHomeomorph y).1.1 0 = 0 ↔
          T.embed y.1 ∈
            (modelWithCornersEuclideanHalfSpace 2).boundary S') ∧
      U ⊆ T.chartOverlap c ∧
      (∀ y : U, g y.1 = (c.chart.symm (g' y)).1) ∧
      (∀ x, T.embed x ∈ A → g x = T.embed x) ∧
      MatchesAtFrontier U g T.embed ∧
      ContinuousOn g U ∧
      Set.InjOn g U ∧
      Disjoint (g '' U) (T.embed '' Uᶜ) ∧
      _root_.Topology.IsEmbedding (frontierGlue U g T.embed)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.PartialTriangulation.exists_straightenedChartOpen
statement:
theorem exists_straightenedChartOpen
    {S' : Type*} [TopologicalSpace S'] [T2Space S'] [CompactSpace S']
    [SecondCountableTopology S']
    [ChartedSpace (EuclideanHalfSpace 2) S']
    (T : PartialTriangulation S') (c : MoiseChart S')
    (hc : c.BoundaryFaithful)
    (hboundary : T.BoundaryFacewiseRegular)
    (U : Set T.toIntrinsic.realization) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hsub : U ⊆ T.chartOverlap c)
    (V : Set Plane) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hVsub : V ⊆ c.kind.perturbationRegion)
    (hmem : ∀ x : U,
      T.chartOverlapMap c ⟨x.1, hsub x.2⟩ ∈ V)
    (hfVclosed : _root_.Topology.IsClosedEmbedding
      (fun x : U ↦
        (⟨T.chartOverlapMap c ⟨x.1, hsub x.2⟩, hmem x⟩ : V))) :
    ∃ (Q : PolygonalReplacementPresentation U V)
      (_ : PolygonalReplacementSourceAtlas T.toIntrinsic U V Q)
      (g' : U → c.kind.modelRegion)
      (g : T.toIntrinsic.realization → S'),
      (∀ y : U, (g' y : Plane) = (Q.sourceHomeomorph y).1.1) ∧
      (∀ (_hk : c.kind = ChartKind.halfDisk) (y : U),
        (Q.sourceHomeomorph y).1.1 0 = 0 ↔
          T.embed y.1 ∈
            (modelWithCornersEuclideanHalfSpace 2).boundary S') ∧
      (∀ y : U, g y.1 = (c.chart.symm (g' y)).1) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∉ U → g x = T.embed x) ∧
      MatchesAtFrontier U g T.embed ∧
      ContinuousOn g U ∧
      Set.InjOn g U ∧
      Disjoint (g '' U) (T.embed '' Uᶜ) ∧
      _root_.Topology.IsEmbedding (frontierGlue U g T.embed)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.PartialTriangulation.exists_straightenedChartOverlap
statement:
theorem PartialTriangulation.exists_straightenedChartOverlap
    (T : PartialTriangulation S) (c : MoiseChart S) :
    ∃ (Q : PolygonalReplacementPresentation (T.chartOverlap c)
        c.kind.perturbationRegion)
      (_ : PolygonalReplacementSourceAtlas T.toIntrinsic (T.chartOverlap c)
        c.kind.perturbationRegion Q)
      (g' : T.chartOverlap c → c.kind.modelRegion)
      (g : T.toIntrinsic.realization → S),
      (∀ y : T.chartOverlap c,
        (g' y : Plane) = (Q.sourceHomeomorph y).1.1) ∧
      (∀ y : T.chartOverlap c, g y.1 = (c.chart.symm (g' y)).1) ∧
      MatchesAtFrontier (T.chartOverlap c) g T.embed ∧
      ContinuousOn g (T.chartOverlap c) ∧
      Set.InjOn g (T.chartOverlap c) ∧
      Disjoint (g '' T.chartOverlap c) (T.embed '' (T.chartOverlap c)ᶜ) ∧
      _root_.Topology.IsEmbedding
        (frontierGlue (T.chartOverlap c) g T.embed)

    (hxCenter : x (M.fanCenterVertex ⟨t, i, a⟩) < 1)
    (hyCenter : y (M.fanCenterVertex ⟨t, j, b⟩) < 1) :
    M.fanFaceMap ⟨t, i, a⟩
        (M.fanNormalizedBasePoint ⟨t, i, a⟩ x hxCenter) =
      M.fanFaceMap ⟨t, j, b⟩

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.SurfaceCellComplex.mem_polygonalIdentifications_iff_exists_occurrences
statement:
theorem mem_polygonalIdentifications_iff_exists_occurrences
    {K : SurfaceCellComplex} (valid : K.OccurrencePairingValid)
    (identification : PolygonGluing.Identification K.Face K.faceBoundaryLength) :
    identification ∈ K.polygonalIdentifications valid ↔
      ∃ source target : K.BoundaryOccurrence,
        identification.source = K.occurrenceSide source ∧
        identification.target = K.occurrenceSide target ∧
        source ≠ target ∧
        ¬K.IsBoundaryDart (K.occurrenceDart source) ∧
        ¬K.IsBoundaryDart (K.occurrenceDart target) ∧
        match identification.direction with
        | .same => K.occurrenceDart target = K.occurrenceDart source
        | .opposite => K.occurrenceDart target = K.inv (K.occurrenceDart source)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.SurfaceCellComplex.oneFace_mem_polygonalIdentifications_iff
statement:
theorem oneFace_mem_polygonalIdentifications_iff
    {Edge : Type} [Fintype Edge]
    (word : List (SignedDart Edge))
    (valid : (oneFacePresentation Edge word).OccurrencePairingValid)
    (identification :
      PolygonGluing.Identification (oneFacePresentation Edge word).Face
        (oneFacePresentation Edge word).faceBoundaryLength) :
    identification ∈ (oneFacePresentation Edge word).polygonalIdentifications valid ↔
      ∃ i j : Fin word.length,
        identification.source =
            (oneFacePresentation Edge word).occurrenceSide (oneFaceOccurrence word i) ∧
        identification.target =
            (oneFacePresentation Edge word).occurrenceSide (oneFaceOccurrence word j) ∧
        i ≠ j ∧
        ¬(oneFacePresentation Edge word).IsBoundaryDart (word.get i) ∧
        ¬(oneFacePresentation Edge word).IsBoundaryDart (word.get j) ∧
        match identification.direction with
        | .same => word.get j = word.get i
        | .opposite => word.get j = SignedDart.flipEquiv Edge (word.get i)

statement:
theorem mem_nonOrientable_polygonalIdentifications_iff
    {p n : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (identification :
      PolygonGluing.Identification (nonOrientableCellComplex p n).Face
        (nonOrientableCellComplex p n).faceBoundaryLength) :
    identification ∈
        (nonOrientableCellComplex p n).polygonalIdentifications
          (nonOrientableCellComplex_occurrencePairingValid hp) ↔
      (∃ i : Fin p,
          identification = nonOrientableCrosscapIdentification (n := n) i ∨
          identification = nonOrientableCrosscapIdentificationReverse (n := n) i) ∨

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.card_edgeOccurrences

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.continuous_polygonalMk

statement:
theorem edgeMultiplicity_eq_card_edgeOccurrences

statement:
theorem not_isBoundaryEdge_of_ne_of_edge_eq

statement:
@[simp]
theorem occurrenceSide_face (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (o : P.BoundaryOccurrence) :

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.occurrenceSide_index
statement:
@[simp]
theorem occurrenceSide_index (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (o : P.BoundaryOccurrence) :

statement:
theorem polygonalMk_pairing_eq

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.boundary_get_sideIndex
statement:
theorem boundary_get_sideIndex (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q)
    (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid) (f : P.Face)
    (i : Fin (P.boundary f).length) :
    (Q.boundary (e.faceEquiv f)).get (e.sideIndex validQ f i) =
      e.edgeRelabeling.mapDart ((P.boundary f).get i)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.comapPairing_direction
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comapPairing_direction (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q)
    (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid) (pairing : Q.BoundaryPairing) :
    (e.comapPairing validQ pairing).direction = pairing.direction

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.mapOccurrence_dart
statement:
theorem mapOccurrence_dart (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q)
    (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid) (o : P.BoundaryOccurrence) :
    (e.mapOccurrence validQ o).dart =
      e.edgeRelabeling.mapDart o.dart

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.mapOccurrence_edge
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapOccurrence_edge (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.mapOccurrence_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapOccurrence_fst (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q)
    (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid) (o : P.BoundaryOccurrence) :
    (e.mapOccurrence validQ o).1 = e.faceEquiv o.1

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.mapOccurrence_injective
statement:
theorem mapOccurrence_injective (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q)
    (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid) :
    Function.Injective (e.mapOccurrence validQ)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.mapOccurrence_occurrenceEquiv_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapOccurrence_occurrenceEquiv_symm
    (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q) (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid)
    (o : Q.BoundaryOccurrence) :
    e.mapOccurrence validQ ((e.occurrenceEquiv validQ).symm o) = o

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.mapOccurrence_snd_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapOccurrence_snd_val (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q)
    (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid) (o : P.BoundaryOccurrence) :
    (e.mapOccurrence validQ o).2.val =
      (o.2.val + e.faceRotation o.1) %
        (Q.boundary (e.faceEquiv o.1)).length

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.mapPairing_direction
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapPairing_direction (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q)
    (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid) (pairing : P.BoundaryPairing) :
    (e.mapPairing validQ pairing).direction = pairing.direction

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.mapPairing_source
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapPairing_source (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q)
    (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid) (pairing : P.BoundaryPairing) :
    (e.mapPairing validQ pairing).source =
      e.mapOccurrence validQ pairing.source

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.mapPairing_target
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapPairing_target (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.occurrenceEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem occurrenceEquiv_apply (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q)

statement:
theorem occurrenceEquiv_symm_dart
    (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q) (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid)

theorem occurrenceEquiv_symm_edge

theorem polygonallyEquivalent

statement:
@[simp]
theorem preHomeomorph_apply_fst (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q)
    (x : P.PolygonalPreRealization) :

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.preHomeomorph_apply_snd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem preHomeomorph_apply_snd (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q)
    (x : P.PolygonalPreRealization) :
    (e.preHomeomorph x).2 = e.faceHomeomorph x.1 x.2

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.preHomeomorph_generator_related
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_generator_related
    (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q) (_validP : P.IsSurfaceValid)
    (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid) (pairing : P.BoundaryPairing)
    (t : unitInterval) :
    Q.PolygonalGluingRel validQ
      (e.preHomeomorph (pairing.identification.source.point t))
      (e.preHomeomorph
        (pairing.identification.target.point
          (pairing.identification.parameter t)))

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.preHomeomorph_occurrenceSide_point
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_occurrenceSide_point
    (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q) (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid)
    (o : P.BoundaryOccurrence) (t : unitInterval) :
    e.preHomeomorph ((P.occurrenceSide o).point t) =
      (Q.occurrenceSide (e.mapOccurrence validQ o)).point t

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.preHomeomorph_pairing_parameter_point
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_pairing_parameter_point
    (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q) (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid)
    (pairing : P.BoundaryPairing) (t : unitInterval) :
    e.preHomeomorph
        (pairing.identification.target.point
          (pairing.identification.parameter t)) =
      (e.mapPairing validQ pairing).identification.target.point
        ((e.mapPairing validQ pairing).identification.parameter t)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.preHomeomorph_pairing_source_point
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_pairing_source_point
    (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q) (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.preHomeomorph_pairing_target_point
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_pairing_target_point
    (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q) (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid)
    (pairing : P.BoundaryPairing) (t : unitInterval) :

      ((e.mapPairing validQ pairing).identification.target.point t)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.preHomeomorph_related
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_related
    (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q) (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid)
    (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid) {x y : P.PolygonalPreRealization}
    (hxy : P.PolygonalGluingRel validP x y) :
    Q.PolygonalGluingRel validQ (e.preHomeomorph x) (e.preHomeomorph y)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.preHomeomorph_related_iff
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_related_iff
    (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q) (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid)
    (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid) (x y : P.PolygonalPreRealization) :
    P.PolygonalGluingRel validP x y ↔
      Q.PolygonalGluingRel validQ (e.preHomeomorph x) (e.preHomeomorph y)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.preHomeomorph_side
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_side (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q)
    (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid) (f : P.Face)
    (i : Fin (P.boundary f).length) (t : unitInterval) :
    e.preHomeomorph ⟨f, PolygonCell.side i t⟩ =
      ⟨e.faceEquiv f, PolygonCell.side (e.sideIndex validQ f i) t⟩

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.preHomeomorph_symm_generator_related
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_symm_generator_related
    (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q) (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid)

    (t : unitInterval) :
    P.PolygonalGluingRel validP
      (e.preHomeomorph.symm (pairing.identification.source.point t))
      (e.preHomeomorph.symm
        (pairing.identification.target.point
          (pairing.identification.parameter t)))

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.preHomeomorph_symm_occurrenceSide_point
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_symm_occurrenceSide_point

    (o : Q.BoundaryOccurrence) (t : unitInterval) :
    e.preHomeomorph.symm ((Q.occurrenceSide o).point t) =
      (P.occurrenceSide ((e.occurrenceEquiv validQ).symm o)).point t

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.preHomeomorph_symm_pairing_parameter_point
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_symm_pairing_parameter_point
    (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q) (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid)

    e.preHomeomorph.symm
        (pairing.identification.target.point
          (pairing.identification.parameter t)) =
      (e.comapPairing validQ pairing).identification.target.point
        ((e.comapPairing validQ pairing).identification.parameter t)

statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_symm_pairing_source_point
    (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q) (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.preHomeomorph_symm_pairing_target_point
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_symm_pairing_target_point

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.preHomeomorph_symm_related
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_symm_related
    (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q) (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid)
    (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid) {x y : Q.PolygonalPreRealization}
    (hxy : Q.PolygonalGluingRel validQ x y) :
    P.PolygonalGluingRel validP (e.preHomeomorph.symm x)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.rotate_target_boundary
statement:
theorem rotate_target_boundary (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q) (f : P.Face) :
    (Q.boundary (e.faceEquiv f)).rotate (e.faceRotation f) =
      (P.boundary f).map e.edgeRelabeling.mapDart

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.SignedPresentationIso.sideIndex_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sideIndex_val (e : SignedPresentationIso P Q)
    (validQ : Q.IsSurfaceValid) (f : P.Face)
    (i : Fin (P.boundary f).length) :
    (e.sideIndex validQ f i).val =
      (i.val + e.faceRotation f) %
        (Q.boundary (e.faceEquiv f)).length

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.PolygonCell.rotateHomeomorph_apply_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotateHomeomorph_apply_val {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) (k : ℕ)
    (z : PolygonCell n) :
    (rotateHomeomorph h k z).val = (rotationUnit n k : ℂ) * z.val

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.PolygonCell.rotateHomeomorph_side
statement:
theorem rotateHomeomorph_side {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (k : ℕ)
    (i : Fin n) (t : unitInterval) :
    rotateHomeomorph (Eq.refl n) k (side i t) =
      side (rotateIndex hn k i) t

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.PolygonCell.rotateHomeomorph_side_of_eq
statement:
theorem rotateHomeomorph_side_of_eq {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) (hm : 0 < m) (k : ℕ)
    (i : Fin n) (t : unitInterval) :
    rotateHomeomorph h k (side i t) =
      side
        (⟨(i.val + k) % m, Nat.mod_lt _ hm⟩ : Fin m) t

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.PolygonCell.rotateIndex_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotateIndex_val {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (k : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    (rotateIndex hn k i).val = (i.val + k) % n

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.IsSurfaceValid.not_isBoundaryEdge_of_distinct_occurrences
statement:
theorem IsSurfaceValid.not_isBoundaryEdge_of_distinct_occurrences
    {P : FiniteCyclicPresentation} (_valid : P.IsSurfaceValid)

    (hedge : target.edge = source.edge) :

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.ofOneFaceWordMapPairing_direction
statement:

theorem ofOneFaceWordMapPairing_direction

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.ofOneFaceWordMapPairing_source
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofOneFaceWordMapPairing_source
    (word : List (SignedDart Edge))

theorem contractDart_castSuccDart {n : ℕ} (d : SignedDart (Fin n)) :

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.contractWord_retainWord
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contractWord_retainWord {n : ℕ}
    (word : List (SignedDart (Fin n))) :
    P1.contractWord (retainWord word) = word

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.count_retainWord_castSucc
statement:
theorem count_retainWord_castSucc {n : ℕ} (e : Fin n)
    (word : List (SignedDart (Fin n))) :
    ((retainWord word).map edgeOfDart).count e.castSucc =
      (word.map edgeOfDart).count e

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.count_storedWord
statement:
theorem count_storedWord (orientation : Bool) {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (word : List (SignedDart α)) (e : α) :
    ((storedWord orientation word).map edgeOfDart).count e =
      (word.map edgeOfDart).count e

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.edgeMultiplicity_split_castSucc
statement:
theorem edgeMultiplicity_split_castSucc
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) (e : P.Edge) :
    P.edgeMultiplicity e =
      (split P cut).edgeMultiplicity e.castSucc

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.edgeMultiplicity_split_freshEdge
statement:
@[simp]
theorem edgeMultiplicity_split_freshEdge
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) :
    (split P cut).edgeMultiplicity (freshEdge P) = 2

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.edgeOfDart_rightFreshDart
statement:
@[simp]
theorem edgeOfDart_rightFreshDart
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) :
    edgeOfDart (rightFreshDart P cut) = freshEdge P

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.edgeOfDart_selectedFreshDart
statement:
@[simp]
theorem edgeOfDart_selectedFreshDart
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) :
    edgeOfDart (selectedFreshDart P cut) = freshEdge P

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.edge_mem_cut_pieces_iff
statement:
theorem edge_mem_cut_pieces_iff
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) (e : P.Edge) :
    e ∈ cut.left.map edgeOfDart ∨ e ∈ cut.right.map edgeOfDart ↔
      e ∈ (P.boundary cut.face.face).map edgeOfDart

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.edge_mem_orientedBoundary_iff
statement:
theorem edge_mem_orientedBoundary_iff
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (face : P.OrientedFace) (e : P.Edge) :
    e ∈ (P.orientedBoundary face).map edgeOfDart ↔
      e ∈ (P.boundary face.face).map edgeOfDart

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.edge_mem_storedWord_iff
statement:
theorem edge_mem_storedWord_iff
    {α : Type*} (orientation : Bool)
    (word : List (SignedDart α)) (e : α) :
    e ∈ (storedWord orientation word).map edgeOfDart ↔
      e ∈ word.map edgeOfDart

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.emptyWordSphereLastCut_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem emptyWordSphereLastCut_eq :
    emptyWordSphereLastCut = emptyWordSphereCut

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.exists_child_edge
statement:
theorem exists_child_edge
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P)
    (f : P.Face) (e : P.Edge)
    (h : e ∈ (P.boundary f).map edgeOfDart) :
    ∃ q : (split P cut).Face,
      Relation.ReflTransGen (split P cut).FaceAdjacent
        (oldFace P cut f) q ∧
      e.castSucc ∈ ((split P cut).boundary q).map edgeOfDart

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.faceEdgeMultiplicity_cut_eq_add
statement:
theorem faceEdgeMultiplicity_cut_eq_add
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) (e : P.Edge) :
    P.faceEdgeMultiplicity cut.face.face e =
      (cut.left.map edgeOfDart).count e +
        (cut.right.map edgeOfDart).count e

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.faceEdgeMultiplicity_split_old_freshEdge_of_ne
statement:
theorem faceEdgeMultiplicity_split_old_freshEdge_of_ne
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) {f : P.Face}
    (h : f ≠ cut.face.face) :
    (split P cut).faceEdgeMultiplicity (oldFace P cut f) (freshEdge P) = 0

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.faceEdgeMultiplicity_split_old_of_ne
statement:
theorem faceEdgeMultiplicity_split_old_of_ne
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) {f : P.Face}
    (h : f ≠ cut.face.face) (e : P.Edge) :
    (split P cut).faceEdgeMultiplicity (oldFace P cut f) e.castSucc =
      P.faceEdgeMultiplicity f e

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.faceEdgeMultiplicity_split_right_castSucc
statement:
theorem faceEdgeMultiplicity_split_right_castSucc
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) (e : P.Edge) :
    (split P cut).faceEdgeMultiplicity (rightFace P cut) e.castSucc =
      (cut.right.map edgeOfDart).count e

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.faceEdgeMultiplicity_split_right_freshEdge
statement:
@[simp]
theorem faceEdgeMultiplicity_split_right_freshEdge

    (split P cut).faceEdgeMultiplicity (rightFace P cut) (freshEdge P) = 1

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.faceEdgeMultiplicity_split_selected_castSucc
statement:
theorem faceEdgeMultiplicity_split_selected_castSucc

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.faceEdgeMultiplicity_split_selected_freshEdge
statement:
@[simp]
theorem faceEdgeMultiplicity_split_selected_freshEdge
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) :
    (split P cut).faceEdgeMultiplicity (oldFace P cut cut.face.face)
      (freshEdge P) = 1

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.faceEquiv_apply_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem faceEquiv_apply_val (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P)
    (f : Fin (P.faces.length + 1)) :
    (faceEquiv P cut f).val = f.val

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.face_cases
statement:
theorem face_cases (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P)
    (q : (split P cut).Face) :
    (∃ f : P.Face, q = oldFace P cut f) ∨ q = rightFace P cut

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.freshEdge_not_mem_retainWord
statement:
theorem freshEdge_not_mem_retainWord
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (word : List P.Dart) :

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.isConnected_of_split
statement:
theorem isConnected_of_split
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P)

    P.IsConnected

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.map_faceAdjacent_chain
statement:
theorem map_faceAdjacent_chain
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) {f g : P.Face}
    (h : P.FaceAdjacent f g) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (split P cut).FaceAdjacent
      (oldFace P cut f) (oldFace P cut g)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.map_faceChain
statement:
theorem map_faceChain
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) {f g : P.Face}
    (h : Relation.ReflTransGen P.FaceAdjacent f g) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (split P cut).FaceAdjacent
      (oldFace P cut f) (oldFace P cut g)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.neg_freshEdge_not_mem_inverse_retainWord
statement:
@[simp]
theorem neg_freshEdge_not_mem_inverse_retainWord
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (word : List P.Dart) :
    SignedDart.neg (freshEdge P) ∉ inverseWord (retainWord word)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.neg_freshEdge_not_mem_retainWord
statement:
@[simp]
theorem neg_freshEdge_not_mem_retainWord
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (word : List P.Dart) :
    SignedDart.neg (freshEdge P) ∉ retainWord word

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.oriented_storedWord
statement:
@[simp]
theorem oriented_storedWord {α : Type*} (orientation : Bool)
    (word : List (SignedDart α)) :
    (if orientation then inverseWord (storedWord orientation word)
      else storedWord orientation word) = word

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.pos_freshEdge_not_mem_inverse_retainWord
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pos_freshEdge_not_mem_inverse_retainWord

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.pos_freshEdge_not_mem_retainWord
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pos_freshEdge_not_mem_retainWord
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (word : List P.Dart) :
    SignedDart.pos (freshEdge P) ∉ retainWord word

statement:
@[simp]
theorem retainWord_append {n : ℕ}

statement:
@[simp]
theorem retainWord_eq_nil_iff {n : ℕ}

statement:
@[simp]
theorem retainWord_inverseWord {n : ℕ}

statement:
@[simp]
theorem retainWord_isRotated_iff {n : ℕ}
    (left right : List (SignedDart (Fin n))) :
    (retainWord left).IsRotated (retainWord right) ↔
      left.IsRotated right

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.retainWord_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem retainWord_nil {n : ℕ} :
    retainWord ([] : List (SignedDart (Fin n))) = []

statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightBoundary_flip

statement:
theorem rightBoundary_of_orientation_false

    rightBoundary P cut =
      .neg (freshEdge P) :: retainWord cut.right

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.rightBoundary_of_orientation_true
statement:
theorem rightBoundary_of_orientation_true
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P)

    rightBoundary P cut =
      inverseWord (retainWord cut.right) ++ [.pos (freshEdge P)]

statement:
theorem rightFreshDart_mem_rightBoundary

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.rightFreshDart_not_mem_retainWord
statement:
theorem rightFreshDart_not_mem_retainWord
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) (word : List P.Dart) :

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.rightFreshDart_not_mem_selectedBoundary
statement:
theorem rightFreshDart_not_mem_selectedBoundary
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) :

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.selectedBoundary_flip
statement:
@[simp]
theorem selectedBoundary_flip
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) :
    selectedBoundary P cut.flip = rightBoundary P cut

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.selectedBoundary_of_orientation_false
statement:
theorem selectedBoundary_of_orientation_false
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P)

    selectedBoundary P cut =
      retainWord cut.left ++ [.pos (freshEdge P)]

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.selectedBoundary_of_orientation_true
statement:
theorem selectedBoundary_of_orientation_true
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.selectedFreshDart_mem_selectedBoundary
statement:
theorem selectedFreshDart_mem_selectedBoundary

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.selectedFreshDart_not_mem_retainWord
statement:
theorem selectedFreshDart_not_mem_retainWord
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) (word : List P.Dart) :

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.selectedFreshDart_not_mem_rightBoundary
statement:
theorem selectedFreshDart_not_mem_rightBoundary

statement:
@[simp]
theorem split_boundary_index (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P)

    (split P cut).boundary (faceEquiv P cut q) = faceWord P cut q

statement:
@[simp]
theorem split_boundary_old (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P)
    (f : P.Face) :
    (split P cut).boundary (oldFace P cut f) =
      if f = cut.face.face then
        selectedBoundary P cut
      else
        retainWord (P.boundary f)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.split_boundary_old_of_ne
statement:
theorem split_boundary_old_of_ne (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P)
    {f : P.Face} (h : f ≠ cut.face.face) :
    (split P cut).boundary (oldFace P cut f) =
      retainWord (P.boundary f)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.split_boundary_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem split_boundary_right (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) :
    (split P cut).boundary (rightFace P cut) = rightBoundary P cut

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.split_boundary_selected
statement:
theorem split_boundary_selected (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) :

      selectedBoundary P cut

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.split_children_faceAdjacent
statement:
theorem split_children_faceAdjacent

statement:

theorem split_edgeCount (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) :

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.split_emptyWordSphere_last
statement:

theorem split_emptyWordSphere_last :

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.split_faces_length
statement:
theorem split_faces_length (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) :

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.split_isConnected
statement:
theorem split_isConnected

statement:

    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (cut : P2Cut P) :

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2.storedWord_false
statement:

theorem storedWord_false {α : Type*} (word : List (SignedDart α)) :

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P2Cut.canonical_zero_left

theorem canonical_zero_left {P : FiniteCyclicPresentation} (face : P.OrientedFace) :

    (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Set.Ico 0 (weights.length : ℝ)) :
    addCircleHomeomorph weights h hne

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.WeightedCircle.circleHomeomorph_exp_index_add
statement:
theorem circleHomeomorph_exp_index_add
    (weights : List ℕ) (h : Positive weights) (hne : weights ≠ [])
    (i : Fin weights.length) (t : unitInterval)
    (hnotLastEndpoint :
      ((i : ℝ) + (t : ℝ)) < weights.length) :
    circleHomeomorph weights h hne
        (Circle.exp
          (2 * Real.pi / weights.length * ((i : ℝ) + (t : ℝ)))) =
      Circle.exp
        (2 * Real.pi / weights.sum *
          ((weights.take i).sum + weights.get i * (t : ℝ)))

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.WeightedCircle.circleHomeomorph_exp_of_mem_Ico
statement:
theorem circleHomeomorph_exp_of_mem_Ico
    (weights : List ℕ) (h : Positive weights) (hne : weights ≠ [])
    (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Set.Ico 0 (weights.length : ℝ)) :
    circleHomeomorph weights h hne
        (Circle.exp (2 * Real.pi / weights.length * x)) =
      Circle.exp (2 * Real.pi / weights.sum * stretch weights x)

statement:
theorem exists_eq_expandedPairing
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid)
    (q : (expand P a).BoundaryPairing) :
    (∃ (r : P.BoundaryPairing)
        (_hdirection : r.direction = .same)
        (hcompatible : r.target.dart = r.source.dart)
        (k : Fin (dartWeight a r.source.dart)),
        q = expandedPairingSame P a r hcompatible k) ∨
      (∃ (r : P.BoundaryPairing)
        (_hdirection : r.direction = .opposite)
        (hcompatible : r.target.dart = r.source.dart.flip)
        (k : Fin (dartWeight a r.source.dart)),
        q = expandedPairingOpposite P a r hcompatible k)

    (p : ExpandedSourcePosition P a) :
    (expandedOccurrenceAt P a p).edge =
      expandedSubedge a p.1.dart p.2

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.expandedOccurrenceAt_injective
statement:
theorem expandedOccurrenceAt_injective
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge) :
    Function.Injective (expandedOccurrenceAt P a)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.expandedOccurrenceAt_not_boundary
statement:
theorem expandedOccurrenceAt_not_boundary
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (p : ExpandedSourcePosition P a)
    (h : ¬P.IsBoundaryEdge p.1.edge) :
    ¬(expand P a).IsBoundaryEdge (expandedOccurrenceAt P a p).edge

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.expandedOccurrenceEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expandedOccurrenceEquiv_apply
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (p : ExpandedSourcePosition P a) :
    expandedOccurrenceEquiv P a p = expandedOccurrenceAt P a p

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.expandedOffsetIndex_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expandedOffsetIndex_val
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge) (f : P.Face)
    (i : Fin (P.boundary f).length)
    (k : Fin (dartWeight a ((P.boundary f).get i))) :
    (expandedOffsetIndex P a f i k).val =
      ((faceWeights P a f).take i).sum + k

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.expandedPairingOpposite_related
statement:
theorem expandedPairingOpposite_related
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validQ : (expand P a).IsSurfaceValid)
    (pairing : P.BoundaryPairing)
    (hcompatible : pairing.target.dart = pairing.source.dart.flip)
    (k : Fin (dartWeight a pairing.source.dart))
    (u : unitInterval) :
    (expand P a).PolygonalGluingRel validQ
      (((expand P a).occurrenceSide
        (expandedOccurrenceAt P a ⟨pairing.source, k⟩)).point u)
      (((expand P a).occurrenceSide
        (expandedOccurrenceAt P a
          ⟨pairing.target,
            oppositePairedOffset a pairing hcompatible k⟩)).point
        (unitInterval.symm u))

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.expandedPairingSame_related
statement:
theorem expandedPairingSame_related
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validQ : (expand P a).IsSurfaceValid)
    (pairing : P.BoundaryPairing)
    (hcompatible : pairing.target.dart = pairing.source.dart)
    (k : Fin (dartWeight a pairing.source.dart))
    (u : unitInterval) :
    (expand P a).PolygonalGluingRel validQ
      (((expand P a).occurrenceSide
        (expandedOccurrenceAt P a ⟨pairing.source, k⟩)).point u)
      (((expand P a).occurrenceSide
        (expandedOccurrenceAt P a
          ⟨pairing.target,
            samePairedOffset a pairing hcompatible k⟩)).point u)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.expandedSourcePosition_eq_of_fst_eq_of_subedge_eq
statement:
theorem expandedSourcePosition_eq_of_fst_eq_of_subedge_eq
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (p q : ExpandedSourcePosition P a)
    (hfst : p.1 = q.1)
    (hedge :
      expandedSubedge a p.1.dart p.2 =
        expandedSubedge a q.1.dart q.2) :
    p = q

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.expandedSourcePosition_mk_transport
statement:
theorem expandedSourcePosition_mk_transport
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    {o o' : P.BoundaryOccurrence} (h : o = o')
    (k : Fin (dartWeight a o'.dart)) :
    (⟨o, h.symm ▸ k⟩ : ExpandedSourcePosition P a) = ⟨o', k⟩

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.expandedStartIndex_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expandedStartIndex_val
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge) (f : P.Face)
    (i : Fin (P.boundary f).length) :
    (expandedStartIndex P a f i).val =
      ((faceWeights P a f).take i).sum

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.expandedSubdart_cast_eq
statement:
theorem expandedSubdart_cast_eq {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n)
    {d₁ d₂ : SignedDart (Fin n)} (h : d₂ = d₁)
    (k : Fin (dartWeight a d₁)) :
    expandedSubdart a d₂
        (Fin.cast (congrArg (dartWeight a) h.symm) k) =
      expandedSubdart a d₁ k

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.expandedSubdart_cast_flip
statement:
theorem expandedSubdart_cast_flip {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n)
    {d₁ d₂ : SignedDart (Fin n)} (h : d₂ = d₁.flip)
    (k : Fin (dartWeight a d₁)) :
    expandedSubdart a d₂
        (Fin.cast (congrArg (dartWeight a) h.symm)
          (reverseOffset a d₁ k)) =
      (expandedSubdart a d₁ k).flip

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.expandedSubdart_flip_reverseOffset
statement:
theorem expandedSubdart_flip_reverseOffset {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n)
    (d : SignedDart (Fin n)) (k : Fin (dartWeight a d)) :
    expandedSubdart a d.flip (reverseOffset a d k) =
      (expandedSubdart a d k).flip

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.expandedSubdart_oppositePairedOffset
statement:
theorem expandedSubdart_oppositePairedOffset
    {P : FiniteCyclicPresentation} (a : P.Edge)
    (pairing : P.BoundaryPairing)
    (hcompatible : pairing.target.dart = pairing.source.dart.flip)
    (k : Fin (dartWeight a pairing.source.dart)) :
    expandedSubdart a pairing.target.dart
        (oppositePairedOffset a pairing hcompatible k) =
      (expandedSubdart a pairing.source.dart k).flip

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.expandedSubdart_samePairedOffset
statement:
theorem expandedSubdart_samePairedOffset
    {P : FiniteCyclicPresentation} (a : P.Edge)
    (pairing : P.BoundaryPairing)
    (hcompatible : pairing.target.dart = pairing.source.dart)
    (k : Fin (dartWeight a pairing.source.dart)) :
    expandedSubdart a pairing.target.dart
        (samePairedOffset a pairing hcompatible k) =
      expandedSubdart a pairing.source.dart k

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.expandedSubedge_injective_offset
statement:
theorem expandedSubedge_injective_offset {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n)
    (d : SignedDart (Fin n)) :
    Function.Injective (expandedSubedge a d)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.faceHomeomorph_ofCircle
statement:
@[simp]
theorem faceHomeomorph_ofCircle
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) (f : P.Face) (z : Circle) :
    faceHomeomorph P a validP f
        (PolygonCell.ofCircle (P.boundary f).length z) =
      PolygonCell.ofCircle
        ((expand P a).boundary (faceEquiv P a f)).length
        (faceCircleHomeomorph P a validP f z)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.faceHomeomorph_side
statement:
theorem faceHomeomorph_side
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) (f : P.Face)
    (i : Fin (P.boundary f).length) (t : unitInterval) :
    faceHomeomorph P a validP f (PolygonCell.side i t) =
      PolygonCell.ofCircle
        ((expand P a).boundary (faceEquiv P a f)).length
        (Circle.exp
          (2 * Real.pi /
              ((expand P a).boundary (faceEquiv P a f)).length *
            (((faceWeights P a f).take i).sum +
              (faceWeights P a f).get
                  (Fin.cast (faceWeights_length P a f).symm i) *
                (t : ℝ))))

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.faceHomeomorph_side_firstHalf
statement:
theorem faceHomeomorph_side_firstHalf
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) (f : P.Face)
    (i : Fin (P.boundary f).length)
    (hselected : edgeOfDart ((P.boundary f).get i) = a)
    (t : unitInterval) (ht : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) :
    faceHomeomorph P a validP f (PolygonCell.side i t) =
      PolygonCell.side (expandedStartIndex P a f i)
        (firstHalfParameter t ht)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.faceHomeomorph_side_of_not_selected
statement:
theorem faceHomeomorph_side_of_not_selected
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) (f : P.Face)
    (i : Fin (P.boundary f).length)
    (hnot : edgeOfDart ((P.boundary f).get i) ≠ a)
    (t : unitInterval) :
    faceHomeomorph P a validP f (PolygonCell.side i t) =
      PolygonCell.side (expandedStartIndex P a f i) t

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.faceHomeomorph_side_secondHalf
statement:
theorem faceHomeomorph_side_secondHalf
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) (f : P.Face)
    (i : Fin (P.boundary f).length)
    (hselected : edgeOfDart ((P.boundary f).get i) = a)
    (t : unitInterval) (ht : 1 / 2 ≤ (t : ℝ)) :
    faceHomeomorph P a validP f (PolygonCell.side i t) =
      PolygonCell.side (secondExpandedIndex P a f i hselected)
        (secondHalfParameter t ht)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.faceHomeomorph_side_unexpand
statement:
theorem faceHomeomorph_side_unexpand
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) (f : P.Face)
    (i : Fin (P.boundary f).length)
    (k : Fin (dartWeight a ((P.boundary f).get i)))
    (u : unitInterval) :
    faceHomeomorph P a validP f
        (PolygonCell.side i
          (unexpandParameter a ((P.boundary f).get i) k u)) =
      PolygonCell.side (expandedOffsetIndex P a f i k) u

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.faceWeights_get
statement:
theorem faceWeights_get
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge) (f : P.Face)
    (i : Fin (P.boundary f).length) :
    (faceWeights P a f).get
        (Fin.cast (faceWeights_length P a f).symm i) =
      dartWeight a ((P.boundary f).get i)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.faceWeights_length
statement:
@[simp]
theorem faceWeights_length (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (f : P.Face) :
    (faceWeights P a f).length = (P.boundary f).length

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.faceWeights_ne_nil
statement:
theorem faceWeights_ne_nil
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge) (f : P.Face)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) :
    faceWeights P a f ≠ []

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.faceWeights_positive
statement:
theorem faceWeights_positive (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (f : P.Face) :
    WeightedCircle.Positive (faceWeights P a f)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.faceWeights_sum
statement:
theorem faceWeights_sum
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge) (f : P.Face) :
    (faceWeights P a f).sum =
      ((expand P a).boundary (faceEquiv P a f)).length

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.firstExpandedOccurrence_dart
statement:
theorem firstExpandedOccurrence_dart
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (o : P.BoundaryOccurrence) :
    (firstExpandedOccurrence P a o).dart =
      (expandDart a o.dart).get
        ⟨0, expandDart_length_pos a o.dart⟩

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.firstHalfParameter_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem firstHalfParameter_val (t : unitInterval)
    (h : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (firstHalfParameter t h : ℝ) = 2 * (t : ℝ)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.isBoundaryEdge_expand_castSucc_iff
statement:
theorem isBoundaryEdge_expand_castSucc_iff
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a e : P.Edge) :
    (expand P a).IsBoundaryEdge e.castSucc ↔
      P.IsBoundaryEdge e

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.isBoundaryEdge_expand_freshEdge_iff
statement:
theorem isBoundaryEdge_expand_freshEdge_iff
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge) :
    (expand P a).IsBoundaryEdge (freshEdge P.edgeCount) ↔
      P.IsBoundaryEdge a

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.isBoundaryEdge_expandedSubedge_iff
statement:
theorem isBoundaryEdge_expandedSubedge_iff
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge) (d : P.Dart)
    (k : Fin (dartWeight a d)) :
    (expand P a).IsBoundaryEdge (expandedSubedge a d k) ↔
      P.IsBoundaryEdge (edgeOfDart d)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.length_expandDart_eq_dartWeight
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_expandDart_eq_dartWeight {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n)
    (d : SignedDart (Fin n)) :
    (expandDart a d).length = dartWeight a d

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.oppositePairedOffset_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem oppositePairedOffset_val
    {P : FiniteCyclicPresentation} (a : P.Edge)
    (pairing : P.BoundaryPairing)
    (hcompatible : pairing.target.dart = pairing.source.dart.flip)
    (k : Fin (dartWeight a pairing.source.dart)) :
    (oppositePairedOffset a pairing hcompatible k).val =
      dartWeight a pairing.source.dart - (k.val + 1)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.polygonallyEquivalent
statement:
theorem polygonallyEquivalent
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) :
    P.PolygonallyEquivalent (expand P a) validP
      (expand_isSurfaceValid P a validP)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.preHomeomorph_apply_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem preHomeomorph_apply_fst
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) (x : P.PolygonalPreRealization) :
    (preHomeomorph P a validP x).1 = faceEquiv P a x.1

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.preHomeomorph_generator_related
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_generator_related
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) (pairing : P.BoundaryPairing)
    (t : unitInterval) :
    (expand P a).PolygonalGluingRel (expand_isSurfaceValid P a validP)
      (preHomeomorph P a validP
        (pairing.identification.source.point t))
      (preHomeomorph P a validP
        (pairing.identification.target.point
          (pairing.identification.parameter t)))

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.preHomeomorph_occurrenceSide_firstHalf
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_occurrenceSide_firstHalf
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) (o : P.BoundaryOccurrence)
    (hselected : o.edge = a) (t : unitInterval)
    (ht : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) :
    preHomeomorph P a validP ((P.occurrenceSide o).point t) =
      ((expand P a).occurrenceSide
        (expandedOccurrenceAt P a
          ⟨o, zeroOffset a o.dart⟩)).point
        (firstHalfParameter t ht)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.preHomeomorph_occurrenceSide_of_not_selected
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_occurrenceSide_of_not_selected
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) (o : P.BoundaryOccurrence)
    (hnot : o.edge ≠ a) (t : unitInterval) :
    preHomeomorph P a validP ((P.occurrenceSide o).point t) =
      ((expand P a).occurrenceSide
        (expandedOccurrenceAt P a ⟨o, zeroOffset a o.dart⟩)).point t

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.preHomeomorph_occurrenceSide_secondHalf
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_occurrenceSide_secondHalf
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) (o : P.BoundaryOccurrence)
    (hselected : o.edge = a) (t : unitInterval)
    (ht : 1 / 2 ≤ (t : ℝ)) :
    preHomeomorph P a validP ((P.occurrenceSide o).point t) =
      ((expand P a).occurrenceSide
        (expandedOccurrenceAt P a
          ⟨o, oneOffset a o.dart hselected⟩)).point
        (secondHalfParameter t ht)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.preHomeomorph_occurrenceSide_unexpand
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_occurrenceSide_unexpand
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) (p : ExpandedSourcePosition P a)
    (u : unitInterval) :
    preHomeomorph P a validP
        ((P.occurrenceSide p.1).point
          (unexpandParameter a p.1.dart p.2 u)) =
      ((expand P a).occurrenceSide
        (expandedOccurrenceAt P a p)).point u

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.preHomeomorph_related
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_related
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) {x y : P.PolygonalPreRealization}
    (hxy : P.PolygonalGluingRel validP x y) :
    (expand P a).PolygonalGluingRel (expand_isSurfaceValid P a validP)
      (preHomeomorph P a validP x) (preHomeomorph P a validP y)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.preHomeomorph_related_iff
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_related_iff
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) (x y : P.PolygonalPreRealization) :
    P.PolygonalGluingRel validP x y ↔
      (expand P a).PolygonalGluingRel (expand_isSurfaceValid P a validP)
        (preHomeomorph P a validP x) (preHomeomorph P a validP y)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.preHomeomorph_symm_expandedOccurrenceAt
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_symm_expandedOccurrenceAt
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) (p : ExpandedSourcePosition P a)
    (u : unitInterval) :
    (preHomeomorph P a validP).symm
        (((expand P a).occurrenceSide
          (expandedOccurrenceAt P a p)).point u) =
      (P.occurrenceSide p.1).point
        (unexpandParameter a p.1.dart p.2 u)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.preHomeomorph_symm_expandedPairingOpposite_generator_related
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_symm_expandedPairingOpposite_generator_related
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) (pairing : P.BoundaryPairing)
    (hdirection : pairing.direction = .opposite)
    (hcompatible : pairing.target.dart = pairing.source.dart.flip)
    (k : Fin (dartWeight a pairing.source.dart))
    (u : unitInterval) :
    P.PolygonalGluingRel validP
      ((preHomeomorph P a validP).symm
        ((expandedPairingOpposite P a pairing hcompatible k).identification.source.point u))
      ((preHomeomorph P a validP).symm
        ((expandedPairingOpposite P a pairing hcompatible k).identification.target.point
          ((expandedPairingOpposite P a pairing hcompatible k).identification.parameter u)))

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.preHomeomorph_symm_expandedPairingSame_generator_related
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_symm_expandedPairingSame_generator_related
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) (pairing : P.BoundaryPairing)
    (hdirection : pairing.direction = .same)
    (hcompatible : pairing.target.dart = pairing.source.dart)
    (k : Fin (dartWeight a pairing.source.dart))
    (u : unitInterval) :
    P.PolygonalGluingRel validP
      ((preHomeomorph P a validP).symm
        ((expandedPairingSame P a pairing hcompatible k).identification.source.point u))
      ((preHomeomorph P a validP).symm
        ((expandedPairingSame P a pairing hcompatible k).identification.target.point
          ((expandedPairingSame P a pairing hcompatible k).identification.parameter u)))

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.preHomeomorph_symm_generator_related
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_symm_generator_related
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid) (pairing : (expand P a).BoundaryPairing)
    (t : unitInterval) :
    P.PolygonalGluingRel validP
      ((preHomeomorph P a validP).symm
        (pairing.identification.source.point t))
      ((preHomeomorph P a validP).symm
        (pairing.identification.target.point
          (pairing.identification.parameter t)))

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.preHomeomorph_symm_related
statement:
theorem preHomeomorph_symm_related
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (validP : P.IsSurfaceValid)
    {x y : (expand P a).PolygonalPreRealization}
    (hxy :
      (expand P a).PolygonalGluingRel (expand_isSurfaceValid P a validP) x y) :
    P.PolygonalGluingRel validP
      ((preHomeomorph P a validP).symm x)
      ((preHomeomorph P a validP).symm y)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.samePairedOffset_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem samePairedOffset_val
    {P : FiniteCyclicPresentation} (a : P.Edge)
    (pairing : P.BoundaryPairing)
    (hcompatible : pairing.target.dart = pairing.source.dart)
    (k : Fin (dartWeight a pairing.source.dart)) :
    (samePairedOffset a pairing hcompatible k).val = k.val

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.secondExpandedIndex_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem secondExpandedIndex_val
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge) (f : P.Face)
    (i : Fin (P.boundary f).length)
    (hselected : edgeOfDart ((P.boundary f).get i) = a) :
    (secondExpandedIndex P a f i hselected).val =
      ((faceWeights P a f).take i).sum + 1

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.FiniteCyclicPresentation.P1.secondExpandedOccurrence_dart
statement:
theorem secondExpandedOccurrence_dart
    (P : FiniteCyclicPresentation) (a : P.Edge)
    (o : P.BoundaryOccurrence) (hselected : o.edge = a) :
    (secondExpandedOccurrence P a o hselected).dart =
      (expandDart a o.dart).get
        ⟨1, by

    (k : Fin (dartWeight a d₁)) (u : unitInterval) :

      unexpandParameter a d₁ k u

    (pairing : P.BoundaryPairing)
    (hcompatible : pairing.target.dart = pairing.source.dart.flip)
    (k : Fin (dartWeight a pairing.source.dart)) (u : unitInterval) :
    unexpandParameter a pairing.target.dart
        (oppositePairedOffset a pairing hcompatible k)
        (unitInterval.symm u) =
      unitInterval.symm
        (unexpandParameter a pairing.source.dart k u)

    (k : Fin (dartWeight a pairing.source.dart)) (u : unitInterval) :
    unexpandParameter a pairing.target.dart
        (samePairedOffset a pairing hcompatible k) u =
      unexpandParameter a pairing.source.dart k u

theorem boundary_get_sideIndex

    (f : P.Face) (i : Fin (P.boundary f).length) :
    (Q.boundary (e.faceEquiv f)).get (e.sideIndex validQ f i) =
      if e.reverseFace f then
        (e.edgeRelabeling.mapDart ((P.boundary f).get i)).flip
      else
        e.edgeRelabeling.mapDart ((P.boundary f).get i)

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.TriangleCell.cellHomeomorph_side
statement:
theorem cellHomeomorph_side (i : Fin 3) (t : unitInterval) :
    cellHomeomorph (PolygonCell.side i t) =
      ⟨AffineMap.lineMap (k := ℝ)
          (Moise.standardTriangleVertex i)
          (Moise.standardTriangleVertex (finRotate 3 i)) t,
        by
          have hfrontier :
              AffineMap.lineMap (k := ℝ)
                  (Moise.standardTriangleVertex i)
                  (Moise.standardTriangleVertex (finRotate 3 i)) t ∈
                frontier Moise.standardTrianglePlaneComplex.support := by
            have heq := congrArg Subtype.val
              (circleBoundaryHomeomorph_side i t)
            change
              (circleBoundaryHomeomorph
                  (Circle.exp (PolygonCell.sideAngle i t))).1 =
                AffineMap.lineMap (k := ℝ)
                  (Moise.standardTriangleVertex i)
                  (Moise.standardTriangleVertex (finRotate 3 i)) t at heq
            rw [← heq]
            exact (circleBoundaryHomeomorph
              (Circle.exp (PolygonCell.sideAngle i t))).2
          exact
            Moise.standardTrianglePlaneComplex.isCompact_support.isClosed.frontier_subset
              hfrontier⟩

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.TriangleCell.circleBoundaryHomeomorph_side
statement:
theorem circleBoundaryHomeomorph_side
    (i : Fin 3) (t : unitInterval) :
    circleBoundaryHomeomorph
        (Circle.exp (PolygonCell.sideAngle i t)) =
      ⟨AffineMap.lineMap (k := ℝ)
          (Moise.standardTriangleVertex i)
          (Moise.standardTriangleVertex (finRotate 3 i)) t,
        by
          change
            AffineMap.lineMap (k := ℝ)
                (Moise.standardTriangleVertex i)
                (Moise.standardTriangleVertex (finRotate 3 i)) t ∈
              frontier Moise.standardTrianglePlaneComplex.support
          rw [Moise.standardTrianglePlaneComplex_support,
            ← Moise.standardTriangleCircle_carrier]
          apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
          refine ⟨(i : ZMod 3), ?_⟩
          unfold Moise.PolygonalCircle.edgeSegment
          rw [segment_eq_image_lineMap]
          refine ⟨t, t.2, ?_⟩
          congr 2; fin_cases i <;> rfl⟩

          (T.toIntrinsic.faceVertexEmbedding (T.cyclicFace f)

          T.toIntrinsic.Vertex → ℝ) r

name: ComputableℝSeq.Sqrt.TLUW_lower
statement:

    (fun n (x : ℚ) => ↑((fun n q =>
      mkRat (Int.sqrt (q.num * 4 ^ n)) ((q.den * 4 ^ n).sqrt + 1)) n x))

name: ComputableℝSeq.Sqrt.denom_err
statement:
lemma denom_err (x y ε : ℝ) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hyε : y + ε ≠ 0) :

name: ComputableℝSeq.Sqrt.lb_le_sqrt_lb
statement: theorem lb_le_sqrt_lb (q : ℚInterval) (n : ℕ) : (sqrtq q n).fst ≤ Real.sqrt q.fst

name: ComputableℝSeq.Sqrt.mkRat_sub_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem mkRat_sub_le_sqrt (q : ℚ) (n : ℕ) :

      mkRat (Int.sqrt (q.num * 4 ^ n) + 1) (q.den * 4 ^ n).sqrt

theorem rsqrt_le_boundedSqrt (y : ℚ) (n : ℕ) (b : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) :

name: ComputableℝSeq.Sqrt.sqrt_lb_def
statement:
theorem sqrt_lb_def (q : ℚInterval) (n : ℕ) :
    (sqrtq q n).fst = if q.snd ≤ 0 then 0 else
      mkRat (Int.sqrt (q.fst.num * 4^n)) ((q.fst.den * 4^n).sqrt + 1)

name: ComputableℝSeq.Sqrt.sqrt_le_mkRat_add
statement:
theorem sqrt_le_mkRat_add (q : ℚ) (n : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt q ≤ mkRat (Int.sqrt (q.num * 4^n)) ((q.den * 4^n).sqrt + 1) + 2 * Real.sqrt q / 2^n

name: ComputableℝSeq.Sqrt.sqrt_le_sqrtq_add
statement:
theorem sqrt_le_sqrtq_add (r : ℝ) (x : ℚInterval) (n : ℕ) (hq : x.fst ≤ r ∧ r ≤ x.snd) (hx : 0 <
  x.fst) :
    √r ≤ (sqrtq x n).fst + 2 * √r / 2^n + (x.snd - x.fst) / (2 * √x.fst)

name: ComputableℝSeq.Sqrt.sqrt_le_sqrtq_add'
statement:
theorem sqrt_le_sqrtq_add' (r : ℝ) (x : ℚInterval) (n : ℕ) (hq : x.fst ≤ r ∧ r ≤ x.snd) (hr : 0 <
  r) :
    √r ≤ (sqrtq x n).fst + 2 * √r / 2^n + (x.snd - x.fst) / √r

name: ComputableℝSeq.Sqrt.sqrt_ub_def
statement:
theorem sqrt_ub_def (q : ℚInterval) (n : ℕ) :
    (sqrtq q n).snd = if q.snd ≤ 0 then 0 else
       mkRat (Int.sqrt (q.snd.num * 4 ^ n) + 1) (q.snd.den * 4 ^ n).sqrt

name: ComputableℝSeq.Sqrt.sqrt_ub_le_ub

name: ComputableℝSeq.Sqrt.sqrtq_sub_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem sqrtq_sub_le_sqrt (r : ℝ) (x : ℚInterval) (n : ℕ) (hq : x.fst ≤ r ∧ r ≤ x.snd) (hx : 0 <
  x.fst)
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) : (sqrtq x n).snd - (7 * √r / 2^n) - (x.snd - x.fst) / √x.fst ≤ √r

name: Contrib.Bennett.exp_mul_le_bennett_quadratic
statement:
theorem exp_mul_le_bennett_quadratic {t b x : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hb : 0 < b) (hx : x ≤ b) :
    Real.exp (t * x) ≤
      1 + t * x + x ^ 2 * (Real.exp (t * b) - 1 - t * b) / b ^ 2

name: Contrib.Bennett.exp_sub_one_sub_le_bernstein
statement:

    Real.exp u - 1 - u ≤ u ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - u / 3))

name: Contrib.Bennett.hasSubgammaMGF_of_bounded_above
statement:
theorem hasSubgammaMGF_of_bounded_above [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ} {V b : ℝ}
    (hbpos : 0 < b)
    (hX0 : μ[X] = 0) (hb : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω ≤ b)
    (hvar : μ[fun ω => (X ω) ^ 2] ≤ V)
    (hXint : Integrable X μ) (hXsqint : Integrable (fun ω => (X ω) ^ 2) μ)
    (hexpint : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < 3 / b →
      Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ) :
    HasSubgammaMGF X V (b / 3) μ

name: Contrib.Bennett.mgf_le_bennett
statement:
theorem mgf_le_bennett [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ} {V b t : ℝ}
    (hbpos : 0 < b) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hX0 : μ[X] = 0) (hb : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω ≤ b)
    (hvar : μ[fun ω => (X ω) ^ 2] ≤ V)
    (hXint : Integrable X μ) (hXsqint : Integrable (fun ω => (X ω) ^ 2) μ)
    (hexpint : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ) :
    mgf X μ t ≤ Real.exp (V * (Real.exp (t * b) - 1 - t * b) / b ^ 2)

name: Contrib.Bennett.subgamma_tail
statement:
theorem subgamma_tail [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ} {V c ε : ℝ}
    (h : HasSubgammaMGF X V c μ) (hV : 0 < V) (hc : 0 < c) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hint : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp ((ε / (V + c * ε)) * X ω)) μ) :
    μ.real {ω | ε ≤ X ω} ≤ Real.exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * (V + c * ε)))

name: Contrib.ConditionalHoeffding.hasCondSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc

theorem hasCondSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc [StandardBorelSpace Ω] [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

    (hb : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω ∈ Set.Icc a b)

statement:

    [IsProbabilityMeasure (ℙ : Measure Ω)] {n : ℕ}
    (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ)
    (hmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : iIndepFun X ℙ)
    (h01 : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂(ℙ : Measure Ω), X i ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (ℙ {ω | (∑ i, X i ω) ≥ (∑ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂ℙ) + t})
