      (f : Forest) (g : Forest → M) :
      ((coprodForest f).map (fun pr => εmon k pr.1 • g pr.2)).sum = g f

name: CK.collapseL_tree
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.collapseL_tree {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module k M]
      (t : RTree) (g : Forest → M) :
      ((coprodTree t).map (fun pr => εmon k pr.1 • g pr.2)).sum = g [t]

name: CK.collapseR_forest
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.collapseR_forest {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module k M]
      (f : Forest) (g : Forest → M) :
      ((coprodForest f).map (fun pr => εmon k pr.2 • g pr.1)).sum = g f

name: CK.collapseR_tree
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.collapseR_tree {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module k M]
      (t : RTree) (g : Forest → M) :
      ((coprodTree t).map (fun pr => εmon k pr.2 • g pr.1)).sum = g [t]

name: CK.comul_sf
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.comul_sf (f : Forest) :
    (Coalgebra.comul (R := k) (A := H k)) (sf k f) = Δ₀ k f

name: CK.conv_apply
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.conv_apply (F G : H k →ₗ[k] H k) (x : H k) :
    (WithConv.toConv F * WithConv.toConv G).ofConv x
      = LinearMap.mul' k (H k) (TensorProduct.map F G (Δ k x))

name: CK.conv_apply_ab
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.conv_apply_ab (F G : Hab k →ₗ[k] Hab k) (x : Hab k) :
    (WithConv.toConv F * WithConv.toConv G).ofConv x
      = LinearMap.mul' k (Hab k) (TensorProduct.map F G ((Δab k).toLinearMap x))

name: CK.conv_ofConv_sf
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.conv_ofConv_sf (F G : H k →ₗ[k] H k) (f : Forest) :
    (WithConv.toConv F * WithConv.toConv G).ofConv (sf k f)
      = ((coprodForest f).map (fun pr => F (sf k pr.1) * G (sf k pr.2))).sum

name: CK.coprodForest_append
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.coprodForest_append (F G : Forest) :
    coprodForest (F ++ G) = tmul (coprodForest F) (coprodForest G)

name: CK.coprodForest_filter_emptyL
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.coprodForest_filter_emptyL (f : Forest) :
      (coprodForest f).filter (fun pr => pr.1.isEmpty) = [([], f)]

name: CK.coprodForest_filter_emptyR
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.coprodForest_filter_emptyR (f : Forest) :
      (coprodForest f).filter (fun pr => pr.2.isEmpty) = [(f, [])]

name: CK.coprodForest_single
statement: theorem _root_.CK.coprodForest_single (t : RTree) : coprodForest [t] = coprodTree t

name: CK.coprodTree_filter_emptyL
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.coprodTree_filter_emptyL (t : RTree) :
      (coprodTree t).filter (fun pr => pr.1.isEmpty) = [([], [t])]

name: CK.coprodTree_filter_emptyR
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.coprodTree_filter_emptyR (t : RTree) :
      (coprodTree t).filter (fun pr => pr.2.isEmpty) = [([t], [])]

name: CK.coprodTree_node
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.coprodTree_node (F : Forest) :
    coprodTree (RTree.node F)
      = ([RTree.node F], []) :: (coprodForest F).map (fun pr => (pr.1, [RTree.node pr.2]))

name: CK.e2_mul
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.e2_mul (pr pr' : Forest × Forest) :
    e2 k (pr.1 ++ pr'.1, pr.2 ++ pr'.2) = e2 k pr * e2 k pr'

name: CK.elem_lemma
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.elem_lemma (pr : Forest × Forest) :
    (TensorProduct.assoc k (H k) (H k) (H k))
        (LinearMap.rTensor (H k) (Δ k) (e2 k pr))
      = E3 k ((coprodForest pr.1).map (fun ab => (ab.1, ab.2, pr.2)))

name: CK.elem_lemma_R
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.elem_lemma_R (pr : Forest × Forest) :
    LinearMap.lTensor (H k) (Δ k) (e2 k pr)
      = E3 k ((coprodForest pr.2).map (fun bc => (pr.1, bc.1, bc.2)))

name: CK.eulerCoef_eq_coeff_log
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.eulerCoef_eq_coeff_log (j : ℕ) :
    eulerCoef k j = PowerSeries.coeff j (PowerSeries.log k)

name: CK.eulerCoef_one
statement: @[simp] theorem _root_.CK.eulerCoef_one : eulerCoef k 1 = 1

name: CK.eulerCoef_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem _root_.CK.eulerCoef_zero : eulerCoef k 0 = 0

name: CK.filter_emptyL_tmul
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.filter_emptyL_tmul (A B : Tens) :
    (tmul A B).filter (fun pr => pr.1.isEmpty)
      = tmul (A.filter (fun pr => pr.1.isEmpty)) (B.filter (fun pr => pr.1.isEmpty))

name: CK.filter_emptyR_tmul
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.filter_emptyR_tmul (A B : Tens) :
    (tmul A B).filter (fun pr => pr.2.isEmpty)
      = tmul (A.filter (fun pr => pr.2.isEmpty)) (B.filter (fun pr => pr.2.isEmpty))

name: CK.flatMap_append_distrib
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.flatMap_append_distrib {α β} (l : List α) (X Y : α → List β) :
    (l.flatMap (fun a => X a ++ Y a)).Perm (l.flatMap X ++ l.flatMap Y)

name: CK.flatMap_comm
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.flatMap_comm {α β γ} (l1 : List α) (l2 : List β)
    (f : α → β → List γ) :
    (l1.flatMap (fun a => l2.flatMap (fun b => f a b))).Perm
    (l2.flatMap (fun b => l1.flatMap (fun a => f a b)))

name: CK.flatMap_const_nil
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.flatMap_const_nil {α β} (l : List α) :
    l.flatMap (fun _ => ([] : List β)) = []

name: CK.flatMap_singleton_eq_map
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.flatMap_singleton_eq_map {α β} (g : α → β) (l : List α) :
    l.flatMap (fun a => [g a]) = l.map g

name: CK.isEmpty_append_of_ne
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.isEmpty_append_of_ne {r b : Forest} (h : r ≠ []) :
    (r ++ b).isEmpty = false

name: CK.lTensor_antipode'_Δ₀
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.lTensor_antipode'_Δ₀ (f : Forest) :
    (LinearMap.mul' k (H k) ∘ₗ LinearMap.lTensor (H k) (antipode' k)) (Δ₀ k f)
      = εmon k f • (1 : H k)

name: CK.leftAntipode_eq
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.leftAntipode_eq :
    LinearMap.mul' k (H k) ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor (H k) (antipode k) ∘ₗ Δ k
      = Algebra.linearMap k (H k) ∘ₗ ε k

name: CK.leftConvF
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.leftConvF (f : Forest) :
    ((coprodForest f).map (fun pr => antipodeF k pr.1 * sf k pr.2)).sum =
      εmon k f • (1 : H k)

name: CK.lhom_ext
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.lhom_ext {N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] [Module k N] ⦃φ ψ : H k →ₗ[k] N⦄
    (h : ∀ (f : Forest) (b : k),
      φ (MonoidAlgebra.single f b) = ψ (MonoidAlgebra.single f b)) : φ = ψ

name: CK.lhs_core
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.lhs_core (f : Forest) :
    (TensorProduct.assoc k (H k) (H k) (H k))
        (LinearMap.rTensor (H k) (Δ k) (Δ₀ k f))
      = E3 k (coLeft (coprodForest f))

name: CK.linmap_list_sum
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.linmap_list_sum {α} {M N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid N]
    [Module k M] [Module k N] (φ : M →ₗ[k] N) (l : List α) (h : α → M) :
    φ ((l.map h).sum) = (l.map (fun a => φ (h a))).sum

name: CK.list_range_sum_eq
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.list_range_sum_eq {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (m : ℕ) (g : ℕ → M) :
    ((List.range m).map g).sum = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, g j

name: CK.list_sum_mul_sum
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.list_sum_mul_sum {M : Type*} [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring M] (L1 L2 : List M) :
    L1.sum * L2.sum = (L1.flatMap (fun a => L2.map (fun b => a * b))).sum

name: CK.lmap_eq_sum
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.lmap_eq_sum (g : H k →ₗ[k] H k) (y : H k) :
    g y = y.coeff.sum (fun a b => g (MonoidAlgebra.single a b))

name: CK.map_flatMap_sum
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.map_flatMap_sum {α β : Type*} {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (L : List α) (G : α → List β) (h : β → M) :
    ((L.flatMap G).map h).sum = (L.map (fun a => ((G a).map h).sum)).sum

name: CK.map_sum_filter_split
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.map_sum_filter_split {α : Type*} (L : List α) (P : α → Bool)
    (g : α → H k) :
    (L.map g).sum
      = ((L.filter P).map g).sum + ((L.filter (fun x => !P x)).map g).sum

name: CK.mul'_π
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.mul'_π :
    LinearMap.mul' k (Hab k) ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (π k).toLinearMap (π k).toLinearMap
      = (π k).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.mul' k (H k)

name: CK.mul_lTensor_antipode'_e2
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.mul_lTensor_antipode'_e2 (pr : Forest × Forest) :
    LinearMap.mul' k (H k) (LinearMap.lTensor (H k) (antipode' k) (e2 k pr))
      = sf k pr.1 * antipodeF' k pr.2

name: CK.mul_list_sum
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.mul_list_sum {M : Type*} [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring M] (a : M) (L : List M) :
    a * L.sum = (L.map (fun b => a * b)).sum

name: CK.mul_map_e2
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.mul_map_e2 (F G : H k →ₗ[k] H k) (pr : Forest × Forest) :
    LinearMap.mul' k (H k) (TensorProduct.map F G (e2 k pr))
      = F (sf k pr.1) * G (sf k pr.2)

name: CK.mul_rTensor_antipode_e2
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.mul_rTensor_antipode_e2 (pr : Forest × Forest) :
    LinearMap.mul' k (H k) (LinearMap.rTensor (H k) (antipode k) (e2 k pr))
      = antipodeF k pr.1 * sf k pr.2

name: CK.perm_E3
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.perm_E3 (f : Forest) :
    E3 k (coLeft (coprodForest f)) = E3 k (coRight (coprodForest f))

name: CK.perm_middle_swap
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.perm_middle_swap {α} (A B C D : List α) :
    ((A ++ B) ++ (C ++ D)).Perm ((A ++ C) ++ (B ++ D))

name: CK.rTensor_antipode_Δ₀
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.rTensor_antipode_Δ₀ (f : Forest) :
    (LinearMap.mul' k (H k) ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor (H k) (antipode k)) (Δ₀ k f)
      = εmon k f • (1 : H k)

name: CK.rTensor_ε_Δ₀
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.rTensor_ε_Δ₀ (f : Forest) :
    LinearMap.rTensor (H k) (ε k) (Δ₀ k f) = (1 : k) ⊗ₜ[k] MonoidAlgebra.single f 1

name: CK.rhs_core
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.rhs_core (f : Forest) :
    LinearMap.lTensor (H k) (Δ k) (Δ₀ k f) = E3 k (coRight (coprodForest f))

name: CK.rightAntipode'_eq
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.rightAntipode'_eq :
    LinearMap.mul' k (H k) ∘ₗ LinearMap.lTensor (H k) (antipode' k) ∘ₗ Δ k
      = Algebra.linearMap k (H k) ∘ₗ ε k

name: CK.rightConvF'
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.rightConvF' (f : Forest) :
    ((coprodForest f).map (fun pr => sf k pr.1 * antipodeF' k pr.2)).sum =
      εmon k f • (1 : H k)

name: CK.sf_append
statement: theorem _root_.CK.sf_append (a b : Forest) : sf k (a ++ b) = sf k a * sf k b

name: CK.sf_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem _root_.CK.sf_nil : sf k [] = 1

name: CK.single_append
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.single_append (p p' : Forest) :
    (MonoidAlgebra.single (p ++ p') (1 : k) : H k)
      = (MonoidAlgebra.single p 1 : H k) * (MonoidAlgebra.single p' 1 : H k)

name: CK.single_smul_one
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.single_smul_one (f : FreeMonoid RTree) (b : k) :
    MonoidAlgebra.single f b = b • MonoidAlgebra.single f 1

name: CK.sizeF_append
statement: theorem _root_.CK.sizeF_append (F G : Forest) : sizeF (F ++ G) = sizeF F + sizeF G

name: CK.sizeF_pos
statement: theorem _root_.CK.sizeF_pos {f : Forest} (h : f ≠ []) : 0 < sizeF f

name: CK.size_consForest
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.size_consForest (f : Forest) :
      ∀ pr ∈ coprodForest f, sizeF pr.1 + sizeF pr.2 = sizeF f

name: CK.size_consTree
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.size_consTree (t : RTree) :
      ∀ pr ∈ coprodTree t, sizeF pr.1 + sizeF pr.2 = sizeT t

name: CK.smul_list_sum
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.smul_list_sum {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module k M] (c : k) (l : List M) :
    c • l.sum = (l.map (fun x => c • x)).sum

name: CK.smul_list_sum'
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.smul_list_sum' {α M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module k M]
    (c : k) (l : List α) (F : α → M) :
    c • (l.map F).sum = (l.map (fun x => c • F x)).sum

name: CK.tmul3_perm
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.tmul3_perm {a a' b b' : Tens3} (ha : a.Perm a') (hb : b.Perm b') :
    (tmul3 a b).Perm (tmul3 a' b')

name: CK.tmul_append_left
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.tmul_append_left (x₁ x₂ y : Tens) :
    tmul (x₁ ++ x₂) y = tmul x₁ y ++ tmul x₂ y

name: CK.tmul_assoc
statement: theorem _root_.CK.tmul_assoc (x y z : Tens) : tmul (tmul x y) z = tmul x (tmul y z)

name: CK.tmul_cons
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.tmul_cons (p r : Forest) (xs y : Tens) :
    tmul ((p, r) :: xs) y =
      y.map (fun (p', r') => (p ++ p', r ++ r')) ++ tmul xs y

name: CK.tmul_scalar_left
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.tmul_scalar_left (c : k) (m : H k) :
    (c : k) ⊗ₜ[k] m = c • ((1 : k) ⊗ₜ[k] m)

name: CK.tmul_scalar_right
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.tmul_scalar_right (m : H k) (c : k) :
    m ⊗ₜ[k] c = c • (m ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : k))

name: CK.tmul_unit_left
statement: @[simp] theorem _root_.CK.tmul_unit_left (y : Tens) : tmul [([], [])] y = y

name: CK.tmul_unit_right
statement: @[simp] theorem _root_.CK.tmul_unit_right (x : Tens) : tmul x [([], [])] = x

name: CK.ΔAlg_resp_commRel
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.ΔAlg_resp_commRel ⦃a b : H k⦄ (h : commRel k a b) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (π k) (π k)).comp (ΔAlg k) a
      = (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (π k) (π k)).comp (ΔAlg k) b

name: CK.Δ_mul
statement: theorem _root_.CK.Δ_mul (a b : H k) : Δ k (a * b) = Δ k a * Δ k b

name: CK.Δ_one
statement: theorem _root_.CK.Δ_one : Δ k (1 : H k) = 1

name: CK.Δ_one_tmul
statement: theorem _root_.CK.Δ_one_tmul : Δ k (1 : H k) = (1 : H k) ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : H k)

name: CK.Δ_sf
statement: theorem _root_.CK.Δ_sf (f : Forest) : Δ k (sf k f) = Δ₀ k f

name: CK.Δ_single
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.Δ_single (f : Forest) (b : k) :
    Δ k (MonoidAlgebra.single f b) = b • Δ₀ k f

name: CK.Δab_lTensor_natural
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.Δab_lTensor_natural :
    (LinearMap.lTensor (Hab k) (Δab k).toLinearMap)
        ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (π k).toLinearMap (π k).toLinearMap
      = TensorProduct.map (π k).toLinearMap
          (TensorProduct.map (π k).toLinearMap (π k).toLinearMap)
          ∘ₗ LinearMap.lTensor (H k) (Δ k)

name: CK.Δab_rTensor_natural
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.Δab_rTensor_natural :
    (LinearMap.rTensor (Hab k) (Δab k).toLinearMap)
        ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (π k).toLinearMap (π k).toLinearMap
      = TensorProduct.map
          (TensorProduct.map (π k).toLinearMap (π k).toLinearMap) (π k).toLinearMap
          ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor (H k) (Δ k)

name: CK.Δab_tl_π
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.Δab_tl_π (x : H k) :
    (Δab k).toLinearMap (π k x)
      = TensorProduct.map (π k).toLinearMap (π k).toLinearMap (Δ k x)

name: CK.Δab_π
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.Δab_π (x : H k) :
    Δab k (π k x) = Algebra.TensorProduct.map (π k) (π k) (ΔAlg k x)

name: CK.Δab_π'
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.Δab_π' (x : H k) :
    Δab k (π k x)
      = TensorProduct.map (π k).toLinearMap (π k).toLinearMap (Δ k x)

name: CK.Δ₀_mul
statement: theorem _root_.CK.Δ₀_mul (F G : Forest) : Δ₀ k (F ++ G) = Δ₀ k F * Δ₀ k G

name: CK.ε_sf
statement: theorem _root_.CK.ε_sf (p : Forest) : ε k (sf k p) = εmon k p

name: CK.ε_single
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.ε_single (f : Forest) (b : k) :
    ε k (MonoidAlgebra.single f b) = b * εmon k f

name: CK.εab_lTensor_natural
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.εab_lTensor_natural :
    (LinearMap.lTensor (Hab k) (εab k).toLinearMap) ∘ₗ
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (π k) (π k)).toLinearMap
      = TensorProduct.map (π k).toLinearMap (ε k)

name: CK.εab_rTensor_natural
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.εab_rTensor_natural :
    (LinearMap.rTensor (Hab k) (εab k).toLinearMap) ∘ₗ
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (π k) (π k)).toLinearMap
      = TensorProduct.map (ε k) (π k).toLinearMap

name: CK.εab_π
statement: theorem _root_.CK.εab_π (x : H k) : εab k (π k x) = εalg k x

name: CK.εalg_resp_commRel
statement:
theorem _root_.CK.εalg_resp_commRel ⦃a b : H k⦄ (h : commRel k a b) :
    εalg k a = εalg k b

name: CK.εmon_append
statement: theorem _root_.CK.εmon_append (p p' : Forest) : εmon k (p ++ p') = εmon k p * εmon k p'

name: CK.εmon_cons
statement: @[simp] theorem _root_.CK.εmon_cons (a : RTree) (l : Forest) : εmon k (a :: l) = 0

name: CK.εmon_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem _root_.CK.εmon_nil : εmon k ([] : Forest) = 1

name: CK.εmon_of
statement: @[simp] theorem _root_.CK.εmon_of (a : RTree) : εmon k (FreeMonoid.of a) = 0

name: CK.π_mul_comm
statement: theorem _root_.CK.π_mul_comm (x y : H k) : π k (x * y) = π k (y * x)

name: CK.π_surjective
statement: theorem _root_.CK.π_surjective : Function.Surjective (π k)

name: Connes.OpenAIPort.exists_half_of_reduceVector_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_half_of_reduceVector_eq_zero
    (v : IntegralLattice) (hv : reduceVector v = 0) :
    ∃ u : IntegralLattice, (2 : ℕ) • u = v

name: Connes.OpenAIPort.liftVector_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem liftVector_zero : liftVector (0 : ModTwoSpace) = 0

name: Connes.OpenAIPort.modTwoSpace_exponent_two
statement:
theorem modTwoSpace_exponent_two (w : ModTwoSpace) :
    (2 : ℕ) • w = 0

name: Connes.OpenAIPort.reduceVector_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem reduceVector_apply (v : IntegralLattice) (i : SymplecticIndex) :
    reduceVector v i = (v i : ZMod 2)

name: Connes.OpenAIPort.reduceVector_liftVector
statement:
@[simp] theorem reduceVector_liftVector (w : ModTwoSpace) :
    reduceVector (liftVector w) = w

name: Connes.OpenAIPort.reduceVector_smul
statement:
theorem reduceVector_smul (g : IntegralSymplecticGroup) (v : IntegralLattice) :
    reduceVector (g • v) = g • reduceVector v

name: Connes.OpenAIPort.standardQuadraticForm_add
statement:
theorem standardQuadraticForm_add (x y : ModTwoSpace) :
    standardQuadraticForm (x + y) =
      standardQuadraticForm x + standardQuadraticForm y + modTwoSymplecticForm x y

name: Connes.OpenAIPort.two_nsmul_integralLattice_injective
statement:
theorem two_nsmul_integralLattice_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun v : IntegralLattice ↦ (2 : ℕ) • v)

name: Connes.OpenAIPort.finiteQuadraticCocycle_defining_identity
statement:
theorem finiteQuadraticCocycle_defining_identity
    (g : ModTwoSymplecticGroup) (w : ModTwoSpace) :
    standardQuadraticForm (g⁻¹ • w) + standardQuadraticForm w =
      modTwoSymplecticForm (finiteQuadraticCocycle g) w

name: Connes.OpenAIPort.finiteQuadraticCocycle_isCocycle
statement:
theorem finiteQuadraticCocycle_isCocycle :
    groupCohomology.IsCocycle₁ finiteQuadraticCocycle

name: Connes.OpenAIPort.integralQuadraticCocycle_defining_identity
statement:
theorem integralQuadraticCocycle_defining_identity
    (g : IntegralSymplecticGroup) (w : ModTwoSpace) :
    standardQuadraticForm (g⁻¹ • w) + standardQuadraticForm w =
      modTwoSymplecticForm (integralQuadraticCocycle g) w

name: Connes.OpenAIPort.integralQuadraticCocycle_isCocycle
statement:
theorem integralQuadraticCocycle_isCocycle :
    groupCohomology.IsCocycle₁ integralQuadraticCocycle

name: Connes.OpenAIPort.modTwoSymplecticForm_add_left
statement:
theorem modTwoSymplecticForm_add_left (x y z : ModTwoSpace) :
    modTwoSymplecticForm (x + y) z =
      modTwoSymplecticForm x z + modTwoSymplecticForm y z

name: Connes.OpenAIPort.modTwoSymplecticForm_add_right
statement:
theorem modTwoSymplecticForm_add_right (x y z : ModTwoSpace) :
    modTwoSymplecticForm x (y + z) =
      modTwoSymplecticForm x y + modTwoSymplecticForm x z

name: Connes.OpenAIPort.modTwoSymplecticForm_eq_dotProduct
statement:
theorem modTwoSymplecticForm_eq_dotProduct (x y : ModTwoSpace) :
    modTwoSymplecticForm x y =
      dotProduct x ((Matrix.J (Fin 2) (ZMod 2)).mulVec y)

name: Connes.OpenAIPort.modTwoSymplecticForm_nondegenerate
Connes.OpenAIPort.modTwoSymplecticForm_smul
statement:
theorem modTwoSymplecticForm_smul

    {K : Type u} {Ω : Type v} {Ξ : Type w} [Group K]
    [AddCommGroup Ω] [TopologicalSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [AddCommGroup Ξ] [TopologicalSpace Ξ] [MeasurableSpace Ξ]
    {X : HaarProbabilityAction K Ω} {Y : HaarProbabilityAction K Ξ}
    (e : EquivariantHaarEquiv X Y) (f : crossedBaseHilbert X) :
    crossedBaseHaarEquiv e f =
      Lp.compMeasurePreserving e.toMeasurableEquiv.symm
        (EquivariantHaarEquiv.symm e).measure_preserving f

name: Connes.CrossedProduct.crossedBaseMultiplier_apply_ae

name: Connes.CrossedProduct.crossedGroupUnitary_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem crossedGroupUnitary_apply
    {K : Type u} {Ω : Type v} [Group K]

    (X : HaarProbabilityAction K Ω) (k : K)
    (ξ : crossedHilbert X) (h : K) :
    crossedGroupUnitary X k ξ h =
      crossedActionL2Equiv X k (ξ (k⁻¹ * h))

name: Connes.CrossedProduct.crossedIndexEquiv_apply

theorem crossedBaseHaarEquiv_const_one

    {Y : HaarProbabilityAction K Ξ}

    let _ : IsProbabilityMeasure X.measure := X.probability
    let _ : IsProbabilityMeasure Y.measure := Y.probability
    crossedBaseHaarEquiv e (Lp.const 2 X.measure (1 : ℂ)) =
      Lp.const 2 Y.measure (1 : ℂ)

statement:
theorem crossedBaseHaarEquiv_multiplier_apply
    {X : HaarProbabilityAction K Ω}

    (e : EquivariantHaarEquiv X Y)
    (f : crossedCoefficient X) (ξ : crossedBaseHilbert X) :
    crossedBaseHaarEquiv e (crossedBaseMultiplier X f ξ) =
      crossedBaseMultiplier Y
        (Lp.compMeasurePreserving e.toMeasurableEquiv.symm
          (EquivariantHaarEquiv.symm e).measure_preserving f)
        (crossedBaseHaarEquiv e ξ)

name: Connes.measureReal_detection_gap_of_uniform_primitive_counts
statement:
theorem measureReal_detection_gap_of_uniform_primitive_counts
    {α ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (primitive : Finset ι)
    (detect : ι → Set α) [DecidableRel (fun x v ↦ x ∈ detect v)]
    (active : Set α) (e : ι)
    (he : e ∈ primitive)
    (hdetect : ∀ v ∈ primitive, MeasurableSet (detect v))
    (hactive : MeasurableSet active)
    (hpointwise : ∀ x ∈ active,
      primitive.card ≤ 7 * (primitive.filter (fun v ↦ x ∈ detect v)).card)
    (huniform : ∀ v ∈ primitive, μ (detect v) = μ (detect e)) :
    μ.real active ≤ 7 * μ.real (detect e)

name: Connes.measureReal_iUnion_le_of_monotone

    (hmono : Monotone U)
    {c : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ n, μ.real (U n) ≤ c) :

    (hdetect : ∀ v ∈ primitive, MeasurableSet (detect v))
    (hactive : MeasurableSet active)
    (hpointwise : ∀ x ∈ active,
      primitive.card ≤ 7 * (primitive.filter (fun v ↦ x ∈ detect v)).card)
    (huniform : ∀ v ∈ primitive, μ (detect v) = μ (detect e)) :
    μ active ≤ 7 * μ (detect e)

name: Connes.probability_detection_gap_of_exhaustion
statement:
theorem probability_detection_gap_of_exhaustion
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure α) (zero : α) (U : ℕ → Set α)
    (hzero : MeasurableSet ({zero} : Set α))
    (hmono : Monotone U)
    (hunion : (⋃ n, U n) = ({zero} : Set α)ᶜ)
    {p : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ n, (μ : Measure α).real (U n) ≤ 7 * p) :
    (1 / 7 : ℝ) * (1 - (μ : Measure α).real {zero}) ≤ p

name: Connes.PaperChartDetector.diagonal_sum_expansion
statement:
theorem diagonal_sum_expansion {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (b : A) (u : ι → A) :
    PaperKernel.diagonal (b + ∑ i, u i) =
      PaperKernel.diagonal b +
        ∑ i, cross b (u i) +
          ∑ i, PaperKernel.diagonal (u i) +
            ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ upper i, cross (u i) (u j)

name: Connes.PaperChartDetector.sum_pair_upper
statement:
theorem sum_pair_upper {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (T : ι → ι → TensorAA) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, T i j =
      ∑ i, T i i + ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ upper i, (T i j + T j i)

name: Connes.PaperChartDetector.upper_quadratic_sum
statement:
theorem upper_quadratic_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (d : ι → F) (c : ι → ι → F) (x : ι → F) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j,
      (if i = j then d i else if i < j then c i j else 0) * x i * x j) =
      ∑ i, d i * x i +
        ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ upper i, c i j * x i * x j

name: CriticalPortraits.Q_bSeq_d
statement:
lemma Q_bSeq_d {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m))) :
    Q (bSeq S) d = (d : ℤ) - (S.card : ℤ)

name: CriticalPortraits.Q_bSeq_d_one
statement:
lemma Q_bSeq_d_one {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m)))
    (hcard : S.card = d - 1) : Q (bSeq S) d = 1

name: CriticalPortraits.Q_bSeq_eq
statement:
lemma Q_bSeq_eq {d m : ℕ} (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m))) (k : ℕ) :
    Q (bSeq S) k = (k : ℤ) - ∑ l ∈ Finset.range k, (aP S l : ℤ)

name: CriticalPortraits.Q_bSeq_period
statement:
lemma Q_bSeq_period {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m)))
    (hcard : S.card = d - 1) (k : ℕ) : Q (bSeq S) (k + d) = Q (bSeq S) k + 1

name: CriticalPortraits.Q_e_c_cross
statement:
lemma Q_e_c_cross {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m)))
    (hcard : S.card = d - 1) (t : ℕ) (ht : t < d) (x : ℕ) :
    Q (bSeq S) (d - t) + Q (bSeq S) ((d - t) % d + x)
      = Q (bSeq S) ((d - t) % d) + Q (bSeq S) ((d - t) + x)

name: CriticalPortraits.aP_lt
statement:
lemma aP_lt {d m : ℕ} (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m))) {l : ℕ} (hl : l < d) :
    aP S l = cnt S l

name: CriticalPortraits.bSeq_periodic
statement:
lemma bSeq_periodic {d m : ℕ} (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m))) (k : ℕ) :
    bSeq S (k + d) = bSeq S k

name: CriticalPortraits.canIdx_eq
statement:
lemma canIdx_eq {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m)))
    (hcard : S.card = d - 1) {t : ℕ} (htd : t < d) (htLC : LevelCanonical d m (rhoPow t S)) :
    t = canIdx hd hm S

name: CriticalPortraits.canIdx_of_canonical
statement:
lemma canIdx_of_canonical {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (c : Finset (ZMod (d * m)))
    (hcard : c.card = d - 1) (hLC : LevelCanonical d m c) : canIdx hd hm c = 0

name: CriticalPortraits.canIdx_spec
statement:
lemma canIdx_spec {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m)))
    (hcard : S.card = d - 1) :
    canIdx hd hm S < d ∧ LevelCanonical d m (rhoPow (canIdx hd hm S) S)

name: CriticalPortraits.canonical_unique
statement:
theorem canonical_unique {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m)))
    (hcard : S.card = d - 1) :
    ∃! t, t < d ∧ LevelCanonical d m (rhoPow t S)

CriticalPortraits.card_levelCanonical_mul
CriticalPortraits.card_rhoPow
statement:
@[simp] lemma card_rhoPow {d m : ℕ} (t : ℕ) (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m))) :
    (rhoPow t S).card = S.card

name: CriticalPortraits.cnt_rhoPow
statement:
lemma cnt_rhoPow {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ) (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m)))
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j < d) :
    cnt (rhoPow t S) j = cnt S ((j + (d - t % d)) % d)

name: CriticalPortraits.cyc_inv
statement:
lemma cyc_inv (a b c d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d) (ha : a < d) (hb : b < d) (_hc : c < d)
    (h : c = (a + b) % d) : a = (c + (d - b)) % d

name: CriticalPortraits.cyc_round
statement:
lemma cyc_round (a b d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d) (ha : a < d) (hb : b < d) :
    (((a + (d - b)) % d) + b) % d = a

name: CriticalPortraits.lc_iff_good
statement:
lemma lc_iff_good {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m)))
    (hcard : S.card = d - 1) (t : ℕ) (ht : t < d) :
    LevelCanonical d m (rhoPow t S) ↔ Good d (bSeq S) ((d - t) % d)

name: CriticalPortraits.lc_index_iff
statement:
lemma lc_index_iff {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ) (ht : t < d)
    (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m))) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < d) :
    (((rhoPow t S).filter (fun i => i.val / m ≤ j)).card ≤ j)
      ↔ Q (bSeq S) (d - t) < Q (bSeq S) ((d - t) + (j + 1))

name: CriticalPortraits.level_add
statement:
lemma level_add {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ) (i : ZMod (d * m)) :
    (i + ((t * m : ℕ) : ZMod (d * m))).val / m = (i.val / m + t % d) % d

name: CriticalPortraits.level_lt
statement:
lemma level_lt {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (i : ZMod (d * m)) :
    i.val / m < d

name: CriticalPortraits.mem_rhoPow
statement:
lemma mem_rhoPow {d m : ℕ} (t : ℕ) (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m))) (x : ZMod (d * m)) :
    x ∈ rhoPow t S ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, y + ((t * m : ℕ) : ZMod (d * m)) = x

name: CriticalPortraits.prefix_cnt
statement:
lemma prefix_cnt {d m : ℕ} (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m))) (j : ℕ) :
    (S.filter (fun i => i.val / m ≤ j)).card = ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), cnt S l

name: CriticalPortraits.prefix_rhoPow
statement:
lemma prefix_rhoPow {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ) (ht : t < d)
    (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m))) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < d) :
    ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), ((cnt (rhoPow t S) l : ℤ))
      = ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (aP S (l + (d - t)) : ℤ)

name: CriticalPortraits.rhoPow_add
statement:
lemma rhoPow_add {d m : ℕ} (t u : ℕ) (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m))) :
    rhoPow t (rhoPow u S) = rhoPow (t + u) S

name: CriticalPortraits.rhoPow_mod
statement:
lemma rhoPow_mod {d m : ℕ} (t : ℕ) (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m))) :
    rhoPow (t % d) S = rhoPow t S

name: CriticalPortraits.rhoPow_period
statement: lemma rhoPow_period {d m : ℕ} (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m))) : rhoPow d S = S

name: CriticalPortraits.rhoPow_round
statement:
lemma rhoPow_round {d m : ℕ} (t : ℕ) (ht : t < d) (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m))) :
    rhoPow ((d - t) % d) (rhoPow t S) = S

name: CriticalPortraits.rhoPow_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma rhoPow_zero {d m : ℕ} (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m))) : rhoPow 0 S = S

name: CriticalPortraits.shift_cast
statement:
lemma shift_cast {d m : ℕ} (t : ℕ) :
    ((t * m : ℕ) : ZMod (d * m)) = (((t % d) * m : ℕ) : ZMod (d * m))

name: CriticalPortraits.shift_val_lt
statement:
lemma shift_val_lt {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ) :
    (t % d) * m < d * m

name: CriticalPortraits.sigma_invol
statement:
lemma sigma_invol {d : ℕ} (_hd : 0 < d) {t : ℕ} (ht : t < d) :
    (d - ((d - t) % d)) % d = t

name: CriticalPortraits.sigma_lt
statement: lemma sigma_lt {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (t : ℕ) : (d - t) % d < d

name: CriticalPortraits.sum_aP
statement:
lemma sum_aP {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m))) :
    ∑ l ∈ Finset.range d, (aP S l : ℤ) = (S.card : ℤ)

name: CriticalPortraits.sum_cnt
statement:
lemma sum_cnt {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (S : Finset (ZMod (d * m))) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range d, cnt S j = S.card

name: CriticalPortraits.sum_shift_window
statement:
lemma sum_shift_window (f : ℕ → ℤ) (e j : ℕ) :
    ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), f (l + e)
      = (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (e + (j + 1)), f l) - (∑ l ∈ Finset.range e, f l)

name: CriticalPortraits.T_card
statement:
theorem T_card {d m : ℕ} {P : Finset (Finset (ZMod (d * m)))}

lemma eraseMin_card {N : ℕ} (S : Finset (ZMod N)) (h : S.Nonempty) :

statement:
lemma eraseMin_pairwiseDisjoint {d m : ℕ} (P : Finset (Finset (ZMod (d * m))))
    (hP : Portrait d m P) : (↑P : Set (Finset (ZMod (d * m)))).PairwiseDisjoint eraseMin

name: CriticalPortraits.eraseMin_subset

name: CriticalPortraits.level_injOn_fiber
statement:
theorem level_injOn_fiber {N m : ℕ} [NeZero N] {x y : ZMod N}
    (hxy : x.val % m = y.val % m) (hlev : x.val / m = y.val / m) : x = y

name: CriticalPortraits.linked_of_lt
statement:
lemma linked_of_lt {N : ℕ} {A B : Finset (ZMod N)} {a1 a2 b1 b2 : ZMod N}
    (ha1 : a1 ∈ A) (ha2 : a2 ∈ A) (hb1 : b1 ∈ B) (hb2 : b2 ∈ B)

name: CriticalPortraits.mem_T
statement:
lemma mem_T {N : ℕ} {P : Finset (Finset (ZMod N))} {x : ZMod N} :
    x ∈ T P ↔ ∃ S ∈ P, x ∈ eraseMin S

name: CriticalPortraits.mem_eraseMin
statement:
lemma mem_eraseMin {N : ℕ} (S : Finset (ZMod N)) (h : S.Nonempty) (x : ZMod N) :
    x ∈ eraseMin S ↔ x ∈ S ∧ x ≠ minVal S h

name: CriticalPortraits.minVal_le
statement:
lemma minVal_le {N : ℕ} (S : Finset (ZMod N)) (h : S.Nonempty) :

    {S : Finset (ZMod (d * m))} (hS : IsCriticalSet d m S) (h : S.Nonempty) :

name: CriticalPortraits.minVal_mem

name: CriticalPortraits.sep_master
statement:
lemma sep_master {m : ℕ} {p q a c : ℕ} (hp : p < m) (_hq : q < m) (hac : a < c) :
    p + a * m < q + c * m

name: CriticalPortraits.val_eq_level_mul_add_col
statement:
lemma val_eq_level_mul_add_col {N : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (i : ZMod N) :

name: AbstractLaminar.N_split
statement: lemma N_split : N fam a b = (topEdges fam a b).card + (Sstrict fam a b).card

name: AbstractLaminar.Sstrict_card_eq_sum
statement:
lemma Sstrict_card_eq_sum :
    (Sstrict fam a b).card = ∑ r ∈ Roots fam a b, N fam (fam.lo r) (fam.hi r)

name: AbstractLaminar.Sstrict_eq_filter_not
statement:
lemma Sstrict_eq_filter_not :
    Sstrict fam a b = (contained fam a b).filter (fun e => ¬ (fam.lo e = a ∧ fam.hi e = b))

name: AbstractLaminar.containersS_nonempty
statement:
lemma containersS_nonempty {a b : ℕ} {f : ι} (hf : f ∈ Sstrict fam a b) :
    (containersS fam a b f).Nonempty

name: AbstractLaminar.crux
statement:
lemma crux (hab : a < b) (htop : (topEdges fam a b).Nonempty) :
    ∑ r ∈ Roots fam a b, (fam.hi r - fam.lo r) ≤ b - a - 1

name: AbstractLaminar.fiber_eq_contained
statement:
lemma fiber_eq_contained {r : ι} (hr : r ∈ Roots fam a b) :
    (Sstrict fam a b).filter (fun g => rootS fam a b g = r) =
      contained fam (fam.lo r) (fam.hi r)

name: AbstractLaminar.master
statement: theorem master (a b : ℕ) : N fam a b ≤ b - a

name: AbstractLaminar.mem_Roots
statement: lemma mem_Roots {r : ι} : r ∈ Roots fam a b ↔ r ∈ Sstrict fam a b ∧ rootS fam a b r = r

name: AbstractLaminar.mem_Sstrict
statement:
lemma mem_Sstrict {a b : ℕ} {e : ι} :
    e ∈ Sstrict fam a b ↔ (e ∈ fam.E ∧ a ≤ fam.lo e ∧ fam.hi e ≤ b) ∧
      (fam.lo e ≠ a ∨ fam.hi e ≠ b)

name: AbstractLaminar.mem_contained
statement:
lemma mem_contained {a b : ℕ} {e : ι} :
    e ∈ contained fam a b ↔ e ∈ fam.E ∧ a ≤ fam.lo e ∧ fam.hi e ≤ b

name: AbstractLaminar.mem_containersS
statement:
lemma mem_containersS {a b : ℕ} {f g : ι} :
    g ∈ containersS fam a b f ↔
      ((g ∈ fam.E ∧ a ≤ fam.lo g ∧ fam.hi g ≤ b) ∧ (fam.lo g ≠ a ∨ fam.hi g ≠ b)) ∧
        fam.lo g ≤ fam.lo f ∧ fam.hi f ≤ fam.hi g

name: AbstractLaminar.overlap_imp_nested
statement:
lemma overlap_imp_nested {e f : ι} (he : e ∈ fam.E) (hf : f ∈ fam.E)
    (h1 : fam.lo e < fam.hi f) (h2 : fam.lo f < fam.hi e) :
    (fam.lo f ≤ fam.lo e ∧ fam.hi e ≤ fam.hi f) ∨
    (fam.lo e ≤ fam.lo f ∧ fam.hi f ≤ fam.hi e)

name: AbstractLaminar.rootS_contains
statement:
lemma rootS_contains {f : ι} (hf : f ∈ Sstrict fam a b) :
    fam.lo (rootS fam a b f) ≤ fam.lo f ∧ fam.hi f ≤ fam.hi (rootS fam a b f)

name: AbstractLaminar.rootS_idem
statement:
lemma rootS_idem {f : ι} (hf : f ∈ Sstrict fam a b) :
    rootS fam a b (rootS fam a b f) = rootS fam a b f

name: AbstractLaminar.rootS_max
statement:
lemma rootS_max {a b : ℕ} {f : ι} (hf : f ∈ Sstrict fam a b) :
    ∀ g ∈ containersS fam a b f,
      fam.hi g - fam.lo g ≤ fam.hi (rootS fam a b f) - fam.lo (rootS fam a b f)

name: AbstractLaminar.rootS_maximal
statement:
lemma rootS_maximal {f : ι} (hf : f ∈ Sstrict fam a b)
    {g : ι} (hg : g ∈ Sstrict fam a b)
    (h1 : fam.lo g ≤ fam.lo (rootS fam a b f)) (h2 : fam.hi (rootS fam a b f) ≤ fam.hi g) :
    fam.lo g = fam.lo (rootS fam a b f) ∧ fam.hi g = fam.hi (rootS fam a b f)

name: AbstractLaminar.rootS_mem_E
statement: lemma rootS_mem_E {f : ι} (hf : f ∈ Sstrict fam a b) : rootS fam a b f ∈ fam.E

name: AbstractLaminar.rootS_mem_Roots
statement: lemma rootS_mem_Roots {f : ι} (hf : f ∈ Sstrict fam a b) : rootS fam a b f ∈ Roots fam a b

name: AbstractLaminar.rootS_mem_Sstrict
statement: lemma rootS_mem_Sstrict {f : ι} (hf : f ∈ Sstrict fam a b) : rootS fam a b f ∈ Sstrict fam a b

name: AbstractLaminar.rootS_mem_containersS
statement:
lemma rootS_mem_containersS {a b : ℕ} {f : ι} (hf : f ∈ Sstrict fam a b) :
    rootS fam a b f ∈ containersS fam a b f

name: AbstractLaminar.rootS_strict
statement:
lemma rootS_strict {f : ι} (hf : f ∈ Sstrict fam a b) :
    fam.lo (rootS fam a b f) ≠ a ∨ fam.hi (rootS fam a b f) ≠ b

name: AbstractLaminar.rootS_width_lt
statement:
lemma rootS_width_lt {f : ι} (hf : f ∈ Sstrict fam a b) :
    fam.hi (rootS fam a b f) - fam.lo (rootS fam a b f) < b - a

name: AbstractLaminar.rootS_window
statement:
lemma rootS_window {f : ι} (hf : f ∈ Sstrict fam a b) :
    a ≤ fam.lo (rootS fam a b f) ∧ fam.hi (rootS fam a b f) ≤ b

name: AbstractLaminar.root_self_props
statement:
lemma root_self_props {r : ι} (hr : r ∈ Roots fam a b) :
    r ∈ fam.E ∧ a ≤ fam.lo r ∧ fam.hi r ≤ b ∧ (fam.lo r ≠ a ∨ fam.hi r ≠ b)

name: AbstractLaminar.root_unique
statement:
lemma root_unique {r r' : ι} (hr : r ∈ Roots fam a b) (hr' : r' ∈ Roots fam a b)
    {g : ι} (hg : g ∈ fam.E)
    (h1 : fam.lo r ≤ fam.lo g) (h2 : fam.hi g ≤ fam.hi r)
    (h1' : fam.lo r' ≤ fam.lo g) (h2' : fam.hi g ≤ fam.hi r') :
    r = r'

name: AbstractLaminar.roots_Ioc_disjoint
statement:
lemma roots_Ioc_disjoint :
    (Roots fam a b : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint (fun r => Finset.Ioc (fam.lo r) (fam.hi r))

name: AbstractLaminar.roots_interval_disjoint
statement:
lemma roots_interval_disjoint {r r' : ι} (hr : r ∈ Roots fam a b) (hr' : r' ∈ Roots fam a b)
    (hne : r ≠ r') : fam.hi r ≤ fam.lo r' ∨ fam.hi r' ≤ fam.lo r

name: AbstractLaminar.roots_width_sum_le
statement:
lemma roots_width_sum_le :

statement:
lemma column_sep {a b : ℕ} (hab : a < b) (hsat : N fam a b = b - a)
    {e0 : ι} (he0E : e0 ∈ fam.E) (he0lo : fam.lo e0 = a) (he0hi : fam.hi e0 = b) :
    ∀ r ∈ Roots fam a b, fam.col r ≠ fam.col e0

name: AbstractLaminar.column_sep_with_gap
statement:
lemma column_sep_with_gap {a b : ℕ} (hab : a < b) (hsat : N fam a b = b - a)
    {e0 : ι} (he0E : e0 ∈ fam.E) (he0lo : fam.lo e0 = a) (he0hi : fam.hi e0 = b) :
    ∃ g, a < g ∧ g ≤ b ∧ (∀ r ∈ Roots fam a b, ¬ (fam.lo r < g ∧ g ≤ fam.hi r)) ∧
      (∀ r ∈ Roots fam a b, fam.hi r < g → fam.col e0 < fam.col r) ∧
      (∀ r ∈ Roots fam a b, g ≤ fam.lo r → fam.col r < fam.col e0)

name: AbstractLaminar.covered_of_ne_gap
statement:
lemma covered_of_ne_gap {a b g : ℕ} (htop : (topEdges fam a b).Nonempty)
    (hsat : N fam a b = b - a) (hab : a < b)
    (hg1 : a < g) (hg2 : g ≤ b)
    (hgap : ∀ r ∈ Roots fam a b, ¬ (fam.lo r < g ∧ g ≤ fam.hi r))
    {t : ℕ} (ht1 : a < t) (ht2 : t ≤ b) (htne : t ≠ g) :
    ∃ r ∈ Roots fam a b, fam.lo r < t ∧ t ≤ fam.hi r

name: AbstractLaminar.edge_tight_of_saturated
statement:
lemma edge_tight_of_saturated :
    ∀ w : ℕ, ∀ a b : ℕ, b - a = w → N fam a b = b - a →
      ∀ e ∈ contained fam a b, N fam (fam.lo e) (fam.hi e) = fam.hi e - fam.lo e

name: AbstractLaminar.root_saturated
statement:
lemma root_saturated {a b : ℕ} (hsat : N fam a b = b - a) :
    ∀ r ∈ Roots fam a b, N fam (fam.lo r) (fam.hi r) = fam.hi r - fam.lo r

name: AbstractLaminar.roots_width_sum_eq
statement:

name: CriticalPortraits.bridge_edge
statement:
theorem bridge_edge [NeZero (d * m)] (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m)
    {P : Finset (Finset (ZMod (d * m)))} (hP : Portrait d m P)
    {u b2 : ZMod (d * m)} (hu : u ∈ T P) (hb2 : b2 ∈ T P)
    (hcol : colV b2 = colV u)
    (hlo : loV P u < loV P b2) (hhi : hiV b2 < hiV u) :
    ∃ g ∈ T P, colV g ≠ colV u ∧
      loV P u ≤ loV P g ∧ loV P g ≤ loV P b2 ∧ hiV b2 ≤ hiV g ∧ hiV g ≤ hiV u ∧ g ≠ b2

statement:

    {P : Finset (Finset (ZMod (d * m)))} (hP : Portrait d m P)
    {e : ZMod (d * m)} (he : e ∈ T P) (hwin : loV P e < hiV e) :
    ∀ r ∈ AbstractLaminar.Roots (survivorFamily hd hm hP) (loV P e) (hiV e),
      colV r ≠ colV e

name: CriticalPortraits.column_sep_geom_dir
statement:
theorem column_sep_geom_dir [NeZero (d * m)] (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m)
    {P : Finset (Finset (ZMod (d * m)))} (hP : Portrait d m P)
    {e : ZMod (d * m)} (he : e ∈ T P) (hwin : loV P e < hiV e) :
    ∃ g, loV P e < g ∧ g ≤ hiV e ∧
      (∀ r ∈ AbstractLaminar.Roots (survivorFamily hd hm hP) (loV P e) (hiV e),
        ¬ (loV P r < g ∧ g ≤ hiV r)) ∧
      (∀ r ∈ AbstractLaminar.Roots (survivorFamily hd hm hP) (loV P e) (hiV e),
        hiV r < g → colV e < colV r) ∧
      (∀ r ∈ AbstractLaminar.Roots (survivorFamily hd hm hP) (loV P e) (hiV e),
        g ≤ loV P r → colV r < colV e)

    (hAne : A.Nonempty) (hBne : B.Nonempty) :
    ¬ (spanLo A hAne < spanLo B hBne ∧ spanLo B hBne < spanHi A hAne ∧
       spanHi A hAne < spanHi B hBne)

    ∃ b, ∃ hb : b ∈ T P, colV b ≠ colV x ∧
      (predIn P b hb).val < colV x + ℓ * m ∧ colV x + ℓ * m < b.val ∧ b.val < x.val

name: CutAndProject.count_hits_eq_sorted_count
statement:
lemma count_hits_eq_sorted_count (α β : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) (h_ω : 0 ≤ ω)
    [NeZero (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2)] :
    let N := (⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat
    let D := α ^ 2 + β ^ 2
    let r0 := ((-⌊ω * ↑β⌋ : ℤ) : ZMod D).val
    ∀ x : ZMod D, countHits D r0 N x =
      ((Finset.range N).filter
        (fun (k : ℕ) => (sortedMultiset α β ω (↑k : ℤ) : ZMod D) = x)).card

    let N := (⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat
    let D := α ^ 2 + β ^ 2
    let r0 := ((-⌊ω * ↑β⌋ : ℤ) : ZMod D).val
    ∀ x : ZMod D, countHitsUnit D u r0 N x =
      ((Finset.range N).filter
        (fun (k : ℕ) => (sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u (↑k : ℤ) : ZMod D) = x)).card

name: CutAndProject.count_hits_shift_invariant
statement:
lemma count_hits_shift_invariant (α β : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) (h_ω : 0 ≤ ω)
    [NeZero (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2)]
    (L : ℕ) (hL_pos : 0 < L) (hL : IsPeriod (differenceSequence α β ω) L) :
    let N := (⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat
    let D := α ^ 2 + β ^ 2
    let σ := (sortedMultiset α β ω ↑L - sortedMultiset α β ω 0).toNat
    let r0 := ((-⌊ω * ↑β⌋ : ℤ) : ZMod D).val
    ∀ x : ZMod D, countHits D r0 N (x + ↑σ) = countHits D r0 N x

name: CutAndProject.count_hits_shift_invariant_unit

    [NeZero (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2)] (u : (ZMod (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2))ˣ)
    (L : ℕ) (hL_pos : 0 < L) (hL : IsPeriod (differenceSequenceUnit α β ω u) L) :
    let N := (⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat
    let D := α ^ 2 + β ^ 2
    let σ := (sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u ↑L - sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u 0).toNat
    let r0 := ((-⌊ω * ↑β⌋ : ℤ) : ZMod D).val
    ∀ x : ZMod D, countHitsUnit D u r0 N (x + ↑σ) = countHitsUnit D u r0 N x

name: CutAndProject.count_hits_succ
statement:
lemma count_hits_succ (D : ℕ) (r0 N : ℕ) (x : ZMod D) :
    countHits D r0 (N + 1) x = countHits D r0 N x + if (r0 + N : ZMod D) = x then 1 else 0

name: CutAndProject.count_hits_unit_eq_count_hits

lemma count_hits_unit_eq_count_hits

    countHitsUnit D u r0 N x = countHits D r0 N ((u⁻¹ : (ZMod D)ˣ) * x)

name: CutAndProject.count_hits_unit_multiplier_eq_c_r_count

    countHitsUnit (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2) (multiplier α β h_coprime) r0 N x =

lemma cyclic_interval_mem (D s : ℕ) (x0 : ZMod D) (x : ZMod D) :

name: CutAndProject.generic_minimality
statement:
lemma generic_minimality (α β : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) (seq : ℤ → ℤ) [NeZero (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2)]
    [GeometricProjection α β ω seq] :
    let N := (⌊ω * α⌋ + ⌊ω * β⌋ + 1).toNat
    let D := α ^ 2 + β ^ 2
    ¬ (D ∣ N) → ∀ L > 0, IsPeriod seq L → N ≤ L

name: CutAndProject.heavy_set_is_cyclic_interval
statement:
lemma heavy_set_is_cyclic_interval (D : ℕ) [NeZero D] (r0 N : ℕ) :
    let q := N / D
    let s := N % D
    ∀ x : ZMod D, countHits D r0 N x = q + 1
      ↔ x ∈ cyclicInterval D s ((r0 + q * D : ℕ) : ZMod D)

name: CutAndProject.heavy_set_unit_is_cyclic_interval
statement:
lemma heavy_set_unit_is_cyclic_interval (D : ℕ) [NeZero D] (u : (ZMod D)ˣ) (r0 N : ℕ) :
    let q := N / D
    let s := N % D
    ∀ x : ZMod D, countHitsUnit D u r0 N x = q + 1 ↔
      ((u⁻¹ : (ZMod D)ˣ) : ZMod D) * x ∈ cyclicInterval D s ((r0 + q * D : ℕ) : ZMod D)

name: CutAndProject.main_theorem
statement:
theorem main_theorem (α β : ℕ) (h_coprime : Nat.Coprime α β) (ω : ℝ) (_h_ω : 0 ≤ ω)
    [NeZero (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2)] [GeometricProjection α β ω (differenceSequence α β ω)] :
    let N_int := ⌊ω * α⌋ + ⌊ω * β⌋ + 1
    let N := N_int.toNat
    let D := α ^ 2 + β ^ 2
    let L := if D ∣ N then N / D else N
    HasPeriodLength (differenceSequence α β ω) L

    HasPeriodLength (differenceSequence α β ω)
      (if (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2) ∣ (⌊ω * α⌋ + ⌊ω * β⌋ + 1).toNat then
        (⌊ω * α⌋ + ⌊ω * β⌋ + 1).toNat / (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2)

name: CutAndProject.non_uniform_residue_distribution_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem non_uniform_residue_distribution_of_not_dvd
    (D : ℕ) [NeZero D] (r0 N : ℕ) (h : ¬ D ∣ N) :
    let q := N / D
    let s := N % D
    0 < s ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : ZMod D => countHits D r0 N x = q + 1)).card = s ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : ZMod D => countHits D r0 N x = q)).card = D - s

statement:

    (α β : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) [NeZero (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2)]
    (u : (ZMod (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2))ˣ)
    (h : (⌊ω * α⌋ + ⌊ω * β⌋ + 1).toNat < α ^ 2 + β ^ 2) (i : ℤ) :
    setSortedUnit α β ω u i = sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u i

name: CutAndProject.shift_nonneg
statement:
lemma shift_nonneg (α β : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) (h_ω : 0 ≤ ω)
    (L : ℕ) (hL_pos : 0 < L) (hL : IsPeriod (differenceSequence α β ω) L) :
    0 ≤ sortedMultiset α β ω ↑L - sortedMultiset α β ω 0

name: CutAndProject.shift_nonneg_unit
statement:
lemma shift_nonneg_unit (α β : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) (h_ω : 0 ≤ ω)
    (u : (ZMod (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2))ˣ)
    (L : ℕ) (hL_pos : 0 < L) (hL : IsPeriod (differenceSequenceUnit α β ω u) L) :
    0 ≤ sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u ↑L - sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u 0

name: CutAndProject.shift_times_N_eq
statement:
lemma shift_times_N_eq (α β : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) (h_ω : 0 ≤ ω)
    (L : ℕ) (hL : IsPeriod (differenceSequence α β ω) L) :
    let N := (⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat
    let D := α ^ 2 + β ^ 2
    let σ := sortedMultiset α β ω ↑L - sortedMultiset α β ω 0
    ↑N * σ = ↑L * ↑D

name: CutAndProject.shift_times_N_eq_unit
statement:
lemma shift_times_N_eq_unit (α β : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) (h_ω : 0 ≤ ω)
    (u : (ZMod (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2))ˣ)
    (L : ℕ) (hL : IsPeriod (differenceSequenceUnit α β ω u) L) :
    let N := (⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat
    let D := α ^ 2 + β ^ 2
    let σ := sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u ↑L - sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u 0
    ↑N * σ = ↑L * ↑D

name: CutAndProject.sigma_of_period_concrete
statement:
lemma sigma_of_period_concrete (α β : ℕ) (_h_coprime : Nat.Coprime α β) (ω : ℝ)
    (h_ω : 0 ≤ ω) [NeZero (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2)] :
    ∀ L > 0, IsPeriod (differenceSequence α β ω) L →
    ∃ σ : ℕ, σ * (⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat = L * (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2) ∧
    ∃ r0 : ℕ, ∀ x : ZMod (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2),
      countHits (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2) r0 (⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat
          (x + (σ : ZMod (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2)))
        = countHits (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2) r0 (⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat x

name: CutAndProject.sigma_of_period_unit_concrete
statement:
lemma sigma_of_period_unit_concrete (α β : ℕ) (_h_coprime : Nat.Coprime α β)
    (ω : ℝ) (h_ω : 0 ≤ ω) [NeZero (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2)]
    (u : (ZMod (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2))ˣ) :
    ∀ L > 0, IsPeriod (differenceSequenceUnit α β ω u) L →
    ∃ σ : ℕ, σ * (⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat = L * (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2) ∧
    ∃ r0 : ℕ, ∀ x : ZMod (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2),
      countHitsUnit (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2) u r0 (⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat
        (x + (σ : ZMod (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2))) =
      countHitsUnit (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2) u r0 (⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat x

name: CutAndProject.sorted_multiset_add_N
statement:
lemma sorted_multiset_add_N (α β : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) (h_ω : 0 ≤ ω) (i : ℤ) :
    let N := (⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat
    let D := α ^ 2 + β ^ 2
    sortedMultiset α β ω (i + ↑N) = sortedMultiset α β ω i + ↑D

name: CutAndProject.sorted_multiset_add_mul_N
statement:
lemma sorted_multiset_add_mul_N (α β : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) (h_ω : 0 ≤ ω)
    (i : ℤ) (m : ℕ) :
    sortedMultiset α β ω (i + ↑m * ↑(⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat) =
      sortedMultiset α β ω i + ↑m * ↑(α ^ 2 + β ^ 2)

name: CutAndProject.sorted_multiset_mod_D_eq
statement:
lemma sorted_multiset_mod_D_eq (α β : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) (h_ω : 0 ≤ ω)
    (k L : ℕ) :
    (sortedMultiset α β ω ↑(k + L) : ZMod (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2)) =
    (sortedMultiset α β ω ↑((k + L) %
      (⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat) :
      ZMod (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2))

name: CutAndProject.sorted_multiset_unit_add_N
statement:
lemma sorted_multiset_unit_add_N (α β : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) (h_ω : 0 ≤ ω)
    (u : (ZMod (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2))ˣ) (i : ℤ) :
    let N := (⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat
    let D := α ^ 2 + β ^ 2
    sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u (i + ↑N) = sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u i + ↑D

name: CutAndProject.sorted_multiset_unit_add_mul_N
statement:
lemma sorted_multiset_unit_add_mul_N (α β : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) (h_ω : 0 ≤ ω)
    (u : (ZMod (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2))ˣ) (i : ℤ) (m : ℕ) :
    sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u (i + ↑m * ↑(⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat) =
      sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u i + ↑m * ↑(α ^ 2 + β ^ 2)

name: CutAndProject.sorted_multiset_unit_mod_D_eq
statement:
lemma sorted_multiset_unit_mod_D_eq (α β : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) (h_ω : 0 ≤ ω)
    (u : (ZMod (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2))ˣ) (k L : ℕ) :
    (sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u ↑(k + L) : ZMod (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2)) =
    (sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u ↑((k + L) %
      (⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat) :
      ZMod (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2))

name: CutAndProject.sorted_residue_shift
statement:
lemma sorted_residue_shift (α β : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) (h_ω : 0 ≤ ω)
    (L : ℕ) (hL : IsPeriod (differenceSequence α β ω) L) (j : ℕ) :
    let D := α ^ 2 + β ^ 2
    let σ_ℤ := sortedMultiset α β ω ↑L - sortedMultiset α β ω 0
    (sortedMultiset α β ω ↑((j + L) %
      (⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat) : ZMod D) =
    (sortedMultiset α β ω ↑j : ZMod D) + (σ_ℤ : ZMod D)

name: CutAndProject.sorted_residue_shift_unit
statement:
lemma sorted_residue_shift_unit (α β : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) (h_ω : 0 ≤ ω)
    (u : (ZMod (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2))ˣ)
    (L : ℕ) (hL : IsPeriod (differenceSequenceUnit α β ω u) L) (j : ℕ) :
    let D := α ^ 2 + β ^ 2
    let σ_ℤ := sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u ↑L - sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u 0
    (sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u ↑((j + L) %
      (⌊ω * ↑α⌋ + ⌊ω * ↑β⌋ + 1).toNat) : ZMod D) =
    (sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u ↑j : ZMod D) + (σ_ℤ : ZMod D)

name: CutAndProject.sorted_shift_constant
statement:
lemma sorted_shift_constant (α β : ℕ) (ω : ℝ)
    (L : ℕ) (hL : IsPeriod (differenceSequence α β ω) L) (i : ℤ) :
    sortedMultiset α β ω (i + ↑L) - sortedMultiset α β ω i =
    sortedMultiset α β ω ↑L - sortedMultiset α β ω 0

name: CutAndProject.sorted_shift_constant_unit
statement:
lemma sorted_shift_constant_unit (α β : ℕ) (ω : ℝ)
    (u : (ZMod (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2))ˣ)
    (L : ℕ) (hL : IsPeriod (differenceSequenceUnit α β ω u) L) (i : ℤ) :
    sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u (i + ↑L) - sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u i =
    sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u ↑L - sortedMultisetUnit α β ω u 0

name: CutAndProject.sum_count_hits
statement:
lemma sum_count_hits (D : ℕ) [NeZero D] (r0 N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x : ZMod D, countHits D r0 N x = N

name: CutAndProject.uniform_residue_distribution
statement:
theorem uniform_residue_distribution (D : ℕ) [NeZero D] (r0 N : ℕ) (h : D ∣ N) (x : ZMod D) :
    countHits D r0 N x = N / D

name: CutAndProject.uniform_residue_distribution_unit
statement:
theorem uniform_residue_distribution_unit
    (D : ℕ) [NeZero D] (u : (ZMod D)ˣ) (r0 N : ℕ) (h : D ∣ N) (x : ZMod D) :
    countHitsUnit D u r0 N x = N / D

name: CutAndProject.Irrational.accepted_preimage_finite
CutAndProject.Irrational.dense_internal_image

name: CutAndProject.Irrational.gap_pos
statement:
lemma gap_pos (ha : Irrational a) (ha_pos : 0 < a) (hω : 0 < ω) (i : ℤ) :

name: CutAndProject.Irrational.lattice_translation_must_be_zero
statement:
theorem lattice_translation_must_be_zero
    (ha : Irrational a) (ha_pos : 0 < a) (hω : 0 < ω) (v : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hv_inv : ∀ z ∈ acceptedSet a ω, z + v ∈ acceptedSet a ω) :
    v = 0

name: CutAndProject.Irrational.mem_W_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_W_iff (x : ℝ) :
    x ∈ W a ω ↔ -(a * ω) ≤ x ∧ x ≤ ω

name: CutAndProject.Irrational.mem_acceptedSet_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_acceptedSet_iff (z : ℤ × ℤ) :
    z ∈ acceptedSet a ω ↔ sInternal a z ∈ W a ω

name: CutAndProject.Irrational.period_lifts_to_lattice_translation
statement:
theorem period_lifts_to_lattice_translation
    (ha : Irrational a) (ha_pos : 0 < a) (hω : 0 < ω)
    (lam : ℕ) (hp : IsGapPeriod a ω ha ha_pos hω lam) :
    ∃ v : ℤ × ℤ, v ≠ 0 ∧
      0 < tildeP a v ∧
      ∀ z ∈ acceptedSet a ω, z + v ∈ acceptedSet a ω

name: CutAndProject.Irrational.prop_irrational
statement:
theorem prop_irrational
    (ha : Irrational a) (ha_pos : 0 < a) (hω : 0 < ω) :

name: CutAndProject.Irrational.sInternal_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sInternal_apply (m n : ℤ) :

name: CutAndProject.Irrational.tildeP_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma tildeP_apply (m n : ℤ) :
    tildeP a (m, n) = (m : ℝ) + a * (n : ℝ)

name: CutAndProject.Irrational.tildeP_image_unbounded_above
statement:
theorem tildeP_image_unbounded_above

name: CutAndProject.Irrational.tildeP_image_unbounded_below
statement:
theorem tildeP_image_unbounded_below

name: CutAndProject.Irrational.tildeP_injOn_acceptedSet

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.bad_residues_card_le
statement:
lemma bad_residues_card_le (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b)

    ((Finset.range (p ^ 2)).filter fun r => (p ^ 2) ∣ r ∨ ∃ d ∈ T, (p ^ 2) ∣ (b * r + d)).card

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.bad_residues_type_B_card_le

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.bound_summable
statement:
lemma bound_summable (b : ℕ) (_hb : 2 ≤ b) (T : Finset ℕ) (_hT : T ⊆ Finset.range b) :

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.deviation_bound_for_large_prime

theorem deviation_bound_for_large_prime (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b)

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.deviation_bounded_eventually

lemma deviation_bounded_eventually (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (T : Finset ℕ) (hT : T ⊆ Finset.range b) :
    ∀ᶠ p : Nat.Primes in Filter.cofinite,
      ‖|localDensityFactor (p : ℕ) b T - 1|‖ ≤ (T.card + 1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.filtered_subset_image
statement:
lemma filtered_subset_image (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hbp : b < p) (T : Finset ℕ) (_hT : T ⊆ Finset.range b) :

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.valid_residues_card_ge
statement:
lemma valid_residues_card_ge (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hbp : b < p) (T : Finset ℕ) (hT : T ⊆ Finset.range b) :

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.card_modEq_Icc_bound
statement:
lemma card_modEq_Icc_bound (v r X : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    ((Finset.Ioc 0 X).filter fun N => N ≡ v [MOD r]).card ≤ X / r + 1

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.card_multiples_Icc

lemma card_multiples_Icc (q : ℕ) (X : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 X).filter fun N => q ^ 2 ∣ N).card ≤ X / q ^ 2

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.card_shifted_divisible_bound
statement:
lemma card_shifted_divisible_bound (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (q : Nat.Primes) (hq : (q : ℕ) > b)
    (d : ℕ) (X : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 X).filter fun N => (q : ℕ) ^ 2 ∣ b * N + d).card ≤ X / (q : ℕ) ^ 2 + 1

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.card_union_shifted_bound

lemma card_union_shifted_bound (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (T : Finset ℕ) (_hT : T ⊆ Finset.range b)

    ((Finset.Icc 1 X).filter fun N => ∃ d ∈ T, (q : ℕ) ^ 2 ∣ b * N + d).card ≤

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.combined_bound_aux

    X / q_sq + T.card * (X / q_sq + 1) ≤ (T.card + 1) * (X / q_sq + 1)

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.dvd_iff_modEq_of_coprime
statement:
lemma dvd_iff_modEq_of_coprime (p b v d N : ℕ) (hcop : (p ^ 2).gcd b = 1)
    (hdvd_v : (p ^ 2) ∣ (b * v + d)) :
    (p ^ 2) ∣ (b * N + d) ↔ N ≡ v [MOD (p ^ 2)]

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.dvd_shift_iff_modEq_unique
statement:
lemma dvd_shift_iff_modEq_unique (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (q : Nat.Primes) (hq : (q : ℕ) > b) (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ v : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, (q : ℕ) ^ 2 ∣ b * N + d ↔ N ≡ v [MOD (q : ℕ) ^ 2]

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.exists_finset_tsum_compl_lt

lemma exists_finset_tsum_compl_lt (f : Nat.Primes → ℝ) (_hf : ∀ p, 0 ≤ f p) (_hsum : Summable f)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ s : Finset Nat.Primes, ∑' (p : {q : Nat.Primes // q ∉ s}), f p < ε

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.exists_inverse_residue
statement:
lemma exists_inverse_residue (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hbp : b < p) (d : ℕ) :

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.filter_shifted_dvd_eq_filter_modEq
statement:
lemma filter_shifted_dvd_eq_filter_modEq (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (q : Nat.Primes) (hq : (q : ℕ) > b)
    (d : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) :
    ∃ v : ℕ, (S.filter fun N => (q : ℕ) ^ 2 ∣ b * N + d) =
             (S.filter fun N => N ≡ v [MOD (q : ℕ) ^ 2])

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.floor_diff_bound_rat
statement:
lemma floor_diff_bound_rat (X v r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    ⌊((X : ℚ) - v) / r⌋ - ⌊(-(v : ℚ)) / r⌋ ≤ ⌊(X : ℚ) / r⌋ + 1

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.gcd_psq_b_eq_one
statement:
lemma gcd_psq_b_eq_one (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hbp : b < p) :
    (p ^ 2).gcd b = 1

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.gt_sup_imp_not_mem
statement:
lemma gt_sup_imp_not_mem (s : Finset Nat.Primes) (q : Nat.Primes) (hq : (q : ℕ) > s.sup (·.val)) :
    q ∉ s

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.prime_count_le_sqrt
statement:
lemma prime_count_le_sqrt (M : ℕ) :
    (M.sqrt.primesBelow).card ≤ Nat.sqrt M

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.prime_sq_pos
statement: lemma prime_sq_pos (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) : 0 < p ^ 2

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.prime_tail_sum_small
statement:
lemma prime_tail_sum_small (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ y : ℕ, ∑' (p : {q : Nat.Primes // (q : ℕ) > y}), 1 / (((p : Nat.Primes) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 < ε

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.single_prime_violation_bound
statement:
lemma single_prime_violation_bound (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (T : Finset ℕ) (hT : T ⊆ Finset.range b)
    (q : Nat.Primes) (hq : (q : ℕ) > b) (X : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 X).filter fun N =>
      (q : ℕ) ^ 2 ∣ N ∨ ∃ d ∈ T, (q : ℕ) ^ 2 ∣ b * N + d).card ≤ (T.card + 1) * (X / (q : ℕ) ^ 2 +
          1)

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.sqrt_div_X_small
statement:
lemma sqrt_div_X_small (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, (Nat.sqrt X : ℝ) / X < ε

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.tsum_primes_gt_le_tsum_compl
statement:
lemma tsum_primes_gt_le_tsum_compl (f : Nat.Primes → ℝ) (hf : ∀ p, 0 ≤ f p) (hsum : Summable f)
    (s : Finset Nat.Primes) :
    ∑' (p : {q : Nat.Primes // (q : ℕ) > s.sup (·.val)}), f p ≤
    ∑' (p : {q : Nat.Primes // q ∉ s}), f p

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.zmod_mul_inv_add_eq_zero
statement:
lemma zmod_mul_inv_add_eq_zero (n b d : ℕ) (_hn : 0 < n) (hb : b.Coprime n) :
    (↑b : ZMod n) * ((-↑d : ZMod n) * (↑b : ZMod n)⁻¹) + ↑d = 0

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.finsum_le_tsum_tail
statement:
lemma finsum_le_tsum_tail (y : ℕ) (Q : Finset Nat.Primes) (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, (q : ℕ) > y) :
    (∑ q ∈ Q, 1 / (((q : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2))
    ≤ (∑' (p : {q : Nat.Primes // (q : ℕ) > y}), 1 / (((p : Nat.Primes) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.nat_div_floor_le_real_div
statement:
lemma nat_div_floor_le_real_div (X : ℕ) (q : Nat.Primes) :
    ((X / (q : ℕ) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) / ((q : ℕ) ^ 2 : ℝ)

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.nat_sum_le_real_sum
statement:
lemma nat_sum_le_real_sum (T : Finset ℕ) (X : ℕ) (Q : Finset Nat.Primes) :
    ((∑ q ∈ Q, (T.card + 1) * (X / (q : ℕ) ^ 2 + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)
    ≤ ∑ q ∈ Q, ((T.card + 1 : ℝ) * ((X : ℝ) / ((q : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 + 1))

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.not_in_S_implies_gt_y
statement:
lemma not_in_S_implies_gt_y (S : Finset Nat.Primes) (y : ℕ)
    (hy : ∀ p : Nat.Primes, (p : ℕ) ≤ y → p ∈ S) (q : Nat.Primes) (hq : q ∉ S) :
    (q : ℕ) > y

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.prime_sq_bound_from_N_dvd
statement:
lemma prime_sq_bound_from_N_dvd (b X N : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (q : Nat.Primes)
    (hN : N ∈ Finset.Icc 1 X) (hdvd : (q : ℕ) ^ 2 ∣ N) : (q : ℕ) < Nat.sqrt (b * X + b) + 1

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.prime_sq_bound_from_shifted_dvd
statement:
theorem prime_sq_bound_from_shifted_dvd (b X N d : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (q : Nat.Primes)
    (hN : N ∈ Finset.Icc 1 X) (hd : d ∈ Finset.range b) (hdvd : (q : ℕ) ^ 2 ∣ b * N + d) :
    (q : ℕ) < Nat.sqrt (b * X + b) + 1

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.primesBelow'_card
statement: lemma primesBelow'_card (n : ℕ) : (primesBelow' n).card = n.primesBelow.card

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.primesBelow_succ_card_le
statement: lemma primesBelow_succ_card_le (k : ℕ) : (k + 1).primesBelow.card ≤ k

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.relevantNotInS_card_le
statement:
lemma relevantNotInS_card_le (b X : ℕ) (S : Finset Nat.Primes) :
    (relevantNotInS b X S).card ≤ Nat.sqrt (b * X + b)

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.relevantNotInS_gt_b
statement:
lemma relevantNotInS_gt_b (b X : ℕ) (S : Finset Nat.Primes) (y : ℕ)
    (hy : ∀ p : Nat.Primes, (p : ℕ) ≤ y → p ∈ S) (hyb : y ≥ b) (q : Nat.Primes)
    (hq : q ∈ relevantNotInS b X S) :
    (q : ℕ) > b

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.relevantNotInS_gt_y
statement:
lemma relevantNotInS_gt_y (b X : ℕ) (S : Finset Nat.Primes) (y : ℕ)
    (hy : ∀ p : Nat.Primes, (p : ℕ) ≤ y → p ∈ S) (q : Nat.Primes)
    (hq : q ∈ relevantNotInS b X S) :
    (q : ℕ) > y

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.sum_bound_real
statement:
lemma sum_bound_real (T : Finset ℕ) (y : ℕ) (X : ℕ)
    (Q : Finset Nat.Primes) (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, (q : ℕ) > y) :
    (∑ q ∈ Q, ((T.card + 1 : ℝ) * ((X : ℝ) / ((q : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 + 1)))
    ≤ (T.card + 1 : ℝ) * X * (∑' (p : {q : Nat.Primes // (q : ℕ) > y}), 1 / (
        ((p : Nat.Primes) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)
      + (T.card + 1 : ℝ) * Q.card

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.sum_expand
statement:
lemma sum_expand (c : ℝ) (X : ℕ) (Q : Finset Nat.Primes) :
    (∑ q ∈ Q, (c * ((X : ℝ) / ((q : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 + 1)))
    = c * X * (∑ q ∈ Q, 1 / (((q : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)) + c * Q.card

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.union_card_bound
statement:
lemma union_card_bound (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (T : Finset ℕ) (hT : T ⊆ Finset.range b)
    (S : Finset Nat.Primes) (y : ℕ) (hy : ∀ p : Nat.Primes, (p : ℕ) ≤ y → p ∈ S) (hyb : y ≥ b) (
        X : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 X).filter fun N =>
      ∃ q : Nat.Primes, q ∉ S ∧ ((q : ℕ) ^ 2 ∣ N ∨ ∃ d ∈ T, (q : ℕ) ^ 2 ∣ b * N + d)).card
    ≤ ∑ q ∈ relevantNotInS b X S, (T.card + 1) * (X / (q : ℕ) ^ 2 + 1)

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.violation_count_bound
statement:
lemma violation_count_bound (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (T : Finset ℕ) (hT : T ⊆ Finset.range b)
    (S : Finset Nat.Primes) (y : ℕ) (hy : ∀ p : Nat.Primes, (p : ℕ) ≤ y → p ∈ S) (hyb : y ≥ b) (
        X : ℕ) :
    (((Finset.Icc 1 X).filter fun N =>
      ∃ q : Nat.Primes, q ∉ S ∧ ((q : ℕ) ^ 2 ∣ N ∨ ∃ d ∈ T, (q : ℕ) ^ 2 ∣ b * N + d)).card : ℝ)
    ≤ (T.card + 1 : ℝ) * X * (∑' (p : {q : Nat.Primes // (q : ℕ) > y}), 1 / (
        ((p : Nat.Primes) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)
      + (T.card + 1 : ℝ) * Nat.sqrt (b * X + b)

name: LeanPool.DeadEnds.violation_subset_biUnion
statement:
lemma violation_subset_biUnion (b : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (T : Finset ℕ) (hT : T ⊆ Finset.range b)
    (S : Finset Nat.Primes) (X : ℕ) :
    (Finset.Icc 1 X).filter (fun N => ∃ q : Nat.Primes, q ∉ S ∧ ((q : ℕ) ^ 2 ∣ N ∨ ∃ d ∈ T, (
        q : ℕ) ^ 2 ∣ b * N + d))
    ⊆ (relevantNotInS b X S).biUnion
        (fun q => (Finset.Icc 1 X).filter (fun N => (q : ℕ) ^ 2 ∣ N ∨ ∃ d ∈ T, (q : ℕ) ^ 2 ∣ b * N +
            d))
