name: Demazure.equiv_swap_mul_eq_comp
statement:
lemma equiv_swap_mul_eq_comp {a b c d k : Fin n} :
(Equiv.swap a b * Equiv.swap c d) k = (Equiv.swap a b ∘ Equiv.swap c d) k

name: Demazure.omg
statement:
@[simp]
lemma omg {i : ℕ} : i + 1 + 1 = i + 2

name: Demazure.renameEquiv_swap_ext
statement:
lemma renameEquiv_swap_ext {a b c d : Fin n} {R : Type} [CommSemiring R] :
    rename (Equiv.swap a b * Equiv.swap c d) =
      (rename (Equiv.swap a b ∘ Equiv.swap c d) :
        MvPolynomial (Fin n) R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)

name: Demazure.swap_variables_commutes_adjacent
statement:
lemma swap_variables_commutes_adjacent {i : Fin n} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ}
    (h0 : i < n + 1) (h1 : i + 1 < n + 1) (h2 : i + 2 < n + 1) :
    SwapVariablesFun ⟨i, h0⟩ ⟨i + 1, h1⟩
        (SwapVariablesFun ⟨i + 1, h1⟩ ⟨i + 2, h2⟩
          (SwapVariablesFun ⟨i, h0⟩ ⟨i + 1, h1⟩ p)) =
      SwapVariablesFun ⟨i + 1, h1⟩ ⟨i + 2, h2⟩
        (SwapVariablesFun ⟨i, h0⟩ ⟨i + 1, h1⟩
          (SwapVariablesFun ⟨i + 1, h1⟩ ⟨i + 2, h2⟩ p))

name: Demazure.swap_variables_commutes_non_adjacent
statement:
lemma swap_variables_commutes_non_adjacent (i j : Fin n) (h : NonAdjacent i j)
    {p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ} :
    SwapVariablesFun (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.succ i)
        (SwapVariablesFun (Fin.castSucc j) (Fin.succ j) p) =
      SwapVariablesFun (Fin.castSucc j) (Fin.succ j)
        (SwapVariablesFun (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.succ i) p)

name: Demazure.symm_invariant_swap_variables
Demazure.transposition_commutes_adjacent
statement:
lemma transposition_commutes_adjacent {i : Fin n} {j : Fin (n + 1)} (h0 : i < n + 1)
    (h1 : i + 1 < n + 1) (h2 : i + 2 < n + 1) :
    Equiv.swap ⟨i, h0⟩ ⟨i + 1, h1⟩
        (Equiv.swap ⟨i + 1, h1⟩ ⟨i + 2, h2⟩
          (Equiv.swap ⟨i, h0⟩ ⟨i + 1, h1⟩ j)) =
      Equiv.swap ⟨i + 1, h1⟩ ⟨i + 2, h2⟩
        (Equiv.swap ⟨i, h0⟩ ⟨i + 1, h1⟩
          (Equiv.swap ⟨i + 1, h1⟩ ⟨i + 2, h2⟩ j))

name: Demazure.transposition_commutes_adjacent'
statement:
lemma transposition_commutes_adjacent' {i : Fin n} (h0 : i < n + 1)
    (h1 : i + 1 < n + 1) (h2 : i + 2 < n + 1) :
    (Equiv.swap ⟨i, h0⟩ ⟨i + 1, h1⟩ ∘
          (Equiv.swap ⟨i + 1, h1⟩ ⟨i + 2, h2⟩) ∘
        (Equiv.swap ⟨i, h0⟩ ⟨i + 1, h1⟩) :
      Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) =
      Equiv.swap ⟨i + 1, h1⟩ ⟨i + 2, h2⟩ ∘
        (Equiv.swap ⟨i, h0⟩ ⟨i + 1, h1⟩) ∘
          (Equiv.swap ⟨i + 1, h1⟩ ⟨i + 2, h2⟩)

name: Demazure.transposition_commutes_non_adjacent
statement:
lemma transposition_commutes_non_adjacent (i j : Fin n) (h : NonAdjacent i j) :
  Equiv.swap (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.succ i) * Equiv.swap (Fin.castSucc j) (Fin.succ j) =
   Equiv.swap (Fin.castSucc j) (Fin.succ j) * Equiv.swap (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.succ i)

name: Demazure.transposition_commutes_non_adjacent'
statement:
lemma transposition_commutes_non_adjacent' (i j : Fin n) (h : NonAdjacent i j) :
  Equiv.swap (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.succ i) ∘ Equiv.swap (Fin.castSucc j) (Fin.succ j) =
   Equiv.swap (Fin.castSucc j) (Fin.succ j) ∘ Equiv.swap (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.succ i)

name: Demazure.demazure_commutes_adjacent
statement:
lemma demazure_commutes_adjacent (i : Fin n) (h : i + 1 < n) : ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ,
  (DemazureLinear i ∘ DemazureLinear ⟨i+1, h⟩ ∘ DemazureLinear i) p =
    (DemazureLinear ⟨i+1, h⟩ ∘ DemazureLinear i ∘ DemazureLinear ⟨i+1, h⟩) p

name: Demazure.demazure_commutes_non_adjacent
statement:
lemma demazure_commutes_non_adjacent (i j : Fin n) (h : NonAdjacent i j) :
    ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ,
      (DemazureLinear i ∘ DemazureLinear j) p = (DemazureLinear j ∘ DemazureLinear i) p

name: Demazure.demazure_mul_monomial_adjacent
statement:
lemma demazure_mul_monomial_adjacent (i : Fin n) (h : i + 1 < n) :
    ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ,
      (DemazureLinear i (p * X (Fin.castSucc i))) =
        (DemazureLinear i p) * (X (Fin.succ i)) + p

name: Demazure.demazure_mul_monomial_non_adjacent
statement:
lemma demazure_mul_monomial_non_adjacent (i j : Fin n) (h : NonAdjacent i j) :
    ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ,
      DemazureLinear i (p * X (Fin.castSucc j)) =
        (DemazureLinear i p) * (X (Fin.castSucc j))

name: Demazure.demazure_mul_symm
statement:
lemma demazure_mul_symm (i : Fin n) (g f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ)
    (h : MvPolynomial.IsSymmetric g) :
    DemazureLinear i (g*f) = g*(DemazureLinear i f)

name: Demazure.demazure_order_two
statement:
lemma demazure_order_two : ∀ (i : Fin n) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ),
  DemazureLinear i (DemazureLinear i p) = 0

name: CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord_reverse
statement:
lemma alternatingWord_reverse :
    (alternatingWord i j (2 * p)).reverse = alternatingWord j i (2 * p)

name: CoxeterSystem.eraseIdx_of_mul_leftInvSeq
statement:
lemma eraseIdx_of_mul_leftInvSeq (l : List B) (t : cs.Reflection) (h : t.1 ∈ cs.leftInvSeq l) :
  ∃ (k : Fin l.length), t.1 * π l = π (l.eraseIdx k)

name: CoxeterSystem.eta_eq_eta_of_simpleConj
statement:
lemma eta_eq_eta_of_simpleConj (i : B) (t : cs.Reflection) :
    cs.eta i t = cs.eta i (cs.conjOfReflection t (s i))

name: CoxeterSystem.gt_one_of_odd
statement: lemma gt_one_of_odd (n : ℕ) : Odd n → n > 0

name: CoxeterSystem.isInLeftInvSeq_of_parityReflectionOccurrences_eq_one
statement:
lemma isInLeftInvSeq_of_parityReflectionOccurrences_eq_one
    (l : List B) (t : cs.Reflection)
    (h : reflectionMemLeftInvSeqParity cs l t = 1) :
    t.1 ∈ cs.leftInvSeq l

name: CoxeterSystem.isLeftInversion_iff_parityReflectionOccurrences_eq_one
statement:
lemma isLeftInversion_iff_parityReflectionOccurrences_eq_one (l : List B) (t : cs.Reflection) :
  cs.IsLeftInversion (cs.wordProd l) t.1 ↔ reflectionMemLeftInvSeqParity cs l t = 1

name: CoxeterSystem.isLeftInversion_of_parityReflectionOccurrences_eq_one
statement:
lemma isLeftInversion_of_parityReflectionOccurrences_eq_one (l : List B) (t : cs.Reflection) :
  reflectionMemLeftInvSeqParity cs l t = 1 → cs.IsLeftInversion (cs.wordProd l) t.1

name: CoxeterSystem.isReflection_conj_inv_mul_mul
statement:
lemma isReflection_conj_inv_mul_mul (ht : cs.IsReflection t) (w : W) :
  cs.IsReflection (w⁻¹ * t * w)

name: CoxeterSystem.leftInvSeq_repeats
statement:
lemma leftInvSeq_repeats : ∀ (k : ℕ) (h : k < M i j),
    (cs.leftInvSeq (alternatingWord i j (2 * M i j)))[M i j + k]'(by
      simp
      linarith) =
    (cs.leftInvSeq (alternatingWord i j (2 * M i j)))[k]'(by
      simp
      linarith)

name: CoxeterSystem.leftInvSeq_repeats'
statement:
lemma leftInvSeq_repeats' : ∀ (k : ℕ) (h : k < M i j),
    (cs.leftInvSeq (alternatingWord i j (2 * M i j)))[M i j + k]'(by
      simp
      linarith) =
    (cs.leftInvSeq (alternatingWord i j (2 * M i j)))[k]'(by
      simp
      linarith)

name: CoxeterSystem.mulDef
statement: lemma mulDef (f g : cs.Reflection × ZMod 2 → cs.Reflection × ZMod 2) : f * g = f ∘ g

name: CoxeterSystem.nReflectionOccurrences_even_braidWord
statement:
lemma nReflectionOccurrences_even_braidWord (t : cs.Reflection) :
  Even (reflectionMemLeftInvSeqCount cs (alternatingWord i j (2 * M i j)) t)

name: CoxeterSystem.odd_iff_parity_eq_one
statement: lemma odd_iff_parity_eq_one (n : ℕ) : Odd n ↔ (n : ZMod 2) = 1

name: CoxeterSystem.parityReflectionOccurrences_braidWord
statement:
lemma parityReflectionOccurrences_braidWord (t : cs.Reflection) :
  reflectionMemLeftInvSeqParity cs (alternatingWord i j (2 * M i j)) t = 0

name: CoxeterSystem.parityReflectionOccurrences_ext
statement:
theorem parityReflectionOccurrences_ext (l l' : List B) (t : cs.Reflection) (h : π l = π l') :
  reflectionMemLeftInvSeqParity cs l t = reflectionMemLeftInvSeqParity cs l' t

name: CoxeterSystem.permutationMap_ext
statement:
theorem permutationMap_ext (l l' : List B) (t : cs.Reflection) (z : ZMod 2) (h : π l = π l') :
  permutationMapOfList cs l ⟨t,z⟩ = permutationMapOfList cs l' ⟨t,z⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.permutationMap_ofList_mk
statement:
lemma permutationMap_ofList_mk (l : List B) (t : cs.Reflection) (z : ZMod 2) :
  (permutationMapOfList cs l ⟨t,z⟩) = ⟨cs.conjOfReflection t (π l),
   z + reflectionMemLeftInvSeqParity cs l.reverse t⟩

name: CoxeterSystem.permutationMap_ofList_mk_1
statement:
lemma permutationMap_ofList_mk_1 (l : List B) :
  (permutationMapOfList cs l ⟨t,z⟩).1 = cs.conjOfReflection t (π l)

name: CoxeterSystem.permutationMap_ofList_mk_2
statement:
lemma permutationMap_ofList_mk_2 (l : List B) :
    (permutationMapOfList cs l ⟨t,z⟩).2 =
      z + reflectionMemLeftInvSeqParity cs l.reverse t

name: CoxeterSystem.permutationMap_orderTwo
statement: theorem permutationMap_orderTwo (i : B) : cs.permutationMap i ∘ cs.permutationMap i = id

name: CoxeterSystem.strongExchangeProperty
statement:
theorem strongExchangeProperty (l : List B) (t : cs.Reflection)
(h' : cs.IsLeftInversion (cs.wordProd l) t.1) :
  ∃ (k : Fin l.length), t.1 * π l = π (l.eraseIdx k)

name: CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord_succ_ne_alternatingWord_eraseIdx
statement:
theorem alternatingWord_succ_ne_alternatingWord_eraseIdx [MatsumotoCondition cs]
 (i j : B) (p : ℕ) (hp : p < M i j) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (_ : k < p),
      π (alternatingWord i j (p + 1)) ≠ π (alternatingWord i j p).eraseIdx k

name: CoxeterSystem.apply_braidMoveSequence_cons
statement:
lemma apply_braidMoveSequence_cons (bm : cs.BraidMove) (bms : List (cs.BraidMove))
    (l : List B) :
    cs.applyBraidMoveSequence (bm :: bms) l =
      cs.applyBraidMove bm (cs.applyBraidMoveSequence bms l)

name: CoxeterSystem.apply_braidMove_sequence_append
statement:
theorem apply_braidMove_sequence_append (bms bms' : List (cs.BraidMove)) (l : List B) :
    cs.applyBraidMoveSequence (bms ++ bms') l =
      cs.applyBraidMoveSequence bms (cs.applyBraidMoveSequence bms' l)

name: CoxeterSystem.braidMoveSequence_cons
statement:
lemma braidMoveSequence_cons (bms : List (cs.BraidMove)) (l : List B) (a : B) :
    a :: cs.applyBraidMoveSequence bms l =
      cs.applyBraidMoveSequence (List.map cs.shiftBraidMove bms) (a :: l)

name: CoxeterSystem.braidMove_cons
statement:
lemma braidMove_cons (bm : cs.BraidMove) (l : List B) (a : B) :
  a :: cs.applyBraidMove bm l = cs.applyBraidMove (cs.shiftBraidMove bm) (a :: l)

name: CoxeterSystem.braidMove_wordProd
statement:
theorem braidMove_wordProd (bm : cs.BraidMove) (l : List B) :
    π (cs.applyBraidMove bm l) = π l

name: CoxeterSystem.concatenate_braidMove_sequences
statement:
theorem concatenate_braidMove_sequences (l l' l'' : List B)
    (h : ∃ bms : List (cs.BraidMove), cs.applyBraidMoveSequence bms l = l')
    (h' : ∃ bms' : List (cs.BraidMove), cs.applyBraidMoveSequence bms' l' = l'') :
    ∃ bms'' : List (cs.BraidMove), cs.applyBraidMoveSequence bms'' l = l''

name: CoxeterSystem.cons_of_length_succ
statement:
lemma cons_of_length_succ {α : Type} (l : List α) {p : ℕ} (h : l.length = p + 1) :
  ∃ (a : α) (t : List α), l = a :: t ∧ t.length = p

name: CoxeterSystem.coxeterMove_wordProd
statement:
theorem coxeterMove_wordProd (cm : cs.CoxeterMove) (l : List B) :
    π (cs.applyCoxeterMove cm l) = π l

name: CoxeterSystem.eq_length_of_isReduced
statement:
theorem eq_length_of_isReduced (l l' : List B)
(h_eq : π l = π l') (hr : cs.IsReduced l) (hr' : cs.IsReduced l') :
    l.length = l'.length

name: CoxeterSystem.isReduced_cons
statement: theorem isReduced_cons (a : B) (l : List B) : cs.IsReduced (a :: l) → cs.IsReduced l

name: CoxeterSystem.isReduced_of_eq_length
statement:
theorem isReduced_of_eq_length (l l' : List B) (h_len : l.length = l'.length) (h_eq : π l = π l')
   (hr : cs.IsReduced l) : cs.IsReduced l'

name: CoxeterSystem.leftDescent_of_cons
statement:
lemma leftDescent_of_cons (i : B) (l : List B) (hr : cs.IsReduced (i :: l)) :
    cs.IsLeftDescent (π (i :: l)) i

name: CoxeterSystem.leftInversion_of_cons
statement:
lemma leftInversion_of_cons (i : B) (l : List B) (hr : cs.IsReduced (i :: l)) :
    cs.IsLeftInversion (π (i :: l)) (s i)

name: CoxeterSystem.matsumoto_reduced
statement:
theorem matsumoto_reduced [MatsumotoCondition cs] (l l' : List B)
(hr : cs.IsReduced l) (hr' : cs.IsReduced l') (h : π l = π l') :
  ∃ bms : List (cs.BraidMove), cs.applyBraidMoveSequence bms l = l'

name: CoxeterSystem.matsumoto_reduced_aux
statement:
theorem matsumoto_reduced_aux [MatsumotoCondition cs] (p : ℕ) (l l' : List B)
(len_l_eq_p : l.length = p) (len_l'_eq_p : l'.length = p)
(l_reduced : cs.IsReduced l) (l'_reduced : cs.IsReduced l') (h_eq : π l = π l') :
  ∃ bms : List (cs.BraidMove), cs.applyBraidMoveSequence bms l = l'

name: CoxeterSystem.matsumoto_reduced_inductionStep_of_firstLetterEq
statement:
lemma matsumoto_reduced_inductionStep_of_firstLetterEq (p : ℕ) (l_t l'_t : List B) (i : B)
    (len_l_t_eq_p : l_t.length = p) (len_l'_t_eq_p : l'_t.length = p)
    (h_eq : π(i :: l_t) = π(i :: l'_t))
    (l_reduced : cs.IsReduced (i :: l_t)) (l'_reduced : cs.IsReduced (i :: l'_t))
    (ih : ∀ (l l' : List B),
      l.length = p →
        l'.length = p →
          cs.IsReduced l →
            cs.IsReduced l' →
              cs.wordProd l = cs.wordProd l' →
                ∃ bms, cs.applyBraidMoveSequence bms l = l') :
    ∃ bms, cs.applyBraidMoveSequence bms (i :: l_t) = i :: l'_t

name: CoxeterSystem.nilMove_wordProd
statement: theorem nilMove_wordProd (nm : cs.NilMove) (l : List B) : π (cs.applyNilMove nm l) = π l

name: CoxeterSystem.prefix_braidWord
statement:
lemma prefix_braidWord [MatsumotoCondition cs] (l l' : List B) (i j : B)
    (i_ne_j : i ≠ j) (pi_eq : π(i :: l) = π(j :: l'))
    (hr : cs.IsReduced (i :: l)) (hr' : cs.IsReduced (j :: l')) :
    ∃ t : List B, π (i :: l) = π (braidWord M i j ++ t) ∧
      cs.IsReduced (braidWord M i j ++ t)

name: CoxeterSystem.prefix_braidWord_aux
statement:
lemma prefix_braidWord_aux [MatsumotoCondition cs] (w : W) (l l' : List B) (i j : B)
    (i_ne_j : i ≠ j) (hil : π(i :: l) = w) (hjl' : π(j :: l') = w)
    (hr : cs.IsReduced (i :: l)) (hr' : cs.IsReduced (j :: l')) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (_ : p ≤ M i j),
      ∃ t : List B, π (alternatingWord i j p ++ t) = w ∧
        cs.IsReduced (alternatingWord i j p ++ t)

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Valley.M_spec
statement: lemma M_spec : ∀ n : ℤ, v.f n ≥ v.f v.M ∧ (n > v.M → v.f n > v.f v.M)

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Valley.argmin_set_nonempty
statement: lemma argmin_set_nonempty : (v.floor v.min).Nonempty

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Valley.f_M
statement: lemma f_M : v.f v.M = v.min

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Valley.floor_image_nonempty
statement: lemma floor_image_nonempty (n : ℤ) : (Finset.image v.f <| v.floor (v.f n)).Nonempty

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Valley.mem_floor
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_floor (m n : ℤ) : n ∈ v.floor m ↔ v.f n ≤ m

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Valley.min_mem
statement: lemma min_mem : ∃ a ∈ {n | v.f n ≤ v.f 0}, v.f a = v.min

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Valley.min_spec
statement: lemma min_spec : ∀ n : ℤ, v.f n ≥ v.min

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Valley.shift_down_M
statement: lemma shift_down_M (k : ℤ) : (v.shiftDown k).M = v.M

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Valley.shift_down_min
statement: lemma shift_down_min (k : ℤ) : (v.shiftDown k).min = v.min - k

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SF_ext
statement: lemma SF_ext (s t : SlipFace) : s = t ↔ ∀ a b, s a b = t a b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.D_props_of_sf
statement: lemma D_props_of_sf (sf : SlipFace) : D_props sf.func ∧ D_props sf.dual.func

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.bend_set_finite
statement: lemma bend_set_finite (t : SlipFace) (b : ℤ) : Finite (bendSet t b)

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.bend_set_witness
statement:
lemma bend_set_witness (s t : SlipFace) (a b : ℤ) :
  ∃ l ∈ bendSet t b, (s ⋆ t) a b = s a l + t l b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.bend_set_witness_lres
statement:
lemma bend_set_witness_lres (s t : SlipFace) (a b : ℤ) :
    ∃ l ∈ bendSet t b, (s ◃ t) a b = s a l - t.dual b l

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.chi_lres
statement: @[simp] lemma chi_lres (s t : SlipFace) : (s ◃ t).χ = s.χ + t.χ

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.chi_rres
statement: @[simp] lemma chi_rres (s t : SlipFace) : (s ▹ t).χ = s.χ + t.χ

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.chi_star
statement: @[simp] lemma chi_star (s t : SlipFace) : (s ⋆ t).χ = s.χ + t.χ

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.dual_dual
statement: lemma dual_dual (s : SlipFace) : s.dual.dual = s

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.duality
statement: lemma duality (a b : ℤ) : sf a b - sf.dual b a = a - b + sf.χ

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.eq_iff_nonspecial
statement:
lemma eq_iff_nonspecial (a b : ℤ) : sf a b = max 0 (a - b + sf.χ)
  ↔ sf a b = 0 ∨ sf.dual b a = 0

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.ess_clifford
statement:
theorem ess_clifford (s t : SlipFace) (cliff : s.isClifford) :
  s ≤ t ↔ s.χ ≤ t.χ ∧ ∀ (a b : ℤ), (a, b) ∈ s.ess → s a b ≤ t a b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.ess_step
statement:
lemma ess_step (s t : SlipFace) (a b : ℤ) (wit : s a b > t a b) :
  ¬ (a, b) ∈ s.ess →
    ∃ (a' b' : ℤ), ⟨a', b'⟩ ∈ ({ (a-1,b), (a+1,b), (a,b-1), (a,b+1) } : Set (ℤ × ℤ) ) ∧
    s a' b' > t a' b' ∧ s a b + s.dual b a < s a' b' + s.dual b' a'

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.ge_max
statement: lemma ge_max (a b : ℤ) : sf a b ≥ max 0 (a - b + sf.χ)

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.ge_star_iff_ge_lres
statement:
lemma ge_star_iff_ge_lres (s t u : SlipFace) :
    s ≥ u ◃ t.dual ↔ s ⋆ t ≥ u

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.ge_star_iff_ge_rres
statement:
lemma ge_star_iff_ge_rres (s t u : SlipFace) :
    t ≥ s.dual ▹ u ↔ s ⋆ t ≥ u

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.ge_star_val_iff
statement:
lemma ge_star_val_iff (r s t : SlipFace) (a b : ℤ) :
  r a b ≥ (s ⋆ t) a b ↔ ∃ l, r a b ≥ s a l + t l b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.gt_iff_special
statement:
lemma gt_iff_special (a b : ℤ) : sf a b > max 0 (a - b + sf.χ)
  ↔ sf a b > 0 ∧ sf.dual b a > 0

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.id_mul
statement: lemma id_mul (s : SlipFace) : id ⋆ s = s

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.le_star_val_iff
statement:
lemma le_star_val_iff (r s t : SlipFace) (a b : ℤ) :
  r a b ≤ (s ⋆ t) a b ↔ ∀ l, r a b ≤ s a l + t l b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.lres_assoc
statement:
lemma lres_assoc (s t u : SlipFace) :
    (s ◃ t) ◃ u = s ◃ (t ⋆ u)

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.lres_dual
statement:
@[simp] lemma lres_dual (s t : SlipFace) :
    (s ◃ t).dual = t.dual ▹ s.dual

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.lres_eq_max
statement:
lemma lres_eq_max (s t : SlipFace) (a b : ℤ) :
    IsGreatest {s a l - t.dual b l | l : ℤ} ((s ◃ t) a b)

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.lres_func_eq
statement: lemma lres_func_eq (s t : SlipFace) : (s ◃ t).func = lresFunc s t

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.lres_func_nonneg
statement: lemma lres_func_nonneg (s t : SlipFace) (a b : ℤ) : 0 ≤ lresFunc s t a b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.lres_mono
LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.lres_val_ge
statement: lemma lres_val_ge (s t : SlipFace) (a b l : ℤ) : s a l - t.dual b l ≤ lresFunc s t a b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.lres_wit_exists
statement:
lemma lres_wit_exists (s t : SlipFace) (a b : ℤ) : ∃ m, ∀ l,
  s a l - t.dual b l ≤ s a m - t.dual b m

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.lres_wit_spec
statement:
lemma lres_wit_spec (s t : SlipFace) (a b : ℤ) :
    (s ◃ t) a b = s a (lresWit s t a b) - t.dual b (lresWit s t a b)

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.mono_a_of_D_props
statement:
lemma mono_a_of_D_props (f : ℤ → ℤ → ℤ) (h : D_props f) :
    ∀ a a' b, a ≤ a' → f a' b ≥ f a b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.mono_b_of_D_props
statement:
lemma mono_b_of_D_props (f : ℤ → ℤ → ℤ) (h : D_props f) :
    ∀ a b b', b ≤ b' → f a b' ≤ f a b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.mul_id
statement: lemma mul_id (s : SlipFace) : s ⋆ id = s

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.nondec
statement: lemma nondec {a a' b b' : ℤ} (a_le_a' : a ≤ a') (b'_le_b : b' ≤ b) : sf a b ≤ sf a' b'

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.rres_assoc
statement:
lemma rres_assoc (s t u : SlipFace) :
    s ▹ (t ▹ u) = (s ⋆ t) ▹ u

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.rres_dual
statement:
@[simp] lemma rres_dual (s t : SlipFace) :
    (s ▹ t).dual = t.dual ◃ s.dual

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.rres_eq_max
statement:
lemma rres_eq_max (s t : SlipFace) (a b : ℤ) :
    IsGreatest {t l b - s.dual l a | l : ℤ} ((s ▹ t) a b)

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.rres_func_eq
statement: lemma rres_func_eq (s t : SlipFace) : (s ▹ t).func = rresFunc s t

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.rres_func_nonneg
statement: lemma rres_func_nonneg (s t : SlipFace) (a b : ℤ) : 0 ≤ rresFunc s t a b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.rres_mono
LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.rres_val_ge
statement: lemma rres_val_ge (s t : SlipFace) (a b l : ℤ) : t l b - s.dual l a ≤ rresFunc s t a b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.rres_wit_spec
statement:
lemma rres_wit_spec (s t : SlipFace) (a b : ℤ) :
    (s ▹ t) a b = t (rresWit s t a b) b - s.dual (rresWit s t a b) a

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.s'_eq
statement: lemma s'_eq (b a : ℤ) : sf.dual b a = sf a b - a + b - sf.χ

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.s_eq
statement: lemma s_eq (a b : ℤ) : sf a b = a - b + sf.χ + sf.dual b a

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.sf_of_D_props
statement:
lemma sf_of_D_props {s t : ℤ → ℤ → ℤ} {χ : ℤ}
    (h : ∀ a b, s a b - t b a = a - b + χ) :
  D_props s ∧ D_props t →
  ∃ sf : SlipFace, (sf.func = s ∧ sf.χ = χ) ∧ sf.dual.func = t

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.star_assoc
statement: lemma star_assoc (r s t : SlipFace) : r ⋆ s ⋆ t = r ⋆ (s ⋆ t)

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.star_dual
statement: @[simp] lemma star_dual (s t : SlipFace) : (s ⋆ t).dual = t.dual ⋆ s.dual

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.star_dual_eq
statement:
lemma star_dual_eq (s t : SlipFace) (a b : ℤ) :
  starFunc s t a b - starFunc t.dual s.dual b a = a - b + s.χ + t.χ

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.star_dual_ineq
statement:
lemma star_dual_ineq (s t : SlipFace) (a b : ℤ) :
  starFunc t.dual s.dual b a ≤ starFunc s t a b - a + b - s.χ - t.χ

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.star_eq_min
statement:
lemma star_eq_min (s t : SlipFace) (a b : ℤ) :
  IsLeast { s a l + t l b | l : ℤ } ( (s ⋆ t) a b )

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.star_func_eq
statement: lemma star_func_eq (s t : SlipFace) : (s ⋆ t).func = starFunc s t

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.star_mono
LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.star_val_le
statement: lemma star_val_le (s t : SlipFace) (a b l : ℤ) : (s ⋆ t) a b ≤ s a l + t l b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.star_wit_spec
statement:
lemma star_wit_spec (s t : SlipFace) (a b : ℤ) :
  (s ⋆ t) a b = s a (starWit s t a b) + t (starWit s t a b) b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.zero_below
statement:
lemma zero_below {a a' b b' : ℤ} (a_le_a' : a ≤ a') (b'_le_b : b' ≤ b) :
  sf a' b' = 0 → sf a b = 0

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.Γ_dual
statement: lemma Γ_dual : ∀ (a b : ℤ), (a, b) ∈ sf.Γ ↔ (b, a) ∈ sf.dual.Γ

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.Δ_dual
statement: lemma Δ_dual (a b : ℤ) : sf.dual.Δ b a = sf.Δ a b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.Δ_values
statement: lemma Δ_values (a b : ℤ) : sf.Δ a b = 0 ∨ sf.Δ a b = 1 ∨ sf.Δ a b = -1

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.SlipFace.Δ_zero_of_s_zero
statement: lemma Δ_zero_of_s_zero (a b : ℤ) (h0 : sf (a + 1) b = 0) : sf.Δ a b = 0

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Utils.card_filter_helper
statement:
lemma card_filter_helper (S : Finset ℤ) (f : ℤ → ℤ) (c : ℤ) :
  (S.filter (f · ≥ c)).card + (S.filter (f · < c)).card = S.card

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Utils.min_helper
statement:
lemma min_helper {m n : ℤ} (m_pos : m ≥ 1) (n_pos : n ≥ 1)
    {S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)} (mem : ⟨m, n⟩ ∈ S) (nmem : ⟨1, 1⟩ ∉ S) :
  ∃ m' n', m' ≥ 1 ∧ n' ≥ 1 ∧ ⟨m', n'⟩ ∈ S
  ∧ ( ⟨m'-1,n'⟩ ∉ S ∧ m' ≥ 2 ∨ ⟨m', n'-1⟩ ∉ S ∧ n' ≥ 2)

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Utils.oneIf_congr
statement:
lemma oneIf_congr {P Q : Prop} (h : P ↔ Q) :
    oneIf P = oneIf Q

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Utils.sub_card_eq_sub_card_diff
statement:
lemma sub_card_eq_sub_card_diff (S T : Finset ℤ) :
  (↑S.card : ℤ) - ↑T.card = ↑(S \ T).card - ↑(T \ S).card

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Utils.sum_oneIf_mem_of_subset
statement:
lemma sum_oneIf_mem_of_subset {ι : Type*} {A U : Finset ι} (hAU : A ⊆ U) :
    (∑ k ∈ U, oneIf (k ∈ A)) = (A.card : ℤ)

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.Delta_eq
statement: lemma Delta_eq (a b : ℤ) : τ.s.Δ a b = if τ b = a then 1 else 0

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.M''_eq_M
statement: lemma M''_eq_M : τ.M'' = τ.M

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.M'_eq_M
statement: lemma M'_eq_M : τ.M' = τ.M

statement: lemma a_step_eq_iff' (u b : ℤ) : τ.s (τ u + 1) b = τ.s (τ u) b ↔ u < b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.a_step_one_iff'
statement: lemma a_step_one_iff' (u b : ℤ) : τ.s (τ u + 1) b = τ.s (τ u) b + 1 ↔ u ≥ b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.b_step
statement:
lemma b_step (a b : ℤ) :
    τ.s a (b + 1) = τ.s a b - (if τ b < a then 1 else 0)

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.b_step_eq_iff
statement: lemma b_step_eq_iff (a b : ℤ) : τ.s a (b+1) = τ.s a b ↔ a ≤ τ b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.b_step_ge_iff
statement: lemma b_step_ge_iff (a b : ℤ) : τ.s a (b + 1) ≥ τ.s a b ↔ a ≤ τ b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.b_step_lt_iff
statement: lemma b_step_lt_iff (a b : ℤ) : τ.s a (b + 1) < τ.s a b ↔ τ b < a

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.b_step_one_iff
statement: lemma b_step_one_iff (a b : ℤ) : τ.s a (b+1) = τ.s a b - 1 ↔ τ b < a

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.bdiff_iff_clifford
statement: theorem bdiff_iff_clifford : τ.isBdiff ↔ τ.s.isClifford

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.bdiff_iff_width
statement: theorem bdiff_iff_width : τ.isBdiff ↔ ∃ N, τ.widthBound N

statement:
lemma chi_eq_of_drop_eq {τ α β : AspPerm} (h_eq : τ.eqDprod α β) :

statement:
lemma chi_ge_of_dprod_ge {α β τ : AspPerm} (h_ge : τ.leDprod α β) :

statement:
lemma chi_le_of_dprod_le {α β τ : AspPerm} (h_le : τ.geDprod α β) :

theorem eq_of_inv_set_eq_of_chi_eq (σ τ : AspPerm)

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.ess_asp_eq_ess_sf
statement: lemma ess_asp_eq_ess_sf (τ : AspPerm) : τ.ess = τ.s.ess

statement: @[simp] lemma id_chi : AspPerm.id.χ = 0

statement: lemma inset_finite (v : ℤ) : (τ.inset v).Finite

statement:
lemma inv_iff_le {i j : ℤ} (i_lt_j : i < j) :

statement:
lemma inv_iff_lt {i j : ℤ} (i_le_j : i ≤ j) :

statement:

statement:

lemma inv_set_id : invSet AspPerm.id = ∅

statement:
lemma mem_ramp_iff_s_ge (b m n : ℤ) :

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.outset_finite
statement: lemma outset_finite (u : ℤ) : (τ.outset u).Finite

statement:
lemma ramp_closed (b : ℤ) {m₁ n₁ m₂ n₂ : ℤ} (hm : m₁ ≤ m₂) (hn : n₁ ≤ n₂) :
  ⟨m₂, n₂⟩ ∈ τ.ramp b → ⟨m₁, n₁⟩ ∈ τ.ramp b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.reconstruction
statement:
theorem reconstruction : ∀ n : ℤ,
  τ n = n - τ.χ + (τ.outset n).ncard - (τ.inset n).ncard

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.s_chi_eq
statement: @[simp] lemma s_chi_eq : τ.s.χ = τ.χ

statement: lemma s_ge (a b : ℤ) : τ.s a b ≥ a - b + τ.χ

statement:
lemma s_nondec {a a' : ℤ} (a_le_a' : a ≤ a') (b : ℤ) :
    τ.s a b ≤ τ.s a' b ∧
      (τ.s a b = τ.s a' b ↔ ∀ x : ℤ, a ≤ τ x → τ x < a' → x < b)

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.s_noninc
statement:
lemma s_noninc (a : ℤ) {b b' : ℤ} (b_le_b' : b ≤ b') :
    τ.s a b ≥ τ.s a b' ∧
      (τ.s a b = τ.s a b' ↔ ∀ x : ℤ, b ≤ x → x < b' → τ x ≥ a)

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.s_nonneg
statement: lemma s_nonneg (a b : ℤ) : τ.s a b ≥ 0

statement:
lemma s_τv_b (b : ℤ) {m : ℤ} (m_pos : m > 0) :

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.se_finite
statement: lemma se_finite (a b : ℤ) : (southeastSet τ a b).Finite

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.tend_zero_b
statement: lemma tend_zero_b (a : ℤ) : ∃ b : ℤ, τ.s a b = 0

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.u_lt
statement: lemma u_lt (b : ℤ) {n : ℤ} (n_pos : n > 0) : τ.u b n_pos < b

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.v_crit
statement:
lemma v_crit (b : ℤ) {m : ℤ} (m_pos : m > 0) (v : ℤ) :
  v = τ.v b m_pos ↔ τ.s (τ v) b = m - 1 ∧ b ≤ v

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.v_ge
statement: lemma v_ge (b : ℤ) {m : ℤ} (m_pos : m > 0) : b ≤ τ.v b m_pos

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.Γ_eq
statement: lemma Γ_eq : τ.s.Γ = { ⟨a, b⟩ | τ b = a }

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspPerm.τv_lt
statement:
lemma τv_lt (b : ℤ) {m : ℤ} (m_pos : m > 0)

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.se_finite_of_asp
statement:
lemma se_finite_of_asp {τ : ℤ → ℤ} (h_inj : Function.Injective τ) (m n : ℤ) :

@[simp] lemma AspPerm_equiv_AspSet_toFun_fst (τ : AspPerm) :

statement:
@[simp] lemma AspPerm_equiv_AspSet_toFun_snd (τ : AspPerm) :

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspSet.finiteOutdegree
statement:
theorem finiteOutdegree (asps : AspSet) :
    ∀ u : ℤ, { v : ℤ | ⟨u, v⟩ ∈ asps }.Finite

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.AspSet.inv_set_AspPerm_equiv_AspSet_invFun

@[simp] lemma inv_set_AspPerm_equiv_AspSet_invFun (asps : AspSet) (χ : ℤ) :

lemma mem_inset (asps : AspSet) (n x : ℤ) :

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Reduction.reduceList
statement:
theorem reduceList :
    ∀ (αs : List AspPerm) (γ : AspPerm),
      (αs.map AspPerm.χ).sum = γ.χ →
      DProd αs ≥ γ →
      ∃ βs : List AspPerm,
        List.Forall₂ (fun α β => β ≤χ α) αs βs ∧
        DProd βs = γ ∧ OrdProd βs = γ
  | [], γ, hχ, h => by
      -- Proof written by Claude Opus 4.7.
      -- Base case: γ ≤ id and γ.χ = 0, hence γ = id.
      simp only [List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, DProd_nil] at hχ h
      have hγ : γ = AspPerm.id := eq_id_of_le_id_chi_zero h hχ.symm
      simp_all
  | (α :: αs), γ, hχ, h => by
      -- Proof written by Claude Opus 4.7.
      -- Inductive step: apply `reduce` to split off `α` from the suffix.
      have hsuff : α.χ + (DProd αs).χ = γ.χ := by
        rw [AspPerm.chi_DProd]
        simpa [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons] using hχ
      have h' : α ⋆ DProd αs ≥ γ := by
        simpa only [DProd_cons] using h
      obtain ⟨α₁, π, hα₁, hπ, h_star, h_mul⟩

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Tableaux.LSet_of_LPerm_of_Chain
statement:
lemma LSet_of_LPerm_of_Chain :
  ∀ (C : List (Set (ℤ × ℤ) × ℤ)) (hC : isChain C) (htfas : set_321a_prop (boxUnion C)),
    lSetOfLPerm (lPermOfChain C hC htfas) = C
  | [], _, _ => by
      simp only [lPermOfChain, lSetOfLPerm]
  | ⟨A, χ⟩ :: Q, hC, htfas => by
      let L := linkOfSets hC.1 htfas χ (chiSum Q)
      have htfasQ : set_321a_prop (boxUnion Q) := by
        change set_321a_prop L.B
        exact L.B_set_321a_prop
      have ih := LSet_of_LPerm_of_Chain Q hC.2 htfasQ
      have hβ : DProd (lPermOfChain Q hC.2 htfasQ) = L.β := by
        let asps : AspSet := ⟨boxUnion Q, htfasQ.asp⟩
        apply AspPerm.eq_of_inv_set_eq_of_chi_eq
        · rw [DProd_LPerm_of_Chain Q hC.2 htfasQ]
          rw [L.inv_set_β]
          change invSet ((asps.toAspPerm (chiSum Q)).func) = boxUnion Q
          exact asps.invSet_of_toAspPerm (chiSum Q)
        · rw [DProd_LPerm_of_Chain Q hC.2 htfasQ]
          rw [L.chi_beta]
          change (asps.toAspPerm (chiSum Q)).χ = chiSum Q
          exact asps.chi_of_toAspPerm (chiSum Q)
      have hτ : DProd (L.α :: lPermOfChain Q hC.2 htfasQ) = L.τ := by
        simpa [DProd_cons, hβ] using L.dprod
      have hA : (DProd (L.α :: lPermOfChain Q hC.2 htfasQ)).sr L.α '' invSet L.α = A := by
        have hsr :
            (DProd (L.α :: lPermOfChain Q hC.2 htfasQ)).sr L.α '' invSet L.α
              = L.τ.sr L.α '' invSet L.α := by
          simpa using congrArg (fun t => t.sr L.α '' invSet L.α) hτ
        calc
          (DProd (L.α :: lPermOfChain Q hC.2 htfasQ)).sr L.α '' invSet L.α
              = L.τ.sr L.α '' invSet L.α

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Transpositions.asp_residual_sigma_sf
statement:
theorem asp_residual_sigma_sf (S : Set ℤ) (hS : NoConsecutive S)
    (α : AspPerm) (a b : ℤ) :
    (α.s ◃ (sigma S hS).s) a b =
      α.s a b - Utils.oneIf (b - 1 ∈ S ∧ α b < a ∧ a ≤ α (b - 1))

theorem asp_star_sigma_sf (S : Set ℤ) (hS : NoConsecutive S) (α : AspPerm) (a b : ℤ) :
    (α.s ⋆ (sigma S hS).s) a b =
      α.s a b + Utils.oneIf (b - 1 ∈ S ∧ α (b - 1) < a ∧ a ≤ α b)

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Transpositions.sf_lres_sigma
statement:
theorem sf_lres_sigma (S : Set ℤ) (hS : NoConsecutive S)
    (s : SlipFace) (a b : ℤ) :
    (s ◃ (sigma S hS).s) a b =
        s a b
          - Utils.oneIf (b - 1 ∈ S ∧ s a (b - 1) = s a b ∧ s a b > s a (b + 1))

name: LeanPool.DemazureProduct.Transpositions.sf_star_sigma
statement:
theorem sf_star_sigma (S : Set ℤ) (hS : NoConsecutive S) (s : SlipFace) (a b : ℤ) :
    (s ⋆ (sigma S hS).s) a b =
        s a b
          + Utils.oneIf (b - 1 ∈ S ∧ s a (b - 1) > s a b ∧ s a b = s a (b + 1))

statement:
lemma frac_add_frac (v w : M^ℕ) (m : M.LargeIdeal ^ v) (n : M.LargeIdeal ^ w) :
    (m/.v) + (n/.w) =
    (⟨(m : A') * M.elem ^ w + (n : A') * M.elem ^ v, Ideal.add_mem _
      (Ideal.mem_familyPow_add m.2 (Ideal.mem_familyPow_of_mem fun i _ ↦ elem_mem_LargeIdeal M i))
      (add_comm v w ▸
        Ideal.mem_familyPow_add n.2 (Ideal.mem_familyPow_of_mem fun i _ ↦ elem_mem_LargeIdeal
          M i))⟩) /. (v + w)

name: SplitProperties.firstPart_of_firstPart
statement:
lemma firstPart_of_firstPart (γ : Dipath x₀ x₁) {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k < n) (hk : 0 < k) :
    FirstPart
      (FirstPart γ (Fraction (lt_trans hk hkn) (le_of_lt hkn)))
        (Fraction.ofPos hk) -- 1/k
    = (FirstPart γ (Fraction.ofPos <| lt_trans hk hkn)).cast rfl
      (show γ _ = γ _ by { congr 1; rw [←Fraction.mul_inv hk (le_of_lt hkn)]; rfl })

statement:
lemma firstPart_range_interval (γ : Dipath x₀ x₁) {n : ℕ} (h : 0 < n) :
    range (FirstPart γ (Fraction.ofPos h)) = γ ''  Icc 0 (Fraction.ofPos h)

name: SplitProperties.firstPart_range_interval_partial
statement:
lemma firstPart_range_interval_partial (γ : Dipath x₀ x₁) {n d i : ℕ} (hd : d.succ < n.succ)
    (hi : i < d.succ) :
  (FirstPart γ (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n) (le_of_lt hd))) '' Icc -- First part at (d + 1)/(n + 1)
    (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos d) (le_of_lt hi)) -- frac i/(d+1)
    (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos d) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)) -- frac (i+1)/(d+1)
    = γ ''  Icc
    (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n) (le_of_lt (lt_trans hi hd))) -- frac i/(n+1)
    (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (lt_trans hi hd))) -- frac (i+1)/(n+1)

name: SplitProperties.first_part_of_second_part
statement:
lemma first_part_of_second_part (γ : Dipath x₀ x₁) {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k < n) (hk : 0 < k) :
  SecondPart
    (FirstPart γ (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n) (le_of_lt <| Nat.succ_lt_succ hkn))) -- (k+1)/(n+1)
    (Fraction.ofPos (Nat.succ_pos k)) -- 1/(k+1)
  =
  (FirstPart
      (SecondPart γ (Fraction.ofPos (Nat.succ_pos n))) -- 1/(n+1)
      (Fraction (lt_trans hk hkn) (le_of_lt hkn)) -- k/n
  ).cast
    (show γ _ = γ _ by
      congr 1
      apply Subtype.coe_inj.mp
      rw [←Fraction.mul_inv (Nat.succ_pos k) (le_of_lt (Nat.succ_lt_succ hkn))]
      rfl)
    (show γ _ = γ _ by
      congr 1
      rw [← Subtype.coe_inj]
      simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, unitInterval.coe_symm_eq, zero_add, Nat.cast_one,
        Nat.cast_add, one_div]
      have : (n : ℝ) > 0 := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (lt_trans hk hkn)
      rw [← one_div, FractionEqualities.one_sub_inverse_of_add_one,
        FractionEqualities.frac_cancel', ← add_div]
      · linarith
      linarith)

name: SplitProperties.first_part_trans
statement:
lemma first_part_trans (γ₁ : Dipath x₀ x₁) (γ₂ : Dipath x₁ x₂) :
    (FirstPart (γ₁.trans γ₂) (Fraction.ofPos two_pos)) =
      γ₁.cast rfl (Dipath.trans_eval_at_half γ₁ γ₂)

name: SplitProperties.interval_cast
statement:
lemma interval_cast {γ : Dipath x₀ x₁} {A : Set X} {a b a' b' : I} (h_im : A = γ '' Icc a b)
      (ha : a' = a) (hb : b' = b) :
    A = γ '' Icc a' b'

name: SplitProperties.secondPart_cast
statement:
lemma secondPart_cast {x₀' x₁' : X} (γ : Dipath x₀ x₁) (hx₀ : x₀' = x₀) (hx₁ : x₁' = x₁) (T : I) :
  (SecondPart (γ.cast hx₀ hx₁) T) = (SecondPart γ T).cast rfl hx₁

name: SplitProperties.secondPart_eq_of_point_eq
statement:
lemma secondPart_eq_of_point_eq (γ : Dipath x₀ x₁) {T T' : I} (h : T = T') (t : I) :
  (SecondPart γ T) t = (SecondPart γ T') t

name: SplitProperties.secondPart_eq_of_split_point_eq
statement:
lemma secondPart_eq_of_split_point_eq (γ : Dipath x₀ x₁) {T T' : I} (hT : T = T') :
  (SecondPart γ T) = (SecondPart γ T').cast (congr_arg γ hT) rfl

name: SplitProperties.secondPart_image
statement:
lemma secondPart_image (γ : Dipath x₀ x₁) (T a b : I) (h_ab : a ≤ b) :
    (SecondPart γ T) '' Icc a b = γ '' Icc
      ⟨σ T * a + T, interp_left_mem_I T a⟩
      ⟨σ T * b + T, interp_left_mem_I T b⟩

name: SplitProperties.secondPart_range
statement:
lemma secondPart_range (γ : Dipath x₀ x₁) (T : I) :
    range (SecondPart γ T) = γ '' Icc T 1

name: SplitProperties.secondPart_range_interval
statement:
lemma secondPart_range_interval (γ : Dipath x₀ x₁) {i n : ℕ} (hi : i < n) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (SecondPart γ (Fraction.ofPos (Nat.succ_pos n))) '' Icc
      (Fraction hn (le_of_lt hi)) (Fraction hn (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)) =
    γ ''  Icc (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n) (show i+1 ≤ n+1 by exact (le_of_lt (Nat.succ_lt_succ hi))))
              (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n)
                (show i+2 ≤ n+1 by exact Nat.succ_lt_succ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)))

name: SplitProperties.secondPart_range_partial_interval
statement:
lemma secondPart_range_partial_interval (γ : Dipath x₀ x₁) {i d n : ℕ} (hd : d.succ < n.succ)
    (hi : i < n - d) :
    (SecondPart γ (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n) (le_of_lt hd))) '' Icc
      (Fraction (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hd)) (le_of_lt hi)) -- i/(n-d)
      (Fraction (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hd)) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi))
          -- (i+1)/(n-d)
      =
    γ ''  Icc
      (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n) (show i+d.succ ≤ n.succ by
        apply le_of_lt
        have : i < n.succ - d.succ := (Nat.succ_sub_succ n d).symm ▸ hi
        exact lt_tsub_iff_right.mp this
      )) -- (i+d+1)/(n+1)
      (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n) (show i+d.succ + 1 ≤ n.succ by
        apply Nat.succ_le_of_lt
        have : i < n.succ - d.succ := (Nat.succ_sub_succ n d).symm ▸ hi
        exact lt_tsub_iff_right.mp this
      )) -- (i+d+2)/(n+1)

name: SplitProperties.second_part_of_second_part
statement:
lemma second_part_of_second_part (γ : Dipath x₀ x₁) {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k < n) :
  SecondPart
    (SecondPart γ (Fraction.ofPos (Nat.succ_pos n.succ))) -- 1/(n+2)
    (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n) (le_of_lt <| Nat.succ_lt_succ hkn)) -- (k+1)/(n+1)
  =
  (
    SecondPart γ (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n.succ)
      (le_of_lt <| Nat.succ_lt_succ (Nat.succ_lt_succ hkn))) -- (k+2)/(n+2)
  ).cast
    (show γ _ = γ _ by
      congr 1
      rw [← Subtype.coe_inj]
      simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, unitInterval.coe_symm_eq, zero_add, Nat.cast_one,
        Nat.cast_add, one_div]
      have : (n : ℝ) + 1 > 0 := by
        rw [←Nat.cast_succ]
        exact Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos n)
      rw [←one_div, FractionEqualities.one_sub_inverse_of_add_one,
        FractionEqualities.frac_cancel', ← add_div]
      · linarith
      · linarith
    )
    rfl

name: SplitProperties.second_part_trans
statement:
lemma second_part_trans (γ₁ : Dipath x₀ x₁) (γ₂ : Dipath x₁ x₂) :
    (SecondPart (γ₁.trans γ₂) (Fraction.ofPos two_pos)) =
    γ₂.cast (Dipath.trans_eval_at_half γ₁ γ₂) rfl

name: SplitProperties.second_part_trans_eval_at_end
statement:
lemma second_part_trans_eval_at_end (γ₁ : Dipath x₀ x₁) (γ₂ : Dipath x₁ x₂) (n : ℕ) :
    (SecondPart (γ₁.trans γ₂) <| Fraction.ofPos <| Nat.succ_pos (n.succ + n.succ).succ)
    (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos (n+n).succ.succ) (le_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self _)))
    = γ₂ (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos (n.succ)) (le_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self _)))

name: SplitProperties.trans_first_part
statement:
lemma trans_first_part (γ₁ : Dipath x₀ x₁) (γ₂ : Dipath x₁ x₂) (n : ℕ) (t : I) :
    (FirstPart (γ₁.trans γ₂) (Fraction.ofPos (Nat.succ_pos (n + n).succ))) t =
      (FirstPart γ₁ (Fraction.ofPos (Nat.succ_pos n))) t

name: SplitProperties.trans_first_part_of_second_part
statement:
lemma trans_first_part_of_second_part (γ₁ : Dipath x₀ x₁) (γ₂ : Dipath x₁ x₂) (n : ℕ) (t : I) :
  (FirstPart
    (SecondPart (γ₁.trans γ₂) (Fraction.ofPos <| Nat.succ_pos (n.succ + n.succ).succ))
    (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos (n + n).succ.succ) (le_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self ((n + n).succ.succ))))
   ) t
  =
  ((SecondPart γ₁ (Fraction.ofPos (Nat.succ_pos n.succ)))).trans
   (FirstPart γ₂ (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n.succ) (Nat.le_succ n.succ))) t

name: SplitProperties.trans_image_inv_eq_first
statement:
lemma trans_image_inv_eq_first (γ₁ : Dipath x₀ x₁) (γ₂ : Dipath x₁ x₂) (n : ℕ) :
    (γ₁.trans γ₂) (Fraction.ofPos (Nat.succ_pos (n + n).succ)) =
      γ₁ (Fraction.ofPos (Nat.succ_pos n))

name: SplitProperties.trans_second_part_second_part
statement:
lemma trans_second_part_second_part (γ₁ : Dipath x₀ x₁) (γ₂ : Dipath x₁ x₂) (n : ℕ) (t : I) :
  (SecondPart
    (SecondPart (γ₁.trans γ₂) <| Fraction.ofPos <| Nat.succ_pos (n.succ + n.succ).succ)
    (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos (n + n).succ.succ) (Nat.le_succ (n + n).succ.succ))
   ) t
  =
    (SecondPart γ₂ (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n.succ) (Nat.le_succ n.succ))) t

statement:

Dipath.coveredPartwise.has_interval_division
statement:
lemma has_interval_division {X₁ X₂ : Set X} (hX : X₁ ∪ X₂ = Set.univ) (X₁_open : IsOpen X₁)
  (X₂_open : IsOpen X₂) (γ : Dipath x₀ x₁) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ), (n > 0) ∧ ∀ (i : ℕ) (_ : i < n),
      Set.Icc ((i :ℝ)/(n :ℝ)) ((i+1 :ℝ)/(n :ℝ)) ⊆ γ.extend ⁻¹' X₁ ∨
      Set.Icc ((i :ℝ)/(n :ℝ)) ((i+1 :ℝ)/(n :ℝ)) ⊆ γ.extend ⁻¹' X₂

lemma directedFst_apply (T t : I) : DirectedFst T t = ⟨_, unitInterval.mul_mem T.2 t.2⟩

    (hi : i < m.succ) :

name: DirectedMap.Dihomotopy.spv_aux₁
statement:
lemma spv_aux₁ {t : I} {n i : ℕ} (hi : i < n.succ)
    (ht : Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n) (le_of_lt hi) ≤ t) :
  Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n.succ) (le_of_lt (Nat.succ_lt_succ hi)) ≤
    (⟨_, interp_left_mem_I
      (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n.succ) (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n.succ))) t⟩ : I)

name: DirectedMap.Dihomotopy.spv_aux₁_coed
statement:
lemma spv_aux₁_coed {t : ℝ} {n i : ℕ} (_ : i < n.succ) (ht : (i : ℝ) / (n.succ : ℝ) ≤ t) :
    (i+1 : ℝ) / (n+2 : ℝ) ≤ (1 - 1/(n+1+1)) * t + (1/(n+1+1))

name: DirectedMap.Dihomotopy.spv_aux₂
statement:
lemma spv_aux₂ {t : I} {n i : ℕ} (hi : i < n.succ)
    (ht : t ≤ Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)) :
    (⟨_, interp_left_mem_I
      (Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n.succ) (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n.succ))) t⟩ : I) ≤
      Fraction (Nat.succ_pos n.succ) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.succ_lt_succ hi))

name: DirectedMap.Dihomotopy.spv_aux₂_coed
statement:
lemma spv_aux₂_coed {t : ℝ} {n i : ℕ} (_ : i < n.succ) (_ : 0 ≤ t)

name: DirectedMap.Dihomotopy.hcomp'_apply
statement:
lemma hcomp'_apply (F : Dihomotopy p₀.toDirectedMap q₀.toDirectedMap)
    (G : Dihomotopy p₁.toDirectedMap q₁.toDirectedMap)
  (h : (F.evalAtRight 1).toDirectedMap = (G.evalAtRight 0).toDirectedMap) (t₁ t₂ : I) :
    (hcomp' F G h) (t₁, t₂) =
    if h : (t₂ : ℝ) ≤ 1/2 then
      F.evalAtLeft t₁ ⟨2 * t₂, (unitInterval.mul_pos_mem_iff two_pos).2 ⟨t₂.2.1, h⟩⟩
    else
      G.evalAtLeft t₁ ⟨2 * t₂ - 1,
        unitInterval.two_mul_sub_one_mem_iff.2 ⟨(not_le.1 h).le, t₂.2.2⟩⟩

theorem le_sSup (X : Set V.Element) (hX : V.Bounded X) {x : V.Element} (hx : x ∈ X) :
    x ≤ V.sSup X hX

name: Domain.Neighborhood.NeighborhoodSystem.sSup_le
statement:
theorem sSup_le (X : Set V.Element) (hX : V.Bounded X) {z : V.Element}
    (hz : ∀ x ∈ X, x ≤ z) : V.sSup X hX ≤ z

name: Domain.Neighborhood.NeighborhoodSystem.upperBounds_nonempty
statement:
theorem upperBounds_nonempty {X : Set V.Element} (hX : V.Bounded X) :
    (V.upperBounds X).Nonempty

name: Domain.Neighborhood.ApproximableMap.rel_master
statement:
theorem ApproximableMap.rel_master (f : ApproximableMap V₀ V₁) {X : Set α} (hX : V₀.mem X) :
    f.rel X V₁.master

name: Domain.Neighborhood.ApproximableMap₂.ext
statement:
theorem ApproximableMap₂.ext {f g : ApproximableMap₂ V₀ V₁ V₂}
    (h : ∀ X Y Z, f.rel X Y Z ↔ g.rel X Y Z) : f = g

name: Domain.Neighborhood.constMap_rel
statement:
@[simp] theorem constMap_rel {b : V₁.Element} {X : Set α} {Y : Set β} :
    (constMap V₀ b).rel X Y ↔ V₀.mem X ∧ b.mem Y

name: Domain.Neighborhood.fst_pair
statement: @[simp] theorem fst_pair (x : V₀.Element) (y : V₁.Element) : (pair x y).fst = x

name: Domain.Neighborhood.inl_preimage_prodNbhd
statement:
@[simp] theorem inl_preimage_prodNbhd (X : Set α) (Y : Set β) :
    Sum.inl ⁻¹' prodNbhd X Y = X

name: Domain.Neighborhood.inr_preimage_prodNbhd
statement:
@[simp] theorem inr_preimage_prodNbhd (X : Set α) (Y : Set β) :
    Sum.inr ⁻¹' prodNbhd X Y = Y

name: Domain.Neighborhood.mem_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_fst {z : (prod V₀ V₁).Element} {X : Set α} :
    z.fst.mem X ↔ V₀.mem X ∧ z.mem (prodNbhd X V₁.master)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.mem_pair
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_pair {x : V₀.Element} {y : V₁.Element} {W : Set (α ⊕ β)} :
    (pair x y).mem W ↔ ∃ X Y, x.mem X ∧ y.mem Y ∧ W = prodNbhd X Y

name: Domain.Neighborhood.mem_pair_prodNbhd
statement:
theorem mem_pair_prodNbhd {x : V₀.Element} {y : V₁.Element} {X : Set α} {Y : Set β} :
    (pair x y).mem (prodNbhd X Y) ↔ x.mem X ∧ y.mem Y

name: Domain.Neighborhood.mem_prodNbhd_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_prodNbhd_inl {X : Set α} {Y : Set β} {a : α} :
    (Sum.inl a : α ⊕ β) ∈ prodNbhd X Y ↔ a ∈ X

name: Domain.Neighborhood.mem_prodNbhd_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_prodNbhd_inr {X : Set α} {Y : Set β} {b : β} :
    (Sum.inr b : α ⊕ β) ∈ prodNbhd X Y ↔ b ∈ Y

name: Domain.Neighborhood.mem_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_snd {z : (prod V₀ V₁).Element} {Y : Set β} :
    z.snd.mem Y ↔ V₁.mem Y ∧ z.mem (prodNbhd V₀.master Y)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.ofMap₂_toMap₂
statement: theorem ofMap₂_toMap₂ (f : ApproximableMap (prod V₀ V₁) V₂) : ofMap₂ (toMap₂ f) = f

name: Domain.Neighborhood.pair_fst_snd
statement: theorem pair_fst_snd (z : (prod V₀ V₁).Element) : pair z.fst z.snd = z

name: Domain.Neighborhood.pair_le_pair_iff
statement:
theorem pair_le_pair_iff {x x' : V₀.Element} {y y' : V₁.Element} :
    pair x y ≤ pair x' y' ↔ x ≤ x' ∧ y ≤ y'

name: Domain.Neighborhood.paired_proj
statement:
theorem paired_proj (h : ApproximableMap V₂ (prod V₀ V₁)) :
    paired ((proj₀ V₀ V₁).comp h) ((proj₁ V₀ V₁).comp h) = h

name: Domain.Neighborhood.paired_rel
statement:
@[simp] theorem paired_rel {f : ApproximableMap V₂ V₀} {g : ApproximableMap V₂ V₁}
    {Z : Set γ} {P : Set (α ⊕ β)} :
    (paired f g).rel Z P ↔
      (prod V₀ V₁).mem P ∧ f.rel Z (Sum.inl ⁻¹' P) ∧ g.rel Z (Sum.inr ⁻¹' P)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.prodEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem prodEquiv_apply (z : (prod V₀ V₁).Element) :
    prodEquiv V₀ V₁ z = (z.fst, z.snd)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.prodEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem prodEquiv_symm_apply (p : V₀.Element × V₁.Element) :
    (prodEquiv V₀ V₁).symm p = pair p.1 p.2

name: Domain.Neighborhood.prodNbhd_injective
statement:
theorem prodNbhd_injective {X X' : Set α} {Y Y' : Set β}
    (h : prodNbhd X Y = prodNbhd X' Y') : X = X' ∧ Y = Y'

name: Domain.Neighborhood.prodNbhd_inter
statement:
theorem prodNbhd_inter (X X' : Set α) (Y Y' : Set β) :
    prodNbhd X Y ∩ prodNbhd X' Y' = prodNbhd (X ∩ X') (Y ∩ Y')

name: Domain.Neighborhood.prodNbhd_preimage
statement:
theorem prodNbhd_preimage {W : Set (α ⊕ β)} (hW : (prod V₀ V₁).mem W) :
    W = prodNbhd (Sum.inl ⁻¹' W) (Sum.inr ⁻¹' W)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.prodNbhd_subset_iff
statement:
theorem prodNbhd_subset_iff {X X' : Set α} {Y Y' : Set β} :
    prodNbhd X Y ⊆ prodNbhd X' Y' ↔ X ⊆ X' ∧ Y ⊆ Y'

name: Domain.Neighborhood.prod_master
statement: @[simp] theorem prod_master : (prod V₀ V₁).master = prodNbhd V₀.master V₁.master

name: Domain.Neighborhood.prod_mem_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem prod_mem_iff {W : Set (α ⊕ β)} :
    (prod V₀ V₁).mem W ↔ ∃ X Y, V₀.mem X ∧ V₁.mem Y ∧ W = prodNbhd X Y

name: Domain.Neighborhood.prod_mem_prodNbhd
statement:
theorem prod_mem_prodNbhd {X : Set α} {Y : Set β} (hX : V₀.mem X) (hY : V₁.mem Y) :
    (prod V₀ V₁).mem (prodNbhd X Y)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.prod_mem_prodNbhd_iff
statement:
theorem prod_mem_prodNbhd_iff {X : Set α} {Y : Set β} :
    (prod V₀ V₁).mem (prodNbhd X Y) ↔ V₀.mem X ∧ V₁.mem Y

name: Domain.Neighborhood.prod_mem_split
Domain.Neighborhood.proj₀_comp_paired
statement:
theorem proj₀_comp_paired (f : ApproximableMap V₂ V₀) (g : ApproximableMap V₂ V₁) :
    (proj₀ V₀ V₁).comp (paired f g) = f

name: Domain.Neighborhood.proj₀_rel
statement:
@[simp] theorem proj₀_rel {W : Set (α ⊕ β)} {X' : Set α} :
    (proj₀ V₀ V₁).rel W X' ↔ (prod V₀ V₁).mem W ∧ V₀.mem X' ∧ Sum.inl ⁻¹' W ⊆ X'

name: Domain.Neighborhood.proj₁_comp_paired
statement:
theorem proj₁_comp_paired (f : ApproximableMap V₂ V₀) (g : ApproximableMap V₂ V₁) :
    (proj₁ V₀ V₁).comp (paired f g) = g

name: Domain.Neighborhood.proj₁_rel
statement:
@[simp] theorem proj₁_rel {W : Set (α ⊕ β)} {Y' : Set β} :
    (proj₁ V₀ V₁).rel W Y' ↔ (prod V₀ V₁).mem W ∧ V₁.mem Y' ∧ Sum.inr ⁻¹' W ⊆ Y'

name: Domain.Neighborhood.snd_pair
statement: @[simp] theorem snd_pair (x : V₀.Element) (y : V₁.Element) : (pair x y).snd = y

name: Domain.Neighborhood.substitution_toElementMap
statement:
theorem substitution_toElementMap (F : ApproximableMap (prod V₀ V₁) V₂)
    (a : ApproximableMap V₃ V₀) (b : ApproximableMap V₃ V₁) (w : V₃.Element) :
    (F.comp (paired a b)).toElementMap w
      = (toMap₂ F).toElementMap₂ (a.toElementMap w) (b.toElementMap w)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.toElementMap_constMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem toElementMap_constMap (b : V₁.Element) (x : V₀.Element) :
    (constMap V₀ b).toElementMap x = b

name: Domain.Neighborhood.toElementMap_paired
statement:
theorem toElementMap_paired (f : ApproximableMap V₂ V₀) (g : ApproximableMap V₂ V₁)
    (w : V₂.Element) :
    (paired f g).toElementMap w = pair (f.toElementMap w) (g.toElementMap w)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.toElementMap_proj₀
statement:
@[simp] theorem toElementMap_proj₀ (z : (prod V₀ V₁).Element) :
    (proj₀ V₀ V₁).toElementMap z = z.fst

name: Domain.Neighborhood.toElementMap_proj₁
statement:
@[simp] theorem toElementMap_proj₁ (z : (prod V₀ V₁).Element) :
    (proj₁ V₀ V₁).toElementMap z = z.snd

name: Domain.Neighborhood.toElementMap₂_toMap₂
statement:
theorem toElementMap₂_toMap₂ (f : ApproximableMap (prod V₀ V₁) V₂) (x : V₀.Element)
    (y : V₁.Element) :
    (toMap₂ f).toElementMap₂ x y = f.toElementMap (pair x y)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.toMap₂_ofMap₂
statement: theorem toMap₂_ofMap₂ (f : ApproximableMap₂ V₀ V₁ V₂) : toMap₂ (ofMap₂ f) = f

name: Domain.Neighborhood.ApproximableMap.le_iff
statement:
theorem ApproximableMap.le_iff {f g : ApproximableMap V₀ V₁} :
    f ≤ g ↔ ∀ X Y, f.rel X Y → g.rel X Y

name: Domain.Neighborhood.curry_eval_comp
statement:
theorem curry_eval_comp (h : ApproximableMap V₀ (funSpace V₁ V₂)) :
    curry ((evalMap V₁ V₂).comp (paired (h.comp (proj₀ V₀ V₁)) (proj₁ V₀ V₁))) = h

name: Domain.Neighborhood.curry_rel
Domain.Neighborhood.curry_uncurry
statement: theorem curry_uncurry (h : ApproximableMap V₀ (funSpace V₁ V₂)) : curry (uncurry h) = h

name: Domain.Neighborhood.evalMap_apply
statement:
theorem evalMap_apply (φ : (funSpace V₁ V₂).Element) (x : V₁.Element) :
    (evalMap V₁ V₂).toElementMap (pair φ x) = (toApproxMap φ).toElementMap x

name: Domain.Neighborhood.eval_comp_curry
statement:
theorem eval_comp_curry (g : ApproximableMap (prod V₀ V₁) V₂) :
    (evalMap V₁ V₂).comp (paired ((curry g).comp (proj₀ V₀ V₁)) (proj₁ V₀ V₁)) = g

name: Domain.Neighborhood.funSpaceEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem funSpaceEquiv_apply (φ : (funSpace V₀ V₁).Element) :
    funSpaceEquiv V₀ V₁ φ = toApproxMap φ

name: Domain.Neighborhood.funSpaceEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem funSpaceEquiv_symm_apply (f : ApproximableMap V₀ V₁) :
    (funSpaceEquiv V₀ V₁).symm f = toFilter f

name: Domain.Neighborhood.funSpace_master
statement: @[simp] theorem funSpace_master : (funSpace V₀ V₁).master = Set.univ

name: Domain.Neighborhood.funSpace_mem_iff
statement:
theorem funSpace_mem_iff {W : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)} :
    (funSpace V₀ V₁).mem W ↔
      (∃ L : List (Set α × Set β), (∀ p ∈ L, V₀.mem p.1 ∧ V₁.mem p.2) ∧ W = stepFun L)
        ∧ W.Nonempty

name: Domain.Neighborhood.funSpace_mem_inter
Domain.Neighborhood.funSpace_mem_up_closed
statement:
theorem funSpace_mem_up_closed {W : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)} (hW : (funSpace V₀ V₁).mem W)
    {f f' : ApproximableMap V₀ V₁} (hf : f ∈ W) (hff' : f ≤ f') : f' ∈ W

name: Domain.Neighborhood.gSection_le
statement:
theorem gSection_le {g : ApproximableMap (prod V₀ V₁) V₂} {X X' : Set α}
    (hX : V₀.mem X) (hX' : V₀.mem X') (hX'X : X' ⊆ X) : gSection g hX ≤ gSection g hX'

name: Domain.Neighborhood.gSection_rel
statement:
@[simp] theorem gSection_rel {g : ApproximableMap (prod V₀ V₁) V₂} {X : Set α} (hX : V₀.mem X)
    {Y : Set β} {Z : Set γ} : (gSection g hX).rel Y Z ↔ g.rel (prodNbhd X Y) Z

name: Domain.Neighborhood.interYs_antitone
statement:
theorem interYs_antitone {m : Set β} {L : List (Set α × Set β)} {X X' : Set α} (h : X' ⊆ X) :
    interYs m L X' ⊆ interYs m L X

name: Domain.Neighborhood.interYs_cons
statement:
theorem interYs_cons (m : Set β) (p : Set α × Set β) (L : List (Set α × Set β)) (X : Set α) :
    interYs m (p :: L) X = {z | X ⊆ p.1 → z ∈ p.2} ∩ interYs m L X

name: Domain.Neighborhood.interYs_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem interYs_nil (m : Set β) (X : Set α) : interYs m [] X = m

name: Domain.Neighborhood.interYs_subset_master
statement:
theorem interYs_subset_master {m : Set β} {L : List (Set α × Set β)} {X : Set α} :
    interYs m L X ⊆ m

name: Domain.Neighborhood.interYs_subset_of_mem
statement:
theorem interYs_subset_of_mem {m : Set β} {L : List (Set α × Set β)} {p : Set α × Set β}
    (hp : p ∈ L) : interYs m L p.1 ⊆ p.2

name: Domain.Neighborhood.le_iff_toElementMap_le
statement:
theorem le_iff_toElementMap_le {f g : ApproximableMap V₀ V₁} :
    f ≤ g ↔ ∀ x, f.toElementMap x ≤ g.toElementMap x

name: Domain.Neighborhood.le_sSupMaps
statement:
theorem le_sSupMaps {F : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)} (hF : PointwiseBounded F)
    {f : ApproximableMap V₀ V₁} (hf : f ∈ F) : f ≤ sSupMaps F hF

name: Domain.Neighborhood.leastMap_le
Domain.Neighborhood.leastMap_mem_stepFun
statement:
theorem leastMap_mem_stepFun {L : List (Set α × Set β)} (hL : ∀ p ∈ L, V₀.mem p.1 ∧ V₁.mem p.2)
    (hcons : ∀ {X}, V₀.mem X → V₁.mem (interYs V₁.master L X)) :
      leastMap L hcons ∈ stepFun L

name: Domain.Neighborhood.leastMap_rel
Domain.Neighborhood.mapsBounded_iff_pointwiseBounded
statement:
theorem mapsBounded_iff_pointwiseBounded {F : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)} :
    MapsBounded F ↔ PointwiseBounded F

name: Domain.Neighborhood.mapsBounded_principal
statement:
theorem mapsBounded_principal {F : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)} (hF : PointwiseBounded F)
    {X : Set α} (hX : V₀.mem X) :
    V₁.Bounded (Set.image (fun f => f.toElementMap (V₀.principal hX)) F)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.mapsBounded_to_filters
statement:
theorem mapsBounded_to_filters {F : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)} (h : MapsBounded F) :
    (funSpace V₀ V₁).Bounded (Set.image toFilter F)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.mem_interYs
statement:
theorem mem_interYs {m : Set β} {L : List (Set α × Set β)} {X : Set α} {z : β} :
    z ∈ interYs m L X ↔ z ∈ m ∧ ∀ p ∈ L, X ⊆ p.1 → z ∈ p.2

name: Domain.Neighborhood.mem_step
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_step {X : Set α} {Y : Set β} {f : ApproximableMap V₀ V₁} :
    f ∈ step X Y ↔ f.rel X Y

name: Domain.Neighborhood.mem_stepFun
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_stepFun {L : List (Set α × Set β)} {f : ApproximableMap V₀ V₁} :
    f ∈ stepFun L ↔ ∀ p ∈ L, f.rel p.1 p.2

name: Domain.Neighborhood.mem_stepFun_iff
Domain.Neighborhood.mem_toFilter
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_toFilter {f : ApproximableMap V₀ V₁} {W : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)} :
    (toFilter f).mem W ↔ (funSpace V₀ V₁).mem W ∧ f ∈ W

name: Domain.Neighborhood.prod_mem_inl
statement: theorem prod_mem_inl {W : Set (α ⊕ β)} (hW : (prod V₀ V₁).mem W) : V₀.mem (Sum.inl ⁻¹' W)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.prod_mem_inr
statement: theorem prod_mem_inr {W : Set (α ⊕ β)} (hW : (prod V₀ V₁).mem W) : V₁.mem (Sum.inr ⁻¹' W)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.rel_interYs
statement:
theorem rel_interYs {L : List (Set α × Set β)} {f : ApproximableMap V₀ V₁} (hf : f ∈ stepFun L)
    {X : Set α} (hX : V₀.mem X) : f.rel X (interYs V₁.master L X)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.rel_stepFun_iff
statement:
theorem rel_stepFun_iff (h : ApproximableMap V₀ (funSpace V₁ V₂)) {X : Set α} (hX : V₀.mem X)
    {L : List (Set β × Set γ)} (hL : ∀ p ∈ L, V₁.mem p.1 ∧ V₂.mem p.2) :
    h.rel X (stepFun L) ↔ ∀ p ∈ L, h.rel X (step p.1 p.2)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.sSupMaps_le
statement:
theorem sSupMaps_le {F : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)} (hF : PointwiseBounded F)
    {h : ApproximableMap V₀ V₁} (hh : ∀ f ∈ F, f ≤ h) : sSupMaps F hF ≤ h

name: Domain.Neighborhood.stepFun_append
statement:
theorem stepFun_append (L L' : List (Set α × Set β)) :
    (stepFun (L ++ L') : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)) = stepFun L ∩ stepFun L'

name: Domain.Neighborhood.stepFun_cons
statement:
theorem stepFun_cons (p : Set α × Set β) (L : List (Set α × Set β)) :
    (stepFun (p :: L) : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)) = step p.1 p.2 ∩ stepFun L

name: Domain.Neighborhood.stepFun_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem stepFun_nil : (stepFun [] : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)) = Set.univ

name: Domain.Neighborhood.stepFun_singleton
statement:
theorem stepFun_singleton (X : Set α) (Y : Set β) :
    (stepFun [(X, Y)] : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)) = step X Y

name: Domain.Neighborhood.stepFun_subset_step_iff
statement:
theorem stepFun_subset_step_iff {L : List (Set α × Set β)} (hL : ∀ p ∈ L, V₀.mem p.1 ∧ V₁.mem p.2)
    (hcons : ∀ {X}, V₀.mem X → V₁.mem (interYs V₁.master L X)) {X : Set α} {Y : Set β}
    (hX : V₀.mem X) (hY : V₁.mem Y) :
    (stepFun L : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)) ⊆ step X Y ↔ interYs V₁.master L X ⊆ Y

name: Domain.Neighborhood.stepFun_up_closed
statement:
theorem stepFun_up_closed {L : List (Set α × Set β)} {f f' : ApproximableMap V₀ V₁}
    (hf : f ∈ stepFun L) (hff' : f ≤ f') : f' ∈ stepFun L

name: Domain.Neighborhood.step_inter_right
statement:
theorem step_inter_right {X : Set α} {Y Y' : Set β} (hY : V₁.mem Y) (hY' : V₁.mem Y') :
    (step X Y ∩ step X Y' : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)) = step X (Y ∩ Y')

name: Domain.Neighborhood.step_master_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem step_master_eq : (step V₀.master V₁.master : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)) =
  Set.univ

name: Domain.Neighborhood.step_mem
statement:
theorem step_mem {X : Set α} {Y : Set β} (hX : V₀.mem X) (hY : V₁.mem Y) :
    (funSpace V₀ V₁).mem (step X Y)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.step_subset
statement:
theorem step_subset {X X' : Set α} {Y Y' : Set β} (hX' : V₀.mem X') (hY' : V₁.mem Y')
    (hX'X : X' ⊆ X) (hYY' : Y ⊆ Y') : (step X Y : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)) ⊆ step X' Y'

name: Domain.Neighborhood.supOnPrincipal_mono
statement:
theorem supOnPrincipal_mono (F : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)) (hF : PointwiseBounded F)
    (X X' : Set α) (hX : V₀.mem X) (hX' : V₀.mem X') (hX'X : X' ⊆ X) :
    supOnPrincipal F hF X hX ≤ supOnPrincipal F hF X' hX'

name: Domain.Neighborhood.toApproxMap_rel
statement:
@[simp] theorem toApproxMap_rel {φ : (funSpace V₀ V₁).Element} {X : Set α} {Y : Set β} :
    (toApproxMap φ).rel X Y ↔ φ.mem (step X Y)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.toElementMap_curry_apply
statement:
theorem toElementMap_curry_apply (g : ApproximableMap (prod V₀ V₁) V₂)
    (x : V₀.Element) (y : V₁.Element) :
    (toApproxMap ((curry g).toElementMap x)).toElementMap y = g.toElementMap (pair x y)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.toElementMap_sSupMaps
statement:
theorem toElementMap_sSupMaps {F : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)} (hF : PointwiseBounded F)
    (x : V₀.Element) :
    (sSupMaps F hF).toElementMap x =
      V₁.sSup (Set.image (fun f => f.toElementMap x) F) (hF x)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.toElementMap_sSupMaps'
statement:
theorem toElementMap_sSupMaps' {F : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)} (hF : MapsBounded F)
    (x : V₀.Element) :
    (sSupMaps F (mapsBounded_iff_pointwiseBounded.mp hF)).toElementMap x =
      V₁.sSup (Set.image (fun f => f.toElementMap x) F)
        (mapsBounded_iff_pointwiseBounded.mp hF x)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.toElementMap_sSupMaps_principal
statement:
theorem toElementMap_sSupMaps_principal {F : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)} (hF : PointwiseBounded F)
    {X : Set α} (hX : V₀.mem X) :
    (sSupMaps F hF).toElementMap (V₀.principal hX) = supOnPrincipal F hF X hX

name: Domain.Neighborhood.toElementMap₂_eval
statement:
theorem toElementMap₂_eval (φ : (funSpace V₁ V₂).Element) (x : V₁.Element) :
    (eval V₁ V₂).toElementMap₂ φ x = (toApproxMap φ).toElementMap x

name: Domain.Neighborhood.toFilter_le_iff
statement: theorem toFilter_le_iff {f g : ApproximableMap V₀ V₁} : toFilter f ≤ toFilter g ↔ f ≤ g

name: Domain.Neighborhood.uncurry_curry
statement: theorem uncurry_curry (g : ApproximableMap (prod V₀ V₁) V₂) : uncurry (curry g) = g

name: Domain.Neighborhood.uncurry_eq
statement:
theorem uncurry_eq (h : ApproximableMap V₀ (funSpace V₁ V₂)) :
    uncurry h = (evalMap V₁ V₂).comp (paired (h.comp (proj₀ V₀ V₁)) (proj₁ V₀ V₁))

name: Domain.Neighborhood.uncurry_rel
statement:
@[simp] theorem uncurry_rel {h : ApproximableMap V₀ (funSpace V₁ V₂)}
    {W : Set (α ⊕ β)} {Z : Set γ} :
    (uncurry h).rel W Z ↔
      (prod V₀ V₁).mem W ∧ h.rel (Sum.inl ⁻¹' W) (step (Sum.inr ⁻¹' W) Z)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise510.isStrict_smashSection
statement:
theorem isStrict_smashSection {g : ApproximableMap (smash V₀ V₁) V₂} (hg : IsStrict g)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise510.mem_smashPair
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_smashPair {x : V₀.Element} {y : V₁.Element} {W : Set (α ⊕ β)} :
    (smashPair x y).mem W ↔ W = prodNbhd V₀.master V₁.master ∨
      ∃ X Y, x.mem X ∧ X ≠ V₀.master ∧ y.mem Y ∧ Y ≠ V₁.master ∧ W = prodNbhd X Y

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise510.mem_sstep
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_sstep {X : Set α} {Y : Set β} {f : StrictMap V₀ V₁} :
    f ∈ sstep X Y ↔ f.1.rel X Y

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise510.mem_sstepFun
statement:

    f ∈ sstepFun L ↔ ∀ p ∈ L, f.1.rel p.1 p.2

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise510.mem_sstepFun_iff
Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise510.mem_toStrictFilter
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_toStrictFilter {f : StrictMap V₀ V₁} {W : Set (StrictMap V₀ V₁)} :

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise510.principal_master_eq_bot
statement:
theorem principal_master_eq_bot {X : Set α} (hX : V₀.mem X) (hXm : X = V₀.master) :

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise510.rel_sstepFun_iff
statement:
theorem rel_sstepFun_iff (h : ApproximableMap V₀ (strictFun V₁ V₂)) {X : Set α} (hX : V₀.mem X)
    {L : List (Set β × Set γ)} (hL : ∀ p ∈ L, V₁.mem p.1 ∧ V₂.mem p.2) :
    h.rel X (sstepFun L) ↔ ∀ p ∈ L, h.rel X (sstep p.1 p.2)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise510.section_uncurry_rel
statement:
theorem section_uncurry_rel (h : StrictMap V₀ (strictFun V₁ V₂))

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise510.smashPair_principal_apply
statement:
theorem smashPair_principal_apply (g : ApproximableMap (smash V₀ V₁) V₂)

    (hY : V₁.mem Y) (hYne : Y ≠ V₁.master) {Z : Set γ} :
    (g.toElementMap (smashPair (V₀.principal hX) (V₁.principal hY))).mem Z

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise510.smashSection_mono
Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise510.smashSection_rel
statement:
theorem smashSection_rel {g : ApproximableMap (smash V₀ V₁) V₂} {X : Set α} (hX : V₀.mem X)

    (smashSection g hX).rel Y Z ↔

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise510.smash_mem_proper

name: Domain.Recursive.amGM
statement:
theorem amGM : ∀ {a b : ℕ}, 4 * a * b ≤ (a + b) * (a + b)
  | 0, _ => by rw [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_mul]; exact Nat.zero_le _
  | _, 0 => by rw [Nat.mul_zero]; exact Nat.zero_le _
  | a + 1, b + 1 => by
    simpa only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul, show (4 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 from rfl, Nat.one_mul,
      Nat.mul_one, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_le_add_iff_left]
      using Nat.add_le_add_right (@amGM a b) 4

name: Domain.Recursive.decodeList_encodeList
statement:
theorem decodeList_encodeList : ∀ l : List ℕ, decodeList (encodeList l) = l
  | [] => by rw [encodeList, decodeList_zero]
  | a :: l => by
    rw [encodeList, decodeList_succ, unpair_pair_fst, unpair_pair_snd, decodeList_encodeList l]

name: Domain.Recursive.decodeList_foldl_mapPairStp
statement:
theorem decodeList_foldl_mapPairStp (n : ℕ) (el : List ℕ) (acc : ℕ) :
    decodeList (List.foldl (fun acc x => mapPairStp (Nat.pair x (Nat.pair acc n))) acc el)
      = (el.map (Nat.pair n ·)).reverse ++ decodeList acc

theorem decodeList_mapPairStep (n acc x : ℕ) :

name: Domain.Recursive.decodeList_succ

theorem decodeList_succ (c : ℕ) :

  | [] => Nat.le_refl 0
  | a :: l => by
    simp only [encodeList, List.length_cons]
    have hrec

name: Domain.Recursive.foldCode_eq
statement:
theorem foldCode_eq (stp : ℕ → ℕ) (params z : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) :

theorem foldCode_eq' (stp : ℕ → ℕ) (params z c : ℕ) :

      ((foldStep stp params)^[k] (Nat.pair (encodeList l) acc)).unpair.2
        = List.foldl (fun acc x => stp (Nat.pair x (Nat.pair acc params))) acc l

name: Domain.Recursive.foldStep_pos

theorem foldStep_pos (stp : ℕ → ℕ) (params a t acc : ℕ) :

name: Domain.Recursive.lt_iter_succ_sq

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Example62A.slot_list_inj
statement:
theorem slot_list_inj : ∀ (j j' : ℕ) (u v : Str),
    List.replicate j true ++ false :: u = List.replicate j' true ++ false :: v → j = j' ∧ u = v
  | 0, 0, u, v, h => by simpa using h
  | 0, j' + 1, u, v, h => by simp [List.replicate_succ] at h
  | j + 1, 0, u, v, h => by simp [List.replicate_succ] at h
  | j + 1, j' + 1, u, v, h => by
      rw [List.replicate_succ, List.cons_append, List.replicate_succ, List.cons_append,
        List.cons.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨hj, hu⟩

name: Domain.Neighborhood.mem_fiber

name: Domain.Neighborhood.ofSeq_component

name: Domain.Neighborhood.ofSeq_mono

theorem leastStep_rel {Y : Set α} {Z : Set β} (hY : V₀.mem Y) (hZ : V₁.mem Z)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.stepCons
statement:

name: Domain.Neighborhood.step_eq_iff
statement:
theorem step_eq_iff {Y : Set α} {Z : Set β} (hY : V₀.mem Y) (hZ : V₁.mem Z)

    (step Y Z : Set (ApproximableMap V₀ V₁)) = step Y' Z' ↔
      (Z = V₁.master ∧ Z' = V₁.master) ∨ (Y = Y' ∧ Z = Z')

name: Domain.Neighborhood.copair_rel
statement:
@[simp] theorem copair_rel {a : ApproximableMap V₀ V₂} {b : ApproximableMap V₁ V₂}

      g.toElementMap (F W g) = F W g)
    (huniform : ∀ {β γ : Type u} (W₀ : NeighborhoodSystem β) (W₁ : NeighborhoodSystem γ)
      (g₀ : ApproximableMap W₀ W₀) (g₁ : ApproximableMap W₁ W₁) (h : ApproximableMap W₀ W₁),
      h.toElementMap W₀.bot = W₁.bot →
      (∀ x, h.toElementMap (g₀.toElementMap x) = g₁.toElementMap (h.toElementMap x)) →

theorem mergeVal_SLe : ∀ (σ : Str) (b₀ : Bool) (σ' : Str) (b₀' : Bool)
    (τ : Str) (b₁ : Bool) (τ' : Str) (b₁' : Bool),
    SLe b₀ σ b₀' σ' → SLe b₁ τ b₁' τ' →
    SLe (mergeVal σ b₀ τ b₁).2 (mergeVal σ b₀ τ b₁).1
      (mergeVal σ' b₀' τ' b₁').2 (mergeVal σ' b₀' τ' b₁').1
  | [], b₀, σ', b₀', τ, b₁, τ', b₁', h0, _ => by
    cases b₀ with
    | true =>
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise516.shape_injective
statement:
theorem shape_injective : ∀ {b b' : Bool} {σ σ' : Str}, shape b σ = shape b' σ' → b = b' ∧ σ = σ'
  | true, true, σ, σ', h => ⟨rfl, by rwa [shape, shape, Set.singleton_eq_singleton_iff] at h⟩
  | true, false, σ, σ', h => absurd h.symm (cone_ne_singleton σ' σ)
  | false, true, σ, σ', h => absurd h (cone_ne_singleton σ σ')
  | false, false, σ, σ', h => ⟨rfl, cone_injective h⟩

statement:
theorem genKey (g : ApproximableMap (Cn A) B.carrier.sys) (a : A) (w : (Cn A).Element) :

        g).toElementMap (toCC ((consMapN a).toElementMap w)))

        g).toElementMap (toCC (strElemN ([] : Strn A))))
      = descE B

    (hsing : ∀ {σ τ : Strn A}, σ <+: τ → coneVal σ ≤ singVal τ) (σ : Strn A) :

theorem sumMapSig_comp (g : ApproximableMap V₁ V₂) (f : ApproximableMap V₀ V₁) :

      = (sumMapSig (A := A) (h₀ := h₁) (h₁ := h₂) g).comp
          (sumMapSig (A := A) (h₀ := h₀) (h₁ := h₁) f)

statement:
theorem sumMapSig_id :
    sumMapSig (A := A) (V₀ := V₀) (V₁ := V₀) (h₀ := h₀) (h₁ := h₀) (idMap V₀)
      = idMap (sumSig A V₀ h₀)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise617Gen.sumMapSig_rel
statement:
@[simp] theorem sumMapSig_rel {f : ApproximableMap V₀ V₁} {W W'} :
    (sumMapSig (A := A) (h₀ := h₀) (h₁ := h₁) f).rel W W' ↔
      (sumSig A V₀ h₀).mem W ∧ (sumSig A V₁ h₁).mem W' ∧
        (W' = masterSig V₁ ∨ (W = jU ∧ W' = jU) ∨
          ∃ a X Y', W = jc a X ∧ W' = jc a Y' ∧ f.rel X Y')

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise617Gen.sumMapSig_sinjC

theorem sumMapSig_sinjC (f : ApproximableMap V₀ V₁) (a : A) (x : V₀.Element) :

      = sinjC (h := h₁) a (f.toElementMap x)

theorem sumMapSig_sinjU (f : ApproximableMap V₀ V₁) :

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise618.comm_unique
statement:
theorem comm_unique (k : ApproximableMap (prod V E) E)
    {g g' : ApproximableMap (iterSys V) E} (hg : IsStrict g) (hg' : IsStrict g')
    (hc : g.comp (imap V) = k.comp (prodMap (idMap V) g))
    (hc' : g'.comp (imap V) = k.comp (prodMap (idMap V) g')) : g = g'

statement:

statement:
theorem descMap_comm (k : ApproximableMap (prod V E) E) :

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise618.descMap_eq
statement:
theorem descMap_eq (k : ApproximableMap (prod V E) E) (x : (iterSys V).Element) :
    (descMap k).toElementMap x
      = iSupDirected (fun n => (descSeq k n).toElementMap x)
          (succChainDir _ (descSeqEltMono k x))

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise618.descMap_strict

theorem descMap_toElementMap (k : ApproximableMap (prod V E) E) (z : (iterSys V).Element)
    {Y : Set γ} :
    ((descMap k).toElementMap z).mem Y ↔ ∃ n, ((descSeq k n).toElementMap z).mem Y

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise618.descOp_apply
statement:
theorem descOp_apply (k : ApproximableMap (prod V E) E) (f : ApproximableMap (iterSys V) E)
    (z : (iterSys V).Element) :
    (descOp k f).toElementMap z
      = k.toElementMap (pair (component z 0)
          (f.toElementMap (ofSeq (fun n => component z (n + 1)))))

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise618.descOp_mono
statement:
theorem descOp_mono (k : ApproximableMap (prod V E) E) {f f' : ApproximableMap (iterSys V) E}

statement:
theorem descSeq_dir (k : ApproximableMap (prod V E) E) :
    ∀ i j, ∃ l, (∀ X Y, (descSeq k i).rel X Y → (descSeq k l).rel X Y) ∧
      (∀ X Y, (descSeq k j).rel X Y → (descSeq k l).rel X Y)

statement:
theorem descSeq_strict (k : ApproximableMap (prod V E) E) (hk : IsStrict k) :
    ∀ n, IsStrict (descSeq k n)
  | 0 => isStrict_constBot
  | (n + 1) => by
      have ih

theorem gcomp_rho_succ (k : ApproximableMap (prod V E) E) (g : ApproximableMap (iterSys V) E)

    g.comp (descSeq (imap V) (n + 1)) = descOp k (g.comp (descSeq (imap V) n))

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise619.FExpr.map_comp
statement:
theorem FExpr.map_comp : (T : FExpr) → {X Y Z : ScottSys} → (f : ApproximableMap X.sys Y.sys) →
    (g : ApproximableMap Y.sys Z.sys) → T.map (g.comp f) = (T.map g).comp (T.map f)
  | .const D, _, _, _, _, _ => (idMap_comp (idMap D.sys)).symm
  | .var, _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | .sum T₀ T₁, _, _, _, f, g => by
      change sumMapTok (T₀.map (g.comp f)) (T₁.map (g.comp f))
          = (sumMapTok (T₀.map g) (T₁.map g)).comp (sumMapTok (T₀.map f) (T₁.map f))
      rw [T₀.map_comp f g, T₁.map_comp f g, sumMapTok_comp]
  | .prod T₀ T₁, _, _, _, f, g => by
      change prodMapTok (T₀.map (g.comp f)) (T₁.map (g.comp f))
          = (prodMapTok (T₀.map g) (T₁.map g)).comp (prodMapTok (T₀.map f) (T₁.map f))
      rw [T₀.map_comp f g, T₁.map_comp f g, prodMapTok_comp]

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise619.FExpr.map_continuous

theorem FExpr.map_continuous (T : FExpr) {I : Type} [Nonempty I] {X Y : ScottSys}
    (g : I → ApproximableMap X.sys Y.sys) (f : ApproximableMap X.sys Y.sys)
    (hdir : ∀ i j, ∃ k, g i ≤ g k ∧ g j ≤ g k)
    (hf : ∀ A B, f.rel A B ↔ ∃ i, (g i).rel A B) (A B : Set Str) :
    (T.map f).rel A B ↔ ∃ i, (T.map (g i)).rel A B

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise619.FExpr.map_continuous_mp
statement:
theorem FExpr.map_continuous_mp : (T : FExpr) → {I : Type} → {X Y : ScottSys} →
    {g : I → ApproximableMap X.sys Y.sys} → {f : ApproximableMap X.sys Y.sys} →
    [Nonempty I] → (∀ i j, ∃ k, g i ≤ g k ∧ g j ≤ g k) →
    (∀ A B, f.rel A B ↔ ∃ i, (g i).rel A B) →
    {A B : Set Str} → (T.map f).rel A B → ∃ i, (T.map (g i)).rel A B
  | .const _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hrel => by
      obtain ⟨i⟩

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise619.FExpr.map_id
statement:
theorem FExpr.map_id : (T : FExpr) → (X : ScottSys) → T.map (idMap X.sys) = idMap (T.obj X).sys
  | .const D, _ => rfl
  | .var, _ => rfl
  | .sum T₀ T₁, X => by
      change sumMapTok (T₀.map (idMap X.sys)) (T₁.map (idMap X.sys))
          = idMap ((T₀.obj X).sum (T₁.obj X)).sys
      rw [T₀.map_id X, T₁.map_id X, sumMapTok_id]
  | .prod T₀ T₁, X => by
      change prodMapTok (T₀.map (idMap X.sys)) (T₁.map (idMap X.sys))
          = idMap ((T₀.obj X).prod (T₁.obj X)).sys
      rw [T₀.map_id X, T₁.map_id X, prodMapTok_id]

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise619.FExpr.map_isStrict
statement:
theorem FExpr.map_isStrict : (T : FExpr) → {X Y : ScottSys} → (f : ApproximableMap X.sys Y.sys) →
    IsStrict f → IsStrict (T.map f)
  | .const _, _, _, _, _ => isStrict_idMap
  | .var, _, _, _, hf => hf
  | .sum T₀ T₁, _, _, f, _ => sumMapTok_isStrict (T₀.map f) (T₁.map f)
  | .prod T₀ T₁, _, _, f, hf =>
      prodMapTok_isStrict (T₀.map_isStrict f hf) (T₁.map_isStrict f hf)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise619.FExpr.map_mono
statement:

    f ≤ f' → T.map f ≤ T.map f'
  | .const _, _, _, _, _, _ => le_rfl
  | .var, _, _, _, _, h => h
  | .sum T₀ T₁, _, _, _, _, h => sumMapTok_mono (T₀.map_mono h) (T₁.map_mono h)
  | .prod T₀ T₁, _, _, _, _, h => prodMapTok_mono (T₀.map_mono h) (T₁.map_mono h)

theorem FExpr.obj_continuous_mp : (T : FExpr) → {ℱ : Set ScottSys} → {U : ScottSys} →

    (∀ D ∈ ℱ, D.sys ◁ U.sys) → (∀ X, U.sys.mem X ↔ ∃ D ∈ ℱ, D.sys.mem X) →
    {W : Set Str} → (T.obj U).sys.mem W → ∃ D ∈ ℱ, (T.obj D).sys.mem W

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise619.FExpr.obj_subsystem

  | .const D, _, _, _ => Subsystem.refl D.sys
  | .var, _, _, h => h
  | .sum T₀ T₁, _, _, h => sumTok_subsystem (T₀.obj_subsystem h) (T₁.obj_subsystem h)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise619.mFun_eq_master
statement:
theorem mFun_eq_master : (T : FExpr) → {Γ : Set Str} → (h : Γ.Nonempty) →
    mFun T Γ = (T.obj (singletonSys Γ h)).sys.master
  | .const _, _, _ => rfl
  | .var, _, _ => rfl
  | .sum T₀ T₁, Γ, h => by
      change insert ([] : Str) (embBit false (mFun T₀ Γ) ∪ embBit true (mFun T₁ Γ))
        = insert ([] : Str) (embBit false ((T₀.obj (singletonSys Γ h)).sys.master)
            ∪ embBit true ((T₁.obj (singletonSys Γ h)).sys.master))
      rw [mFun_eq_master T₀ h, mFun_eq_master T₁ h]
  | .prod T₀ T₁, Γ, h => by
      change insert ([] : Str) (embBit false (mFun T₀ Γ) ∪ embBit true (mFun T₁ Γ))
        = insert ([] : Str) (embBit false ((T₀.obj (singletonSys Γ h)).sys.master)
            ∪ embBit true ((T₁.obj (singletonSys Γ h)).sys.master))
      rw [mFun_eq_master T₀ h, mFun_eq_master T₁ h]

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise619.GExpr.map_comp
statement:
theorem GExpr.map_comp : (T : GExpr) → {X Y Z : ScottSys} → (f : ApproximableMap X.sys Y.sys) →
    {g : ApproximableMap Y.sys Z.sys} → IsStrict g → T.map (g.comp f) = (T.map g).comp (T.map f)
  | .const D, _, _, _, _, _, _ => (idMap_comp (idMap D.sys)).symm
  | .var, _, _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | .sum a b, _, _, _, f, g, hg => by
      change sumMapTok (a.map (g.comp f)) (b.map (g.comp f))
          = (sumMapTok (a.map g) (b.map g)).comp (sumMapTok (a.map f) (b.map f))
      rw [a.map_comp f hg, b.map_comp f hg]
      · exact sumMapTok_comp _ _ _ _
  | .prod a b, _, _, _, f, g, hg => by
      change prodMapTok (a.map (g.comp f)) (b.map (g.comp f))
          = (prodMapTok (a.map g) (b.map g)).comp (prodMapTok (a.map f) (b.map f))
      rw [a.map_comp f hg, b.map_comp f hg]
      · exact prodMapTok_comp _ _ _ _
  | .oplus a b, _, _, _, f, g, hg => by
      change oplusMapTok (a.map (g.comp f)) (b.map (g.comp f))
          = (oplusMapTok (a.map g) (b.map g)).comp (oplusMapTok (a.map f) (b.map f))
      rw [a.map_comp f hg, b.map_comp f hg]
      · exact oplusMapTok_comp _ _ (a.map_isStrict g hg) (b.map_isStrict g hg)
  | .otimes a b, _, _, _, f, g, hg => by
      change otimesMapTok (a.map (g.comp f)) (b.map (g.comp f))
          = (otimesMapTok (a.map g) (b.map g)).comp (otimesMapTok (a.map f) (b.map f))
      rw [a.map_comp f hg, b.map_comp f hg]
      · exact otimesMapTok_comp _ _ (a.map_isStrict g hg) (b.map_isStrict g hg)

    (hdir : ∀ i j, ∃ k, g i ≤ g k ∧ g j ≤ g k)

    (∀ A B, f.rel A B ↔ ∃ i, (g i).rel A B) →
    {A B : Set Str} → (T.map f).rel A B → ∃ i, (T.map (g i)).rel A B

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise619.GExpr.map_id
statement:
theorem GExpr.map_id : (T : GExpr) → (X : ScottSys) → T.map (idMap X.sys) = idMap (T.obj X).sys
  | .const _, _ => rfl
  | .var, _ => rfl
  | .sum a b, X => by
      change sumMapTok (a.map (idMap X.sys)) (
        b.map (idMap X.sys)) = idMap ((a.obj X).sum (b.obj X)).sys
      rw [a.map_id X, b.map_id X, sumMapTok_id]
  | .prod a b, X => by
      change prodMapTok (a.map (idMap X.sys)) (
        b.map (idMap X.sys)) = idMap ((a.obj X).prod (b.obj X)).sys
      rw [a.map_id X, b.map_id X, prodMapTok_id]
  | .oplus a b, X => by
      change oplusMapTok (a.map (idMap X.sys)) (b.map (idMap X.sys))
          = idMap ((a.obj X).oplus (b.obj X)).sys
      rw [a.map_id X, b.map_id X, oplusMapTok_id]
  | .otimes a b, X => by
      change otimesMapTok (a.map (idMap X.sys)) (b.map (idMap X.sys))
          = idMap ((a.obj X).otimes (b.obj X)).sys
      rw [a.map_id X, b.map_id X, otimesMapTok_id]

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise619.GExpr.map_isStrict
statement:
theorem GExpr.map_isStrict : (T : GExpr) → {X Y : ScottSys} → (f : ApproximableMap X.sys Y.sys) →
    IsStrict f → IsStrict (T.map f)
  | .const _, _, _, _, _ => isStrict_idMap
  | .var, _, _, _, hf => hf
  | .sum a b, _, _, f, _ => sumMapTok_isStrict (a.map f) (b.map f)
  | .prod a b, _, _, f, hf => prodMapTok_isStrict (a.map_isStrict f hf) (b.map_isStrict f hf)
  | .oplus a b, _, _, f, _ => oplusMapTok_isStrict (a.map f) (b.map f)
  | .otimes a b, _, _, f, _ => otimesMapTok_isStrict (a.map f) (b.map f)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise619.GExpr.map_mono
statement:
theorem GExpr.map_mono : (T : GExpr) → {X Y : ScottSys} → {f f' : ApproximableMap X.sys Y.sys} →
    f ≤ f' → T.map f ≤ T.map f'
  | .const _, _, _, _, _, _ => le_rfl
  | .var, _, _, _, _, h => h
  | .sum a b, _, _, _, _, h => sumMapTok_mono (a.map_mono h) (b.map_mono h)
  | .prod a b, _, _, _, _, h => prodMapTok_mono (a.map_mono h) (b.map_mono h)
  | .oplus a b, _, _, _, _, h => oplusMapTok_mono (a.map_mono h) (b.map_mono h)
  | .otimes a b, _, _, _, _, h => otimesMapTok_mono (a.map_mono h) (b.map_mono h)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise619.GExpr.naryOp_rootedConst
statement:
theorem GExpr.naryOp_rootedConst {op : GExpr → GExpr → GExpr}
    (hop : ∀ x y, (op x y).RootedConst ↔ x.RootedConst ∧ y.RootedConst) :
    ∀ (a : GExpr) (l : List GExpr), a.RootedConst → (∀ b ∈ l, b.RootedConst) →
      (GExpr.naryOp op a l).RootedConst
  | a, [], ha, _ => ha
  | a, b :: l, ha, hl => by
      rw [GExpr.naryOp, hop]
      exact ⟨ha, GExpr.naryOp_rootedConst hop b l (hl b (List.mem_cons_self ..))
        (fun c hc => hl c (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc))⟩
