name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise619.gFun_eq_master
statement:
theorem gFun_eq_master : (T : GExpr) → {Γ : Set Str} → (h : Γ.Nonempty) →
    gFun T Γ = (T.obj (singletonSys Γ h)).sys.master
  | .const _, _, _ => rfl
  | .var, _, _ => rfl
  | .sum a b, Γ, h => by
      change insert ([] : Str) (embBit false (gFun a Γ) ∪ embBit true (gFun b Γ))
        = insert ([] : Str) (embBit false ((a.obj (singletonSys Γ h)).sys.master)
            ∪ embBit true ((b.obj (singletonSys Γ h)).sys.master))
      rw [gFun_eq_master a h, gFun_eq_master b h]
  | .prod a b, Γ, h => by
      change insert ([] : Str) (embBit false (gFun a Γ) ∪ embBit true (gFun b Γ))
        = insert ([] : Str) (embBit false ((a.obj (singletonSys Γ h)).sys.master)
            ∪ embBit true ((b.obj (singletonSys Γ h)).sys.master))
      rw [gFun_eq_master a h, gFun_eq_master b h]
  | .oplus a b, Γ, h => by
      change insert ([] : Str) (embBit false (gFun a Γ) ∪ embBit true (gFun b Γ))
        = insert ([] : Str) (embBit false ((a.obj (singletonSys Γ h)).sys.master)
            ∪ embBit true ((b.obj (singletonSys Γ h)).sys.master))
      rw [gFun_eq_master a h, gFun_eq_master b h]
  | .otimes a b, Γ, h => by
      change insert ([] : Str) (embBit false (gFun a Γ) ∪ embBit true (gFun b Γ))
        = insert ([] : Str) (embBit false ((a.obj (singletonSys Γ h)).sys.master)
            ∪ embBit true ((b.obj (singletonSys Γ h)).sys.master))
      rw [gFun_eq_master a h, gFun_eq_master b h]

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise619.GExpr.map_inj
statement:
theorem GExpr.map_inj : (T : GExpr) → {X Y : ScottSys} → (h : X.sys ◁ Y.sys) →
    T.map h.inj = (T.obj_subsystem h).inj
  | .const D, _, _, _ => (Subsystem.self_inj (Subsystem.refl D.sys)).symm
  | .var, _, _, _ => rfl
  | .sum a b, _, _, h => by
      change sumMapTok (a.map h.inj) (b.map h.inj)
          = (sumTok_subsystem (a.obj_subsystem h) (b.obj_subsystem h)).inj
      rw [a.map_inj h, b.map_inj h, sumMapTok_inj]
  | .prod a b, _, _, h => by
      change prodMapTok (a.map h.inj) (b.map h.inj)
          = (prodTok_subsystem (a.obj_subsystem h) (b.obj_subsystem h)).inj
      rw [a.map_inj h, b.map_inj h, prodMapTok_inj]
  | .oplus a b, _, _, h => by
      change oplusMapTok (a.map h.inj) (b.map h.inj)
          = (oplusTok_subsystem (a.obj_subsystem h) (b.obj_subsystem h)).inj
      rw [a.map_inj h, b.map_inj h, oplusMapTok_inj]
  | .otimes a b, _, _, h => by
      change otimesMapTok (a.map h.inj) (b.map h.inj)
          = (otimesTok_subsystem (a.obj_subsystem h) (b.obj_subsystem h)).inj
      rw [a.map_inj h, b.map_inj h, otimesMapTok_inj]

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Exercise619.GExpr.map_proj
statement:
theorem GExpr.map_proj : (T : GExpr) → {X Y : ScottSys} → (h : X.sys ◁ Y.sys) →
    T.map h.proj = (T.obj_subsystem h).proj
  | .const D, _, _, _ => (Subsystem.self_proj (Subsystem.refl D.sys)).symm
  | .var, _, _, _ => rfl
  | .sum a b, _, _, h => by
      change sumMapTok (a.map h.proj) (b.map h.proj)
          = (sumTok_subsystem (a.obj_subsystem h) (b.obj_subsystem h)).proj
      rw [a.map_proj h, b.map_proj h, sumMapTok_proj]
  | .prod a b, _, _, h => by
      change prodMapTok (a.map h.proj) (b.map h.proj)
          = (prodTok_subsystem (a.obj_subsystem h) (b.obj_subsystem h)).proj
      rw [a.map_proj h, b.map_proj h, prodMapTok_proj]
  | .oplus a b, _, _, h => by
      change oplusMapTok (a.map h.proj) (b.map h.proj)
          = (oplusTok_subsystem (a.obj_subsystem h) (b.obj_subsystem h)).proj
      rw [a.map_proj h, b.map_proj h, oplusMapTok_proj]
  | .otimes a b, _, _, h => by
      change otimesMapTok (a.map h.proj) (b.map h.proj)
          = (otimesTok_subsystem (a.obj_subsystem h) (b.obj_subsystem h)).proj
      rw [a.map_proj h, b.map_proj h, otimesMapTok_proj]

  | 0 => isStrict_constBot
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [descRel_succ]
      exact isStrict_comp (algStr_strict B)
        (isStrict_comp ((Texp N).map_isStrict _ (descRel_isStrict n)) (expInv_strict N hN))

  | 0 => constBot_le _
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [descRel_succ, algHom_fix hN B g]
      exact comp_mono_gen le_rfl
        (comp_mono_gen ((Texp N).map_mono (descRel_le_algHom g n)) le_rfl)

      exact comp_mono_gen le_rfl
        (comp_mono_gen ((Texp N).map_mono (descRel_le_succ n)) le_rfl)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Proposition77.dsharpStep_nn
statement:
theorem dsharpStep_nn (a b tbl : ℕ) :
    dsharpStep fcons feq finter (Nat.pair (Nat.pair (2 * a + 2) (2 * b + 2)) tbl)
      = packT
          (eqB (listGet tbl (Nat.pair (2 * a + 2) (2 * b + 2) - 1 - Nat.pair a.unpair.1 b.unpair.1))
            * eqB (listGet tbl (Nat.pair (2 * a + 2) (2 * b +
              2) - 1 - Nat.pair a.unpair.2 b.unpair.2)))
          (consB (listGet tbl (Nat.pair (2 * a + 2) (2 * b +
            2) - 1 - Nat.pair a.unpair.1 b.unpair.1))
            * consB (listGet tbl (Nat.pair (2 * a + 2) (2 * b +
              2) - 1 - Nat.pair a.unpair.2 b.unpair.2)))
          (2 * Nat.pair
            (intI (listGet tbl (Nat.pair (2 * a + 2) (2 * b +
              2) - 1 - Nat.pair a.unpair.1 b.unpair.1)))
            (intI (listGet tbl (Nat.pair (2 * a + 2) (2 * b +
              2) - 1 - Nat.pair a.unpair.2 b.unpair.2)))
            + 2)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Proposition77.dsharp_decider_spec
statement:
theorem dsharp_decider_spec (hD : ∀ X, D.mem X → X.Nonempty)
    (hcons : ∀ a b, fcons (Nat.pair a b) = 1 ↔ ∃ l, P.X l ⊆ P.X a ∩ P.X b)
    (heq : ∀ a b, feq (Nat.pair a b) = 1 ↔ P.X a = P.X b)
    (hinter : ∀ a b, (∃ l, P.X l ⊆ P.X a ∩ P.X b) → P.X (finter (Nat.pair a b)) = P.X a ∩ P.X b) :
    ∀ i j : ℕ,
      (consB (gOf (dsharpStep fcons feq finter) (Nat.pair i j)) = 1
          ↔ ∃ l, Vsharp D P l ⊆ Vsharp D P i ∩ Vsharp D P j) ∧
        ((∃ l, Vsharp D P l ⊆ Vsharp D P i ∩ Vsharp D P j) →
          Vsharp D P (intI (gOf (dsharpStep fcons feq finter) (Nat.pair i j)))
            = Vsharp D P i ∩ Vsharp D P j) ∧
        (eqB (gOf (dsharpStep fcons feq finter) (Nat.pair i j)) = 1
          ↔ Vsharp D P i = Vsharp D P j)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Proposition77.dsharp_intI_correct
statement:

    (hinter : ∀ a b, (∃ l, P.X l ⊆ P.X a ∩ P.X b) → P.X (finter (Nat.pair a b)) = P.X a ∩ P.X b) :
    ∀ i j : ℕ, (∃ l, Vsharp D P l ⊆ Vsharp D P i ∩ Vsharp D P j) →
      Vsharp D P (intI (gOf (dsharpStep fcons feq finter) (Nat.pair i j)))
        = Vsharp D P i ∩ Vsharp D P j

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Proposition77.dsharp_interEq_iff
statement:
theorem dsharp_interEq_iff (hD : ∀ X, D.mem X → X.Nonempty)
    (hcons : ∀ a b, fcons (Nat.pair a b) = 1 ↔ ∃ l, P.X l ⊆ P.X a ∩ P.X b)
    (heq : ∀ a b, feq (Nat.pair a b) = 1 ↔ P.X a = P.X b)
    (hinter : ∀ a b, (∃ l, P.X l ⊆ P.X a ∩ P.X b) → P.X (finter (Nat.pair a b)) = P.X a ∩ P.X b)
    (n m k : ℕ) :
    (Vsharp D P n ∩ Vsharp D P m = Vsharp D P k) ↔
      consB (gOf (dsharpStep fcons feq finter) (Nat.pair n m))
        * eqB (gOf (dsharpStep fcons feq finter)
            (Nat.pair (intI (gOf (dsharpStep fcons feq finter) (Nat.pair n m))) k)) = 1

statement:
theorem memS_sub_embPair (hD : ∀ X, D.mem X → X.Nonempty)

theorem component_push_succ (x : N.Element) (s : 𝒩.Element) (j : ℕ) :

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Theorem56Full.component_push_zero

theorem component_push_zero (x : N.Element) (s : 𝒩.Element) :

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Theorem56Full.component_tupleMap
statement:
theorem component_tupleMap : ∀ (n : ℕ) (gs : Fin n → ApproximableMap 𝒩 N) (z : 𝒩.Element)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n),
    component ((tupleMap n gs).toElementMap z) i = (gs ⟨i, hi⟩).toElementMap z
  | 0, _, _, i, hi => absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero i)
  | n + 1, gs, z, 0, hi => by
      rw [tupleMap_succ, toElementMap_comp, toElementMap_paired, component_push_zero]
      exact congrArg (fun w => (gs w).toElementMap z) (Fin.ext (by simp))
  | n + 1, gs, z, i + 1, hi => by
      rw [tupleMap_succ, toElementMap_comp, toElementMap_paired, component_push_succ,
        component_tupleMap n (fun j => gs j.succ) z i (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi)]
      rfl

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Theorem56Full.component_tupleMap_ge
statement:
theorem component_tupleMap_ge : ∀ (n : ℕ) (gs : Fin n → ApproximableMap 𝒩 N) (z : 𝒩.Element)
    (i : ℕ), n ≤ i → component ((tupleMap n gs).toElementMap z) i = N.bot
  | 0, gs, z, i, _ => by rw [tupleMap_zero, toElementMap_constMap, component_bot]
  | n + 1, gs, z, i, hi => by
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, i = j + 1

Domain.Neighborhood.Theorem56Full.lamDef_comp
statement:
theorem lamDef_comp {m nn : ℕ} (f : List.Vector ℕ nn →. ℕ) (g : Fin nn → List.Vector ℕ m →. ℕ)
    (φf : ApproximableMap 𝒩 N) (hf : LamDef φf f)

theorem lamDef_prec {n : ℕ} (f₀ : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ) (g₀ : List.Vector ℕ (n + 2) → ℕ)

    (hg : LamDef φg (g₀ : List.Vector ℕ (n + 2) →. ℕ)) :
    LamDef (strictGuardN (n + 1) (recMap φf φg))
      (((fun v : List.Vector ℕ (n + 1) =>
        v.head.rec (f₀ v.tail) fun y IH => g₀ (y ::ᵥ IH ::ᵥ v.tail)) :

    (φg : Fin nn → ApproximableMap 𝒩 N) (hg : ∀ i, LamDef (φg i) (g₀ i : List.Vector ℕ m →. ℕ)) :
    LamDef (strictGuardN m (φf.comp (tupleMap nn φg)))
      ((fun a => f₀ (List.Vector.ofFn fun i => g₀ i a) : List.Vector ℕ m → ℕ) :

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Theorem56Full.mem_mOfFn
statement:
theorem mem_mOfFn : ∀ {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → Part ℕ) (w : List.Vector ℕ n),
    w ∈ List.Vector.mOfFn p ↔ ∀ i, w.get i ∈ p i
  | 0, p, w => by
      constructor
      · intro _ i; exact i.elim0
      · intro _
        change w ∈ (pure List.Vector.nil : Part _)
        rw [Part.pure_eq_some, Part.mem_some_iff]
        exact List.Vector.eq_nil w
  | n + 1, p, w => by
      have hmof : List.Vector.mOfFn p
          = (p 0).bind (fun a => (List.Vector.mOfFn fun i => p i.succ).bind
              (fun u => Part.some (a ::ᵥ u))) := by
        simp only [List.Vector.mOfFn, Part.bind_eq_bind, Part.pure_eq_some]
      rw [hmof, Part.mem_bind_iff]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨a, ha, hrest⟩
        rw [Part.mem_bind_iff] at hrest
        obtain ⟨u, hu, hw⟩

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Theorem56Full.partrec_one
statement:
theorem partrec_one {h : ℕ →. ℕ}
    (H : Nat.Partrec' (fun v : List.Vector ℕ 1 => h v.head)) :
    ∃ τ : ApproximableMap N N,
      (∀ a m, m ∈ h a → τ.toElementMap (natElem a) = natElem m) ∧
      (∀ a, ¬ (h a).Dom → τ.toElementMap (natElem a) = N.bot) ∧
      τ.toElementMap N.bot = N.bot

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Theorem56Full.precBody_apply
statement:
theorem precBody_apply (k : (funSpace 𝒩 N).Element) (z : 𝒩.Element) :
    (precBody φf φg).toElementMap (pair k z) =
      (cond N).toElementMap
        (pair (zeroMap.toElementMap ((head N).toElementMap z))
          (pair (φf.toElementMap ((tail N).toElementMap z))
            (φg.toElementMap
              ((push N).toElementMap
                (pair (predMap.toElementMap ((head N).toElementMap z))
                  ((push N).toElementMap
                    (pair ((toApproxMap k).toElementMap
                            ((push N).toElementMap
                              (pair (predMap.toElementMap ((head N).toElementMap z))
                                ((tail N).toElementMap z))))
                      ((tail N).toElementMap z))))))))

Domain.Neighborhood.Theorem56Full.recMap_eval
statement:
theorem recMap_eval {n : ℕ} (f₀ : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ) (g₀ : List.Vector ℕ (n + 2) → ℕ)
    (hf : LamDef φf (f₀ : List.Vector ℕ n →. ℕ)) (hg : LamDef φg (g₀ : List.Vector ℕ (n + 2) →. ℕ))
    (u : List.Vector ℕ n) (d : ℕ) :
    (recMap φf φg).toElementMap (vecElem (d ::ᵥ u))
      = natElem (Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => ℕ) (f₀ u)
          (fun y IH => g₀ (y ::ᵥ IH ::ᵥ u)) d)

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Theorem56Full.recMap_rec
statement:
theorem recMap_rec (z : 𝒩.Element) :
    (recMap φf φg).toElementMap z =
      (cond N).toElementMap
        (pair (zeroMap.toElementMap ((head N).toElementMap z))
          (pair (φf.toElementMap ((tail N).toElementMap z))
            (φg.toElementMap
              ((push N).toElementMap
                (pair (predMap.toElementMap ((head N).toElementMap z))
                  ((push N).toElementMap
                    (pair ((recMap φf φg).toElementMap
                            ((push N).toElementMap
                              (pair (predMap.toElementMap ((head N).toElementMap z))
                                ((tail N).toElementMap z))))
                      ((tail N).toElementMap z))))))))

statement:
theorem searchMap_climb {n : ℕ} {f : List.Vector ℕ (n + 1) → ℕ}
    (hf : LamDef φf (f : List.Vector ℕ (n + 1) →. ℕ)) (v : List.Vector ℕ n) (m : ℕ)
    (hm0 : f (m ::ᵥ v) = 0) (hmin : ∀ i, i < m → f (i ::ᵥ v) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ d j, j + d = m → (searchMap φf).toElementMap (vecElem (j ::ᵥ v)) = natElem m

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Theorem56Full.searchMap_diverge
statement:

name: Domain.Neighborhood.Theorem56Full.searchMap_rec
statement:
theorem searchMap_rec (z : 𝒩.Element) :
    (searchMap φf).toElementMap z =
      (cond N).toElementMap
        (pair (zeroMap.toElementMap (φf.toElementMap z))
          (pair ((head N).toElementMap z)
            ((searchMap φf).toElementMap
              ((push N).toElementMap
                (pair (succMap.toElementMap ((head N).toElementMap z))
                  ((tail N).toElementMap z))))))

statement:
theorem searchMap_step_next {n : ℕ} {f : List.Vector ℕ (n + 1) → ℕ}

statement:

    (hj : IsStrict j) (hk : IsStrict k)

statement:
theorem andFoldl_eq_one_iff (g : ℕ → ℕ) :
    ∀ (el : List ℕ) (a : ℕ), a ≤ 1 →
      (List.foldl (fun acc x => selectFn acc (isOne (g x)) 0) a el = 1 ↔
        a = 1 ∧ ∀ e ∈ el, g e = 1)
  | [], a, _ => by simp
  | e :: el, a, ha => by
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    have hstep : selectFn a (isOne (g e)) 0 ≤ 1

name: Domain.Neighborhood.condFoldl_spec
statement:
theorem condFoldl_spec (incl0 : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hincl0 : ∀ s, incl0 s = 1 ↔ P₀.X s.unpair.1 ⊆ P₀.X s.unpair.2) (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ (el : List ℕ) (A : Set β) (a : ℕ), P₁.X a = A → V₁.mem A →
      V₁.mem (condSet P₀ P₁ k A el) →
      P₁.X (List.foldl (fun acc x => if incl0 (Nat.pair k x.unpair.1) = 1
              then P₁.inter acc x.unpair.2 else acc) a el) = condSet P₀ P₁ k A el
  | [], A, a, hXa, _, _ => by rw [List.foldl_nil, condSet_nil]; exact hXa
  | e :: el, A, a, hXa, hA, hcons => by
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    by_cases hpred : incl0 (Nat.pair k e.unpair.1) = 1
    · rw [ite_eq_left hpred]
      have hincl : P₀.X k ⊆ P₀.X e.unpair.1 := by
        simp_all
      rw [condSet_cons_pos P₀ P₁ hincl] at hcons ⊢
      have hwit : V₁.mem (A ∩ P₁.X e.unpair.2) :=
        V₁.inter_mem hA (P₁.mem_X _) hcons (condSet_subset P₀ P₁ k (A ∩ P₁.X e.unpair.2) el)
      have hk : ∃ j, P₁.X j ⊆ P₁.X a ∩ P₁.X e.unpair.2 := by
        obtain ⟨j, hj⟩

        (Nat.pair (b / 2)
          (Nat.pair (P.inter idx (projFn x))
            (selectFn flag (isOne (fc (Nat.pair idx (projFn x)))) 0)))

name: Domain.Neighborhood.interFrom_eq_of_foldl
statement:
theorem interFrom_eq_of_foldl : ∀ (js : List ℕ) (A : Set α) (a : ℕ),
    P.X a = A → V.mem A → V.mem (interFrom P A js) →
    P.X (js.foldl (fun acc j => P.inter acc j) a) = interFrom P A js
  | [], A, a, hXa, _, _ => by simpa [interFrom] using hXa
  | j :: js, A, a, hXa, hA, hmem => by
    have hmem' : V.mem (interFrom P (A ∩ P.X j) js) := by rwa [interFrom] at hmem
    have hAXj : V.mem (A ∩ P.X j) :=
      V.inter_mem hA (P.mem_X j) hmem' (interFrom_subset P)
    have hk : ∃ k, P.X k ⊆ P.X a ∩ P.X j := by
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩

      : Set (ApproximableMap V V)).Nonempty) (c ℓ : ℕ) :
    (fixMap V).rel (Xenum P P gN c) (P.X ℓ) ↔
      ∃ full : List ℕ,
        gStepsOK (toApproxMap ((funSpace V V).principal (Xenum_mem P P gN hgN c)))

name: factorize1
statement:
lemma factorize1 (root b p : R) (q : ℕ) :
    root * p ^ q * (p ^ q * b) + root * p ^ q * (root * p ^ q) =
      p ^ q * p ^ q * ((root + b) * root)

name: factorize2
statement:
lemma factorize2 (root a p : R) (q : ℕ) :
    2 * (root * p ^ q) * (p ^ 1 * a) = p ^ q * p ^ 1 * (2 * a * root)

name: factorize3
statement:
lemma factorize3 (root p : R) (q : ℕ) :
    3 * (root * p ^ q * (root * p ^ q)) = p ^ q * p ^ q * (3 * root * root)

name: factorize4
statement:
lemma factorize4 (root a b c p : R) (q : ℕ) :
    p ^ (2 * q + 1) * c + root * p ^ q * (p ^ (q + 1) * b) + (root * p ^ q) ^ 2 * (p ^ 1 * a) =
      p ^ q * p ^ q * p ^ 1 * (a * root ^ 2) + p ^ q * p ^ (q + 1) * (b * root) +
        p ^ (2 * q + 1) * c

name: factorize5
statement:
lemma factorize5 (b c p : R) :
    p ^ 1 * b * (p ^ 1 * b) + 4 * (p ^ 2 * c) = p ^ 2 * (b * b + 4 * c)

name: factorize6
statement:
lemma factorize6 (p x b c : R) :
    p ^ 2 * x ^ 2 + p * x * (p ^ 1 * b) + p ^ 2 * -c = p ^ 2 * (1 * x ^ 2 + b * x + -c)

name: factorize7
statement:
lemma factorize7 (a b r p : R) :
    p ^ 2 * a + 2 * (p * r) * (p ^ 1 * b) + 3 * (p * r) ^ 2 =
      p ^ 2 * (a + 2 * r * b + 3 * r ^ 2)

name: factorize8
statement:
lemma factorize8 (a b c r p : R) :
    (p ^ 3 * a) + (p * r) * (p ^ 2 * b) + (p * r) ^ 2 * (p ^ 1 * c) + (p * r) ^ 3 =
      p ^ 3 * (a + r * b + r ^ 2 * c + r ^ 3)

theorem sub_one_mul_padicValNat_centralBinom (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (n : ℕ) :
    (p - 1) * padicValNat p (Nat.centralBinom n) =
      2 * (Nat.digits p n).sum - (Nat.digits p (2 * n)).sum

name: Egrs75.ConcreteMath.two_mul_padicValNat_three_centralBinom
statement:
theorem two_mul_padicValNat_three_centralBinom (n : ℕ) :
    2 * padicValNat 3 (Nat.centralBinom n) =
      2 * (Nat.digits 3 n).sum - (Nat.digits 3 (2 * n)).sum

name: Egrs75.Erdos376.carryCount_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem carryCount_eq_zero_iff {b : ℕ} (_hb : 2 ≤ b) (ds : List ℕ) :
    doubleCarryCountAux b ds 0 = 0 ↔ ∀ d ∈ ds, 2 * d < b

name: Egrs75.Erdos376.centralBinom_coprime_105_iff
statement:
theorem centralBinom_coprime_105_iff (n : ℕ) :
    Nat.Coprime (Nat.centralBinom n) 105 ↔
      LowDoubleDigits 3 n ∧ LowDoubleDigits 5 n ∧ LowDoubleDigits 7 n

name: Egrs75.Erdos376.coprime_centralBinom_prime_iff
statement:
theorem coprime_centralBinom_prime_iff {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (n : ℕ) :
    Nat.Coprime (Nat.centralBinom n) p ↔ LowDoubleDigits p n

name: Egrs75.Erdos376.digitExcess_eq
statement:
theorem digitExcess_eq {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (n : ℕ) :
    2 * (Nat.digits b n).sum - (Nat.digits b (2 * n)).sum =
      (b - 1) * doubleCarryCount b (Nat.digits b n)

name: Egrs75.Erdos376.doubleCarryStep_eq_div
statement:
lemma doubleCarryStep_eq_div {b carry d : ℕ} (_hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hcarry : carry ≤ 1) (hd : d < b) :
    doubleCarryStep b carry d = (2 * d + carry) / b

name: Egrs75.Erdos376.doubleCarryStep_le_one
statement: lemma doubleCarryStep_le_one (b carry d : ℕ) : doubleCarryStep b carry d ≤ 1

name: Egrs75.Erdos376.doubleCarryStep_local
statement:
lemma doubleCarryStep_local {b carry d : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hcarry : carry ≤ 1) (hd : d < b) :
    (2 * d + carry) % b + b * doubleCarryStep b carry d = 2 * d + carry

name: Egrs75.Erdos376.doubleDigitsAux_length
statement:
lemma doubleDigitsAux_length (b : ℕ) :
    ∀ (ds : List ℕ) (carry : ℕ),
      (doubleDigitsAux b ds carry).length = ds.length + 1

name: Egrs75.Erdos376.doubleDigitsAux_lt_base
statement:
lemma doubleDigitsAux_lt_base {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) :
    ∀ {ds : List ℕ} {carry : ℕ}, carry < b → (∀ d ∈ ds, d < b) →
      ∀ x ∈ doubleDigitsAux b ds carry, x < b

name: Egrs75.Erdos376.doubleDigitsAux_ofDigits
statement:
lemma doubleDigitsAux_ofDigits {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) :
    ∀ {ds : List ℕ} {carry : ℕ}, carry ≤ 1 → (∀ d ∈ ds, d < b) →
      Nat.ofDigits b (doubleDigitsAux b ds carry) =
        2 * Nat.ofDigits b ds + carry

name: Egrs75.Erdos376.doubleDigitsAux_sum
statement:
lemma doubleDigitsAux_sum {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) :
    ∀ {ds : List ℕ} {carry : ℕ}, carry ≤ 1 → (∀ d ∈ ds, d < b) →
      (doubleDigitsAux b ds carry).sum + (b - 1) * doubleCarryCountAux b ds carry =
        2 * ds.sum + carry

name: Egrs75.digit_le_half_iff_two_mul_lt
statement:
lemma digit_le_half_iff_two_mul_lt {p d : ℕ} (hp2 : 2 ≤ p) (hpodd : Odd p) :
    d ≤ (p - 1) / 2 ↔ 2 * d < p

name: Egrs75.lowDigits_iff_lowDoubleDigits
statement:
theorem lowDigits_iff_lowDoubleDigits {p n : ℕ} (hp2 : 2 ≤ p) (hpodd : Odd p) :
    LowDigits p n ↔ Egrs75.Erdos376.LowDoubleDigits p n

name: Egrs75.not_dvd_centralBinom_iff_lowDigits
statement:
theorem not_dvd_centralBinom_iff_lowDigits {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpodd : Odd p)
    (n : ℕ) : ¬ p ∣ Nat.centralBinom n ↔ LowDigits p n

name: Egrs75.LeafInduction.align_of_repair
statement:
theorem align_of_repair {p q : ℕ} (N : ℕ)
    (hrepair : ∀ {n : ℕ}, LowDigits p n → 0 < badCountQ q n →
      ∃ n', n < n' ∧ LowDigits p n' ∧ badCountQ q n' < badCountQ q n)
    (seed : ℕ) (hseedN : N < seed) (hseedp : LowDigits p seed) :
    ∃ n, N < n ∧ LowDigits p n ∧ LowDigits q n

name: Egrs75.LeafInduction.badCountQ_eq_zero_iff_lowDigits
statement:
theorem badCountQ_eq_zero_iff_lowDigits {q n : ℕ} :

name: Egrs75.LeafInduction.seed_lowDigits_pow

name: Egrs75.LeafInduction.seed_lt_pow_succ

name: Egrs75.RepairPaperfaithful.digitAt_add_high
statement:
theorem digitAt_add_high {p : ℕ} {k u h i : ℕ} (hu : u < p ^ k) (hki : k ≤ i) :
    digitAt p i (u + p ^ k * h) = digitAt p (i - k) h

name: Egrs75.RepairPaperfaithful.digitAt_add_low
statement:
theorem digitAt_add_low {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) {k u h i : ℕ} (hik : i < k) :

name: Egrs75.RepairPaperfaithful.exists_highest_bad
statement:
theorem exists_highest_bad {q n : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hbad : 0 < badCountQ q n) :

name: Egrs75.RepairPaperfaithful.lowDigits_add_disjoint
Egrs75.RepairPaperfaithful.lowDigits_iff_digitAt
statement:
theorem lowDigits_iff_digitAt {p n : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :

name: Egrs75.RepairDV.badCountQ_eq
statement:
theorem badCountQ_eq (q n : ℕ) :

name: Egrs75.RepairDV.badCountQ_split
statement:
theorem badCountQ_split {q k Lo Hi : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hLo : Lo < q ^ k) (hHi : 0 < Hi) :

name: Egrs75.RepairDV.badCount_eq_lowBlock
statement:
theorem badCount_eq_lowBlock {q n : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hbad : 0 < badCountQ q n) :
    badCountQ q n = badCountQ q (n % q ^ (topBadIndex q n + 1))

name: Egrs75.RepairDV.badCount_filter_append
statement:
theorem badCount_filter_append (q : ℕ) (L₁ L₂ : List ℕ) :
    ((L₁ ++ L₂).filter (fun d => bigQ q d)).length =
      (L₁.filter (fun d => bigQ q d)).length + (L₂.filter (fun d => bigQ q d)).length

name: Egrs75.RepairDV.badCount_filter_replicate_zero
statement:
theorem badCount_filter_replicate_zero (q k : ℕ) :
    ((List.replicate k 0).filter (fun d => bigQ q d)).length = 0

name: Egrs75.RepairDV.badIndexSet_nonempty
statement:
theorem badIndexSet_nonempty {q n : ℕ} (_hq : 1 < q) (hbad : 0 < badCountQ q n) :

name: Egrs75.RepairDV.digit_good_above_top
statement:
theorem digit_good_above_top {q n i : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hbad : 0 < badCountQ q n)
    (hi : topBadIndex q n < i) : n / q ^ i % q ≤ (q - 1) / 2

name: Egrs75.RepairDV.digit_top_big
statement:
theorem digit_top_big {q n : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hbad : 0 < badCountQ q n) :
    (q - 1) / 2 < n / q ^ (topBadIndex q n) % q

name: Egrs75.RepairDV.digits_split
statement:
theorem digits_split {q k Lo Hi : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hLo : Lo < q ^ k) (hHi : 0 < Hi) :
    Nat.digits q (Lo + q ^ k * Hi) =
      Nat.digits q Lo ++ List.replicate (k - (Nat.digits q Lo).length) 0 ++ Nat.digits q Hi

name: Egrs75.RepairDV.highBlock_lowDigits
statement:
theorem highBlock_lowDigits {q n : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (hbad : 0 < badCountQ q n) :

name: Egrs75.RepairDV.le_topBadIndex

name: Egrs75.RepairDV.lowDigits_disjoint_add

name: Egrs75.RepairDV.topBadIndex_mem

name: Egrs75.RoundUp.exists_lowDigits_between

name: Egrs75.RoundUp.lowDigits_one

name: Egrs75.RoundUp.lowDigits_ru
statement: lemma lowDigits_ru {p : ℕ} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (x : ℕ) : LowDigits p (ru p x)

name: Egrs75.RoundUp.lowDigits_zero
statement: lemma lowDigits_zero (p : ℕ) : LowDigits p 0

name: Egrs75.RoundUp.one_le_half
statement: lemma one_le_half {p : ℕ} (hp : 3 ≤ p) : (1 : ℕ) ≤ (p - 1) / 2

theorem clearing_high {p q : ℕ} (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpo : Odd p) (hq3 : 3 ≤ q)

name: Egrs75.P4.cond3_of_tail_small
statement:
theorem cond3_of_tail_small {p q : ℕ} (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hpo : Odd p) (hqo : Odd q) (m i T : ℕ)
    (hlo : (q - 1) / 2 * geomQ q i + 1 ≤ T)
    (hTS : T < (p ^ m + 1) / 2) :
    q ^ i < p ^ m

name: Egrs75.P4.cond3_window
statement:
theorem cond3_window {p q : ℕ} (_hp : 3 ≤ p) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hpo : Odd p) (hqo : Odd q)
    (n m : ℕ) (hbad : 0 < badCountQ q n)
    (hTS : n % q ^ (leastGoodAbove hq hbad) < (p ^ m + 1) / 2) :

name: Egrs75.P4.exists_strictGood_above

name: Egrs75.P4.geomQ_golden
statement:
theorem geomQ_golden {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (i : ℕ) :

name: Egrs75.P4.geomQ_mul
statement:
theorem geomQ_mul {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (i : ℕ) :

name: Egrs75.P4.geomQ_succ
statement: theorem geomQ_succ (q i : ℕ) : geomQ q (i + 1) = geomQ q i + q ^ i

name: Egrs75.P4.middle_digit_eq

theorem middle_digit_eq {q n k : ℕ} (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hbad : 0 < badCountQ q n)

name: Egrs75.P4.mod_pow_succ
statement:

name: Egrs75.P4.one_le_geomQ
statement: theorem one_le_geomQ {q i : ℕ} (hi : 1 ≤ i) : 1 ≤ geomQ q i

name: Egrs75.P4.strictGoodAt_leastGoodAbove

name: Egrs75.P4.tailLB_le_mod

name: Egrs75.P4.tail_ge
statement:
theorem tail_ge {q n : ℕ} (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hbad : 0 < badCountQ q n) :

name: Egrs75.P4.topBad_lt_leastGoodAbove

name: Egrs75.MoveDigits.add_carry_decomp
statement:
theorem add_carry_decomp {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (n U i : ℕ)
    (hlo : q ^ i ≤ n % q ^ i + U) :

name: Egrs75.MoveDigits.add_digit_i

theorem add_digit_i {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (n U i : ℕ)

name: Egrs75.MoveDigits.add_div_pow_eq

name: Egrs75.MoveDigits.add_high_frozen

theorem add_high_frozen {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (n U i idx : ℕ)

name: Egrs75.MoveDigits.add_low_digit

name: Egrs75.MoveDigits.div_mul_pow_mono
statement:
theorem div_mul_pow_mono {q : ℕ} (_hq : 0 < q) (n : ℕ) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) :

name: Egrs75.MoveDigits.mem_badIndexSet_iff'

theorem mem_badIndexSet_iff' {q n i : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) :

name: Egrs75.MoveDigits.staircase

theorem staircase {q : ℕ} (hq3 : 3 ≤ q) (hqo : Odd q) :

name: Egrs75.MoveDigits.succ_div_pow_eq

name: Egrs75.SeedWindow.exists_small_step
statement:
theorem exists_small_step {p q : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) (hpq : p ≠ q)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ a b : ℕ, 1 ≤ a ∧
      (a : ℝ) * Real.log p - (b : ℝ) * Real.log q ≠ 0 ∧
      |(a : ℝ) * Real.log p - (b : ℝ) * Real.log q| < ε ∧

name: Egrs75.SeedWindow.seed_window
statement:
theorem seed_window {p q : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) (hq3 : 3 ≤ q)
    (hpq : p ≠ q) (F : ℕ) :
    ∃ α e : ℕ, 1 ≤ α ∧ F < q ^ (e + 3) ∧
      (q - 1) / 2 * q ^ (e + 3) < p ^ α ∧
      4 * p ^ α < 4 * ((q - 1) / 2 * q ^ (e + 3)) + q ^ (e + 1)

name: Egrs75.SeedWindow.walk_hits

         ∃ hbad' : 0 < badCountQ q n',

           (leastGoodAbove hq3 hbad' = leastGoodAbove hq3 hbad ∧

    (hβsq : β ^ 2 = 1 - 4 * r * p)
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hfailure : 1 + γ < 2 * β)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hhsq : h ^ 2 = 1 - r ^ 2)
    (hksq : k ^ 2 = 1 - (r + p) ^ 2)

    {r p β γ h δ : ℝ}

    (hβsq : β ^ 2 = 1 - 4 * r * p)
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hfailure : 1 + γ < 2 * β)
    (hβlo : (3 : ℝ) / 5 ≤ β) (hβh : β ≤ h)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    (1 + 2 * γ ^ 2 - 3 * β ^ 2) / (4 * δ) < h - β

name: LeanPool.Erdos132ConvexK3.metric_sign_dichotomy

    {r p β γ h k δ : ℝ}

    (hβsq : β ^ 2 = 1 - 4 * r * p) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hhsq : h ^ 2 = 1 - r ^ 2)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hksq : k ^ 2 = 1 - (r + p) ^ 2)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδdef : δ = h - k) :
    2 * β ≤ 1 + γ ∨
      (1 + 2 * γ ^ 2 - 3 * β ^ 2) / (4 * δ) < h - β

name: LeanPool.Erdos132ConvexK3.forced_penultimate_coordinates

theorem forced_penultimate_coordinates
    {c A B W R K_w K_r : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hBA : B < A)
    (hwA : W ^ 2 + K_w ^ 2 = A)
    (hwB : (W - 2 * c) ^ 2 + K_w ^ 2 = B)
    (hrB : R ^ 2 + K_r ^ 2 = B)
    (hrA : (R - 2 * c) ^ 2 + K_r ^ 2 = A)
    (hKw : 0 < K_w) (hKr : 0 < K_r) :
    ∃ d K : ℝ, 0 < d ∧ W = c + d ∧ R = c - d ∧
      K_w = K ∧ K_r = K ∧ A - B = 4 * c * d

    (hConvex : CyclicStrictConvex P)
    (hHigh : ∀ v, 7 ≤ vertexDegree P d₁ d₂ d₃ v)
    (x : Fin n)
    (hMax : ∀ v, firstNeighborGap P d₁ d₂ d₃ v ≤
      firstNeighborGap P d₁ d₂ d₃ x)
    (first : K3MajorantWitness P d₁ d₂ d₃
      (firstClockwiseNeighbor P d₁ d₂ d₃ x) x)
    (second : K3MajorantWitness P d₁ d₂ d₃
      (cyclicAdvance x 3)
      (firstCounterclockwiseNeighbor P d₁ d₂ d₃ (cyclicAdvance x 3)))
    (hInner : first.rightMoves + second.leftMoves < 3) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, M ≤ second.rightMoves ∧
      cyclicRetreat (firstClockwiseNeighbor P d₁ d₂ d₃ x) first.leftMoves =
        cyclicAdvance
          (firstCounterclockwiseNeighbor P d₁ d₂ d₃ (cyclicAdvance x 3)) M

name: LeanPool.Erdos132ConvexK3.coordinated_exceptional_22_forces_cross_top_three
statement:
theorem coordinated_exceptional_22_forces_cross_top_three
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : Fin n → Point ℝ) (d₁ d₂ d₃ : ℝ)
    (hConvex : CyclicStrictConvex P)
    (hClasses : HasTopThreeDistanceClasses P d₁ d₂ d₃)
    (hHigh : ∀ v, 7 ≤ vertexDegree P d₁ d₂ d₃ v)
    (x : Fin n)
    (hMax : ∀ v, firstNeighborGap P d₁ d₂ d₃ v ≤
      firstNeighborGap P d₁ d₂ d₃ x)
    (pair : CoordinatedK3MajorantPair P d₁ d₂ d₃
      (firstClockwiseNeighbor P d₁ d₂ d₃ x) x
      (cyclicAdvance x 3)
      (firstCounterclockwiseNeighbor P d₁ d₂ d₃
        (cyclicAdvance x 3)))
    (h22 : pair.first.rightMoves = 2 ∧ pair.second.leftMoves = 2) :
    TopThreeAdjacent P d₁ d₂ d₃
        (firstClockwiseNeighbor P d₁ d₂ d₃ x) (cyclicAdvance x 3) ∨
      TopThreeAdjacent P d₁ d₂ d₃ x

name: LeanPool.Erdos132ConvexK3.coordinated_exceptional_count_rigidity
statement:
theorem coordinated_exceptional_count_rigidity
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {P : Fin n → Point ℝ} {d₁ d₂ d₃ : ℝ}
    {z x t u : Fin n}
    (pair : CoordinatedK3MajorantPair P d₁ d₂ d₃ z x t u)
    (hExceptional : 3 ≤ pair.first.rightMoves + pair.second.leftMoves) :
    ((pair.first.rightMoves = 1 ∧ pair.second.leftMoves = 2) ∧
        (∀ first' : K3MajorantWitness P d₁ d₂ d₃ z x,
          1 ≤ first'.rightMoves) ∧
        (∀ second' : K3MajorantWitness P d₁ d₂ d₃ t u,
          second'.leftMoves = 2 ∧ second'.rightMoves = 0)) ∨
      ((pair.first.rightMoves = 2 ∧ pair.second.leftMoves = 1) ∧
        (∀ first' : K3MajorantWitness P d₁ d₂ d₃ z x,
          first'.rightMoves = 2 ∧ first'.leftMoves = 0) ∧
        (∀ second' : K3MajorantWitness P d₁ d₂ d₃ t u,
          1 ≤ second'.leftMoves)) ∨
      ((pair.first.rightMoves = 2 ∧ pair.second.leftMoves = 2) ∧
        (∀ first' : K3MajorantWitness P d₁ d₂ d₃ z x,
          first'.rightMoves = 2 ∧ first'.leftMoves = 0) ∧
        (∀ second' : K3MajorantWitness P d₁ d₂ d₃ t u,
          second'.leftMoves = 2 ∧ second'.rightMoves = 0))

name: LeanPool.Erdos132ConvexK3.coordinated_exceptional_forced_paths
statement:
theorem coordinated_exceptional_forced_paths
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {P : Fin n → Point ℝ} {d₁ d₂ d₃ : ℝ}
    {z x t u : Fin n}
    (pair : CoordinatedK3MajorantPair P d₁ d₂ d₃ z x t u)
    (hExceptional : 3 ≤ pair.first.rightMoves + pair.second.leftMoves) :
    ((pair.first.rightMoves = 1 ∧ pair.second.leftMoves = 2) ∧
        IsLeftCover P t u ∧
        IsLeftCover P (cyclicRetreat t 1) u) ∨
      ((pair.first.rightMoves = 2 ∧ pair.second.leftMoves = 1) ∧
        IsRightCover P z x ∧
        IsRightCover P z (cyclicAdvance x 1)) ∨
      ((pair.first.rightMoves = 2 ∧ pair.second.leftMoves = 2) ∧
        IsRightCover P z x ∧
        IsRightCover P z (cyclicAdvance x 1) ∧
        IsLeftCover P t u ∧
        IsLeftCover P (cyclicRetreat t 1) u)

name: LeanPool.Erdos132ConvexK3.coordinated_exceptional_inner_endpoints
statement:
theorem coordinated_exceptional_inner_endpoints
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    {P : Fin n → Point ℝ} {d₁ d₂ d₃ : ℝ} {z x u : Fin n}
    (pair : CoordinatedK3MajorantPair P d₁ d₂ d₃
      z x (cyclicAdvance x 3) u)
    (hExceptional : 3 ≤ pair.first.rightMoves + pair.second.leftMoves) :
    ((pair.first.rightMoves = 1 ∧ pair.second.leftMoves = 2) ∧
        cyclicAdvance x pair.first.rightMoves =
          cyclicRetreat (cyclicAdvance x 3) pair.second.leftMoves ∧
        cyclicAdvance x pair.first.rightMoves = cyclicAdvance x 1) ∨
      ((pair.first.rightMoves = 2 ∧ pair.second.leftMoves = 1) ∧
        cyclicAdvance x pair.first.rightMoves =
          cyclicRetreat (cyclicAdvance x 3) pair.second.leftMoves ∧
        cyclicAdvance x pair.first.rightMoves = cyclicAdvance x 2) ∨
      ((pair.first.rightMoves = 2 ∧ pair.second.leftMoves = 2) ∧
        cyclicAdvance x pair.first.rightMoves = cyclicAdvance x 2 ∧
        cyclicRetreat (cyclicAdvance x 3) pair.second.leftMoves =
          cyclicAdvance x 1)

name: LeanPool.Erdos132ConvexK3.coordinated_exceptional_rank_and_exchange_obstruction
statement:
theorem coordinated_exceptional_rank_and_exchange_obstruction
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {P : Fin n → Point ℝ} {d₁ d₂ d₃ : ℝ}
    (hClasses : HasTopThreeDistanceClasses P d₁ d₂ d₃)
    {z x t u : Fin n}
    (hFirstStart : TopThreeAdjacent P d₁ d₂ d₃ z x)
    (hSecondStart : TopThreeAdjacent P d₁ d₂ d₃ t u)
    (pair : CoordinatedK3MajorantPair P d₁ d₂ d₃ z x t u)
    (hExceptional : 3 ≤ pair.first.rightMoves + pair.second.leftMoves) :
    ((pair.first.rightMoves = 1 ∧ pair.second.leftMoves = 2) ∧
        sqDist (P t) (P u) = d₃ ∧
        sqDist (P (cyclicRetreat t 1)) (P u) = d₂ ∧
        sqDist (P (cyclicRetreat t 2)) (P u) = d₁ ∧
        ¬IsMajorant P (cyclicRetreat t 1) u) ∨
      ((pair.first.rightMoves = 2 ∧ pair.second.leftMoves = 1) ∧
        sqDist (P z) (P x) = d₃ ∧
        sqDist (P z) (P (cyclicAdvance x 1)) = d₂ ∧
        sqDist (P z) (P (cyclicAdvance x 2)) = d₁ ∧
        ¬IsMajorant P z (cyclicAdvance x 1)) ∨
      ((pair.first.rightMoves = 2 ∧ pair.second.leftMoves = 2) ∧
        sqDist (P z) (P x) = d₃ ∧
        sqDist (P z) (P (cyclicAdvance x 1)) = d₂ ∧
        sqDist (P z) (P (cyclicAdvance x 2)) = d₁ ∧
        sqDist (P t) (P u) = d₃ ∧
        sqDist (P (cyclicRetreat t 1)) (P u) = d₂ ∧
        sqDist (P (cyclicRetreat t 2)) (P u) = d₁ ∧
        ¬IsMajorant P z (cyclicAdvance x 1) ∧
        ¬IsMajorant P (cyclicRetreat t 1) u)

name: LeanPool.Erdos132ConvexK3.coordinated_inner_endpoint_budget_partition

name: LeanPool.Erdos132ConvexK3.erlv_case12_shared_tip_rank_data
statement:
theorem erlv_case12_shared_tip_rank_data
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {P : Fin n → Point ℝ} {d₁ d₂ d₃ : ℝ}
    (S : ErLVAtVertexUseSite P d₁ d₂ d₃) (h12 : S.Case12) :
    let z := firstClockwiseNeighbor P d₁ d₂ d₃ S.x
    let u := firstCounterclockwiseNeighbor P d₁ d₂ d₃
      (cyclicAdvance S.x 3)
    sqDist (P (cyclicAdvance S.x 1)) (P u) = d₁ ∧
      (sqDist (P (cyclicRetreat z S.pair.first.leftMoves))
          (P (cyclicAdvance S.x 1)) = d₁ ∨
        sqDist (P (cyclicRetreat z S.pair.first.leftMoves))
          (P (cyclicAdvance S.x 1)) = d₂) ∧
      sqDist (P (cyclicAdvance S.x 2)) (P u) = d₂

name: LeanPool.Erdos132ConvexK3.erlv_case21_shared_tip_rank_data
statement:
theorem erlv_case21_shared_tip_rank_data
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {P : Fin n → Point ℝ} {d₁ d₂ d₃ : ℝ}
    (S : ErLVAtVertexUseSite P d₁ d₂ d₃) (h21 : S.Case21) :
    let z := firstClockwiseNeighbor P d₁ d₂ d₃ S.x
    let u := firstCounterclockwiseNeighbor P d₁ d₂ d₃
      (cyclicAdvance S.x 3)
    sqDist (P z) (P (cyclicAdvance S.x 2)) = d₁ ∧
      (sqDist (P (cyclicAdvance S.x 2))
          (P (cyclicAdvance u S.pair.second.rightMoves)) = d₁ ∨
        sqDist (P (cyclicAdvance S.x 2))
          (P (cyclicAdvance u S.pair.second.rightMoves)) = d₂) ∧
      sqDist (P z) (P (cyclicAdvance S.x 1)) = d₂

    let z := firstClockwiseNeighbor P d₁ d₂ d₃ S.x

    let u := firstCounterclockwiseNeighbor P d₁ d₂ d₃ t

    (htip : ((ccwNeighborOffsets P d₁ d₂ d₃ (cyclicAdvance S.x 1)).filter

theorem sum_of_one_rare_and_double_chords
    (f : Fin 13 → ℝ) (weight : ℝ → ℝ) (rare : ℝ)
    (hcover : ∀ i, f i ∈ insert rare
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 6)).image regularTridecagonChord))
    (hrareNotChord : ∀ k, rare ≠ regularTridecagonChord k)
    (hrareCard : ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 13)).filter
      (fun i ↦ f i = rare)).card = 1)
    (hchordCard : ∀ k, ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 13)).filter
      (fun i ↦ f i = regularTridecagonChord k)).card = 2) :
    ∑ i, weight (f i) =
      weight rare + 2 * ∑ k : Fin 6, weight (regularTridecagonChord k)

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.classify_point
statement:
theorem classify_point {A B P : Point} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hAB : sqDist A B = c)
    (hAP : IsChainValue c (sqDist A P)) (hBP : IsChainValue c (sqDist B P)) :
    (∃ x : ℕ, sqDist A P = c * 3 ^ x ∧ sqDist B P = c * 3 ^ x)
      ∨ (sqDist A P = c ∧ sqDist B P = 3 * c)
      ∨ (sqDist A P = 3 * c ∧ sqDist B P = c)

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.gramDet_isoceles
statement:
theorem gramDet_isoceles (c r s t : ℝ) :
    gramDet c r s r s t
      = -2 * c * (r ^ 2 + s ^ 2 + t ^ 2 - 2 * r * s - 2 * r * t - 2 * s * t + c * t)

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.gramDet_mixed
statement:
theorem gramDet_mixed (c r t : ℝ) :
    gramDet c r c r (3 * c) t = -2 * c * ((r - t) ^ 2 - 3 * c * t + 3 * c ^ 2)

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.gramDet_mixed'
statement:
theorem gramDet_mixed' (c r t : ℝ) :
    gramDet c r (3 * c) r c t = -2 * c * ((r - t) ^ 2 - 3 * c * t + 3 * c ^ 2)

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.gramDet_opposite
statement:
theorem gramDet_opposite (c t : ℝ) :
    gramDet c c (3 * c) (3 * c) c t = -2 * c * (4 * c - t) * (7 * c - t)

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.gramDet_spanning
statement:
theorem gramDet_spanning (c t : ℝ) :
    gramDet c c c (3 * c) (3 * c) t = 2 * t * c * (3 * c - t)

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.gramDet_spanning'
statement:
theorem gramDet_spanning' (c t : ℝ) :
    gramDet c (3 * c) (3 * c) c c t = 2 * t * c * (3 * c - t)

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.pair_classification
statement:
theorem pair_classification {A B C D : Point} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hAB : sqDist A B = c)
    (hAC : IsChainValue c (sqDist A C)) (hBC : IsChainValue c (sqDist B C))
    (hAD : IsChainValue c (sqDist A D)) (hBD : IsChainValue c (sqDist B D))
    (hCD : IsChainValue c (sqDist C D)) :
    ChainQuadruple A B C D c

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.pair_isoceles
statement:
theorem pair_isoceles {A B C D : Point} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {x y l : ℕ}
    (hAB : sqDist A B = c)
    (hAC : sqDist A C = c * 3 ^ x) (hBC : sqDist B C = c * 3 ^ x)
    (hAD : sqDist A D = c * 3 ^ y) (hBD : sqDist B D = c * 3 ^ y)
    (hCD : sqDist C D = c * 3 ^ l) :
    x = 0 ∧ y = 0 ∧ l = 1

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.pair_isoceles_aux
statement:
theorem pair_isoceles_aux {A B C D : Point} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {x y l : ℕ} (hxy : x ≤ y)
    (hAB : sqDist A B = c)
    (hAC : sqDist A C = c * 3 ^ x) (hBC : sqDist B C = c * 3 ^ x)
    (hAD : sqDist A D = c * 3 ^ y) (hBD : sqDist B D = c * 3 ^ y)
    (hCD : sqDist C D = c * 3 ^ l) :
    x = 0 ∧ y = 0 ∧ l = 1

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.pair_mixed
statement:
theorem pair_mixed {A B C D : Point} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {x l : ℕ}
    (hAB : sqDist A B = c)
    (hAC : sqDist A C = c * 3 ^ x) (hBC : sqDist B C = c * 3 ^ x)
    (hD : (sqDist A D = c ∧ sqDist B D = 3 * c) ∨ (sqDist A D = 3 * c ∧ sqDist B D = c))
    (hCD : sqDist C D = c * 3 ^ l) :
    x = 0 ∧ l = 0

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.pair_opposite
statement:
theorem pair_opposite {A B C D : Point} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {l : ℕ}
    (hAB : sqDist A B = c) (hCD : sqDist C D = c * 3 ^ l)
    (hAC : sqDist A C = c) (hBC : sqDist B C = 3 * c)
    (hAD : sqDist A D = 3 * c) (hBD : sqDist B D = c) : False

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.pair_spanning
statement:
theorem pair_spanning {A B C D : Point} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {l : ℕ}
    (hAB : sqDist A B = c) (hCD : sqDist C D = c * 3 ^ l)
    (h : (sqDist A C = c ∧ sqDist B C = 3 * c ∧ sqDist A D = c ∧ sqDist B D = 3 * c)
      ∨ (sqDist A C = 3 * c ∧ sqDist B C = c ∧ sqDist A D = 3 * c ∧ sqDist B D = c)) :
    l = 1

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.dot_sq_of_chain
statement:
theorem dot_sq_of_chain {O P Q : Point} {c : ℝ} (hP : sqDist P O = c) (hQ : sqDist Q O = c)
    (h : sqDist P Q = c ∨ sqDist P Q = 3 * c) : dotp O P Q ^ 2 = c ^ 2 / 4

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.dot_triple_prod
statement:
theorem dot_triple_prod {O P Q R : Point} {c : ℝ}
    (hP : sqDist P O = c) (hQ : sqDist Q O = c) (hR : sqDist R O = c)
    (hpq : dotp O P Q ^ 2 = c ^ 2 / 4) (hpr : dotp O P R ^ 2 = c ^ 2 / 4)
    (hqr : dotp O Q R ^ 2 = c ^ 2 / 4) :
    dotp O P Q * dotp O P R * dotp O Q R = -(c ^ 3 / 8)

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.no_five_chain_points
statement:
theorem no_five_chain_points {A B C D E : Point} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hAB : sqDist A B = c)
    (hAC : IsChainValue c (sqDist A C)) (hAD : IsChainValue c (sqDist A D))
    (hAE : IsChainValue c (sqDist A E)) (hBC : IsChainValue c (sqDist B C))
    (hBD : IsChainValue c (sqDist B D)) (hBE : IsChainValue c (sqDist B E))
    (hCD : IsChainValue c (sqDist C D)) (hCE : IsChainValue c (sqDist C E))
    (hDE : IsChainValue c (sqDist D E)) : False

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.no_four_on_circle
statement:
theorem no_four_on_circle {O P Q R S : Point} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hP : sqDist P O = c) (hQ : sqDist Q O = c) (hR : sqDist R O = c) (hS : sqDist S O = c)
    (hPQ : sqDist P Q = c ∨ sqDist P Q = 3 * c)
    (hPR : sqDist P R = c ∨ sqDist P R = 3 * c)
    (hPS : sqDist P S = c ∨ sqDist P S = 3 * c)
    (hQR : sqDist Q R = c ∨ sqDist Q R = 3 * c)
    (hQS : sqDist Q S = c ∨ sqDist Q S = 3 * c)
    (hRS : sqDist R S = c ∨ sqDist R S = 3 * c) : False

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.IsSqDiameter.pos
statement: theorem IsSqDiameter.pos {X : Finset Point} {D : ℝ} (h : IsSqDiameter X D) : 0 < D

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.cross_dotp_identity
statement:
theorem cross_dotp_identity (v a b c w : Point) :
    cross v a c * dotp v b w = cross v b c * dotp v a w + cross v a b * dotp v c w

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.cross_ne_zero
statement:
theorem cross_ne_zero {v a b : Point} {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hva : sqDist v a = D) (hvb : sqDist v b = D) (hab : sqDist a b ≤ D) (hne : a ≠ b) :
    cross v a b ≠ 0

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.cross_sq_identity
statement:
theorem cross_sq_identity (v a b c : Point) :
    cross v a c ^ 2 * sqDist v b
      = cross v b c ^ 2 * sqDist v a + cross v a b ^ 2 * sqDist v c
        + 2 * (cross v b c * cross v a b) * dotp v a c

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.diameterAdj_irrefl
statement: theorem diameterAdj_irrefl (D : ℝ) (p : Point) : ¬ DiameterAdj D p p

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.diameterAdj_symm
statement: theorem diameterAdj_symm (D : ℝ) (p q : Point) : DiameterAdj D p q → DiameterAdj D q p

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.dotp_sq_add_cross_sq
statement:
theorem dotp_sq_add_cross_sq (v a b : Point) :
    dotp v a b ^ 2 + cross v a b ^ 2 = sqDist v a * sqDist v b

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.exists_middle
statement:
theorem exists_middle (v a b c : Point) (hab : cross v a b ≠ 0) (hbc : cross v b c ≠ 0)
    (hac : cross v a c ≠ 0) :
    (0 < cross v a b ∧ 0 < cross v b c) ∨ (0 < cross v c b ∧ 0 < cross v b a) ∨
      (0 < cross v b a ∧ 0 < cross v a c) ∨ (0 < cross v c a ∧ 0 < cross v a b) ∨
      (0 < cross v a c ∧ 0 < cross v c b) ∨ (0 < cross v b c ∧ 0 < cross v c a)

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.exists_pendant
statement:
theorem exists_pendant {X : Finset Point} {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hmax : ∀ p ∈ X, ∀ q ∈ X, sqDist p q ≤ D)
    {v a b c : Point} (haX : a ∈ X) (hbX : b ∈ X) (hcX : c ∈ X)
    (hva : sqDist v a = D) (hvb : sqDist v b = D) (hvc : sqDist v c = D)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c) :
    (∀ w ∈ X, sqDist a w = D → w = v) ∨ (∀ w ∈ X, sqDist b w = D → w = v)
      ∨ (∀ w ∈ X, sqDist c w = D → w = v)

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.hopfPannwitz
statement:
theorem hopfPannwitz {X : Finset Point} {D : ℝ} (hD : IsSqDiameter X D) :
    ∑ v ∈ X, degree (DiameterAdj D) X v ≤ 2 * X.card

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.middle_no_other_neighbour
statement:
theorem middle_no_other_neighbour {v a b c w : Point} {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hva : sqDist v a = D) (hvb : sqDist v b = D) (hvc : sqDist v c = D) (hac : a ≠ c)
    (hX : 0 < cross v a b) (hY : 0 < cross v b c)
    (hbw : sqDist b w = D) (haw : sqDist a w ≤ D) (hcw : sqDist c w ≤ D) : w = v

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.sqDist_expand
statement:
theorem sqDist_expand (v a w : Point) :
    sqDist a w = sqDist v a + sqDist v w - 2 * dotp v a w

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.sum_degree_erase
statement:
theorem sum_degree_erase {X : Finset Point} {D : ℝ} {b v : Point} (hbX : b ∈ X) (hvX : v ∈ X)
    (hbv : b ≠ v) (hstar : X.filter (DiameterAdj D b) = {v}) :
    ∑ u ∈ X, degree (DiameterAdj D) X u
      = (∑ u ∈ X.erase b, degree (DiameterAdj D) (X.erase b) u) + 2

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.sum_degree_le
statement:
theorem sum_degree_le {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D) (X : Finset Point)
    (hmax : ∀ p ∈ X, ∀ q ∈ X, sqDist p q ≤ D) :
    ∑ v ∈ X, degree (DiameterAdj D) X v ≤ 2 * X.card

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.sum_degree_le_of_pendant
statement:
theorem sum_degree_le_of_pendant {X : Finset Point} {D : ℝ} {b v : Point}
    (hbX : b ∈ X) (hvX : v ∈ X) (hbv : b ≠ v) (hvb : sqDist v b = D)
    (hstar : ∀ w ∈ X, sqDist b w = D → w = v)
    (ih : ∑ u ∈ X.erase b, degree (DiameterAdj D) (X.erase b) u ≤ 2 * (X.erase b).card) :
    ∑ u ∈ X, degree (DiameterAdj D) X u ≤ 2 * X.card

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.exists_min_edge
statement:
theorem exists_min_edge {S : Finset Point} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hcard : 2 ≤ S.card)
    (hch : ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ q ∈ S, p ≠ q → ∃ j : ℕ, sqDist p q = a * 3 ^ j) :
    ∃ A ∈ S, ∃ B ∈ S, A ≠ B ∧
      ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ q ∈ S, p ≠ q → IsChainValue (sqDist A B) (sqDist p q)

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.four_chain_adjacent
statement:
theorem four_chain_adjacent {S : Finset Point} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hcard : S.card = 4)
    (hch : ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ q ∈ S, p ≠ q → ∃ j : ℕ, sqDist p q = a * 3 ^ j) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ (∃ j : ℕ, r = a * 3 ^ j) ∧
      ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ q ∈ S, p ≠ q → sqDist p q = r ∨ sqDist p q = 3 * r

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.isChainValue_of_le
statement:
theorem isChainValue_of_le {a c x : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {j₀ j : ℕ} (hc : c = a * 3 ^ j₀)
    (hx : x = a * 3 ^ j) (hle : c ≤ x) : IsChainValue c x

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.no_five_chain_finset
statement:
theorem no_five_chain_finset {S : Finset Point} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hcard : S.card = 5)
    (hch : ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ q ∈ S, p ≠ q → ∃ j : ℕ, sqDist p q = a * 3 ^ j) : False

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.nonDiameterSqDists_ne_chain
Erdos132ThreeChain.threeChain_support_empty
statement:
theorem threeChain_support_empty {X : Finset Point} {D a : ℝ} {n h : ℕ}
    (hn : 13 ≤ n) (_hh : 2 ≤ h) (ha : 0 < a) (hcard : X.card = n)
    (hD : IsSqDiameter X D)
    (hsupport : nonDiameterSqDists X D = chain a h) : False

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.centroid_chain_config
statement:
theorem centroid_chain_config :
    ∃ A B C D : Point, A ≠ B ∧ A ≠ C ∧ A ≠ D ∧ B ≠ C ∧ B ≠ D ∧ C ≠ D ∧
      sqDist A B = 1 ∧ sqDist A C = 1 ∧ sqDist A D = 1 ∧ sqDist B C = 3 ∧ sqDist B D = 3 ∧
      sqDist C D = 3

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.chainTwo_config
statement:
theorem chainTwo_config :
    ∃ A B C E F : Point,
      A ≠ B ∧ A ≠ C ∧ A ≠ E ∧ A ≠ F ∧ B ≠ C ∧ B ≠ E ∧ B ≠ F ∧ C ≠ E ∧ C ≠ F ∧ E ≠ F ∧
      sqDist A B = 1 ∧ sqDist A C = 1 ∧ sqDist A E = 1 ∧ sqDist A F = 3 ∧ sqDist B C = 3 ∧
      sqDist B E = 1 ∧ sqDist B F = 4 ∧ sqDist C E = 1 ∧ sqDist C F = 1 ∧ sqDist E F = 1

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.chainTwo_nonDiameter_support
statement:
theorem chainTwo_nonDiameter_support :
    ∃ X : Finset Point, X.card = 5 ∧ IsSqDiameter X 4 ∧ nonDiameterSqDists X 4 = chain 1 2

name: Erdos132ThreeChain.rhombus_chain_config
statement:
theorem rhombus_chain_config :
    ∃ A B C D : Point, A ≠ B ∧ A ≠ C ∧ A ≠ D ∧ B ≠ C ∧ B ≠ D ∧ C ≠ D ∧
      sqDist A B = 1 ∧ sqDist A C = 1 ∧ sqDist A D = 1 ∧ sqDist B C = 1 ∧ sqDist B D = 1 ∧
      sqDist C D = 3

lemma rad_smooth_rough_split (k n : ℕ) :
    rad (F k n)
      = (∏ p ∈ (F k n).primeFactors.filter (· < k), p)
        * (∏ p ∈ (F k n).primeFactors.filter (fun p => ¬ p < k), p)

lemma smooth_rad_dvd_P {k n : ℕ} :

lemma smooth_rad_le_P {k n : ℕ} :

lemma factorization_Wg {g k n : ℕ} (_hn : 1 ≤ n) (p : ℕ) :
    (Wg g k n).factorization p =
      if p ∈ (Bg g k n).primeFactors then overlapg g k n p - 1 else 0

statement:
lemma factorization_rad_Bg (hg : 1 ≤ g) {k n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (p : ℕ) :
    (rad (Bg g k n)).factorization p = if p ∈ (Bg g k n).primeFactors then 1 else 0

name: Erdos137.firstHit_mem_Icc

statement:
lemma pred_finSingletonCompleteThreshold_next3_forces_shifted_prefix

    (hmono : StrictMono a)

    (hthreshold_le : finSingletonCompleteThreshold a hfinite hF M ≤ a (M + 3)) :
    ∃ t s : ℕ,
      t = finSingletonCompleteThreshold a hfinite hF M - 1 ∧
        a (M + 2) ≤ t ∧ t < a (M + 3) ∧
          t ∉ subsetSums a (F ∪ ({M + 1} : Set ℕ))ᶜ ∧

    (hthreshold_le : finSingletonCompleteThreshold a hfinite hF M ≤ a (R + 1)) :

          t ∉ subsetSums a (F ∪ ({M + 1} : Set ℕ))ᶜ ∧
            s = t - a (M + 1) ∧

name: Erdos346.recursiveBudgetSeq_gap
statement:
lemma recursiveBudgetSeq_gap
    {a : ℕ → ℕ} {threshold : ℕ → ℕ} {C start : ℕ} :
    ∀ k : ℕ,
      recursiveBudgetSeq a threshold C start k + 1 <
        recursiveBudgetSeq a threshold C start (k + 1)

name: Erdos346.recursiveBudgetSeq_succ
statement:
lemma recursiveBudgetSeq_succ
    {a : ℕ → ℕ} {threshold : ℕ → ℕ} {C start k : ℕ} :
    recursiveBudgetSeq a threshold C start (k + 1) =
      max (recursiveBudgetSeq a threshold C start k + 2)
        (threshold
          (C + indexedDeletedSum a (recursiveBudgetSeq a threshold C start) (k + 1)))

name: Erdos346.recursiveBudgetSeq_threshold_le_succ
statement:
lemma recursiveBudgetSeq_threshold_le_succ
    {a : ℕ → ℕ} {threshold : ℕ → ℕ} {C start k : ℕ} :
    threshold
        (C + indexedDeletedSum a (recursiveBudgetSeq a threshold C start) (k + 1)) ≤
      recursiveBudgetSeq a threshold C start (k + 1)

name: Erdos346.recursiveBudgetSeq_zero

lemma recursiveBudgetSeq_zero

name: Erdos346.recursiveBudgetState_sum
statement:
lemma recursiveBudgetState_sum
    {a : ℕ → ℕ} {threshold : ℕ → ℕ} {C start : ℕ} :
    ∀ k : ℕ,
      (recursiveBudgetState a threshold C start k).2 =
        indexedDeletedSum a (recursiveBudgetSeq a threshold C start) (k + 1)
  | 0 => by
      simp [recursiveBudgetSeq, recursiveBudgetState, indexedDeletedSum]
  | k + 1 => by
      have ih

statement:
lemma shifted_prefix_hole_gives_prefix_shift_gap
    {a : ℕ → ℕ} {F : Set ℕ} {M t : ℕ}
    (ha : a (M + 1) ≤ t)
    (hsource : t - a (M + 1) ∈ prefixSubsetSums a Fᶜ M)
    (hmiss : t ∉ subsetSums a (F ∪ ({M + 1} : Set ℕ))ᶜ)
    (hlt : t < a (M + 2)) :
    ∃ s : ℕ,
      s ∈ prefixSubsetSums a Fᶜ M ∧
        s < nextSeedMargin a M ∧
          a (M + 1) + s < a (M + 2) ∧
            a (M + 1) + s ∉ prefixSubsetSums a Fᶜ M

statement:
lemma fullWordCount_eq_sum {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (l₀ : List α) (N : α → α → Prop) (A : α → Finset α → Prop) :
    fullWordCount l₀ N A = ∑ b ∈ l₀.toFinset,
      (goodWordCuts (permutationWords (l₀.erase b)) (l₀.length - 1) (N b) (A b)).card

    FullWordQualifies N A (b::q) k ↔
      MarkedEnd (N b) (q.take k) ∧ A b (q.take k).toFinset

statement:
lemma full_word_gluing_count {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (l₀ : List α) (hl : l₀.Nodup) (hne : l₀ ≠ [])
    (N : α → α → Prop) (A B C : α → Finset α → Prop)
    (hCA : ∀ b X, C b X → A b X)
    (hglue : ∀ b R X, Disjoint R X → A b R → B b X → C b (R ∪ X)) :
    fullWordCount l₀ N A + fullWordCount l₀ N B ≤
      fullWordCount l₀ N (fun _ _ => True) + (permutationWords l₀).card + fullWordCount l₀ N C

name: Erdos548.full_word_transfer_count
statement:
lemma full_word_transfer_count {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (l₀ : List α) (N N' : α → α → Prop) (A B : α → Finset α → Prop)
    (hstep : ∀ l, l.Perm l₀ → ∀ k, k < l₀.length → FullWordQualifies N A l k →
      ∀ j, j < k → FullWordQualifies N A l j →
        FullWordQualifies N' B (reverseWordAt l (k + 1)) k) :
    fullWordCount l₀ N A ≤ fullWordCount l₀ N' B + (permutationWords l₀).card

name: Erdos548.marked_prefix_rotation_exists
statement:
lemma marked_prefix_rotation_exists {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (N : α → Prop) (A B C : Finset α → Prop)
    (hglue : ∀ R X, Disjoint R X → A R → B X → C (R ∪ X))
    (l : List α) (hl : l.Nodup) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ l.length)
    (hm : MarkedEnd N (l.take k)) (hA : A (l.take k).toFinset)
    (hC : ¬C (l.take k).toFinset) :
    ∃ r x y : List α,
      l = (r ++ x) ++ y ∧ k = r.length + x.length ∧
      FirstPrefix (fun q => MarkedEnd N q ∧ A q.toFinset ∧ ¬C q.toFinset) r ∧
      (x = [] ∨ MarkedEnd N x) ∧ ¬B x.toFinset

name: Erdos548.marked_word_gluing_count

lemma marked_word_gluing_count {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (W : Finset (List α)) (m : ℕ) (N : α → Prop) (A B C : Finset α → Prop)
    (hlen : ∀ l ∈ W, l.length = m) (hnodup : ∀ l ∈ W, l.Nodup)
    (hperm : ∀ l ∈ W, ∀ l', l'.Perm l → l' ∈ W)
    (hCA : ∀ X, C X → A X)
    (hglue : ∀ R X, Disjoint R X → A R → B X → C (R ∪ X)) :
    (goodWordCuts W m N A).card + (goodWordCuts W m N B).card ≤
      (allowedWordCuts W m N).card + (goodWordCuts W m N C).card

name: Erdos548.rooted_word_branch_gluing_count
statement:
lemma rooted_word_branch_gluing_count {U V : Type*} [DecidableEq V]
    (T : SimpleGraph U) (G : SimpleGraph V) (A : Set U) (r : U) (hr : r ∈ A)
    (hsep : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∉ A, T.Adj x y → x = r)
    (l₀ : List V) (hl : l₀.Nodup) (hne : l₀ ≠ []) :
    rootedWordCount (T.induce A) ⟨r, hr⟩ G l₀ +
      rootedWordCount (T.induce (Aᶜ ∪ {r})) ⟨r, Or.inr rfl⟩ G l₀ ≤
      fullWordCount l₀ G.Adj (fun _ _ => True) + (permutationWords l₀).card +
        rootedWordCount T r G l₀

name: Erdos548.rooted_word_count_base
statement:
lemma rooted_word_count_base {U V : Type*} [Fintype U] [DecidableEq V]
    (T : SimpleGraph U) (r : U) (ht : Fintype.card U = 2)
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (l₀ : List V) :
    fullWordCount l₀ G.Adj (fun _ _ => True) ≤ rootedWordCount T r G l₀

lemma rooted_word_leaf_move_count {U V : Type*} [DecidableEq V]

    rootedWordCount S r G l₀ ≤

name: Erdos548.rooted_word_tree_bound
statement:
lemma rooted_word_tree_bound {U V : Type} [Fintype U] [DecidableEq V]
    (T : SimpleGraph U) (r : U) (hT : T.IsTree) (ht2 : 2 ≤ Fintype.card U)
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (l₀ : List V) (hl : l₀.Nodup) (hne : l₀ ≠ []) :
    fullWordCount l₀ G.Adj (fun _ _ => True) ≤
      rootedWordCount T r G l₀ + (Fintype.card U - 2) * (permutationWords l₀).card

name: Erdos548.rooted_word_tree_bound_aux
statement:
lemma rooted_word_tree_bound_aux (t : ℕ) :
    ∀ (U V : Type) [Fintype U] [DecidableEq V]
      (T : SimpleGraph U) (r : U) (_hT : T.IsTree) (_ht : Fintype.card U = t) (_ht2 : 2 ≤ t)
      (G : SimpleGraph V) (l₀ : List V) (_hl : l₀.Nodup) (_hne : l₀ ≠ []),
      fullWordCount l₀ G.Adj (fun _ _ => True) ≤
        rootedWordCount T r G l₀ + (t - 2) * (permutationWords l₀).card

name: Erdos548.tree_edge_partition
statement:
lemma tree_edge_partition {U : Type} (T : SimpleGraph U) (hT : T.IsTree)
    (r s : U) (hrs : T.Adj r s) :
    ∃ A : Set U, r ∈ A ∧ s ∉ A ∧ (T.induce A).IsTree ∧ (T.induce Aᶜ).IsTree ∧
      ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∉ A, T.Adj x y → x = r ∧ y = s

name: Erdos548.tree_root_partition
statement:
lemma tree_root_partition {U : Type} [Finite U] (T : SimpleGraph U) (hT : T.IsTree)
    (r s z : U) (hrs : T.Adj r s) (hrz : T.Adj r z) (hsz : s ≠ z) :
    ∃ A : Set U, ∃ _hr : r ∈ A,
      (T.induce A).IsTree ∧ (T.induce (Aᶜ ∪ {r})).IsTree ∧
      2 ≤ Nat.card A ∧ 2 ≤ Nat.card (Aᶜ ∪ {r} : Set U) ∧
      Nat.card A < Nat.card U ∧ Nat.card (Aᶜ ∪ {r} : Set U) < Nat.card U ∧
      Nat.card A + Nat.card (Aᶜ ∪ {r} : Set U) = Nat.card U + 1 ∧
      ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∉ A, T.Adj x y → x = r

name: Erdos548.full_word_base_count
statement:
lemma full_word_base_count {V : Type*} [Finite V] [DecidableEq V]

name: LeanPool.Erdos81PaperIContrib.conic_caratheodory
statement:
lemma conic_caratheodory {R M : Type*} [Field R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Fintype κ]
    (v : κ → M) (c : κ → R) (hc : ∀ k, 0 ≤ c k) :
    ∃ (d : κ → R) (s : Finset κ), (∀ k, 0 ≤ d k) ∧ (∀ k ∉ s, d k = 0) ∧
      LinearIndepOn R v s ∧ (∑ k ∈ s, d k • v k) = ∑ k, c k • v k

name: LeanPool.Erdos81PaperIContrib.covering_packing_duality
statement:
theorem covering_packing_duality [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (A : ι → κ → ℝ) (r : ι → ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ e t, 0 ≤ A e t) (hr : ∀ e, 0 ≤ r e)
    (hcol : ∀ t, ∃ e, 0 < A e t) :
    ∃ w : κ → ℝ, (∀ t, 0 ≤ w t) ∧ (∀ e, (∑ t, A e t * w t) ≤ r e) ∧
      (∑ t, w t) = sInf {v : ℝ | ∃ x : ι → ℝ, (∀ e, 0 ≤ x e) ∧
        (∀ t, 1 ≤ ∑ e, A e t * x e) ∧ v = ∑ e, r e * x e}

name: LeanPool.Erdos81PaperIContrib.farkas_ge

name: SumZeroTriangles.canonical_triple_mem
statement:
lemma canonical_triple_mem (rho : ZMod n → V) (hrhoU : ∀ z, rho z ∈ U)
    (hrho : ∀ z, psi (rho z) = z) {a b : V} (ha : a ∈ U) (hb : b ∈ U) (hab : a ≠ b)

name: Erdos865.four_card_le
statement:
theorem four_card_le {X : Type*} [DecidableEq X] (s1 s2 s3 s4 : Finset X) :
    s1.card + s2.card + s3.card + s4.card ≤
      (s1 ∪ s2 ∪ s3 ∪ s4).card +
        ((s1 ∩ s2).card + (s1 ∩ s3).card + (s1 ∩ s4).card +

name: Erdos865.core_step
statement:

    (hmin2 : ∀ x ∈ S, x ≠ α → β ≤ x) (hsum : α + β < m)
    (IH : ∀ S', FoldedOK m S' → S'.card < S.card →
      4 * S'.card ≤ 4 * (collisions m S').card + m + 8) :

name: Erdos865.folding_lemma
statement:
theorem folding_lemma {A : Finset ℕ} {N h : ℕ} (hA : IsTripleFree A) (hh : h ∈ A) :
    4 * ((Xset A h).card + (Yset A N h).card)
      + 4 * (Eset A N h \ collisions h (Bset A N h)).card ≤ 5 * h + 4

name: Erdos865.card_A_bound
statement:

    A.card ≤ (Xset A h).card + (Yset A N h).card + 2 + (N - 2 * h)

name: Erdos865.case1_I_sub
statement:
theorem case1_I_sub {A : Finset ℕ} {H p q : ℕ} (_hqlo : H ≤ q)
    (hqmin : ∀ a ∈ A, H ≤ a → q ≤ a) (hpmax : ∀ a ∈ A, a ≤ H → a ≤ p) :
    Finset.Ico (max p (2 * H - q) + 1) q ⊆
      Eset A (2 * H) q \ collisions q (Bset A (2 * H) q)

name: Erdos865.case2_Bset_disjoint
Erdos865.case2_I_sub
statement:
theorem case2_I_sub {A : Finset ℕ} {H p q : ℕ} (hple : q - p ≤ p)
    (hqmin : ∀ a ∈ A, H ≤ a → q ≤ a) (hpmax : ∀ a ∈ A, a ≤ H → a ≤ p) :
    Finset.Ico 1 (q - p) \ A ⊆ Eset A (2 * H) p \ collisions p (Bset A (2 * H) p)

name: Erdos865.even_bound
statement:
theorem even_bound (H : ℕ) (A : Finset ℕ) (hsub : A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 (2 * H))
    (hA : IsTripleFree A) : 4 * A.card ≤ 5 * H + 24

name: Erdos865.even_bound_case1
statement:
theorem even_bound_case1 {H p q : ℕ} {A : Finset ℕ} (hsub : A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 (2 * H))
    (hA : IsTripleFree A) (hq : q ∈ A) (hqlo : H ≤ q) (hqhi : q ≤ 2 * H)
    (hqmin : ∀ a ∈ A, H ≤ a → q ≤ a) (_hp : p ∈ A) (_hplo : 1 ≤ p) (hphi : p ≤ H)
    (hpmax : ∀ a ∈ A, a ≤ H → a ≤ p) (hcase : q - H ≤ 4 * (H - p)) :
    4 * A.card ≤ 5 * H + 24

name: Erdos865.even_bound_case2
statement:
theorem even_bound_case2 {H p q : ℕ} {A : Finset ℕ} (hsub : A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 (2 * H))
    (hA : IsTripleFree A) (hqlo : H ≤ q) (hqhi : q ≤ 2 * H)
    (hqmin : ∀ a ∈ A, H ≤ a → q ≤ a) (hp : p ∈ A) (hplo : 1 ≤ p) (hphi : p ≤ H)
    (hpmax : ∀ a ∈ A, a ≤ H → a ≤ p) (hcase : 4 * (H - p) < q - H)
    (IH : ∀ H' (A' : Finset ℕ), H' < H → A' ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 (2 * H') → IsTripleFree A' →
      4 * A'.card ≤ 5 * H' + 24) :
    4 * A.card ≤ 5 * H + 24

name: Erdos97Octagon.gram3_expand
statement:
lemma gram3_expand (a b c : Plane) :
    (Matrix.of fun i j => (⟪(![a, b, c]) i, (![a, b, c]) j⟫_ℝ : ℝ)).det =
      ⟪a, a⟫_ℝ * ⟪b, b⟫_ℝ * ⟪c, c⟫_ℝ -
        ⟪a, a⟫_ℝ * ⟪b, c⟫_ℝ * ⟪c, b⟫_ℝ -
        ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ * ⟪b, a⟫_ℝ * ⟪c, c⟫_ℝ +
        ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ * ⟪b, c⟫_ℝ * ⟪c, a⟫_ℝ +
        ⟪a, c⟫_ℝ * ⟪b, a⟫_ℝ * ⟪c, b⟫_ℝ -
        ⟪a, c⟫_ℝ * ⟪b, b⟫_ℝ * ⟪c, a⟫_ℝ

name: Erdos97Octagon.gram_det_eq_zero

      (sqDist b c / s) (sqDist b d / s) (sqDist c d / s) = 0

name: Erdos97Octagon.cm4_sqDist_eq_zero

name: Erdos97Octagon.inner_sub_sub_eq
